MLB The Show 23 gets you closer than ever to living your Baseball dreams on the diamond. Shock The Game and Own The Show with your favorite players, your favorite rivalries, and all your favorite MLB moments.

title: Blue Reflection: Second Light - Ultimate Edition
Arcade Archives: Grobda
description:
A colosseum for laser battles!

"GROBDA" is a shooting game released by NAMCO (currently Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1984.
Fight through all of your rivals' machines in arenas as you work to become the top-ranked fighter in the "BATTLING" arena.
Blow up multiple enemies with a single explosion for bonus points!

title: Akatsuki Yureru Koi Akari
description: "Jindou" it's a near-future sport where you fight with real swords that's really hot in Japan in the 2040s. Two girls enrolled into Murakumo Academy where said Jindou is taught. One of them is Kazamine Setsugekka, a rough and emotionally-driven girl who bolsters her blade with the unparalleled strength within her. The other is Suzakuin Momiji, a cool headed and incredibly precise girl with a prodigious sense for swordplay and a frightening sharp mind. These two, whose circumstances and personalities are completely different, both aim for the the title conferred upon the strongest in the academy, the "Toujinegi".

title: Match Master
description: Learn how to make pairs with us. Game for your child in any age.

title: Super Neptunia RPG: Party Member - If
Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty - Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty is a historical fantasy action role-playing video game developed by Team Ninja and published by Koei Tecmo.

Set during a fictionalised version of the fall of the Han Dynasty, the plot follows an unnamed protagonist who battles historical characters and Chinese mythological creatures corrupted by demonic qi.

The Digital Deluxe Edition includes:
- Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty (full game)
- Digital Art Book
- Digital Mini Soundtrack
- Season Pass (which includes additional DLCs Battle of Zhongyuan, Conqueror of
Jiangdong, Upheaval in Jingxiang, and Season Pass Bonus Qinglong Armor)

title: Street Fighter 6: Lenticular Edition
description: The Lenticular Edition is a physical standard edition of the game that comes with a holographic key art sleeve designed to give a sense of depth and motion as the viewing angle changes.

title: Street Fighter 6: Mad Gear Box
description:
The Mad Gear Box is the physical collector's edition of Street Fighter 6, it includes the mad gear box itself, Pop Up Parade Figures of Luke and Kimberly, the artbook, a sticker set, the Figure Diorama Board, a standard physical edition of the game and a code for the Year 1 Ultimate Pass.

The Year 1 Ultimate Pass includes 4 new characters, 3 outfits with colors 1-10 for the new characters, 2 additional stages and 7,700 Drive tickets (in-game currency).

title: Dredge: Deluxe Edition
description: The ultimate pack for your impending voyage. The Dredge Deluxe Edition includes everything you’ll need to weather the seas and trawl the deep for sinister secrets.

title: The Legend of Dragoon
description:
Experience The Legend of Dragoon originally released on the PlayStation console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Unveil a fantasy of magnificence, deception, magical combat, and retribution as you join swordsman Dart and his companions to harness the spiritual forces of Dragons and triumph over evil.

Using a unique and innovative tactical combat system, transform into Dragoons and unleash extraordinary powers. Control a wide variety of characters that wield unique weapons and Dragoon attacks powered by the elements in this unforgettable role-playing game.

title: Wild Arms 2
description:
Experience Wild Arms 2 originally released on the PlayStation console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

It’s about one world hanging in the balance. Where one hero must sacrifice his heart for peace. Where courage and fear, love and malice, heroes and villains go hand in hand. It’s power that exceeds human knowledge. It’s neither dream nor reality. It’s what legends are made of.

title: Harvest Moon: Back to Nature
description:
A port of Harvest Moon: Back to Nature, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

It is the first Harvest Moon game for a non-Nintendo console. Starting with a few rudimentary implements and very little money, players begin the arduous task of reviving their grandfather's farm and thereby claiming their place as its rightful heir.

Players are given three years to achieve this goal. A year consists of four seasons, each of which lasts 30 days. Different crops can be planted each season, but before the seeds can be planted, the land must be cleared and then the soil tilled.

Seeds must also be watered until the fruit or vegetable matures. Once the crops are ready for harvest, they can be placed in a shipping bin where they'll be collected and paid for. In addition to farming, players will interact with local villagers and partake in seasonal events such as the Tomato Festival and Fireworks Display. As more money is earned, players can expand their farm and begin to raise livestock such as chickens and cows.

title: Pocket Academy Zero
description:
Congratulations on your enrollment!
Help your students succeed and make your school famous!

title: Xicatrice
description: Around 100 years since superpowers awakened in society, the Anti-Abnormal Unusual Talent Team (AUT) was created to prevent incidents caused by those wrongly using their powers. However, as these efforts became strained, the Reserve Anti-Unusual Talent Team (RAUT) was then formed to assist in tackling such conflict. This group is made up of the aforementioned students. Now, in 2023, the protagonist is a former member of the AUT who lost their powers after an unknown incident.

title: Loopy Ball
description: Fun little game where you must avoid the spikes to live longer.

title: Awesome Asteroids
description:
Awesome Asteroids pays homage to the arcade classics of the time and enhances the gameplay to a full 3d experience.

You'll blast through waves of asteroids using lasers, rockets, and gatling guns while trying to keep bases and other structures from taking damage. Grab shield power ups to charge your shields which will protect you from asteroids and mines. You’ll need to take out enemy ships before they can destroy your bases while avoiding their defenses.

title: Antigravity Racing
description: Enter your antigravity racecraft vehicular and engage in thrilling combat races and get the podium at any costs! Use the power ups to your advantage and use pads to activate your stun gun, missiles or boosters to get to the finish line first! Neckbreaking race circuits are waiting to be raced on in high speed antigravity racecrafts. Choose between 10 different racecrafts each with its advantages and disadvantages. Upgrade your vehicle to your personal fit and create the ultimate winning machine! Race on!

title: Arcade Archives: Don Doko Don
description: "DON DOKO DON" is a fixed-screen action game released by TAITO in 1989. Take control of the old lumberjacks Bob and Jim to progress through a variety of tricky stages. Pick up items to power up, beat the boss at the end of each ROUND, and rescue the captive king and princess!

Megaton Musashi is set on Earth in the year 2118. The main characters pilot giant machines called “Musashi” to combat the Dorakuta, invaders from outer space that destroyed the planet in a matter of days.

This game obtained a free2play version called "Megaton Musashi X (Cross)" with additional content

description: EvilUp is an adventure for roguelike and RPG fans! Fight with the bloodthirsty monsters, explore the dark corners of the labyrinths, and improve your skills and character development. Offering challenging quests, various equipment, numerous types of enemies and random generation of levels will make your every attempt unique.

description: Family Fun Night is the first game from That's My Family to offer both original board games and classic games that were part of your childhood! Play 14 different games, from Snakes and Ladders to Parcheesi, Chess and 4 in a Row, and many more!

description: First released in the West in 2014, AKIBA’s TRIP: Undead & Undressed brings the vampire-slaying action-RPG to the Nintendo Switch for the first time as the Director’s Cut. This new edition features all the awesome otaku content from the previous release, including the original game’s DLC, plus an all-new story route focusing on the lovable Finnish maid Kati Räikkönen, complete with all-new voice over in Japanese and English featuring the original cast.

description:
A cancelled follow-up to Taito's 1994 shooting game Rayforce that was shelved in favour of development of Raystorm - a single stage prototype for the game was made but was formerly unreleased bar for some screenshots and videoclips.

As part of the Ray'z Arcade Chronology the prototype build consisting of a single stage was released as a bonus standalone game, featuring new music from series composer Tamayo Kawamoto.

description:
Experience Ape Academy 2 originally released on the PSP system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

The apes have finally graduated from the Ape Academy, so this term things are going to be a little different! Evil genius Specter has invented a new card game and it’s sweeping the globe, helping him on his way towards world domination.

Get ready to mix it up with the monkeys using Specter’s ‘scissors, paper, rock’ cards – there are 300 to collect – before taking them on in over 100 fiendishly difficult mini-games. Just don’t underestimate the apes, no matter how silly they act; Specter has put an ultra-rare platinum monkey card up for grabs (not to mention a year’s supply of bananas) and they’ll do anything to claim the prize!

title: R4: Ridge Racer Type 4

description:
Tintin Reporter: Cigars of the Pharaoh - Limited Edition is an adventure game that combines exploration, puzzle-solving, and stealth elements as players investigate interconnected locations inspired by the classic comic. Gameplay focuses on navigating varied environments, interacting with characters, and uncovering clues through a mix of action and logic-based challenges.

This edition includes:

title: Fight'n Rage: 5th Anniversary Limited Edition
description: This special edition celebrates five years of the game's success by offering its deep, combo-based combat and branching storylines, heavily inspired by the golden age of 90s arcades, packaged with exclusive collectibles.

title: DeepOne
description: Naoya and his twin sister Konoka had lost their parents at a young age and had a tough childhood. Nevertheless they still managed to find happiness in the little things in life and wished that these warm peaceful days would last forever. However, this faint hope was mercilessly crushed when a Grimoire suddenly appeared before them. It is a forbidden magic book that has existed since the beginning of time, but which should not be in the human realm. They thought that they were an ordinary family, but they were actually the heirs to the “Old One”, which has the power to destabilize the world.

title: Sonic Origins Plus: Day One Edition
description:
Experience the collected adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog in the newly remastered Sonic Origins Plus! With 16 legendary Sonic titles including 12 Game Gear games, new playable characters, modes, challenges, behind the scenes content, and more, this is the definitive way to play these classic games!

Those who purchase the Physical Edition will also receive a retro-inspired reversible coversheet, and a 20-page artbook.

title: NBA 2K23: Championship Edition
description: Step back in time with era-specific visuals that captured Michael Jordan’s ascent from collegiate sensation to global icon with immersive Jordan Challenges chronicling his career-defining dominance.

title: Monopoly Plus: My Little Pony
description: The Rainbow power invades Monopoly! Add some fun, friendship and joy on your board with My Little Pony. This DLC contains a whole customized board with an animated token. It's time to saddle up for the rainbow power and Monopoly!

title: Pyramid Raiders
description: Pyramid Raiders is a hilarious split-screen game where four bumbling soldiers sneak out of their base to steal tons of gold from mysterious tombs. With physics-based gameplay and silly puzzles, players must navigate through obstacles and traps to successfully make their escape with all their loot.

title: Bounce Journey
description: Experience the joy of bouncing through a whimsical world filled with excitement and wonder!

title: Arcade Archives: Navarone
description:
Take control of a fighter plane on a mission to destroy enemy targets of various sizes scattered across a peninsula.
When you take down a major target, all of the minor targets around it will be destroyed with it. You get a bigger bonus from taking out the targets with fewer shots, so aim carefully!

title: Zombie Garden vs. Plants Defence
description: In Zombie Garden & Plants Defense game, you take on the role of the principale character whose mission is to protect her garden from the onslaught of zombies. As you progress through the game, you will need to plant trees strategically and purchase workers who will collect resources like water and wood to help you fend off the zombies.

title: Stroke the Koala
description: The koala, a symbol of Australia (ignore the Kangaroo), cute when dry, horrifying when wet. Luckily, this Koala is dry.

title: Hermit's Tic-Tac-Toe
description: Mark the bottom left space, mark the bottom center space, mark the bottom right space, mark the middle left space, mark the middle center space, mark the middle right space, mark the top left space, mark the top center space, mark the top right space, win with X, win with O.

title: Rayflector
description: Rayflector is a bite-sized game about using the mirrors and other to direct a stream of particles to the receptacles.

title: The Quintessential Quintuplets: Five Promises Made With Her
description: The Quintessential Quintuplets: Five Promises Made with Her is the third The Quintessential Quintuplets romance visual novel developed by MAGES. The theme this time is “heart-pounding summer vacation dates.” As for what kind of story will unfold this time, more information will be shared in future announcements.

title: Ultra Pixel Survive
description: In Ultra Pixel Survive you'll find yourself in a pixel world where a young guy named Thomas lives. Today he is going on a journey across the country, and you will be his company. On the screen you will see your character in a certain place. Using the control keys you will guide your hero forward. On his way there will be various traps and dangers that he will have to overcome with your guidance. Sometimes the character may encounter monsters and wild animals, which you can destroy using different weapons from your character's inventory.

title: Hammerwatch II: The Chronicles Edition
description:
Chronicles Edition Includes:
• Hammerwatch II Base Game
• Hammerwatch: Anniversary Edition Base Game
• Anniversary Pack: 20 Additional Colors to Choose from, 2 Additional Voice Packs, 5 Additional Hero Facial Items

title: Lost Artifacts: Mysterious Book
description:
The team of experienced treasure hunters rushes again to meet adventures!
During a regular inventory at the museum, archaeologist Claire comes across an unfamiliar book with a mysterious lock-puzzle adorned with precious stones.
After unsuccessful attempts to open the book, the girl, in anger, presses a strange mechanism, and all the stones from it fall out immediately!
The museum room quickly changes into a forest with giant trees - the book has taken Claire and the team to its world.
Will the brave treasure hunter be able to find the lost stones and return home?
Embark on a heroic mission with Claire - quench your thirst for adventure and help her find all the stones!
Convenient controls and clear training will help you easily get into the basics of the game.
Embark on an exciting journey through the world of the Enigmatic Book!

title: Arcade Archives: Rezon
description:
Set on Earth during an extraterrestrial invasion, players take control of an SR-91 fighter ship equipped with a VAWS (Variable Armor & Weapon System) and take on the invaders.
Pick up items and equip Arms, a key feature that gives you the ability to attack behind you or block enemy shots when used well.

title: Nightshade Ninja Warrior
description: Nightshade Ninja Warrior is an action-packed game that combines elements of adventure, combat, and stealth. Players take on the role of a skilled ninja, who must traverse a dangerous landscape filled with enemies, obstacles, and treacherous terrain. As players progress through the game, they will encounter various enemies, each with their unique strengths and weaknesses. Combat sequences are fast-paced and intense, with players using a variety of abilities to defeat their foes. The game also features challenging boss fights, where players must utilize their skills and strategy to emerge victorious.

title: Mystic Warriors Battleground
description: Mystic Warriors Battleground is an exciting fighting game where players take on the role of a skilled warrior who must battle through challenging levels to defeat their enemies. Along the way, players will develop their abilities and skills, allowing them to customize their fighter to suit their playstyle.

title: Akka Arrh: Special Edition
description:
Special Edition Includes:

Butcher Bill’s Sticker Sheet
2x Arcade Cabinet Papercrafts

title: Chronicles of 2 Heroes: Amaterasu's Wrath - Collector's Edition
description:
Chronicles of 2 Heroes: Amaterasu's Wrath - Collector's Edition includes:
- Physical copy of the game
- Artbook
- Soundtrack
- Double-sided Poster
- Samurai Pin
- Magatama Necklace
- Stickers Sheet
- Collector's Box

title: Arcade Archives: Dig Dug II
description: "DIG DUG II" is an action game released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1985. In this game, you must rid an island of the familiar POOKA and FYGAR. In addition to defeating monsters by inflating them, you can now jackhammer fault lines around the island that can weaken the ground enough for it to collapse, taking enemies down into the water below. Defeat all monsters to advance to the next stage.

title: Rubberduck Wave Racer
description: Be a duckling - a squeaky duckling!

title: Crash Team Rumble: Deluxe Edition
description:
This Edition includes:
- Crash Team Rumble for PS4 / PS5
- Digital Proto Pack. Includes:
- 8 'Blocky' hero skins
- 'Pixelated' Shadow
- 'Get On My Level' In-Game Victory Music
- 'Blocky' Hat
- 'Blocky' Backpack
- 'Blocky' Score FX
- Unique Banner

title: Space Defend
description: Defend the earth from incoming asteroids. Hit asteroids to destroy them. Survive the Waves.

title: Zero Fire: Toaplan Arcade Garage
description:
Zero Fire includes Zero Wing and Hellfire, the collection will also include the Toaplan-developed side-scrolling run-and-gun bonus game Demon’s World.

Experience full ports of the Toaplan-developed side-scrolling shoot ’em ups Zero Wing and Hellfire, which first launched in arcades in the 1980s, complete with extras. Each game has a “Player 1 and Player 2 Alternating Version” and “Player 1 and Player 2 Simultaneous Play Version” with its own game balance adjustments. The overseas versions of each game are also playable.

Includes also new “Super Easy” and “Arcade Challenge” modes.

title: Arcade Archives: Cosmo Gang the Video
description:
Clear the stage by defeating all the Cozmo Gangs in the Gang.
If you hit the enemy's attack, you will lose one "Hyper Beat", and if you lose everything, the game will be over.

title: B Cannon
description:
B Cannon is a fast-paced one-button game.

You are moving around the screen and can reverse your direction by pressing a button. Your goal is to shoot the circles that are bouncing around. You aim automatically and shoot at the current aim position. Hold a button to shoot. The circles break up into smaller ones and you have to shoot them until they can no longer be broken down.

The game is over when you touch any circle.

title: LocoRoco Midnight Carnival
description:
Roll, jump, bounce and ‘boing’ your way through a mysterious moonlit fairground built by the mischievous BuiBui. Just watch out for the fiendish traps and devious hazards they’ve left behind!

16 classic LocoRoco levels in this playful platformer originally released on the PSP, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: TramSim: Console Edition - Deluxe
description: Urban Transport comes to life in TramSim: Console Edition - Deluxe! Experience more with Munich and Vienna, including additional content for the city of Vienna, the ULF Type Tram and the detailed Vienna Depot. Run to the timetable and face unique challenges, there is gameplay for every taste!

title: TramSim: Console Edition
description: Urban Transport comes to life in TramSim: Console Edition! Experience photorealism in two European cities, Vienna & Munich, no matter where you are in the world, and drive realistic trams on a variety of lines. Run to the timetable and face unique challenges, there is gameplay for every taste!

title: Monochrome Mobius: Rights and Wrongs Forgotten - Deluxe Edition
Arcade Archives: Galaga '88
description:
Win the decisive battle in a massive galactic war!

"GALAGA'88" is a shooter released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1987.
The GALAGA forces have returned, and you have to cross dimensions and fight your way to Planet Galaga to end the war.
This title lets you power up with 3 linked FIGHTERS for a TRIPLE FIGHTER. Use its massive firepower to mow down enemies!

title: Chef
description:
Chef is a fun, easy to play tycoon cooking game with 48 levels to complete.

The aim of the game is to prepare and serve the customers their orders. You will need to be quick , efficient and most importantly accurate, wrongly created orders go into the bin, losing you money and serving a customer too slow will lose you much needed income.

In low levels, this may not be a deal breaker, but pretty soon it will get very challenging as you advance your career and move to higher levels.

title: Stroke The Beaver
description:
Beavers are interesting creatures, they are both wet and furry, due to being in the water so much. Many of us have never stroked one before, but now if your chance to touch one for the first time.

Well, you can't really touch one, but you can at least make it look like you have a beaver in your very own home.

title: Arcade Archives: Tecmo Knight
description: Kick the beastman away!

title: Little Disaster
description: This cute little disaster is bursting with big fun and challenge

title: Rocket Swing
description: Swing the rocket to the right direction to not hit the barriers or the stars. Fly the highest as you can.

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero - Deluxe Edition
description: The Deluxe Edition includes Base Game, Digital Soundtrack and Mini Art Book.

title: Bubble Monsters
description: Bubble Monsters is a classic bubble shoot game.

title: Panic House
description: Panic House is a horror game that is sure to give players a thrilling and heart-pumping experience. As the player enters the game, they are immediately transported to an eerie and foreboding atmosphere. The visuals are dark and gloomy, with shadows lurking in every corner, and the sound effects are designed to keep the player on edge.

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails to Azure - Deluxe Edition
description: The Deluxe Edition includes Base Game, Digital Soundtrack and Mini Art Book.

title: Cyber Citizen Shockman
description: Slash and shoot your way through robots rampaging in Shockman's town!

title: Zapling Bygone: Deluxe Edition
description:
The Zapling Bygone Deluxe Edition will include:
- Physical Game
- Original Soundtrack
- Zapling Pin
- Mini Cómics
- Collector's Box

title: Robolt
description: Run fast and shoot faster as a little robot with a ton of firepower!

title: Quiz Thiz Croatia: Bronze Edition
description: Are you the new quiz master and can you beat your friends on this quiz? Answer questions about this country and collect valuable points! Also, learn new facts about this country while playing!

title: Cubic Figures 2
description: Make up figures from shaped blocks!

title: Arcade Archives: Mazinger Z
description:
"Mazinger Z" is a shooter released by Banpresto (Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1994.
Take control of Mazinger Z, Great Mazinger, and Grendizer, and use shooting, punches, and super weapons to take on Dr. Hell's Underground Empire! Supports up to two players at once.

title: Super Kids Racing: Snow Edition
description:
Super Kids Racing: Snow Edition offers wide variety of challenges with many different types of vehicles to choose from. Players will love to complete these challenges with their friends in split-screen multiplayer mode.

Get ready for ultimate racing adventure with your friends and family.

title: Ever Maiden: Daraku no Sono no Otome-tachi
description: This story is about “Puellarium", a school isolated from the outside world by fog and thorns. Here strict discipline is always in effect, where the air always tense and time never disturbed. However, one morning a girl was found unconscious in front of the school gate. This gate is always closed and should only open on special occasions. The guards, on alert, asked her to name herself to which she replied "Alouette." At that moment, the bell of the clock tower, which was rusty and always silent, rang out. "When the bell of the clock tower rings, the end of this school will come soon."

title: Jinki: Infinity
description: JINKI Infinity is an action-packed video game set in a futuristic world where players take on the role of a skilled pilot controlling a powerful mecha. With fast-paced gameplay and an immersive storyline, players will battle against a wide range of enemy mechas, each with their unique strengths and weaknesses.

title: BlackJack Waifu Tour
description: Feel like in Las Vegas, gamble without spending money at our real blackjack!

title: Thunder
description:
Thunder is a fast-paced one-button game.

You are running in the middle of a thunderstorm. Collect the stars that form when lightning strikes the ground to score points. But avoid getting hit by lightning. Reverse your direction by pressing a button or by hitting the sides of the screen.

The game is over when you get struck.

title: Sakeworld
description:
Welcome to Sakeworld.
Treat the ladies nice and you will be rewarded.
Run and gun to get those weapons and ammo or you're done!
Punch your way out of a crowd and then empty your clip.
Throw a grenade or use a special attack to help keep a cool and level head.
Use the foreground and background to your advantage or you will get smoked.
Beat em up, but be smart, the Mysterious Dr Sake awaits.
Sakeworld is an alternate dimension, so you know things are about to get weird.
Only you can set things right and clean up these streets!

title: R-Type Tactics I & II Cosmos: Deluxe Edition
description: Includes R-Type Tactics I・II Cosmos: Standard Edition, Digital Soundtrack and a Poster

title: Alex Kidd in Miracle World DX: Signature Edition
description:
This version includes:

- Physical Game.
- Certificate of Authenticity.
- Enamel Pins.
- Art Book.
- Original Soundtrack.
- Medallion & Coin Pouch.
- Jankenpon Cards.
- Collector's Keychain.

title: Drift Horizon: Car Driving & Tuning
description: Become a legendary drifter! Tune and upgrade your car, install parts and boost performance! With a dozen of cars to choose from, get them on the track and test them out!

title: Dice Legacy: Definitive Edition
description:
Roll and use your dice to gather resources, construct buildings, expand your settlement and face the menacing threats of a mysterious ringworld.

Dice Legacy Definitive Edition includes all the content from the original Dice Legacy release plus the three major updates.

title: Syphon Filter: Logan's Shadow
description: A port of Syphon Filter: Logan’s Shadow, originally released on the PlayStation Portable system, featuring optimised rendering, rewind, quick saving, and custom video filters.

title: Pursuit Force
description:
Experience Pursuit Force originally released on the PlayStation Portable system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Five vicious gangs are fighting for control of Capital City. The terrified public has given up hope – and the Chief of Police wants results, fast!

Jump into action as a member of the elite Pursuit Force and rid the state of corruption. Dive behind the wheel of a truck, a speedboat or even a helicopter as you hunt down criminals and recover stolen goods.

This title has been converted from the PSP version to the PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5 consoles and provides newly added features.

title: Vigor Chronicles: Salvation
description: Unfold the Chronicles and repent for salvation! What would you do if the apocalypse forced you to leave your precious city? How would you adapt to a different environment? In this update, you can enjoy Myren as an Encounter map and discover the secrets left behind from the society that abandoned it. Gain your vantage point and eliminate your enemies with the new L96 sniper rifle.

title: Velocity 2X: Daily Sprint
description:
Originally part of the Xbox and PC release of the game, it was planned as a DLC for PlayStation but was added as a free update after the AGDQ Speed Run of Velocity 2X.

The mode features platforming sections of the game in a randomly generated order with a practice option to see the new layout each day but only one chance to finish the level with a high score for the leaderboards.

title: Hotel Renovator: Five Star Edition
description: The Hotel Renovator Five Star Edition includes the base game and a pack of 7 DLC to be released in the upcoming months. Expand your inner designer experience with 7 packs featuring amazing decoration items that will make your hotel stand out from the rest.

title: Degroid
description:
The game tells the story of a little man named Degroid, who was caught by Mad Doctor. He had gone crazy during his experiments with teleportation.

A player will have to pass the obstacle course to get to the perpetrator of his imprisonment and get out of this endless madness. On the way there will be loads of circular saws, thorns, aggressive slugs, lasers and other lethal obstacles.

Because of teleports, carrying the Degroid`s body between levels, a player acquires immortality, resurrecting after every defeat.

Will he become mad too after countless deaths?

title: Tilting Tiles: Micro Challenge
description: Tilting Tiles: Micro Challenge is the third installment in the Tilting Tiles series. Micro Challenge brings an entire new take on the unique puzzle series by adding new player movement options and new terrain tiles. Whether you are a fan of the series or a first time player, this is the perfect place to start.

title: Wobbledogs: Console Edition
description: Raise your own hive of mutating dogs, physically simulated down to their guts!

title: Foamstars
description:
A 4v4 online party shooter from Square Enix that has you battling to foam as much of the city as you can while avoiding your opponents traps and weapons.

Use foam to build terrain, creating slippery surfaces to surf around the arena at high speed, help defend from enemy attacks, or create vantage points to take out opponents.

And most importantly, to foam up the opposition!

title: Cult of the Lamb: Heretic Edition
description:
The Heretic Edition of Cult of the Lamb includes:
- The base game
- The Heretic pack
- The Cultist pack

title: Arcade Archives: Rolling Thunder 2
description:
"ROLLING THUNDER 2" is an action game released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1990.
Operate the hero of the Special Operations Forces and destroy the secret organization "NEOGELDRA" that plans to conquer the world.
In this work, you can control not only the main character "ALBATROSS", but also "LEILA BLITZ", who was captured in the previous game, on the 2P side.

title: Echoshift
description:
Experience echoshift originally released on the PSP system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

The Walker’s life is stuck on repeat. Our hero is lost in a series of dangerous, mind-bending mazes, where time keeps replaying, over and over… Do you have the skill to help the Walker escape?

Test your mental agility in 56 levels of puzzle-packed action, where the clock is always ticking as you work to flick switches, unlock doors and overcome obstacles.

Co-operate with ‘echoes’ of your past self to solve problems as you navigate through this ingenious and endlessly addictive puzzle game from 2009.

title: The Last of Us Part II: Grounded Update
description:
This title update adds Grounded and Permadeath as modes.

It adds the following new graphics, audio, and gameplay modifiers:
- Mirror World
- Mirror on Death
- Slow Motion
- Bullet Speed mode
- Infinite Ammo
- Infinite Crafting
- Infinite Melee Durability
- Infinite Listen mode Range
- One Shot
- Touch of Death
- 8-bit Audio
- 4-bit Audio
- Helium Audio
- Xenon Audio

It also adds the following new options and improvements:
- Saves now display playtime up to the second
- Film Grain Adjustment option
- Disable Listen Mode option
- Motion Sensor Function Aiming option
- Arc Throw HUD Display option
- Aiming Acceleration Scale option
- Aiming Ramp Power Scale option
- Accessibility improvements to Ground Zero encounter, collectible tracking, Enhanced Listen Mode for collectibles, and rope gameplay

title: Eperon Defend
description: This time you have to protect the Eperon planet from the meteors, which are incoming.

title: Neko Secret Homecoming Light
description: Explore Neko Town looking for hidden objects. Walk down the streets, find new places to get in. Try a variety of mini games like playing darts, picking locks, breaking safes! Try changing your style using character customization. Finally, find the way to get to the anime factory and hack all its computer's data!

title: Arcade Archives: Tetris - The Absolute: The Grand Master 2 Plus
description: Tetris - The Absolute: The Grand Master 2 Plus is a puzzle game released by ARIKA in 2000. This work has been further enhanced with new modes added from the previous work. Challenge your own limits with "TGM+" where Tetriminos rise up from the bottom and "T.A.DEATH" where Tetriminos fall at a high speed from the beginning.

title: Marvel's Spider-Man: New Game Plus Update
description: Patch updates 1.07 and 1.08 added a New Game+ mode, Ultimate difficulty, and a series of new features, fixes, and updates.

title: We Love Katamari Reroll + Royal Reverie: Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition contains the We Love Katamari REROLL+ Royal Reverie game along with the Katamari Damacy Series Music Pack.

[Set Contents]
Main Game
Katamari Damacy Series Music Pack

■Katamari Damacy Series Music Pack

title: Stroke The Dik-Dik
description:
The Dik-Dik is a small antelope, by nature they are pretty shy and will often run away if you try to approach it. This one tough, it's friendly and will stand to attention allowing you to stroke it.

Stroke your own Dik-Dik in your own living room, bedroom, bathroom, wherever you have your TV.

title: Cat Ping Pong
description: Cat Ping Pong is an arcade style ping pong game. The user controls a cat paddle to bat a yarn ball back and forth against its opponent. Use the meddling rat in the middle of the field to gain speed, and change trajectory of the ball to score on the opposing cat!

title: Dessert DIY: Complete Edition
description:
Preparing delicious desserts is a piece of cake. Try it yourself!
Make sweet ice cream, popsicles and waffles using your creativeness in one of the best dessert decorating games right now.

title: We Love Katamari REROLL+ Royal Reverie: Special Edition
description:
The second title in the Katamari Damacy series has returned in a remastered, powered-up version!

We Love Katamari REROLL+ Royal Reverie is a fully remastered version of We Love Katamari Damacy, originally released in 2005, with new and improved graphics and gameplay enhancements to make it easier to jump in and have fun.

The Special Edition contains We Love Katamari REROLL+ Royal Reverie, the Little Prince Costume, and the Katamari Damacy Series Music Bundle.

title: Sky Runners Infinite: Parkour
description: "Sky Runners Infinite: Parkour" is the ultimate cyberpunk endless runner game that will leave you breathless!. Parkour, slide, jump, and dodge obstacles while collecting coins to buy new clothes, weapons, and upgrades.

title: Hot Wheels Unleashed 2: Turbocharged - Pure Fire Edition
description:
Wal-mart Exclusive! Boost your fun with HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED 2 - Turbocharged - Pure Fire Edition, which contains:
• Full game
• Twin MillTM diecast car with an amazing exclusive livery;
• HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED 2 - Rust and Fast Pack, which includes two vehicles (Mod Rod and FusionBusta)
• HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED 2 - Speed Kings Pack, which includes two vehicles (Impavido 1 and Electro Silhouette)
• HOT WHEELS UNLEASHED 2 - Just a Scratch Pack, which includes two vehicles (Speed Bump and Sudden Stop)

title: Hot Wheels Unleashed 2: Turbocharged - Day One Edition
description:
The ultimate racing game is back — and more charged up than ever!

Over 130 vehicles, including new types like motorbikes and ATVs, five new environments with racing surfaces impacting vehicle performance and creating more dynamic gameplay, new driving unique strategies as like lateral dashes and jumps to ensure more wild races, a story-driven campaign, and a variety of exciting new game modes.

The multiplayer experience is enriched thanks to the Cross-play feature, online ranking and PC anti-cheat system. And a lot of ways to show off your creativity are available with the renewed track editor and brand-new stickers for unique vehicle liveries.

title: Irem Collection: Volume 1
description: Irem Collection Volume 1 is a collection of classic legendary arcade shoot 'em up games including Image Fight, Image Fight 2, and X-Multiply brought to modern platforms.

title: Do Not Crash
description: Drive your car to avoid obstacles and cars chasing you. Crash the cars and collect coins to buy a new whip.

title: Arcade Archives: Bravoman
description:
Here comes Bravoman, an agent of justice!

"BRAVOMAN" is an action game released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1988.
One day, average office worker Hitoshi Nakamura encounters Alpha Man on his way home from a long day of work.
Alpha Man then entrusts him with ultra energy transformation material, asking him to use it to stop the mad scientist Dr. Bomb from taking over the world.
He transforms, becoming a hero of justice and courage...called BRAVOMAN!

title: SwapStar
description: Make patterns to gain energy. Spend energy to do actions. Plan your actions carefully to destroy your opponent's grid before they do yours. Play as Swapster in Story Mode or as any of the 10 colorful cast of characters in Mission or Versus Mode.

title: Crash Team Rumble: Season 1
description: Launch was the first season in Crash Team Rumble, it began on the 20th of June 2023 and ended on the 11th of September 2023.

title: QUByte Classics: Beat 'Em Up Archives
description: Unleash Your Inner Fighter in Beat 'Em Up Archives: Iron Commando and Legend. Experience Classic Brawling Action in Two Timeless Games from the 90s!

title: UD Cave
description:
UD Cave is a fast-paced one-button game.

Your screen is split in halves with a cave in each half. You control two characters simultaneously going through the caves on each side. The cave on the right is upside down. Press a button to make both characters go right. Collect coins on the way to score points.

The game is over when either of the two characters hits the sides of the cave.

title: Learn Katakana!!
description:
Learn Katakana!! is an educational game that helps you memorize the advanced Japanese syllabary typically used for the transcription of the foreign words, Katakana.

Learn Katakana by playing a game! Select the correct spelling of each Katakana character from the 4 options and score points. Attain the highest possible score with 3 lives!

The game features 46 Katakana characters and you can always remind yourself how to read them by using the table in the game.

title: My Time at Sandrock: Collector's Edition
description: Pre-order the Collector's Edition of My Time at Sandrock, which includes the digital PC game, a &quotPensky&quot plush toy, a wooden workshop to assemble, a 40-page comic book &quotA Logan Story,&quot two wooden Standees of Logan and Nia, a Builder's License, and additional digital content!

title: Arcade Archives: Megablast
description: Feast on a four-way firing frenzy!!

title: Scavenger Hunt: Switzerland
description:
In Scavenger Hunt: Switzerland you have to solve various puzzles to reach the goal. The puzzles lead you across Switzerland in different levels.
To master the levels and the puzzles you need internet access and a web browser!
The game will be available in English and German.

title: Subway Simulator: Underground Train Ride
description: Subway Simulator is realistic simulation,provides an opportunity for train enthusiasts and gamers to experience the intricacies of operating a subway system.Players can delve into the world of underground trains and test their skills as responsible train operators.

title: Speed or Death
description:
Cross a city infested with enormous monsters, dodge the fiery breath of a dragon, find how to escape an alien invasion... all without getting eaten by a worm.
This is Speed or Death, a frenzied racing game where the most important thing isn’t reaching the finish line, but surviving the chaos around you. Unlock the different cars and live to tell the tale another day. What apocalypse shall we race through today?

title: Donuts in Space
description: Donuts in Space is an arcade shooter where the player destroys donut meteors and alien ships. Survive and collect powerups as you blast your way through a tasty galactic assault.

title: New Lands 2
description:
See what it’s like to be a farmer and maker of sweet treats. Grow cocoa trees, build mills and make squirrel houses. Decorate your own farmhouse. The farther you go into the new lands, the more varied your tasks will be and the harder they’ll be to complete.
Work your new lands and become the best maker of sweet treats around in new time management game New Lands 2!

title: Robo Ret
description: Robo Ret is a 2D action platformer game where the player takes on the role of a robot fighting against other robot bosses.The player's main weapon is a cannon arm, which they use to shoot at the enemy bosses. The goal of the game is to defeat all of the bosses.

title: S Lanes
description:
S Lanes is a fast-paced one-button game.

You are constantly moving between the four lanes on the left side of the screen. Your goal is to shoot enemies that are coming from the right to keep them from reaching the lanes. Hold a button to shoot and to move forward towards the enemies. Collect the coins that enemies drop after you destroy them to score points.

The game is over when any enemy reaches any of the lanes.

title: Funny Alphabet
description: Learn the first letters with us in our game Funny Alphabet, where your child have to guess the correct letter to the correct image.

title: Creature in the Well: Collector's Edition
The Last Hero of Nostalgaia: Deluxe Edition
description: Experience the full intriguing world of Nostalgaia with the Deluxe Edition which includes the base game and the newest adventure, The Rise of Evil DLC.

title: Hot Wheels: Rift Rally
description: An AR racing game featuring hot wheels cars

title: Envasion
description: You love shooting stuff non-stop while your whole screen keeps exploding for days? Then this game’s for you, son! Buy and upgrade an assortment of tanks and weapons to roll them into battle! Those machineguns, plasma cannons, railguns, cannons, bombs and missiles will be worth everything you spend on ’em!

title: Flappy Eros
description: Flap the little wings of the Eros and try to save St. Valentine's Day! Collect hearts and different equipments like shields and bows to protect yourself during the journey! God of Love awaits you!

title: Radirgy 2
description: Radirgy 2 is the long-awaited sequel to the arcade-style shoot 'em up Radirgy, returning to its roots with classic vertical scrolling gameplay. Players choose between two ships, one with traditional controls and the other offering twin-stick mechanics.

title: Arcade Archives: Splatter House
description:
"Splatter House" is an action game released by Namco (Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1988.
Take control of the hero, Rick, and use the power of the spirit in your mask to make your way through the cursed mansion to rescue your girlfriend Jennifer.
Fight off merciless monsters to get out of the haunted mansion alive!

Cate P is a fast-paced one-button game.

You score points by destroying the caterpillars crawling around you. When you press a button you will rotate clockwise and shoot in the direction you were looking at before. Try to hit the caterpillars and avoid being hit by them. You score points by shooting the segments of a caterpillar.

The game is designed with vibrant, eye-catching graphics that add a dash of charm to the chaos of the roads. It's not just about survival; the speed of traffic increases over time, pushing your agility to the limit. The future is in the hands of the two MB-OG fighters, and they depart for the enemy colony.

title: Firefighter Simulator 911: Car Fire Truck Driver
description:
Strap on your helmet and duty belt, and get ready for the mission! Explore over 30 areas inspired by real locations across the United States!
In the game Firefighter: Firefighter Simulator 911 : Car Fire Truck Driver, you'll step into the shoes of a real fire brigade worker in a large American city. Experience thrilling tasks in more than 30 different locations, all inspired by the scenic landscapes of the US West Coast. Drive carefully recreated Rosenbauer America vehicles, extinguish fires using heavy firefighter equipment and tools!
You'll have access to authentic firefighting equipment, including helmets, safety shoes, firefighter axes, crowbars, water guns, and breathing apparatus from renowned American manufacturers.
Fire alarm! Time is of the essence! Put on your shoes, zip up your firefighter uniform, secure your duty belt, don your helmet, start the fire truck, activate special signals and sirens, and take the shortest route to save lives.
Whether it's an industrial area, the suburbs, or the city centre, firefighters are needed everywhere to rescue people! Do you have what it takes to become a highly skilled firefighter? Take on the challenge right now and become the city's number one lifesaver!

description:
The sakura that bloomed year-round is now a thing of the past and Hatsune Island is now known as an island that shows the beauty of each season.

Kiyotaka is a second-year student at Kazami Academy who is part of the news club along with the school idol Rikka, his younger sister-like childhood friend Himeno, his mixed-race cousin Charles, a hard-working junior who skipped a grade and is in his class Sara, and energetic in spirit but weak in body Aoi.

Unlike in the past, there are no more mysterious things happening on the island. That was until one winter day when the sakura began to bloom. All the news club members got a message on their cell phones telling them to do something at a promised place when the sakura begins to bloom. They couldn’t make out the rest of the message but are surprised that it was dated 1951. Rikka was extremely curious about the message and the sudden blooming of the sakura, so she called on everyone to solve the mystery with her.

Rely on help from the Paccet you rescued in the last game as you complete your mission to finish off the vicious Octy extraterrestrials!

title: Jimbaori: The Onin War
description:
Set in feudal Japan during the late 16th century, the story follows the rise and fall of Hideyoshi, a man consumed by his hunger for power and the tragic consequences that ensue.

As Hideyoshi's life nears its end, his insatiable thirst for power and the consequences of his actions culminate in a dramatic clash between nations.

Driven to expand his influence and secure his legacy, Hideyoshi embarks on a campaign that will test his military prowess and, ultimately, seal his fate.

As the invasion unfolds, Hideyoshi faces unexpected resistance from the Korean forces led by the renowned Admiral Yi Sun-sin.

Choose from a variety of stylish vehicles, each with its own unique abilities. Whether you prefer speedy sports cars or powerful machines, there's a ride for everyone in Rocket Car.

title: Gothic Classic
description:
For the first time, relive this amazing RPG on a handheld console and enjoy the game that revolutionized roleplaying games on the go. Dive into dark times and adventures with great performance and a well adapted UI and controls.

War has been waged across the kingdom of Myrtana. Orcish hordes invaded human territory and the king of the land needed a lot of ore to forge enough weapons, should his army stand against this threat. Whoever breaks the law in these darkest of times is sentenced to serve in the giant penal colony of Khorinis, mining the so much needed ore. You are thrown through the barrier into this prison colony. With your back against the wall, you have to survive and form volatile alliances until you can finally escape.

title: Monster Prom 3: Monster Roadtrip XXL
description:
Monster Roadtrip adds a twist to its predecessors Monster Prom and Monster Camp, multiplayer dating sims brimming with beautiful art and unapologetic humor.

This sequel takes you on an unforgettable road trip along with fan-favorites Scott and Polly. On the way, you will stay at crummy motels, engage in dark cult rituals, help out strangers on the road and pick up more hitchhikers than Scott can count. Bump into old friends and meet plenty of new faces on your way to one of six destinations.

But that’s not all! The XXL version includes ALL of the DLC playable characters: Zoe, Juan, Hazel and Glitch.

title: Yakuzukuri Puzzle Yumeiro Yuramu
description:
Yakuzukuri Puzzle Yumeiru Yuramu, also known simply as Yumeiro Yuramu, is a falling-blocks puzzle game by Nippon Ichi Software.

The basic gameplay consists of the player dropping dominos of two colored blocks onto the playfield. When four blocks of the same color are connected, they form a tetromino. As the player forms patterns such as multiple same-colored tetrominoes connecting or tetrominos forming a square, a score counter next to the playfield will increase. When the player has a valid points-earning board, they may either finish the round to cash in their points, or continue to build, at the expense of possibly losing points if they fail to raise the value of their board.

The game can be either played solo or in versus mode against an opponent, either a CPU-controlled or human opponent. Versus-human play can be done either locally or online, with cross-platform play available between Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 4 players. When playing versus, each round the player whose board is worth more points will damage the opponent's HP with an amount equal to the value of their board. The first player to deplete their opponent's HP wins.

Avon believes that an unknown foreign entity is trying to start a war and would put San Andreas and the United States under a "doomsday scenario". The heist crew is involved in several missions that introduce new military-grade vehicles and weapons featured in the update.

title: 01 Deadliest Zone Catch: Boat Crab & Fishing Simulator
description:
Embark on thrilling maritime adventures where you'll become a professional crab catcher and navigate the treacherous waters of Alaska. Earn a fortune while traveling on a large boat, battling dangerous natural disasters. And don't forget about those menacing crab claws!
Become a true captain. Manage your ship and utilize professional equipment to catch crabs in the vast Bering Sea. Explore the waters of Alaska, study crab migrations, and do everything possible to succeed even in the most turbulent days. Prepare yourself for exciting quests in search of wealth and glory on the open seas!
In "01 Deadliest Zone Catch — Boat Crab & Fishing Simulator" you'll have the opportunity to participate in perilous sea races for the best catch and capture crabs beyond your wildest dreams. Your task won't be easy—you'll have to contend with time constraints, weather conditions, crab migrations, and, most importantly, the unforgiving sea itself. This is your destiny on the waters of Alaska!
It will take all your courage and determination to conquer the deadly waves and build your own fortune in the world of crab catching. Take action and seize the opportunity to become a legend in "01 Deadliest Zone Catch — Boat Crab & Fishing Simulator"!

title: Bomb Up
description:
Bomb Up is a fast-paced one-button game.

You are constantly falling down. Press a button to fire a bomb and press it again to explode it. Score points by destroying all the red squares within the radius of its explosion. The explosion will bounce you up and to the side and you will turn around when you hit a wall.

The game is over when a red square hits you.

The player chooses one of four heroes and sets out on a journey to rescue Princess Sarasa, who has been taken by the evil Barrog.
Buy key items and equipment at the shops along the way, and don’t forget to explore: NPCs are on hand to offer useful hints along the way!

description:
Tappump is a fast-paced one-button game.

You control the circle. Your goal is to move forward while avoiding mines and staying within the horizontal boundaries of the screen. Press the button to jump, hold the button to increase range. Collect coins to earn points.

If you hit a mine or go beyond the top or bottom of the screen, the game is over.

title: Twin P
description:

You control a line with a pin on each end. One end is always pinned in place while the other constantly rotates clockwise. Press a button to pin the other end while releasing the first one or hold a button to extend the line. Your goal is to move around while avoiding the borders of the screen. Collect the coins to score points but avoid hitting the purple spikes.

The game is over when both ends of the line go beyond the borders of the screen or when you touch a spike.

As players progress through the game, they will encounter a number of challenges and obstacles, including difficult jumps, tricky boxes, and complex box stacking puzzles. However, with some careful planning and a little strategic thinking, players can help Mimi overcome these challenges and reach her scratching post.

It's a bundled ticket for double the excitement and twice the train-routing fun. Get ready to navigate the tracks and explore the unique challenges that await this extraordinary train adventure. title: Russian Pinocchio
description:
The story of Pinocchio began with the translation of Carlo Collodi's Italian fairy tale Pinocchio, but then developed into a completely different, author Alexei Tolstoy's story. He brought more adventurism and fun to the story and added many new details and changes.

The story was adapted for film, theatrical productions, and the tale itself was published in the USSR 182 times, was translated into 47 languages, and reached a total circulation of 14.5 million copies.

How different is Tolstoy's version from Carlo Collodi's tale, so unique is the graphic version by artist Ekaterina Volzhina! She retains Tolstoy's entire plot, but brings it to modern Russia! Her story is told without a single word, but with incredibly beautiful illustrations and love for the source material.

title: The Chase: Cop Pursuit
description:
The Chase is finally here. A thrilling and action-packed game that will have your heart racing! Prepare to unleash your inner speed monster as you take on the role of a driver who is being chased by the cops.

It's a challenging game in which you'll be immersed in a world of powered car races and exciting driving. Take control of a variety of customized cars and abilities, each with its own unique characteristics, and overcome your pursuers with your expert driving abilities. Explore smoothly created maps inspired by Eastern culture to give your escape ways a unique touch.

As you race through the maps you will come across power-ups that can give you a significant advantage in your daring escape. Keep an eye out for NOS to boost your car's speed and leave your pursuers in the dust. Additionally, strategically deploying mines can slow down police cars in order to earn victory.

Prepare to be on the edge of your seat with a captivating storyline that immerses you in danger, Can you escape the police? Prove your strength as an escape artist. Unlock additional characters to enrich your gameplay.
