description: An extra arc originally included in Umineko no Naku Koro ni Hane where Battler Ushiromiya returns to Rokkenjima after a six-year absence, but instead of having a friendly reunion with his family, he has plans of murder. This episode explores darker themes and diverges from the canonical timeline, offering fans a speculative “what-if” story.

title: Umineko no Naku Koro ni: Game Master Battler!
description: An extra arc originally included in Umineko no Naku Koro ni Tsubasa, where after finding the truth and becoming Game Master, Battler tries to write a scenario for the next episode. As Game Master, Battler can do anything, and many people are more than willing to secure a role.

title: Umineko no Naku Koro ni: Mahou ni Tsuite no Juuyou Jikou
description: An extra arc that is a discussion between Beatrice and Maria about the importance of magic.

title: Umineko no Naku Koro ni: Jessica to Satsujin Senpuuki
description: An extra arc originally included in Umineko no Naku Koro ni Hane where Jessica writes a play and shows it off to Battler and Shannon when Lambdadelta interferes and sucks the three of them into it. The trio must see the story to the end if they want to escape alive.

title: Umineko no Naku Koro ni: Jessica to Koi no Omajinai
description: An extra arc originally included in Umineko no Naku Koro ni Tsubasa, where Jessica seeks the help of Zepar and Furfur once again, and this time she receives a book of spells.

title: Umineko no Naku Koro ni: Jessica no Haha no Hi Present
description: An extra arc originally included in Umineko When They Cry Tsubasa where Jessica summons Zepar and Furfur to help her get a present for Natsuhi, and the results are not quite what she expected.

title: Umineko no Naku Koro ni: Kinrou Kansha no Hi no Okurimono
description: An extra arc originally included in Umineko no Naku Koro ni Tsubasa where the cousins all pick out gifts to give to their parents for Labor Thanksgiving Day, but Beatrice uses her powers to sow chaos.

title: Umineko no Naku Koro ni: Last Note of the Golden Witch
description: An extra arc originally included in the PC release of Umineko no Naku Koro ni Saku where Battler, Ange, and Beatrice are summoned to challenge a new opponent, Piece, who assembles a new game board and asks them to figure out her identity.

title: Umineko no Naku Koro ni: Shoukanshi Kara no Tegami
description: An extra arc explaining the basics of magic.

title: Umineko no Naku Koro ni: Bern no Tegami
description: An extra arc originally included in Umineko no Naku Koro ni Tsubasa where Bernkastel writes to a friend about the rules of Beatrice's game.

title: Umineko no Naku Koro ni: Memoirs of the ΛΔ
description: An extra arc originally included in the PC release of Umineko no Naku Koro ni Saku where Lambdadelta talks about the wishes she’s granted, remembering in particular the wishes of some certain little kids.

title: Umineko no Naku Koro ni: Aru Ryourinin no Zakki
description: An extra arc originally included in Umineko no Naku Koro ni Tsubasa where Gohda tells of the time he first signed on to serve the Ushiromiya family and the strange events he witnessed.

title: Umineko no Naku Koro ni: Warera no Kokuhaku
description: An extra arc originally included in the PC release of Umineko no Naku Koro ni Saku, which demonstrates the creation of a new game board of Beatrice's from the ground up, showing readers how the mystery is set up and how fantasy elements are used to adorn the tale.

title: Umineko no Naku Koro ni: Sakutaro, Rengoku-san he
description: An extra arc originally included in Umineko no Naku Koro ni Tsubasa where Sakutaro is taken away from Maria and sent to Purgatory, where he must purify his sins if he wishes to reunite with her.

title: Umineko no Naku Koro ni: Tenshi 17-sai Higashi-shi - 44a
description: An extra arc featuring Ange and Virgilia creating new pairings for their yaoi doujins.

title: Umineko no Naku Koro ni: Nana Shimai no Valentine
description: An extra arc originally included in Umineko no Naku Koro ni Tsubasa where Ronove bakes chocolate for Valentine's Day and the Seven Sisters of Purgatory seek out recipients for it.

title: Umineko no Naku Koro ni: Valentine Paper
description: An extra arc originally included in Umineko no Naku Koro ni Tsubasa where Battler receives letters from various characters for Valentine’s Day.

title: Umineko no Naku Koro ni: Dare no Ochakai?
description: An extra arc originally included in Umineko no Naku Koro ni Tsubasa where Bernkastel is invited to a tea party hosted by Lambdadelta and Featherine, but traps abound.

title: Umineko no Naku Koro ni: Majo-tachi no Tanabata ha Amakunai
Kurushi Final: Mental Blocks
description:
Kurushi Final: Mental Blocks originally released on the PlayStation console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
Dare you test your intelligence against a higher power? Featuring nine mind-stretching stages, plus a two player survival mode, 100 additional challenges and a custom-puzzle generator, Kurushi Final: Mental Blocks remains to this day a supreme test of mental and physical agility.

title: Soulcalibur: Broken Destiny
description:
A port of Soulcalibur: Broken Destiny, originally released on the PSP (PlayStationPortable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

The Soulcalibur series is a weapon-based fighting franchise in which characters engage in combat using a range of weapons. Soulcalibur: Broken Destiny includes the Gauntlet mode, a single-player mode in which players progress through a series of missions using different characters. These missions are intended to introduce gameplay mechanics and techniques and to support skill development.

title: Tekken 6
description: A port of the version of Tekken 6 originally released on PlayStation Portable, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Video Poker
description: "Video Poker" is an exciting and immersive video poker game designed specifically for gaming consoles. Step into the virtual world of a luxurious casino and experience the thrill of playing a variety of video poker games right from the comfort of your living room.

title: Ape Escape Academy
description: To become an expert in monkey business, you first have to go to monkey school, so enroll now at the craziest college the world has ever seen. You can work your way up through the school years by winning wacky mini-games but keep an eye on your classmates – students they may be, but when it comes to trouble and tomfoolery, these goofy monkeys are pros!

title: Tommy Is My Hero!
description:
Nelly lost all the balls she played with. Tommy proposed to help her.
He will need to explore the room-mazed environment to find all the balls. Each room will prepare dangers for him, and Tommy will have to avoid them by running and jumping.

title: Ball Jumper
description: Do you like colors and jumping? This is the right game for you. Jump from one colored blob to another colored blob and get the highest score.

title: Arcade Archives: Blandia
description: Blandia is a 1992 fighting game where players select from six warriors competing to defeat a tyrannical king who hoards the world's treasures. Combat features an armor system where each fighter begins with protective gear that absorbs damage until destroyed through repeated attacks, adding a strategic layer to battles. Players must break through opponents' armor before inflicting direct damage, creating a unique mechanic that distinguishes it from traditional fighting games.

title: Persona 4: Golden Grimoire Edition
description:
Persona 4: Golden Grimoire Edition includes:

Physical Copy of Persona 4 Golden
Persona 4 Golden Slipcover
Grimoire Book Box
SteelBook

title: Persona 4: Golden Midnight Channel Edition
description:
Persona 4: Golden Midnight Channel Edition includes:

Physical Copy of Persona 4 Golden for PlayStation 4
Lenticular Midnight Channel Box
Persona 4 Golden Slipcover
Grimoire Book Box
Persona 4 Golden Official Soundtrack
Premium Trading Card Set
Yu Naurkami's Glasses and Display Stand
All Out Attack 3D Shadow Box
Metal Teddie Statuette
SteelBook
Persona 4 Golden Ending Photo
Midnight Channel Pin
Individually Numbered Certificate of Authenticity

title: Car for Sale Simulator 2023: Car Mechanic, Wash, Car Flipper
description: Step into the fast-paced world of automotive entrepreneurship with Car for Sale!

title: Anime Uni
description: A puzzle game that can be played with one hand.

title: Arcade Archives: Burning Force
description:
Pass the graduation exam
to become a glorious space fighter!

title: Excessive Trim
description: Wreak havoc through backwater farmlands as an alien with a buzzsaw flying saucer!

title: Revolve A
description:
Revolve A is a fast-paced one-button game.

You control an arrow that is constantly moving and spinning around. Press a button to move in the direction which the arrow is currently facing. Enemies randomly appear from the sides of the screen and generate links between themselves. By crossing any of the links you score points and destroy all the network of this link.

The game is over when you hit any of the enemies.

title: Whispered Flight
description: Embark upon a whimsical voyage as a radiant sphere of luminescence, gracefully soaring over the placid waters of a lake cradled within the ancient boughs of a mystical woodland. In pursuit of ethereal lumens, gather your scores under the watchful eyes of the stars, whilst evading the malevolent dark skulls seeking to quench your luminous essence. With a trinity of cherished lives, navigate through the verdant whispers of the old trees, to the gentle cadence of tranquility that accompanies your flight. Delight in the quaint, animated tapestry of nature’s hues as you partake in a casual contest of valor with fellow wanderers upon the leaderboard, in this gentle ballet of light against the encroaching shadow.

title: Arcade Archives: Daioh
description: Arcade Archives: Daioh is a 1993 vertical scrolling shooter featuring traditional shoot-em-up mechanics with challenging gameplay. Players pilot spacecraft through enemy-filled stages, utilizing various weapon systems to defeat waves of opponents and large boss encounters. The game includes two versions: a Japanese version with 2-button controls where weapons switch by collecting items, and an International version offering direct selection from six different weapons using dedicated buttons.

title: Into the Gorian's Den
description:
Free DLC for the PS4 version featuring 2 new pos-game stages with a high difficult ins a "as if" scenario.

Only available after finishing the game and loading the "clear save".

title: Our Guest Tonight
description:
Presenting a new late show... Our Guest Tonight!
Hosted by Jack! And our guest tonight is… Bob?!
Play as the audience in this brand-new Late Show. Show your support for Bob by spamming the Clap Button, and share your thoughts about Jack by spamming the Boo button.
Be careful! Everyone loves Bob. By not clapping, you might hurt his feelings, and the show might not go well. As for Jack, he's too cocky to be a host, so make sure to humble him down!

title: Inglorious
description:
Nihil is in danger. Only the champions of the Gods can save the realm of the dead. However, no one said they have to work together to achieve it.

Compete with your friends to see who is better at eliminating waves of enemies in Multiplayer mode! Control the champion you like most and be the first to defeat the final Boss to win!

Use your enemies' souls to improve your champion or to obstruct your opponent without having to use your weapons!

In Single Player mode, battle to conquer and defend the territories of Nihil from the terrible enemy army!

Glory is for the living and you are no longer one of them.

title: Mirror Floor
description:
Mirror Floor is a fast-paced one-button game.

Your goal is to jump between platfroms with coins on them. You score points by picking up the coins but every coin turns you upside down and mirrors your position on the platform. It also changes which sides of the platforms are active. Press a button to jump and hold a button to speed up. You have to think carefully which coins to pick up in order to proceed forward.

The game is over when you fall.

title: Drag Racing Car Simulator
description: Are you ready to prove your skills and become the ultimate racing champion?

title: ForRace GT2D
description: Experience a realistic race that you have not experienced in 2D. In Forrace, you can race with hundreds of cars on dozens of tracks. You can earn money and trade cars.

title: Arcade Archives: Shao-Lin's Road
description:
"SHAO-LIN'S ROAD" is an action game released by KONAMI in 1985.
Take control of WANPYOU, a student of Chin-Style Shao-Lin martial arts who is being held captive in Jaken Temple, the base of the evil YAMUCHA Gang who assassinated WANPYOU's master, RAOCHUU.
Use your lightning-fast kicks to fight your way to freedom and victory!

title: Extreme Skyway Racer Simulator
description: Get ready for a thrilling 3D gaming experience that will push your skills to the edge! Extreme Skyway Racer Simulator puts you in the driver's seat as you navigate precarious platforms suspended in the sky. Your mission: to race across these dizzying heights while maintaining your balance and avoiding a nerve-wracking plunge.

title: Train Valley 2: Community Edition
description: Drive forward the industrial revolution in this train tycoon micro-management game!

title: Air Aces
description: Take command of various modern jet fighters (F-16 Falcon, Eurofighter Typhoon, Dassault Rafale) and copters (Bell AH-1 Cobra, Eurocopter EC665 Tiger) in this perfect mix between a realistic flight simulator and a mission based air combat game.

title: Jet Ski Mania: Aquatic Adrenaline Rush
description: Dive into Adrenaline: Ride the Waves of Victory!

title: Ziggy Zaggy
description: Switch the sides to go further in the world.

title: The Forgotten Tribe
description: The Forgotten Tribe is a small arcade game with 9 levels to go through and get your fellow tribesmen back. Use a map to navigate the dungeon and successfully collect all of your tribe to unlock a happy ending!

title: Danjigoku
description: Danjigoku is a retro-styled classic arcade twin-stick shoot 'em up game. Shoot through hordes of aliens and collect 7 different kinds of upgrades to survive as long as possible!

title: Bamboo
description:
Bamboo is a fast-paced one-button game.

You are constantly running and cutting bamboo that grows in random places. You score points by collecting bamboo. You can run through yellow bamboo to collect it. When bamboo becomes green, you have to cut it multiple times to stop it and you don't get any points from it. Your goal is to stop bamboo from growing and reaching the top.

The game is over when bamboo reaches the top of the screen.

title: R-Type Tactics I & II Cosmos: Limited Edition
description: Includes R-Type Tactics I・II Cosmos: Deluxe Edition, 2-Disc Soundtrack, Conceptual Art Card Set (Set of 6), R-9A Arrowhead Acrylic Stand, B-1D Bydo System Alpha Acrylic Stand, Collector's Box

title: Arcade Archives: Dinorex
description:
Dinorex is a fighting game released by TAITO in 1992.
Choose from 6 available dinosaurs and do battle to win the amazoness queen, and the title of Dino Rex: the king of the land!
Acquiring various types of egg-shaped items and weapons can give you an advantage in a battle.

title: The King of Fighters XIII: Global Match: Deluxe Edition
description:
KOF XIII, the final chapter in the Ash Saga—and one of the series’ most acclaimed entries—is back! This enhanced version comes with rollback netcode for exhilarating online play, as well as brand-new online lobbies that allow you to join/spectate matches with multiple players at once. Also features a packed roster of 36 playable characters, including NESTS Style Kyo, Classic Iori, and Mr. Karate! KOF’s greatest-ever 2D graphics come to life as you face off against players online and around the world!

Complete with rollback netcode and overhauled online functionality!

Comes with magnificent must-haves for fans of the series: a Digital Artbook (with 100+ pages of exclusive illustrations, storyboards, and more) and a Digital Soundtrack (featuring the now-elusive melodies of THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIII)!

Includes:
- "THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIII GLOBAL MATCH" Base game
- "THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIII GLOBAL MATCH Artbook & Soundtrack"

title: Pump Press
description: You control a robot that is constantly moving forward. Your goal is to pump the balloons that are coming towards you by shooting them. If you shoot a balloon 4 times, it will pop. Press a button to shoot and hold a button to go faster. The balloons will remain behind you once they pass you and deflate again. The enemy will push all deflated balloons to the left border. You score points for every balloon that hits the border. To score more points, chain up the balloons.

title: Slick Slack
description: A simple puzzle game in which you, as a player, will need to use your brain.

title: Yama no Susume: Next Summit - Ano Yama ni, Mou Ichido
Persona 5 Tactica: DLC All in One
description:
The All In One DLC Pack includes the following:

• Repaint Your Heart Challenge Pack
• Weapon Pack
• Picaro Summoning Pack + Raoul Persona

title: Guess the Word
description: Play and learn letters and words - "Guess A Word" is an educational game for preschoolers and toddlers.

title: Bar Stella Abyss
description: Bar Stella Abyss sees players take the role of a faceless wanderer who is drawn to Stella Abyss, a bar hidden in a mysterious corner of the city. Players will build a party and explore the dream-like Drunken World.

title: Lasso Catch
description: Lasso Catch is a small and simple retro-inspired arcade game where you have to catch the cows with your lasso while also avoiding the wolves. How many can you catch?

title: Santa's World
description: A family friendly Christmas platformer

title: Arcade Archives: Warp & Warp
description:
"WARP & WARP" is an action game released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1981.
Players travel between two worlds as they progress: a space world where they fight with guns, and a maze world where they fight with time bombs.
Try for a high score by taking down the MYSTERY BEM that spawn under set conditions, or by taking out multiple enemies with a single explosion!

title: Space Papers: Planet's Border
description: Attention, Earthwad! Welcome to Nations United by Convenience, the NUC. You have just called up for a great mission on Earth as an intergalactic border patrol officer!

title: Golf With Your Friends: Ultimate Edition
description: An easy hole in one for any Golf With Your Friends fan! Grab everything from hats to courses, and swing in style with this seriously decked out version.

title: Golf With Your Friends: Starter Edition
description: Tee yourself up for the perfect swing! Your first step into Golf With Your Friends has never looked so good!

title: Poly Shooting Simulator
description: Are you ready to dominate the leaderboard and become the ultimate Poly Shooting legend?

title: Super Solitaire: Card Game
description: The King of Card Games

title: Submarines
description: Submarines is a casual arcade-style game where players pilot a submarine through the ocean using intuitive thrust mechanics. Collect power-ups and weapons to navigate the levels, taking on enemy submarines and adversaries in a fun and engaging underwater experience.

title: Hooligan Simulator 2023: You vs. System
description: In Hooligan Simulator, players are not subjected to trials but are presented with the audacious opportunity to express themselves through graffiti. Armed with the means to draw, you can assert your presence in society through free expression. By painting graffiti, vandalising public property, and leaving your mark, you become the embodiment of audacity. However, be aware that such actions make you a prime target for law enforcement.

title: Missing Parts
description: Find the missing part of the image to complete the image. Funny game for kids to recognize the images.

title: Ao no Kanata no Four Rhythm Extra1P
description: A port of Ao no Kanata no Four Rhythm Extra1S for the PlayStation 4 with enhanced image and sound quality.

title: Ao no Kanata no Four Rhythm Extra2P
description: A port of Ao no Kanata no Four Rhythm Extra2S for the PlayStation 4 with enhanced image and sound quality.

title: Bulldozer Tycoon: Construction Simulator
description: Are you ready to embark on a construction journey like never before?

title: Space Scavengers
description:
Force your way through unique asteroids, stopping a long the way for needed ship and weapon upgrades to help end the the threat to humanity, a modern take on the classic Asteroids game featuring the same great asteroid destruction with modern mechanics.

Recharge your shields, Dodge the magnetic asteroids, Shatter the crystals and challenge the Living Rock to save the world from destruction.

Breakable asteroids mixed with weapons that go brrrr!

title: Arcade Archives: Scramble Formation
description:
Scramble into the skies of Tokio! Master the formation change!

SCRAMBLE FORMATION is a shooting game released by TAITO in 1986.
Pilot your phantom jet into battle, capturing enemy planes along the way to enable formation change.
Formations can be air-to-air, air-to-ground or a hybrid of the two, and matching these to counter the enemy is the key to victory!

title: Super Prehistoric World Adventure
description: Journey to the Stone Age. Fight dangerous enemies and bosses using strategy. Destroy barriers, explore worlds.

title: Santa's Chimney Quest
description: Help Santa to deliver at time

title: Bigfoot's Journey
description:
Learn about a real Bigfoot - a creature that has learned to hide, survive and travel through other dimensions, and guide him through the mazes.

Among the most important events of the twentieth century, three stand out: man went into space; man has been to the moon; the man became convinced that he was not the only possessor of intelligence on Earth.

Years have passed. The planet is in the middle of the 21st century. Humanity is on the verge of extinction. Nuclear winter is raging. Officially, hominology is listed as a pseudoscience, but in fact it is the most important scientific discipline, because the object of its study is real.

title: Arcade Game Zone
description: Dive into the Ultimate Console Arcade Experience!

title: Western Slot Machine
description: Feel lucky today! Now, you can play the best wild casino slot anywhere and anytime. Experience the real thrill of Las Vegas!Enjoy all the fun of a Western slot machine in your hand. Place your bet, spin, and win big prizes!

title: Arcade Archives: Pole Position II
description:
"POLE POSITION II" is a racing game released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1983.
The game is divided into qualifying and grand prix. If you make a lap in the qualifying round with a good time, you will advance to the grand prix.
In addition, new courses have been added to this title.
Aim for pole position on four different courses!

title: M.A.D. Cows
description: M.A.D. Cows is an exciting, retro, action platform game. Mow down aliens. Buy better guns. Rescue cows, dogs, raccoons, and more.

title: Rail Romanesque Origin
description: Rail Romanesque Origin is a console port of the romance visual novel Maitetsu: Last Run!!. The original game was released for PC in Japan on October 30, 2020.

title: Run Show Quest
description: Simple, casual game where you run as a teenager, dodging obstacles for points. Cartoon graphics, easy for all ages.

title: Arcade Archives: Aero Fighters
description: The sonic guys are here, risking their lives on eight missions!

title: Trinity Fusion: Deluxe Edition
description: Explore dark, sci-fi worlds and engage in fast-paced and precise combat in Trinity Fusion - a Rogue-Lite action platformer set in a sprawling, doomed multiverse.

title: Expeditions: A MudRunner Game - Supreme Edition
description: Embark on scientific expeditions with this new off-road adventure from the creators of MudRunner and SnowRunner. Lead research missions as you drive a variety of all-terrain vehicles, using high-tech tools and managing your camp and crew to ensure your success in the wild.

title: Ao no Kanata no Four Rhythm Extra1+2P
description: A bundle that includes Ao no Kanata no Four Rhythm Extra1 and Extra2 in one package, featuring the side stories between Mashiro and Misaki.

title: Draco D
description: Draco D, a casual dragon arcade game where players soar through enchanting levels, unleashing unique breath weapons and collecting magical power-ups to conquer foes. Maneuver through perilous obstacles, defeat monsters for rewards, and aim for high scores in this exhilarating quest.

title: R Wheel
description: R Wheel is a fast-pased one-button game. Try to survive inside a spinning wheel with spikes. Press a button to jump and hold a button to stay in the air longer. But your jumps release a wave that spawns the spikes. Collect bonus items to release a wave that clears the spikes and score points by clearing them. The game is over when you hit the spikes.

title: Air Fight: Sky Fighters
description: Prepare to take to the skies in an adrenaline-pumping adventure like no other with "Air Fight - Sky Fighters." Immerse yourself in the heart-pounding world of aerial combat, where you'll pilot cutting-edge fighter jets through intense dogfights and exhilarating missions that will test your skills, reflexes, and strategic thinking.

title: Truck Drag Racing Legends
description: Get ready to unleash the adrenaline-fueled fury of raw power on the asphalt! Dominate the tracks as you steer through an array of formidable challenges and rivals.

title: Truck Simulator Driver USA 2024
description: Truck Simulator Driver USA is an exciting video game that lets you experience the thrill of driving a truck in America.

title: Thrillville
description:
Experience Thrillville originally released on the PSP (PlayStationPortable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Thrillville allows gamers of all ages to easily build and customize the coaster of your dreams. Gone are the days of the complex PC techniques used in other coaster games. Rather, Thrillville's easy to use building mode has been designed specifically for the console platforms and makes building all 75-plus rides from wooden, corkscrew and inverted coasters to merry go rounds, trains and carnival rides, easy, and most importantly, fun. Imagination is the only height limit with Thrillville, where the fun ranges from racing on go-kart tracks you put together and playing mini-golf on courses you designed to dozens of party games, from bumper cars to arcade shoot-'em-ups. You can also tour the park on foot - a first for theme-park titles - chatting and joking with all the guests to help them out and make sure they're enjoying themselves.

• Build, manage, ride, customize and socialize your way through the five theme parks you've created
• The simplest, most intuitive development tools available for all 75-plus ride types, from wooden, corkscrew and inverted coasters to merry-go-rounds, trains and all your favorite carnival rides
• Play classic midway games like bumper cars, saucer soccer, remote-control cars, shooting gallery, mini-golf, rhythm challenges, arcade-style shoot- em-ups and puzzlers
• Interact and develop a relationship with any guests you see - Listen to and address their unique concerns about your park, joke with them, and even help a guest impress his crush by winning that special prize
• Explore 15 different themed areas spread across five theme parks, such as Pirates Gone Wild, Gold Rush, Ancient Treasures of Egypt and Moon Base

title: Ski Simulator: Winter Sports
description: In "Ski Simulator: Winter Sports," players are on a quest to earn points and unlock new levels by mastering the art of skiing or snowboarding. Navigate through the exhilarating slopes, collecting checkpoints along the way to progress further in the game. But beware, time is of the essence – the clock is ticking, and every second counts!

title: Mr. Run & Jump + Kombinera Adrenaline
description: Features 2 characterful games with beautifully illustrated visual aesthetics bursting with vibrant and approachable graphics. Both titles have a wide variety of puzzles and platforming adventures, as well as challenging levels, collectibles, and additional game modes.

title: Survival Raft Simulator: Lost at Sea
description: Master the Ocean's Challenges: Craft, fish, defend against sharks, and expand your raft into a thriving haven in this immersive and unforgiving survival simulator.

title: Grimoire Organizer
description:
Grimoire Organizer is a game about flicking books into the bookshelves.

The books come in 3 colors - red, green and blue, with 3 cover designs for each of the colors. Take books from the stack, aim and launch them into the bookcase where they belong! If you mismatch the color of the book in hand with the place in the bookcase, or try to place it where there is already a book, you lose 1 try. You start with 5 tries and the goal is to keep at least 1 try under the timer.

Try a different configurable time - either 52 or 200 seconds!

Good luck!

title: Arcade Archives: Solitary Fighter
description:
GOGOON!
Struggle for No. 1 quarreler in the Violence Fight!

title: Arcade Archives: Mystic Warriors
description:
Tranquil death and rebirth,
GOKURAKU OUJOU on a mystic night.

title: Alisa: Developer's Cut
description: Can you survive the Dollhouse? Alisa is a Horror-themed Action Adventure game, and a genuine throwback to the golden age of 90's 3D games.

title: One Piece: Pirate Warriors 4 - Koby's Combat Chronicle & Soul Map 2
description: Join the Marines' young hero, Koby, as he endures a journey of intensive special training!

title: Arcade Archives: Cosmo Gang The Puzzle
description:
"COSMO GANG THE PUZZLE" is a puzzle action game released by Namco (Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1992.
Make sure to line up the cosmos and containers that fall from above to eliminate them.
Containers disappear when lined up horizontally, and cosmos can disappear when hit by the blue ball.
The key to strategy is to rotate the parts well and create a good path for the ball.

title: Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown - F-104C: Avril
description:
The F-104C Avril DLC adds a unique F-104C based on Avril Mead's restoration seen in the game's intro cutscene. No weapons are included, so it can only be used in Free Flight mode.

This DLC is automatically included with every digital purchase of Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown, regardless of edition or base game. It was also included in the Strangereal Edition in Europe and Oceania. It can only be purchased for physical versions of the game in Japan and Asia.

title: Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown - Deluxe Edition 2022
description: The Japan-exclusive 2022 Deluxe Edition of Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown includes the base game and most of its DLC: the Season Pass, the Original Aircraft Series, the Experimental Aircraft Series, the Cutting-Edge Aircraft Series, and the 8 Popular Squadron Emblems DLC.

title: Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown - Ultimate Edition
description: The Japan-exclusive Ultimate Edition of Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown includes the base game and nearly all of its DLC: the Season Pass, the Original Aircraft Series, the Experimental Aircraft Series, the Cutting-Edge Aircraft Series, the Top Gun: Maverick Aircraft Set, and the 8 Popular Squadron Emblems DLC.

title: Ace Combat 7: Skies Unknown - Bonus Emblem Set
description: A free set of emblems containing the "Free Erusea -Bonus-", "Three Arrowheads -Bonus-", and "Three Arrowheads (Low-Vis) -Bonus-" emblems. These are included by default in the Steam version.

title: Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon Chronicles
description:
Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon Chronicles is the ultimate bundle for fans of retro-style action games. This Japanese version of the game includes both Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon and its sequel, Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon 2, in one package. Experience classic side-scrolling gameplay with modern technology that harkens back to the days of 8-bit and 16-bit games.

title: MediEvil: Resurrection
description:
A port of MediEvil: Resurrection, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

MediEvil: Resurrection is a 2005 action-adventure game for the PlayStation Portable and is the third installment in the MediEvil video-game series. It is a reimagining of the first installment in the series, MediEvil, with many alterations to the original structure and content, such as the addition of the "Anubis Stone" sub-plot which never appeared in the original. Many things such as level design and characters were changed drastically, and some levels from the original were removed altogether. New levels and characters were introduced, the cutscenes are completely original, and the game was given a much more comical, cartoon-like style as opposed to the Gothic horror-comedy of the original. The soundtrack is completely orchestrated, and half of the themes from the original were removed while new themes were created to fit with the new levels. Unlike the original, there is no alternate ending; Dan still goes to the Hall of Heroes regardless of whether he collects all of the chalices. The game also features a variety of voice talent, including Tom Baker as the narrator and the Grim Reaper.
