Oreshika is an RPG where you take control of a clan twice-cursed by demon leader Shuten Doji, whose hordes are hell-bent on attacking humans and destroying Kyoto. Join them on their quest to slay Shuten Doji, lift the two curses and bring peace and prosperity to the capital once more.

title: 2048 Boys
description: Get your players on the field! Build the strongest team possible!

title: Air Sea Modern Conflict
description: Dive into the heart-pounding action of "Air Sea Modern Conflict," an exhilarating game where you take direct control of powerful ships and aircraft to annihilate waves of relentless enemies. As a skilled commander, you'll pilot various naval vessels, from agile destroyers and stealthy submarines to massive aircraft carriers, each armed with an array of devastating weapons. Take to the skies with an impressive selection of aircraft, including nimble fighters, heavy bombers, drones and versatile helicopters, to dominate both land and sea.

title: Ball Dodge
description:
You are a ball, you must dodge things. It is as easy as that!

Simple one button controls yet still challenging.

title: Octopo
description: Octopo exploring the sandy shores. Collect shells scattered across the beach to earn points. Along the way, they'll encounter special items that grant temporary boosts like speed, double coins, or invincibility. But watch out! The beach isn't just a serene playground; it's also home to pesky enemies like snails with shells (slugs) and the occasional bomb dropping from above, ready to explode. With each shell collected and enemy evaded, players strive to achieve the highest score possible, making "Octopo" a thrilling adventure of skill and strategy.

title: Wild West Tycoon Empire
description: In "Wild West Tycoon Empire," you are tasked with transforming the rugged Wild West into a thriving economic powerhouse.

title: Vera Blanc: Supernatural Mysteries
description: ~ Vera Blanc: Full Moon + Ghost In The Castle ~

title: Arcade Archives: Rastan Saga II
description: In a time when might was the only justice...

title: Bouncy Chicken
description: It’s time for some fun on the farm in whimsical action puzzler Bouncy Chicken! Master single-screen challenges in top-down 3D style as you take aim at fire your feathered projectile around the chicken pen to gather cobs of corn. In each of the 90 unique levels of Bouncy Chicken, you’ll have only a few shots available to shoot a chicken in any direction, ricocheting off the fence, brick walls and springy obstacles or even through warp points. The objective is to collect every cob of corn on screen before your shot chances run out.

title: Over Horizon X Steel Empire
description: Nostalgic thrills await in this trio of shoot ’em-up masterpieces!

title: Kingdom's Dungeon Rage
description: The king have been taken hostage and locked inside a Dungeon! A dungeon that changes each time you die or complete a level. Complete in challenging different ways to escape, from becoming invisible, turning the world upside down and a lot more - your only goal is to escape without rage quitting.

title: Urban Skater: Skateboard Delivery City Challenge
description: Welcome to Urban Skater - Skateboard Delivery City Challenge, an adrenaline-fueled adventure that puts you on wheels – or rather, a board – like never before! Strap on your helmet, grab your skateboard, and prepare to become the fastest (and coolest) food delivery person in town. Race against time, weave through bustling city streets, and deliver piping hot meals to hungry customers in this fast-paced and exhilarating experience.

title: The Playroom: Ninja Bots
description: Sharpen those shurikens, it's time to send your AR Bots into action in this virtual ninja training mode for up to four players! Using your Dualshock 4 wireless controller, take control of your own Ninja AR Bot, avoiding traps and flicking ninja stars to achieve Ninja Mastership.

title: The Playroom: Toy Maker
description: Using your smartphone, tablet or PS Vita system, let your creativity loose as your drawings magically transform into toys for your AR Bots to play with. You can create anything you like!

title: The Playroom: My Alien Buddy
description: Take your fun to another galaxy with this new toy coming to life exclusively inside The Playroom. My Alien Buddy comes complete with deformable body, UFO and gravity beams, so you can spread mayhem in your living room! And best of all: no battery required!

title: Gundam Versus: Navi - Olga, Atra, Fumitan
Tekken 7: Artist Collaboration Character Panel Set
Tetrack
description: One simple but hard rule here - you must react very quickly to constantly changing conditions, tasks and speed. A challenge for real players with exceptional skills!

title: Cubic Riders
description: You can't imagine how fast Cubics can be! Try them out and test your skills.

title: A Burger in Space
description: Take on the role of Big B and pilot a unique spaceship in the shape of a burger through infinite space!

title: Arcade Archives: Ninja Emaki
description:
Ninja Emaki is a shooter released by Nichibutsu in 1986.
Take control of the young hero Shinbei and fight to rescue the princess from the evil spirit army.
Pick up scrolls to gain access to 8 different kinds of Ninja Magic. Use them wisely, and they'll be the key to advancing through the game!

title: Planet Divers
description: Fire up your blasters and smash through any planet's defenses!

title: Offroad Masters: Motocross Races
description: Embark on an adrenaline-fueled adventure with Offroad Masters: Motocross Races!

title: Border Police: Contraband Simulator 2024
description:
Step into the shoes of a Border Patrol officer in “Border Police: Contraband Simulator 2024”, an immersive and meticulously crafted simulation game.
This captivating experience throws you headfirst into the world of border security, where you'll face the daily challenges, responsibilities, and crucial decisions encountered by those who tirelessly safeguard borders.

title: Runnero
description: Runnero is an exhilarating endless runner game set in tunnels where players must navigate obstacles, collect points, and seize special items that grant temporary invincibility, double scores, or time slowdowns. As player accumulate points, the pace quickens, intensifying the challenge. Dodge obstacles, gather points, and push your reflexes to the limit in this adrenaline-fueled adventure!

title: Sumo Rumble
description: Run, eat and fight!

title: Jeanne d'Arc
description: Experience Jeanne d’Arc, originally released on the PSP, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters. Enter the 15th century, as France and England battle during the Hundred Years’ War. A mysterious and powerful armlet appears on the wrist of a young crusader named Jeanne. Commanded by an oracle from above, Jeanne wields the armlet to turn back the dark invading army to save her homeland once and for all.

title: Ratchet & Clank: Size Matters
description:
A port of Ratchet & Clank: Size Matters, originally released on the PSP, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

The story is about Ratchet and Clank as they are interrupted from their vacation to search for a kidnapped girl and encounter a forgotten race known as the Technomites.

title: Mugen Rinne no Irregular
description:
A new story from the point of view of "Usami Sumireko".
In this original story, she joins the inhabitants of Gensoukyou to fight against the evil spirit "Mima" that has suddenly appeared!
Experience an unknown adventure you've never seen before!

title: Cilla
description:
Cilla is a dynamic 2D side-scrolling shooter that immerses players into the complex narrative of humanity's evolution and the endless struggle for survival at any cost.

You will acquaint themselves with Cilla - a mysterious entity thrust into the heart of war. She is the Perfect Soldier. Devoid of pain, fear, and remorse. Her journey intertwines with the harsh present and what seems to be an inevitable future, as endless losses and extraterrestrial threats pursue her at every turn. But what will happen when Cilla faces her most challenging trial - a choice that will change everything?

Game Features:

Narrative Twist: Immerse yourself in the story of the Perfect Soldier in an alternate future universe. Experience her emotions and confront a moral choice that will impact Cilla's fate and that of all humanity.

Beautiful Pixel Graphics: Enjoy handcrafted game landscapes, meticulously designed multi-layered backgrounds, and unique enemies in each level.

Challenging and Dynamic Combat: Demonstrate maximum agility, collect bonuses, evade enemy fire, and study their behavior and attacks throughout the gripping story of the game.

Take up the challenge and determine the fate of the world!

title: Coded Soul: Uketsugareshi Idea
description: Experience Coded Soul originally released on the PSP (PlayStationPortable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Atelier Marie Plus: The Alchemist of Salburg
description:
A remastered version of the original Atelier Marie Plus, released with the Digital Deluxe Upgrade Pack with upgrade graphics and, for the first time, worldwide.
It is accessible from the Atelier Marie Remake main menu.

title: Arcade Archives: Tinkle Pit
description: "TINKLE PIT" is an action game released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1993. Your objective: Save Tinkle Land from an evil spell and restore peace to the world! Featuring characters drawn from NAMCO classics and deep gameplay for high score competition!

title: Zaggy Car
description: Zaggy Car is an endless journey through the desert where players collect money to unlock new cars. The more money they gather, the faster they go, making it increasingly challenging. Along the way, players can grab special items like double coins or a magnet for a limited time. The goal? Accumulate as much money as possible!

title: Colorama Cubes
description: Try your hand at a unique spatial puzzle game

title: Cola Riders
description: Ride the Cola & Mint Rocket for the craziest experience of your life!

title: Baby Boomer 2: 35 Years Too Soon
description: Nobody asked for it, yet the sequel to “Baby Boomer” is out 35 years after the original! This is literally breaking the world record for the longest time in-between video game sequels!

title: Rooftop Rascal: The Alley Cat
description:
In "Rooftop Rascal: The Alley Cat," you control a clever alley cat navigating city buildings' fire escape stairs to the rooftop goal.
The gameplay centres on precise jumps, avoiding (possible) obstacles, and quick thinking.
Your goal is to climb as high as you can, reach the rooftop, and beat the game.

title: Zombie Harvest: Survival Farming Simulator
description: Grow Your Farm. Survive the Apocalypse. Defend Against the Undead.

title: Suddenly an Ogre
description:
Relive the magic of classic gamebooks.
Step into the adventure: Your story, your ending.
What path will you choose?

title: Project Drift Japan Challenge
description: Unleash Your Inner Drift King on Iconic Roads!

title: Harvest Days
description: Your Dream Farm Is Waiting

title: Dishonored 2: Steelbook Edition
description: Dishonored 2 is a first-person action video game and the sequel to Dishonored. It borrows many of the gameplay elements from the first opus: players define their own play style by blending action, assassination, stealth, mobility and combat. Combining tools at their disposal, players are allowed options to eliminate enemies, whether they choose to pursue them unseen or ruthlessly attack head on. Dishonored 2 features the same campaign style as its predecessor in which the protagonist must advance through a series of missions.

title: Infamous: Second Son - Paper Trail
description:
Paper Trail is a site that is centered around Infamous: Second Son. Its purpose is to have a series of mini-games released on a weekly basis which eventually leads to free DLC for people who participate in the events.

As of December 16, 2018, the website is no longer active, but the in-game missions are still playable.

Paper Trail began a week before the release of Second Son and launched a series of quizzes that would, by the time Second Son came out, be used to start a small series of events inside the game.

By completing each "episode" the player would gain Karmic points which track the player's progress throughout the event game.

title: Anomaly Pools
description: Ready to dive to liminal spaces horror?

title: Ecchi Secrets
description: Find all the hidden secrets of tempting anime girls

title: Busway Islands: Puzzle
description: Build efficient bus routes across beautiful islands! Solve puzzles, connect stations & pick up all passengers

title: Stylist Girl
description: Dress up famous models and VIP celebrities to bring out their best looks with fabulous makeovers!

title: Robin Hood: Shogun Samurai
description: Are you prepared to embrace the way of the samurai and embark on a quest that will test your resolve, courage, and honor?

title: Arcade Archives: Jackal
description:
"JACKAL" is an action game released by KONAMI in 1986.
"Jackal" is a special force that can survive under any conditions.
Control them and drive your armored vehicle into the heart of enemy territory to rescue prisoners.

title: Supermarket Manager 2024
description: Can you transform your modest store into a thriving retail giant?

title: Corn Guard
description:
In this retro-style arcade game, you have to save your corn from the crows!

Shoot the crows from a slingshot to prevent them from stealing corn!

title: Mortal Kombat X: Krimson Ermac
description: This addon allows to play as Krimson Ermac.

title: Conscript: Deluxe Edition
description: During the First World War, a lone French soldier must navigate twisted trenches, scavenge for limited supplies and solve complex puzzles - all whilst fighting for survival in the midst of mankind's most brutal and horrifying conflict. CONSCRIPT is a new take on classic survival horror.

title: Rolling Wheels
description: You are a wheel. A truly deadly wheel. No one will be safe in your path.

title: Bowling in a Skate Park
description: Analyze the playfield, find the best trajectory, pick the right time and go for a strike hit.

title: Cyberpunk Parkour Uprising
description: Are you ready to rise above and become the ultimate parkour champion?

title: Arcade Archives: Football Champ
description:
"FOOTBALL CHAMP" is a sports game released by TAITO in 1990.
Players select their team and star player from one of eight countries in a bid for victory through a series of seven matches.
In addition to playing against the CPU, players can also enjoy playing against each other.
It’s the beautiful game, with all the speed, drama, violence and referee knockouts that any fan would expect!

title: Urban Survival Simulator: The Bum's Journey
description: Do you have what it takes to adapt, survive and become an urban legend?

title: Street Fighter 6: Return of Shadaloo
description:
Get the most out of Street Fighter 6 with the Fighting Pass!

This month's theme: Return of Shadaloo

Free rewards are available now for all players, as well as access to premium rewards for 250 Fighter Coins. Also, starting this month, special effects for the New Challenger screen are included in the rewards!

Rewards include avatar gear, emotes, music, stickers and wallpaper, and the theme will change every month. Don't miss out since rewards are available for a limited time!

Note: The Fighting Pass can be purchased from the in-game shop using Fighter Coins. Avatar gear is cosmetic only and does not affect character fighting attributes.

title: Distance: Console Edition
description: Melding the intensity of arcade racing with the agility of parkour, Distance catapults you into a neon-soaked world shrouded in mystery. Adapt quickly using your car’s abilities to jump, flip, and fly to overcome deadly hazards and survive.

title: Skull Pirates: Adventures
description: Captain, set sail and explore the rough and tumble seas!

title: Flight Simulator Delivery: Cargo Business
description: Lead the Skies and Build Your Aviation Empire!

title: Learn to Play Vol. 4: Happy Racer
Find The Thing
description: Embark on a thrilling quest in 'Find The Thing'! In this immersive game, players are challenged to locate specific objects amidst a chaotic landscape of spawning items. With each successful discovery, players earn points and time, while the stakes increase with more objects spawning. As the score climbs, so does the intensity, with a cluttered playing field making each find more challenging. The ultimate goal? Achieve the highest score possible in this endless adventure of observation and quick thinking!

title: Flip It
description: Wrong side

title: Flight Attendant Simulator: Onboard Tasks
description: Welcome Aboard! Fasten Your Seatbelt—It’s Going to Be a Thrilling Ride!

title: Learn Hangul!!
description: Educational game teaching you fundamental spelling of Hangul.

title: Run, Sandwich, Run!
description: Want to know how sandwiches are really made?

title: Spot The Difference: Anime Edition
description: Introducing Spot The Difference Anime Edition, brought to you by the original creators of the globally renowned Spot The Difference amusement machine game.

title: Cult of the Lamb: Sinful Edition
Aero The Acro-Bat
description: Help Aero rescue his friends and girlfriend, so everyone can enjoy the circus again!

title: Anime Dance-Off: Party Total
description: Step into a universe where music and movement collide in a spectacular party experience for seasoned rhythm gamers and newcomers.

title: Arcade Archives: vs. The Adventure of Valkyrie - The Legend of the Key of Time
description: Defeat ZOUNA, the incarnation of evil, and restore peace!

title: Bid Battle: Auction War Simulator Storage Hunter
description: Outbid, Explore, Profit! Unearth the treasures of the auction world!

title: Puzzle Drop Carnival
description:
More than just another puzzle game. Puzzle Drop Carnival highlights the fun part of puzzle-solving.

Who does not love the good old 'Tetra'-style mechanics? With “Tetra Mode”, the jigsaw is now tetra-saw! Try out Tetra to find out the perfect combination between jigsaw style and 'Tetra'-style games.

title: EmyLiveShow: Dangers & Mysteries Tale
description: Embark on a fantasy RPG with four hot VTubers in the new game EmyLiveShow!

title: Fly Fly
description: Fly Fly is an endless game where players take flight as an eagle, collecting feathers while navigating through randomly generated hoops at varying distances.

title: Meteo Planet
description:
Meteo Planet is a fast-paced one-button game.

Your goal is to collect as many coins as you can without getting caught by a meteorite. Avoid meteorites while rotating around the planet's axis. The closer the coin is to the meteorite, the more points it brings, but be careful not to get hit by the meteorite itself.

title: Arcade Archives: The Final Round
description:
"THE FINAL ROUND" is a sports-action game released by KONAMI in 1988.
Train to become a boxing champion and win matches against your rivals.
If they hit you, hit them back! Hard Punchers covered in blood, win the hot fights and grab the glory!

The "Arcade Archives" series has faithfully reproduced many classic Arcade masterpieces.
Players can change various game settings such as game difficulty, and also reproduce the atmosphere of arcade display settings at that time. Players can also compete against each other from all over the world with their high scores.
Please enjoy the masterpiece that built a generation

title: Zero the Kamikaze Squirrel
description:
Who said bad guys cannot be heroes? Aero the Acro-Bat’s infamous enemy comes for some ninja squirrel action with an adventure of his own!

While working on Edgar Ektor’s evil plan, Zero receives a letter from his girlfriend telling him their forest is in danger and her father has been kidnapped. When he tells Edgar that he needs to go to protect his forest, Edgar refuses, but Zero’s leaves without permission.

Now Zero needs to head back to his forest as soon as possible, but the evil madman Edgar Ektor doesn’t take a no for an answer and is not planning to make it easy for the hero to go save his beloved forest...

title: Pixel Retro Drift: Arcade Car Racing
description: Rediscover the golden era of arcade games, feel the adrenaline and joy of high-speed 80s racing!

title: Escape From the Pharaoh's Tomb
description: Escaping from each challenging room involves solving a puzzle where you’ll aim a magic beam of light to open a magical locked door. You’ll have to contend with dangerous enemies, avoid outlandish traps, and even out-maneuver the chamber walls closing in.

title: Aero The Acro-Bat 2
description: Remaster of Aero The Acro-Bat 2.

title: Aero The Acro-Bat: Rascal Rival Revenge
description:
Help Aero rescue his friends and girlfriend, so everyone can enjoy the circus again!
The 2002 remake of Aero the Acro-Bat is back and better than ever!

This remake includes improved sprites, modified stages and skills, as well as a whole new comic-style introduction scene.

title: Boom Robots
description: Join the fray and let the battles begin - up to 8 players in local multiplayer

title: Robot vs Monsters
description: Robot vs Monsters pits you against relentless waves of foes as you control a powerful robot in a top-down world.

title: Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator
description: Strap yourself in and get ready for an adrenaline-pumping ride in Grand Rush: Highway Car Traffic Racing Simulator! This immersive racing game throws you right into the heart of bustling city traffic, where you'll need to navigate your way to victory.

title: Turn to Mine
description: Space-themed puzzles with real-time-strategy elements

title: Fashion Store Simulator
description: Step into the glamorous world of fashion retail with Fashion Store Simulator, the ultimate 3D fashion store management experience! As the owner of a burgeoning fashion boutique, you'll have the opportunity to turn your store into the go-to destination for style-conscious shoppers.

title: Tiny Whaley 2
description:
Embark on an exciting 2D adventure under the ocean!
In this puzzle platformer game, where we manage a magical and unusual whale,
we not only overcome obstacles by jumping,
but also create our own path by positioning your dead bodies at the right points.
In this adventure you have to prove not only your reflexes and speed but also your strategic and mind skills.
Determine your own strategy, Try to finish the level as fast as possible!

title: Isolation Instinct: Farming, Craft, Survival
description: Show your ability to survive! Be a part of a wild world with unlimited borders!

title: Parking Masters
description: Face the ultimate test of your parking skills!

title: Thief Puzzle
description: Steal your way to the top and become the king of thieves!

title: Arcade Archives: Tecmo Stackers
description:
"Tecmo Stackers" is a puzzle game released by TECMO in 1995.
Match the falling balls with the same color to make them disappear.
Balls near the disappeared ball will be surprised and stretch left and right, creating an unexpected chain reaction.

title: Escape: Backrooms Horror
description: Find your way through a disorienting maze as reality distorts and fear grips your mind.

title: My First Date RPG: Oriana - Story Two
Moe Waifu H: Genius
description: Win the maidens’ hearts through mastery of rhythm and memory!

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails to Azure - Limited Edition
description: The Limited Edition includes The Legend of Heroes: Trails to Azure - Deluxe Edition, "Azure Archives" Hardcover Art Book, "Anthems of Crossbell Part II" Official Soundtrack (10 Select Tracks), "New Recruits" Acrylic Stand, SteelBook, "United as One" Cloth Poster (17" x 24") and Collector's Box.

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails into Reverie - Limited Edition
description: The Limited Edition includes The Legend of Heroes: Trails into Reverie - Deluxe Edition, "Legends of Zemuria" Hardcover Art Book, "Songs of Reverie" Official Soundtrack, "Three & Nine: A Trails Tale" Softcover Novel, Steelbook, "The End and the Beginning" Acrylic Print and Collector's Box.

title: Quack Jump
description:
Jump! Yes, every time you jump there is an action and you activate the puzzles,
Get the key and pass the levels by timing the puzzles correctly with good timing!

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails through Daybreak II - Limited Edition
description: The Limited Edition includes The Legend of Heroes: Trails through Daybreak II - Deluxe Edition, Collector's Box, Art Book, Art Card Set, Digipak Original Soundtrack, Steelbook and Atlas of Calvard.

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails through Daybreak II - Deluxe Edition
description: The Deluxe Edition includes the Base Game, Digital Soundtrack and Mini Art Book.

title: My First Date RPG: Elliot - Story Two
My First Date RPG: Oriana - Story Three
My First Date RPG: Elliot - Story Three
Tiebreak+: Ace Edition
description: Play the complete tennis season in Tiebreak: Official Game of the ATP and WTA

title: A Bibelot: Prototo
description: A retro arcade game with several difficulty modes, as well as high score and best time stats.

title: Tower Hover
description: Tower Hover is an endless building game where players stack sections of a skyscraper to create the tallest structure possible. The goal is to align each new section perfectly on top of the previous one. If the placement isn't accurate, the misaligned part gets cut off, making subsequent placements more challenging. The game ends when a section completely misses the tower. How high can you build before it all comes crashing down?

title: Correct Picture
description: Correct Picture is an engaging and educational game where players are challenged to match pictures on the left with their corresponding names on the right. The objective is to correctly pair as many names with images as possible. The more correct matches a player makes, the higher their score. This game tests and improves the player's recognition and association skills, making it both fun and informative.

title: Parcel Escape
description: Help the little furry lump get out of this strange post office, where obstacles await at every turn.

title: Farm Champions: Harvest Battle
description: A unique blend of classic snake gameplay and harvesting simulators. Try out these new battle arenas and prove you are the one and only champion.

title: Flippy Jump
description: You close the door of your refrigerator and an interesting life begins inside. Fruits and vegetables try to escape from this big white cage. Break everything around you and smash through shelves to find a way out. The more precise the timing of the jump, the more powerful the impact. That's exactly what you need to succeed! Try to get out all the fruits and vegetables out of the fridge. Carrot, cucumber, sausage, and even a spoon for some reason.

title: Space Bouncer
description: In Space Bouncer, player controls a character equipped with a jetpack. Upon hitting a wall, the character bounces off and changes direction. The goal is to avoid obstacles and collect as many points as possible. As player accumulates higher scores, the game speeds up, increasing the difficulty. Navigate through the challenging environment and aim for the highest score while avoiding hazards.

title: Island Survival: Craft, Build, Grow
description: From Shipwreck to Escape: Master Survival.

title: Supermarket Manager Simulator
description: Manage your own shop! Chips, chips, meat, burgers, vegetables and fruit. Eggs, cheese, breakfast cereals, juices or milk - order all your products cheaply online and put them on the shelves.

title: Grand Prix Formula One
description: Live the intense experience of Formula One Racing !

title: Arcade Archives: The Ninja Kids
description:
"THE NINJA KIDS" is an action game released by TAITO in 1990.
Our ninja-doll heroes must battle to save their town from the evildoers who are plotting to resurrect a great evil.
Take control of one of 4 characters, who might look similar, but are as individual as they are colourful, and slice and dice your enemies with justice in your heart, and ninja magic at your fingertips!

title: Arcade Archives: Knuckle Heads
description:
Serious competition is here.

"KNUCKLE HEADS" is a fighting game released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1993.
Join the battle royale “KNUCKLE HEADS” and win cash prizes and fame.
This game can be played by up to 4 players simultaneously.
Choose one of the six very unique and powerful players and survive.

title: Worms Armageddon: Anniversary Edition
description: Worms Armageddon: Anniversary Edition is a modern release of the 1999 classic, including cross-generation console online play for up to 6 players.

title: Supermarket Simulator 2024
description:
Welcome to the world of "Supermarket Simulator 2024"! In this thrilling game, you become the owner and restorer of old and abandoned supermarkets. Your mission is to refurbish them, resume operations, and turn them into thriving shopping centers.

In "Supermarket Simulator ," you'll immerse yourself in the exciting world of business and restoration, where every decision you make matters. Are you ready to take on the challenge and turn abandoned supermarkets into thriving enterprises?

title: Mushroom Colors
description: Mushroom Colors is an exciting endless jumping game where you play as a vibrant mushroom. Your goal is to ascend as high as possible, navigating through colorful obstacles. Each obstacle matches a specific color, and your mushroom can only pass through if it matches the obstacle's hue. Collect items to change your mushroom's color and continue your ascent. Test your reflexes and see how far you can go in this challenging and colorful adventure!

title: HeliCity Demolition Man
description: Take control of a powerful demolition helicopter as you navigate through a high-stakes urban environment. Your mission? To strategically plant explosive charges in a towering construction site, all while facing off against new and unpredictable adversaries.

title: Guilty Gear Xrd: Sign - Character Colors Christmas Set
The Perplexing Orb: Bounce Challenge
description: Return to the world of The Perplexing Orb: Bounce N' Roll with this new spin off! The Perplexing Orb: Bounce Challenge takes the obstacle jumping of Bounce N' Roll and cranks it up with all new challenging stages to roll through!

title: Minefield Combat
description:
Enter the battlefield of Minefield Combat, an intense and strategic tower defense game where quick thinking and precision are your keys to survival. As waves of relentless enemies advance, you must strategically place and upgrade your mortar towers to protect your territory.

Immerse yourself in the fast-paced action with rapid consumption gameplay that keeps you on the edge of your seat. Each mortar tower boasts unique attack patterns and abilities, allowing for endless strategic combinations. Earn and manage your resources wisely to upgrade your defenses and adapt to the ever-increasing challenge.

Navigate through meticulously designed mid-poly warfare-themed environments, from war-torn landscapes to fortified trenches. Each level presents a new battlefield with its own strategic elements, ensuring no two battles are the same.

Whether you're a casual gamer or a strategic mastermind, Minefield Combat offers a thrilling and engaging defense experience for all. Prepare your defenses, upgrade your towers, and become the ultimate defender in Minefield Combat.

title: Anime Girls: Wasteland Shootout
description: Lead fearless heroines through explosive, post-apocalyptic battles.

title: Space CleanUp: Cosmic Robot Disinfector
description: Fight cosmic grime with your trusty robot disinfector!

title: Fill The Cup
description: Main challenge lies in maneuvering the water stream around various obstacles that block the direct path to the glass. However, the player doesn't have an infinite supply of water. This means that players must use their resources wisely, ensuring they avoid unnecessary obstacles and carefully plan their water usage to collect all the stars and to make a happy glass full of water.

title: Fruboom
description: Toss fruits to find their matching pairs! As you play, the fruits change color and become trickier to match, adding an exciting challenge. Designed with young players in mind, it’s a simple, kid-friendly experience perfect for even the littlest hands. Bright visuals and easy-to-understand gameplay make it a joyful adventure for all ages!

title: Zen Drift
description: A new way to experience car drifting. Enjoy every turn in a calm and easy driving. Just let your car drift and slide down the road. Catch the Zen!

title: Pin Strike
description: Bowling can be played not only in the hall and only on a straight track. And who says you can't use bombs or springs in the game?

title: Animal Battle Arena
description: Roll your tough fighting beasts into the arena and compete for the right to be the best. Even the cute panda can beat his rivals, and the turtle isn't so slow when it comes to the big animal fight.

title: Fruits' Harvest Sorter
description: Sort the fruits of this season!

title: The Jumping Donut
description: From the creative minds at The Jumping Food Games comes a brand new, delicious adventure: "The Jumping Donut". Take on the role of a juicy donut and master 27 exciting levels in this unique puzzle platformer!

title: Boys Race
description: You will have a long and difficult road to victory. You know it's better not to go it alone, right? Get your Boys together and get to the finish! Not everyone will make it, but those who do will help the others reach the finish line. It's a team effort and a team victory.

title: Space Surveyor
description: Space Surveyor is an arcade-style UFO surveying and landing game. Your objective is to collect coins, avoid enemies, and land in a designated landing spot. Master the UFO controls and rack up these high scores!

title: 2048 Snake
description: Imagine a mix of classic snake and puzzle game 2048 and there you have a unique gameplay in front of you that you can try right now. Run and grow your snake on different challenging levels and discover new big numbers on the cubes.

title: Forest Cafe
description: It's time to take care of cute animals and build a cozy cafe for them in a forest clearing. Get everything ready for the reception. Add various tasty dishes and drinks to the menu.

title: The Seed: Unit 7
description: Farm for your future in a sci-fi twist on top-down life sim adventure!

title: Arcade Archives: Finalizer Super Transformation
description:
"FINALIZER SUPER TRANSFORMATION" is a shooter released by KONAMI in 1985
The objective is to operate the variable armor combat system "FINALIZER" and save humanity from the out-of-control "Odes-30i".
Fight while powering up by making full use of the shields, various weapons, and parts that appear during the stage.

title: Gold Digger: The Simulator
description: Your Gold Rush Adventure Begins - Build Your Mining Empire.

title: Gori: Cuddly Carnage - Special Edition
description:
The Gori : Cuddly Carnage Special Edition contains :

- The full game of Gori : Cuddly Carnage
- The Neon Neko Triple Skin Pack
- The Dragon Skin Pack
- The Day One Skin Pack

title: Rooftop Rascal: The Midnight Cat
description:
In "Rooftop Rascal: The Midnight Cat," you control a clever cat navigating city buildings' fire escape stairs to the rooftop.
The gameplay centres on jumps, and quick thinking.
Your goal is to climb as high as you can and reach the rooftop.

title: Cazzarion: Treasure Diver
description: Collect a coin treasure underwater, but avoid the sea mines and the fish.

title: Cyberpunk Speed Assassin
description: Control time, strike fast, or don’t survive.

title: Learn to Play Vol. 5: Break the Blocks
Truck Simulator Cargo Driver 2024: Euro
description: Explore a meticulously recreated Europe, delivering cargo across iconic landmarks and diverse landscapes. Master the challenges of the road, manage your virtual trucker's well-being, and customize your rig to become a legend of the European trucking scene!

title: Street Survival: Homeless Simulator
description: Street Survival: Homeless Simulator plunges you into the unforgiving world of life on the streets. As a homeless individual, your daily struggle for survival is real and relentless. Set in a sprawling urban environment, the game challenges you to navigate the complexities of street life with limited resources and constant dangers.

title: Arcade Archives: Lead Angle
description:
"LEAD ANGLE" is a gun shooting game released by SEIBU KAIHATSU in 1988. You control the main character, GEORGE PHOENIX, and fight against gangsters.

Use pistols, grenades, machine guns, and shotguns to defeat the big boss "KING in the final stage.

title: World of Outlaws: Dirt Racing 24
description:
iRacing presents the Official Game of The World of Outlaws, featuring the World of Outlaws Sprint Car, Late Models and Super DIRTcar Big Block Modifieds, as well as 8 additional series including the all-new Micro Sprints, and many others.

World of Outlaws: Dirt Racing 24 features 49 tracks, including all your favorites like Eldora Speedway, Knoxville Raceway, and Volusia Speedway Park, with new additions like Kevin Harvick’s Kern Raceway, and Millbridge Speedway.

Become a LEGEND like Donny Schatz as you work your way through Career Mode in your quest to best his 10-time National Champion status. With so many combinations of cars, tracks, and experiences, your path to victory will be unique! And, don’t forget to check out the all new challenge mode where you can test your skills against Donny himself! Are you Outlaw Tough? It’s the Greatest Show on Dirt!

title: Pixicharm: Fit Frog's Feast
description: Help a lively frog collect tasty fruits while avoiding hazards. Use simple left and right controls to gather nutritious treats and enjoy a fun, stress-free experience with no lives to lose or defeats to worry about!

title: Bus Simulator Driver 2024: City Zone
description: Step into the driver's seat of a variety of meticulously detailed buses and embark on a captivating journey through bustling city streets in "Bus Simulator Driver 2024 : City Zone" As a skilled bus operator, your mission is to faithfully follow designated routes, pick up passengers, and deliver them safely to their destinations. The city's intricate traffic patterns, unpredictable road conditions, and the needs of your passengers will put your driving prowess and multitasking abilities to the test.

title: Drag Racing Professionals: Dirt Mechanic Simulator
description: Immerse yourself in the world of adrenaline, speed, and drag racing mechanics on the quarter-mile with "Drag Racing Professionals: Dirt Mechanic Simulator." Become a master of drag racing, working in the atmosphere of gritty tracks and thrilling competitions.

title: ZombFarm
description: Engage in rewarding life sim elements and farming mini games while avoiding the undead that roam the nearby woods!

title: P Fit
description:
P Fit is a puzzle game in which the player has to match the top and bottom pieces to move to the next level.

Both walls move slowly towards each other, if they touch you will have to start all over again. Your goal as a player is to last as long as possible.

title: The Jumping Ice Cube
description: From the developers at The Jumping Food Games comes a refreshing new game of skill: "The Jumping Ice Cube". In this fast-paced endless game, you play as a nimble ice cube jumping through icy challenges that test your reactions and skill. How long can you hold out and chase your high score?

title: Martian Supermarket Sim
description: Embark on an unprecedented retail adventure with "Martian Supermarket Sim," where you spearhead the first supermarket venture on the dusty red plains of Mars, within the bustling colony of New Olympus. This is more than a business—it’s a cornerstone of a new civilization.

title: Chimp Test
description: Chimp Test is an innovative and engaging memory challenge game designed to push the boundaries of your cognitive abilities and thoroughly test your short-term memory skills. Inspired by the exceptional memory feats of chimpanzees, who have demonstrated remarkable ability in recalling complex sequences with astonishing speed and precision, Chimp Test offers a unique and interactive experience for players of all ages. Whether you are a casual gamer looking for an entertaining challenge or a dedicated enthusiast aiming to sharpen your mental acuity, this game provides a dynamic platform to enhance memory, concentration, and mental agility.

title: Color Recreator
description: Test your color recreating skills!

title: Crasho Cars
description: In Crasho Cars, race through the desert while evading obstacles and police cars that crash into each other. Collect money and power-ups to survive longer. The goal is simple: stay alive as long as you can in this high-speed, chaotic chase!

title: Rooftop Rascal: The Drizzle Cat
description:
In "Rooftop Rascal: The Drizzle Cat," you control a clever cat navigating city buildings' fire escape stairs to the rooftop.

The gameplay centers on jumps, and quick thinking.
Your goal is to climb as high as you can and reach the rooftop.

title: Bubble Aim
description: Bubble Aim is an exciting game where bubbles of various colors and sizes descend from the sky. The player must shoot these bubbles, causing them to either burst or split into smaller bubbles. Each successful shot earns the player points. The objective is to shoot as many bubbles as possible without letting them fall to the ground. The game is endless, challenging players to achieve the highest score possible by continuously popping bubbles. How many bubbles can you shoot?

title: Minecraft: Astronaut Training Center
description: Wondering what's beyond our Earth or how to drive the Mars rover? Learn more about space and what it takes to be an astronaut! Visit the Space Center and follow classes to teach you the basic principles of the universe and redstone. Feel like you know everything? Test your knowledge with the tests!

title: Moo & Move
description: Guide the hungry cow to its goal! Place directional tiles on the ground and choose to solve puzzles the easy or hard way—it's up to you! Watch as the cow follows your path to reach its tasty hay in this fun, kid-friendly game!

title: 1-2-Whopping Word Search!
description: 1-2-Whopping Word Search is sequel to "1-2-Word Search!" packed with all new features! This game now utilizes multiple grid sizes for both large and small puzzles. Each level now has a hidden word to find that will unlock new music, and there are more than 10 new background themes that completely change the look and feel of the game. 1-2-Whopping Word Search! is classic word search puzzle game with a TreeFall twist! Embark on a fun and relaxing journey solving word searches while listening to the TreeFall Radio!

title: Galactic Guardian
description:
From the developers at The Jumping Food Games comes an action-packed endless game that catapults you into the depths of space: "Galactic Guardian". In this colorful, neon-lit cosmos, you'll battle enemy spaceships, destroy asteroids and collect as many stars as you can!

Neon-colored space: Immerse yourself in a breathtaking, glowing galaxy that impresses with dynamic lighting effects and colorful design on every level.

Endless fun: Destroy enemy spaceships and asteroids in an endless game that never ends - only you decide how long you survive and how high your score will be!

title: Dunk Trickster
description:
Let's play a game. A real game. On the real streets. The rule is simple - score.

You can't even imagine where streeball can be played. Discover all the locations for your best shot. Want to play at the airport? This is easy! Jump on the planes like it's your playground. Or do you want to break through the glass before the dunk? You can do it here!

title: Operation Bodycam
description:
"Operation Bodycam" offers an immersive first-person experience where players step into the role of a special unit officer, equipped with a body-worn camera that records all actions for later review. The game features realistic, tactical missions based on real-life police scenarios, such as hostage rescues and raids, requiring strategic planning and quick decision-making.

Players must navigate dynamic environments, adapt to various settings, and coordinate with AI teammates to succeed. Each choice has significant consequences, influencing the storyline and mission outcomes. A skill progression system allows for customization and improvement, while realistic graphics and sound add to the intensity of the experience.

title: Rabbit in the Clouds
description: A small game where you control a rabbit escaping from the darkness that is chasing him. You need to jump on clouds to progress and use soap bubbles to jump even higher. During the game, you can encounter several types of power-up bonuses to gain a temporary advantage.

title: Twins of Legacy: Elemental
description: Step into a unique adventure with Twins of Legacy! Play as a talented painter and a skilled musician, combining art and music to navigate through a world full of mysteries and challenges.

title: Mech Wars
description: Long ago, the Stenian race lived in harmony on the planet Xelarvis, aided by their mechas. However, everything changed when the Kaxeder race arrived. They invaded the world with the intent to destroy and conquer it.

title: Pet Kawaii Shop
description: Create the cutest pet paradise and win customers’ hearts!

title: On Sunday 2
description:
A narrative-based action game with adventure elements.

- Oppose the whimsical bosses by finding out how to pass by them
- Stay unharmed with all those different enemies
- Limited Praying power only available on some levels
- Press X to change the situation with the Prayer
- Pass through the mini story of passions and ire boiling in one tiny soul

title: Moe Waifu H: BlockBlast
description:
Meet 5 lovely female maidens and impress them with your brick breaking skills! Moe Waifu H - BlockBlast is a simple and addictive action puzzler where your goal is to clear the screen in old-school block breaking style. With each level you win, you’ll earn the hearts of your beautiful companions! There are 15 stages to master, each with multiple rounds of gradually increasing challenge.

Can you unlock all of their cute outfits and win them over?

title: Arcade Archives: vs. Battle City
description:
Take down the enemy tank corps and hold your HQ to the end!

"VS. BATTLE CITY" is a shooter released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1985.
Take control of a tank and face down your enemies while defending your own HQ!
The key to victory is to break down walls, create your own routes, lead enemies to fight where you have the advantage, and use the terrain tactically.

title: Anime Girls Military Strike
description: Step into the high-octane world of "Anime Girls Military Strike," where cute meets combat in this adrenaline-pumping first-person shooter. Gear up as one of several highly-trained anime girl operatives, each with their own unique abilities and kawaii charm. From twin-tailed snipers to genki girl grenadiers, assemble your dream team and take on missions across vibrant, anime-inspired battlefields.

title: Arcade Archives: Crime City
description:
"Crime City" is an action game released by TAITO in 1989.
Crime City is rampant with evil organizations and criminal elements.
Serious crime is an everyday occurrence.
With the local police no longer able to cope, two plain clothes officers are called in: Tony Gibson and Raymond Brody.
Players take control of this duo to solve a series of crimes, defeating the criminals using with a variety of weapons and actions!

title: Rope Hope
description:
SWING INTO ACTION!
Play as a red ball that swings from pin to pin using a rope. Perfect your timing and momentum to gain speed and overcome obstacles.

title: Secret Agent Clank
description:
A port of Secret Agent Clank, a platform video game developed by High Impact Games and published by Sony Computer Entertainment, released for the PlayStation Portable (PSP) in 2008.

In the game, Clank dons his "Secret Agent Clank" persona, which was previously seen in brief TV show segments within the main series. The story revolves around Clank working to clear Ratchet's name after Ratchet is framed for a crime he did not commit. The gameplay diverges from the traditional Ratchet & Clank format, focusing more on stealth and gadget-based play, though it retains the series' trademark humour and style.

The port is enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Reflector Satellites
description: In Reflector Satellites, you play as a space defender fighting off an endless number of enemy ships. Your opponents are ships of three colors: red, blue and yellow. Use mirrors to redirect your shots and destroy enemies more effectively.

title: Typingcommand
description: In Typingcommand, you have to defend the Earth from a continuous stream of asteroids. Asteroids fall from the sky, threatening to destroy everything in their path. Your task is to destroy asteroids before they reach the surface of the planet.

title: Tiny Starfighters
description: Embark on an exciting space adventure where you take control of a spaceship and battle endless waves of enemies across the galaxy. Collect coins as you blast through your foes and unlock new, powerful ships to enhance your journey. With every wave, the challenge intensifies—how long can you survive the cosmic chaos? Prepare to gear up and zap your way to victory!

title: TimeSplitters 2
description: TimeSplitters 2 returns, surpassing its predecessor with a larger-than-life experience. This sequel expands on every front, offering faster-paced action, richer storytelling, and diverse graphical styles across nine thrilling time-traveling adventures. From the lawless Wild West to the neon-lit streets of Neo Tokyo, each era boasts its own atmosphere and challenges.

title: TimeSplitters
description:
TimeSplitters is a renowned first-person shooter series that plunges players into an epic battle against the malevolent TimeSplitters, a race dwelling outside of time and space. Awakened from an ancient sleep, these entities tear through time's fabric to erase humanity from history. Players must unite against this common enemy or face a grim future under their shadow.

The game features a rich single-player campaign, taking players through pivotal historical moments, from ancient civilisations to futuristic landscapes, battling the TimeSplitters to alter history's course. Each era is meticulously crafted, providing an immersive experience with dynamic settings and intense action.

title: TimeSplitters: Future Perfect
description:
TimeSplitters: Future Perfect is the pinnacle of the acclaimed series, blending action, humor, and intricate storytelling. Play as Sergeant Cortez, embarking on a time-bending journey across past, present, and future to thwart the sinister TimeSplitters. Explore diverse environments from ancient temples to futuristic cities, each with unique challenges and visual splendor.

The single-player campaign is a blend of action and witty dialogue, unfolding through epic battles, puzzles, and animated cut-scenes that bring to life quirky allies and formidable adversaries. The narrative is cinematic and rich, revealing mysteries behind the TimeSplitters' plans with depth and flair.

title: The Jumping Burger Rush
description:
From the creative minds at The Jumping Food Games comes a fast-paced endless game that will put your reflexes to the test: "The Jumping Burger Rush". In this neon-colored adventure, you control a jumping burger through the vastness of the galaxy and try to push your high score higher and higher. The adrenaline-pumping gameplay will test your reflexes in a fast and challenging endless game where you have to maneuver your burger through a dangerous, neon-lit galaxy.

Endless challenges await as you dodge obstacles, overcome tricky passages, and collect points to beat your own high score over and over again. Can you manage to break your personal record time and time again, dominating the leaderboard and proving your skill by outding yourself? Jump, dodge, and maneuver your burger through the infinite galaxy, mastering the unstoppable pace to beat your high score.

title: Body Cam Shooter
description: Feel the thrill of real combat, a shooter like no other!

title: MX Dirt Bike: Unlimited Bike Experience
Learn to Play Vol. 7: Safe Journey
Survival Float Simulator: Crocodile Waters Craft, Raft, Build
description: Survive on the Raft Conquer the Swamp, Beware the Crocodile

title: SkyGunner
description: Experience SkyGunner originally released on the PlayStation 2 console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Mister Mosquito
description:
Experience Mister Mosquito originally released on the PlayStation2 console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

You are Mister Mosquito, an uninvited guest in the Yamada’s family home. You will need to drink as much of their blood as possible to survive the winter. They know you are in the house, and they plan to take you out.

title: Skater's Solstice
description: Become a master of the ice by skating your way through increasingly challenging sliding puzzles!

title: Cazzarion: Drone Flight
description: Fly through gates in a landscape with a drone and increase your high score

title: Lethal Corporation
description: A solo survival horror experience where every contract could be your last.

title: Dawning Subaru, and The Owl lurking in the twilight.
description:
The scenario for Dawning Subaru, and The Owl lurking in the twilight. is written by Momono Zappa, who won the 67th Edogawa Ranpo Award for the novel Roukou Zanmu. Character designs, CGs, and original images are handled by U35, who drafted the character designs for the TV anime The Aquatope on White.

An authentic world of mystery depicted by Momono Zappa with transparent characters illustrated by U35 come together in this new visual novel!

Additionally, the theme song is sung by Kanako Itou, who is known for her work on the theme songs for Higurashi When They Cry: Kizuna and STEINS;GATE. With its mysterious vibe and fast pace, paired with Kanako Itou’s vocals, the song is a key constructor of the game’s atmosphere.

title: Utawarerumono Trilogy Set
description: Utawarerumono: Prelude to the Fallen, Utawarerumono: Mask of Deception and Utawarerumono: Mask of Truth together as the “Utawarerumono Trilogy Set”.

title: Let's Sing 2025
description: The thirteenth main installment of the popular music game series, allowing to test our vocals. In Let's Sing 2025 we can sing songs from Ariana Grande, Billie Ellish, Ed Sheeran and other popular artists. There's a career mode and we can also play various multiplayer modes.

title: Arcade Archives: Blast Off
description: "Blast Off" is a shooter released by Namco in 1989. Use the four selectable types of equipment to defeat the resurrected Neo Bosconian. In addition, you can fire a piercing bullet by holding down the shot.

title: Let's Sing 2025 with International Hits: Platinum Edition
description:
Let's Sing 2025 brings the ultimate karaoke experience straight to your living room! Sing along with your family and friends to the latest hits, as well as a generous selection of all-time classics.
Platinum Edition: The Let's Sing 2025 Platinum edition includes 35 songs, as well as a one month free trial + 12 months of VIP Pass.

title: Let's Sing 2025 with International Hits: Gold Edition
description:
Let's Sing 2025 brings the ultimate karaoke experience straight to your living room! Sing along with your family and friends to the latest hits, as well as a generous selection of all-time classics.
Gold Edition: The Let's Sing 2025 Gold edition includes 35 songs, as well as a one month free trial + 3 months of VIP Pass.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge - Ultimate Edition
description:
This version contains the base game Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge and the DLCs :

- Dimension Shellshock
- Radical Reptiles

title: Resident Evil: Director's Cut
description: A port of Resident Evil: Director's Cut, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Path Builder
description:
Don't let your people fall down in the dark - build the path, so they can follow you to a better world.

Connect the path blocks and fill in the empty shapes to create a solid road for your friends. Try to do it in the best way possible to collect the stars. New levels will give you the new challenges. Solve all the puzzles to save all your followers!

title: Goblin in the Castle
description: Collect emeralds and avoid the ghosts!

title: Math Genius: Addition Edition
description: Math Genius: Addition Edition is a fun and educational game that challenges players with randomly generated addition problems. Players fill in the missing number in the equation by choosing one of three possible answers. Keep track of your progress with on-screen counters displaying your correct and incorrect answers. Perfect for sharpening math skills in a quick, engaging format!

title: Snake 1
description:
SNAKE 1 is a fast-paced one-button game.

Play Snake with just one button. Collect coins to score points and to make the snake grow in size. Press a button to rotate 90 degrees. You rotate clockwise initially, but you reverse your direction every time you collect a coin.

The game is over when you hit any of the borders of the screen or the snake hits its tail.

title: Herc's Adventures
description:
Herc’s Adventures is an action-adventure game originally released for the PlayStation. Set in a mythological version of ancient Greece, the story centers on the abduction of Persephone by Hades, which causes the land to fall into decline. Zeus calls upon three heroes (Hercules, Atalanta, and Jason) each with distinct abilities and weapons, to rescue her and restore balance. The game features around 40 levels inspired by Greek mythology, combining combat, exploration, and puzzle elements.

Modern re-releases include enhancements such as up-rendering, rewind, quick save functionality, and optional video filters.

title: Arcade Archives: Moon Shuttle
description:
"Moon Shuttle" is a shooter released by Nichibutsu in 1981.
Players can enjoy alternating stages in which they destroy or dodge through groups of meteors to reach the goal, and stages in which they defeat enemies with wave motion cannons.

title: B Math
description:
B MATH is a fast-paced one-button game.

Your goal is to select which one of the five numbers is the correct for the equation. You have limited time for your answer. The faster you answer, the more points you'll score. After every correct answer you get a score multiplier. After every incorrect answer, you lose some time.

The game will end when the time runs out.

title: Persona 4 Dancing All Night: Heaven featuring Hatsune Miku
description: DLC for Persona 4 Dancing All Night which allows the player to play a special versione of Heaven with Hatsune Miku as a dancer.

title: Gym Business: Fitness Empire Simulator
description: Build Your Fitness Empire – Embark on Your Dream Gym Journey!

title: Dagon: Complete Edition
description: Immerse yourself in the twisted world of H.P. Lovecraft and unearth the horrors that lie within.

title: Rookie Boxing
description: Realistic local multiplayer Boxing game

title: Amelia's Garden
description: Repair these pots and start a brand new rooftop garden!

title: Anime Dance-Off: Ghost Party
description: Step into a universe where music and movement collide in a spectacular party experience for seasoned rhythm gamers and newcomers.

title: Arcade Archives: Power Spikes
description:
The long-awaited second instalment of "Super Volleyball" with interesting competitive play!

"POWER SPIKES" is a sports game released by VIDEO SYSTEM in 1991.
This is the second installment of "Super Volleyball", and like the previous game, the controls are simple, but the battles are even more profound with techniques such as timed attacks and feints, as well as new serves added in this game.

title: Arcade Room Simulator
description: STEP INTO THE PAST!

title: Skydivers Paradise
description:
Can you take a simple step at 3 kilometers above the ground? Just hold your breath and push yourself to the limit. Everyone feels the fear, but not everyone can ignore it.

Skydiving is teamwork. Take your place in the beautiful figures at the speed of free fall. You have to stay calm and control the situation to get as many points as possible. Everyone in the team is counting on you.

title: Archery Legend
description: Unleash your archery skills! Step into the world of precision and strategy with Archery Legend. With 5 unique bows and arrows at your disposal, conquer 50 thrilling levels spread across 5 beautifully themed stages.

title: Hero Rescue
description: Do you like rescue games?

title: Scary Bucketman
description: Scary your friends to get candies!

title: Safari Puzzle Match
description:
Embark on an exciting adventure deep into the wilderness with Safari Puzzle Match!
Test your memory and sharpen your skills across four difficulty levels: Easy, Medium, Hard and Expert.
Match unique animal-themed cards in each level and strive for victory.
Capture the spirit of the safari and solve puzzles to earn rewards. The perfect memory game for nature lovers!

title: Color Swiper
description: In "Color Swiper", 30 tricky levels full of challenges await you, where you have to put your skills and strategy to the test. Use clever swiping movements to fill all the fields and solve exciting color puzzles. Sounds easy? Think again - every move counts!

title: Stretchy Adventure
description: Stretch through obstacles!

title: Horn and Shields
description: Horn and Shields is a thrilling Viking-themed game where a ship sails the sea, and shields spawn on its deck. Aim and throw horns at the shields to score points. As the game progresses, more shields appear, and the ship speeds up. How many shields can you hit? Test your skills and achieve the highest score!

title: Zombies Crusher
description: Zombies Crusher is an endless runner game set in a post apocalyptic world. Drive your car forward, crush zombies, and avoid obstacles. Earn money and score points to upgrade your vehicle. Can you achieve the highest score? Join the action and find out!

title: Anime Parody: Tentacle Slayer
description: Play as a tentacle monster, exploring a tragicomic love story from the perspective of a classic hentai villain. Encounter various QTE-style challenges without any jigsaw puzzles.

title: The King Of Fighters XIV: Ryuji Yamazaki
description: Makes Ryuji Yamazki available as an additional playable character

title: The King Of Fighters XIV: Rock Howard
description: Makes 'Rock Howard' available as an additional playable character.

title: The King of Fighters XIV: Vanessa
description: Vanessa lives a double life as a housewife and a mercenary agent. She is highly skilled in boxing and able to KO her opponents with ease.

title: The King Of Fighters XIV: Whip
description: Her background largely remains a mystery, but she closely resembles K's deceased sister “Seirah”.

title: Spearain
description:
SPEARAIN is a fast-paced one-button game.

You are constantly running from side to side. Your goal is to avoid getting hit by the spears falling from the top. Hold a button to run faster and to slow down the spears. You score one point each time you bump into a wall and reverse your direction. Collect the falling coins to score additional points.

The game is over when you get hit by a spear.

title: Unctrl
description:
UNCTRL is a fast-paced one-button game.

Your goal is to launch guided missiles and hit enemies and their projectiles. The enemies come from the right and constantly shoot. Press a button to fire a missile. The missile will always go down on its own and you can make it go up by holding a button.

The game is over when an enemy projectile hits you.

title: Arcade Archives: Violence Fight
description:
"VIOLENCE FIGHT" is a fighting game released by TAITO in 1989.
The game takes place in America of the early 1960s . Fighters gather from all parts of the USA to get the winning money and the honor by defeating all their opponents in the VIOLENCE FIGHT!

title: Spot It
description: Spot It is a game where players quickly find the one object with a different color among many. Each level gets harder with more objects. The goal is to score as high as possible by spotting the unique object quickly. How fast can you spot it?

title: Star Wars: The Clone Wars
description: The Clone Wars has you deep inside the battles of the Old Republic through 16 missions, piloting a range of vehicles including speeder bikes, Republic Gunships and fighter tanks as well as the weapon of the Jedi, your lightsabre, for close combat. Whereas the Rogue Squadron series concentrated on aerial battles, The Clone Wars contains almost all ground battles. You must fight as Anakin Skywalker, Obi Wan Kenobi, Mace Windu, and others throughout the game to prevent the Confederacy from gaining a deadly weapon. Multiplayer options are also included for up to four players with game types including deathmatch, conquest, and a co-op ground and vehicle survival mode.

title: Pet Clinic Simulator
description: Welcome to Pet Clinic Simulator, where your love for animals meets your management skills! Build and run your very own veterinary clinic in this charming, customizable arcade idle game.

title: Rooftop Rascal: The Spooky Cat
description: In "Rooftop Rascal: The Spooky Cat," take control of a nimble cat scaling fire escapes and rooftops in a Halloween-themed adventure. Test your quick thinking and jumping skills as you climb higher and higher to reach the rooftop.

title: Chained Survive Together
description: Chains Can't Hold You Back—Fight to Survive Together!

title: Mechanic Supermarket Simulator
description: Gear up and take the wheel in Mechanic Supermarket Simulator! Build, manage, and expand your very own automotive retail empire. From stocking shelves with cutting-edge car parts to mastering market trends, can you create the ultimate one-stop shop for car enthusiasts?

title: Skater Bunny Simulator
description: Unleash your skate skills and hop to new heights with Bunny Skater!

title: House of Horror: 7 Psychos
description: Face seven deadly psychopaths, each guarding a terrifying floor. Solve puzzles, avoid traps, and exploit their weaknesses to escape the nightmare.

title: Chained Climb Together
description: Balance between you and your partner, survive together! One chain - one life, prove your ability to cooperate!

title: Aquatic Life: Fish Simulator RPG
description: Dive deep into a vibrant underwater world in Aquatic Life: Fish Simulator RPG! Embark on an epic adventure as a small fish with a big destiny. Explore stunning coral reefs, vast oceans, and winding rivers as you evolve into a powerful and majestic creature.

title: Basketball Legends 24
description: Build Your Dream Basketball Team. Own Your Legacy.

title: Cazzarion: Drone Attack
description: The enemy has hidden his military vehicles in the forest. Find the military vehicles in the forest and destroy them with your Kamikaze FPV drone.

title: Kaleidoscope of Phantasm Prison 2
description: A reunion of old middle school friends in a room resembling something from an Alice in Wonderland world. With chains and collars around the girls' necks.

description: An old school and simple shoot 'em up with an adaptative difficulty.

title: Arcade Archives: Face Off
description: "Face Off" is a sports game released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1988. This is an ice hockey game played using the left and right sticks and the shoot button. Choose your favorite team from 8 types and win the tournament.

title: Arcade Archives: Metamorphic Force
description:
"METAMORPHIC FORCE" is an action game released by KONAMI in 1993.
Four young heroes arise as heirs to the goddess and divine beasts that once fought the dark lord to end his evil reign.
Transform into a beast and use your powers in battle. Unleash your wild side and destroy the enemy forces!

title: Foot Step
description: Foot Step is a game in which you need to control a little man and dodge kicks. When it comes into contact with cells, the foot will destroy them underneath it, but if the foot collides with a round object, the foot will not be able to break through it and will stop on this line, turning the round object into a regular cell. The goal of the game is to advance gradually without getting kicked or falling onto the spikes below.

title: Days Gone: Challenge Mode
description: Challenge Mode is a post-launch addition that introduced tweleve challenges focused on combat, survival, and bike skills. Each challenge has unique objectives, requiring players to fend off waves of Freakers, defeat human enemies, or complete bike stunts within specific constraints. Completing challenges awards players with patches, rings, and other rewards that grant gameplay boosts, which can be used in both the Challenge Mode and the main game.

title: Math Genius: Multiplication
description: Math Genius: Multiplication is a fun and educational game that challenges players with randomly generated multiplication problems. Players fill in the missing number in the equation by choosing one of three possible answers. Keep track of your progress with on-screen counters displaying your correct and incorrect answers. Perfect for sharpening math skills in a quick, engaging format!

title: Mechanic Supermarket 2024
description: Master the art of running a supermarket and tuning cars!

title: Arcade Archives: Riot
description: " RIOT " is an action game released by TECMO in 1992. Conquer the stages while defeating the "THE MAGIC TIGERS", warriors armed with special weapons and magic that stand in your way one after another. Enemies appear in the front and back of the screen, so you need to shoot them separately. The key to success is to make good use of various weapons and shields along the way.

title: I'm in Love With Your Dead Grandmother Presents: Noah SmallJohnson's Puzzle Game
description: In memory of a woman he never met, Noah SmallJohnson creates the most epic puzzle game ever. Featuring high-score gameplay, catchy tunes, multiple arcade modes, and a Game Show where players can win cheat codes. It’s weird, it’s wild, and it’s unapologetically heartfelt.

title: The King of Fighters XIV: Najd
description: Najd wears the Abaya (traditional Saudi garment) which has extraordinary powers, but remains humble. She lives a double life, a college student during the day, but at night, she turns into a vigilante to protect her fellow citizens from evil.

title: Arcade Archives: Vs. The Quest of Ki
description:
"VS. The Quest of Ki" is an action game released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1988.
The objective of the game is to recover the BLUE CRYSTAL ROD that has been stolen by DRUAGA.
The main character, KI, is controlled to reach the top of the tower where monsters are roaming around.

title: Bubbelsche Deluxe
description:
In Bubbelsche Deluxe you must navigate a small bubble through a long, complicated maze without colliding on the game blocks. Manage the bubble as fast and wide as possible without bursting.
You have exactly one attempt per game to make it.

title: Rev Grav
description: In "Rev Grav," you play as a cute green alien navigating through 50 challenging levels filled with puzzles and dangers. Your goal is to collect all the gold coins on each level to progress. But beware! Red aliens are lurking around, and you'll need to avoid them at all costs. A single touch from them will result in failure. Use your agility, strategy, and quick reflexes to dodge enemies, overcome obstacles, and emerge victorious.

title: The Glory of America
description: The Glory of America is an action-packed game where you run through New York as Mr. President, armed and ready to fend off zombies. Complete various mini-missions, collect points, and enjoy stunning graphics, intelligent zombie AI, and a beautifully depicted New York City.

title: Bust a Block 2
description:
From the makers of The Jumping Food Games comes the sequel to the popular puzzle game "Bust a Block". In this expansion you can expect 25 new, tricky levels in which the aim is to destroy cleverly arranged blocks with just one shot!

What can you expect in "Bust a Block 2"?

Challenging puzzle gameplay: Every action counts! Find the perfect angle and place your shot strategically to destroy all the blocks at once.

25 cleverly designed levels: Experience an ever-increasing challenge where each level surprises you with increasingly complicated block formations.

Tactics and skill: Think carefully about how you place your shot - one mistake and the blocks will stop! Will you master all the levels?

Can you make the perfect shot and destroy all the blocks in one go? Prove your skill and become the master in "Bust a Block 2"!

title: Jigsaw Puzzle Utopia
description:
Immerse yourself in the serene and satisfying world of Jigsaw Puzzle Utopia, a game designed for relaxation and mental engagement. This virtual jigsaw experience offers thousands of stunning puzzles with themes ranging from scenic landscapes and vibrant wildlife to intricate abstract art.

Choose your difficulty by adjusting the number of pieces, from beginner-friendly sets to expert-level challenges. The game’s intuitive interface makes placing pieces seamless, with features like automatic sorting, hints, and progress tracking. Enjoy soothing background music and customize your workspace for an even more immersive experience.

Jigsaw Puzzle Utopia caters to all puzzle lovers, providing endless hours of calm and joy.

title: Ramp Bike Racing
description: Can you master the ramps and become the ultimate racing champion?

title: Spot The Difference: Christmas Edition
description: Celebrate the holiday season with Spot The Difference: Christmas Edition, brought to you by the original creators of the globally beloved Spot The Difference amusement machine game!

title: VoidCraft Island Chronicles: Sky Survival
description:
In "VoidCraft Island Chronicles: Sky Survival," you find yourself as a nomadic explorer cast into the mysterious Void, a world with its own secrets and surprises. This enigmatic realm invites you to uncover its hidden mysteries and navigate its unique landscapes, each filled with challenges and unexpected encounters.
Construct and enhance your sailing vessel to better equip yourself for the journey ahead. Starting with a simple raft, you'll develop it into a formidable vessel complete with a ship's hold, mast, and captain's cabin. Customize your vessel with various objects, from storages and workbenches to decorations, making it truly your own.
As you traverse the surreal terrains of the Void, you'll confront numerous foes and navigate through ever-changing environments. Whether you journey solo or uncover unexpected twists along the way, the Void promises an unparalleled adventure waiting to be experienced, testing your survival skills and resilience.

title: The Fine Art of Murder
description:
Unravel the mystery, where every choice shapes your fate.
A supernatural gamebook brought to life, with multiple endings to discover. Fully accessible – with or without the screen.

description: You control a UFO. Score points by reflecting bullets back at your enemies. You can change direction by pressing a button or hitting the sides of the screen. Hold a button to enhance your power.

"FINAL BLOW" is a sports-action game released by TAITO in 1989.
Players choose one of five boxers and compete against the remaining four to become champion.
In addition to weak, medium, and strong punches, you can also use switch between low and high blow to take advantage of your opponent's openings.
Step into the ring and face the most fearsome fighters in the world!

In "Sunforge Solar Survival," you find yourself in a futuristic world of floating islands, harnessing the power of sunlight to thrive. You'll have the opportunity to build advanced structures, cultivate food, craft innovative gadgets, and embark on airship journeys to explore distant islands suspended in the sky.
Use renewable energy sources such as sunlight, wind, and water to power your creations and automate essential processes like resource gathering and irrigation.
"Sunforge Solar Survival" offers a unique blend of survival gameplay, technical innovation, and exploration, making every moment a quest for sustainable living in a beautiful and challenging environment.

Enjoy air traffic control by simply selecting commands!

Aircrafts appear one after another at Centrair, which has only one runway. Challenge the “MASTER” stage, the most difficult in the series!

This arcade re-release includes adjustable difficulty settings, authentic arcade display options, and online leaderboards for competitive high-score challenges.

title: My First Gran Turismo
description:
My First Gran Turismo is a free-to-play, beginner-friendly introduction to the world of racing, crafted to bring the excitement of Gran Turismo to new players. Whether you’re a parent introducing your family to racing or a longtime fan revisiting the series, My First GT captures the essence of those unforgettable first laps in a streamlined, approachable experience.

In My First Gran Turismo, players can unlock achievements by completing a variety of fun and engaging challenges that introduce essential racing techniques, such as cornering, braking, and acceleration. As you progress at each level, you will encounter increasingly intricate tracks and vehicles, each designed to build confidence and refine your driving skills, from basic to more advanced techniques, all in pursuit of mastering the craft of racing.

-Find your Line as you unlock various achievements and set record times across an array of challenges, including three Race Events, Time Trials and License Tests.

-Feel the exhilaration of driving 18 unique cars through a variety of scenarios that sharpen your racing craft on three iconic Gran Turismo circuits: Kyoto Driving Park, Deep Forest Raceway, and Trial Mountain Circuit.

description:
Who cares about the ordinary cards? And only the chosen few know that they can be a real treasure! Your collecting dreams can come true.

Open a trading card shop in your town and expand across the world. Let the passionate come to you and find something special. Create an iconic place for your friends to gather!

Expand and upgrade your store. Become a true perfectionist and turn this boring space into a stylish home for collectors.

Organize the space - add new features so everyone can find what they are looking for. Open new zones for customers to buy, trade or play in.

Search for rare collections and sell them in your store. Find the diamonds for you and your special collections!

Make your store and card collection the best in the world!
