Your main objective is to buy stocks at a low price and sell them for maximum profit. But beware: the market can crash at any moment, causing the value of your investments to plummet. Your goal is to make as much money as possible while avoiding bankruptcy! Success hinges on your ability to take calculated risks and act swiftly.

description: In a faraway realm, the benevolent Eldritch Crafters have entrusted you with a powerful artifact: the Dreamcore. description: Set sail into the unknown in RAF Survival - Ocean Shark Survivor, where every wave could spell adventure or doom! Stranded on a precarious makeshift raft, your journey begins in the vast, shimmering expanse of the ocean. With nothing but your wits and determination, transform your humble vessel into a floating sanctuary of survival!

Hop on your sleigh, fly over a bustling town, decide who's been good or bad and deliver lots of wonderful presents to all the happy townsfolk.
Watch out for obstacles in the sky! Can you make it in time for Christmas?

title: Truck Simulator 25: American Driver
description: Truck Simulator 25 - American Driver invites you to an exciting adventure on the roads of America, progressing through levels set in diverse locations — from industrial zones to quiet suburbs and the bustling city center. From hauling cargo across diverse landscapes to managing your trucking business, this game brings the thrill of the road to life. Your task is to deliver goods on time, improving your driving skills and upgrading your trucks as you go.

Immerse yourself in beautifully animated vistas from the farthest reaches of the universe - feast your eyes on the many futures and pasts from the great beyond. The application can also function as a screen saver displaying date and time over the scapes and at a touch of a button can turn each scene into a jigsaw puzzle providing you with entertainment. description:
Get ready to explore over 50 newly designed courses that are not only challenging but also super fun!

There are three fantastic worlds to choose from - a beautiful green park, a camping site in the mountains and a dreamy sandy beach.

Choose between two exciting game modes: take on the challenge in Challenge mode or compete against the AI or your friends in Tournament mode. You can also compete with up to 4 players in local multiplayer mode.

Receive medals for your great achievements - such as an impressive hole-in-one! Show off your skills and leave the competition behind.

So grab your club and bring the whole family - the ultimate MiniGolf experience awaits!

title: Sector Beam
description: A small arcade game where the player needs to destroy asteroids of different colors using an energy beam. The cannon, controlled by the player, automatically targets the nearest asteroid but only within one of four sectors. To succeed, the player must select one of the four surrounding sectors and shoot the closest asteroid with a beam of the matching color. The score multiplier increases as long as no mistakes are made but resets to the base value if an error occurs. There is also a rank multiplier that increases upon reaching specific milestones. Scoring a million points is considered an excellent result, though it’s far from the limit. The game ends if an asteroid hits the platform three times.

title: Let's Compare the Speed of Our Punches!

description:
"The Super Dimension Fortress Macross" is a shooting game released by Banpresto (now Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1992.
This title is based on the film "The Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?".
Pilot the VF-1 Valkyrie, a variable fighter that can transform into three different forms using transformation items and equip optional parts. Use shots and reaction bullets to battle the enemy Zentraedi forces.

title: Arcade Archives: Warrior Blade
description:
Hear the murmur of fate:
“Go forth hero, to the kingdom at the end of the earth!”

WARRIOR BLADE is a beat ‘em up game released by TAITO in 1992.
Rastan the thief and his allies set out for Depon, at the ends of the earth, in search of the treasure said to hidden there.
This is the third game in the Rastan series, released in arcades as a two-screen cabinet, allowing for an enlarged play area and driving soundscapes to enhance this spectacular action adventure!

title: Tsumi no Hikari Rendezvous
description:
In front of the lone tunnel leading out from the small village of Tamasato, Yuuto draws a picture of a mermaid living in the deep ocean where light does not reach. One day, he looked up from his drawing and there was a girl in front of him who looked just like the one on his canvas. She called herself a ‘sinner’ who came to this town to repent for her sins. Yuuto and the townspeople welcomed the girl, Ai, to their town.

Come spring, the entrance ceremony was underway. The new students took pictures and videos in front of the school with their parents to commemorate this special day. However, it was a depressing event for Yuuto, who lives alone after the death of his father and the abandonment by his mother and older sister. While he had gotten used to it, this time he suddenly felt very lonely due to the recent passing of grandmother, the sole close relative he had left.

Upon finding out about Yuuto’s loneliness, Ai confided that she was abandoned by her parents. She searched for a reason for living, whereas he ran away from reality through his imaginative drawings. Even though they were polar opposites, their backgrounds also made them quite similar. Gradually, they became closer to each other, while harbouring secrets of their own.

title: Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii - Collector's Edition
description:
A new legend begins as you step into the steel toe boots of Goro Majima, a man who has lost his memory and reinvents himself as a pirate on the open sea.

Embark on an over-the-top, modern-day pirate adventure with an ex-yakuza, now pirate captain and his crew as they engage in exhilarating combat on land and sea in the hunt for lost memories and a legendary treasure.

You don't need Mishelin Star to create the best restaurant in the world. Who says street food can't be delicious?

Start a real street food restaurant in your city and make it a legend. It's all for your beloved customers and let everyone visit you and find something tasty. Make this place trendy and watch your business grow!

Expand and upgrade your restaurant. Every guest will feel the fusion of the simple street food and amazing taste. Be a perfectionist and create something unique even in such a trivial place.

Manage the restaurant - add tables and new thematic spaces. Open new zones and add new dishes. Experiment with the menus and the ingredients. It's all up to you!

Let everyone taste and fall in love with your delicious street food!

Zombie Blocks: Pixel Shooter Gun offers a unique blend of blocky graphics and intense gameplay in a world full of zombies and challenges. Prepare for endless adventures and prove that you can survive in this dangerous world!

Match them before they touch the target, and your score will climb, earning up to 3 stars for your performance. Fail to match them and you’ll lose hearts!

Each girl’s expressions will change in reaction to your gameplay, so don’t let them down! Can you unlock all their cute outfits, fill your gallery and complete the jukebox to win them over?

Each jump will change the direction and you can jump mid air as many times as you want, but you will quickly lose impulse, so be careful.

You'll score points by climbing, and you'll get a big score bonus with each coin you catch, but as soon as you fall, it's game over.

title: MediEvil II
description:
A port of MediEvil 2, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

MediEvil 2, or MediEvil II in its NA release, is an action-adventure game originally developed by SCE Cambridge Studio and published by Sony Computer Entertainment. Released in 2000 for the PlayStation, it is a sequel to the original MediEvil and continues the story of Sir Daniel Fortesque.

Set in Victorian-era London, the game follows Sir Dan as he is resurrected once again to stop a sorcerer named Lord Palethorn, who has unleashed chaos by reanimating the dead using pages from Zarok's spellbook. The gameplay combines hack-and-slash combat, exploration, and puzzle-solving, with new weapons, levels, and enemies. The game introduces unique features such as a ghostly ally, Kiya, and new mechanics like controlling Dan’s detached head for specific puzzles.

Step into a beautifully crafted world where colorful rubber ducks bob and weave across a shimmering water track, each one waiting to test your sharpshooting skills. From classic yellow ducks to rare golden specimens and tricky color-changing variants, every target brings its own challenge and rewards.

The game captures the authentic feel of vintage carnival attractions with its warm, glowing lights, hand-painted wooden booth designs, and cheerful carnival music that'll transport you straight back to those summer fairground memories.

title: Crime Opera II: The Floodgate Effect
description:
Experience a new chapter in the mafia tale surrounding the Gallos family! This story begins 9 years after the original. Xander Gallo is now bitter, alone and out of control. He’s causing problems for not only other families within the syndicate but also for younger Gallo members as well. Those who remained behind to continue the family legacy are soon forced to take sides with or against Xander Gallo, while others who have seemingly moved on with their lives are pulled back in against their will.

This is a tale of loyalty and deceit, murder and survival, as well as the strength or frailty of familial bonds. As a visual novel, Crime Opera II: The Floodgate Effect allows players the option of witnessing events in linear “kinetic” fashion or to affect how the narrative progresses by making key decisions along the way, all depicted with meticulously hand-drawn character portraits, a wide variety of scenes and scenarios to explore, original backgrounds and a soundtrack to fit the brooding and dangerous atmosphere.

title: Dropship: United Peace Force
description:
Dropship is an action game set in the year 2050. Terrorist attacks have increased severely, which is why big nations of the world decided to form the UPF, "United Peace Force", replacing the UN and NATO. It is an anti-terror army, operating world-wide.

But there is another globally operating group: A massively militarised drug syndicate. When an attack on a peace convoy in Columbia is linked to this cartel, the UPF starts investigation. A central base and training camp of the drug cartel is believed to be located somewhere in Libya. The UPF opens up a base in this country and starts looking for the criminals.

The player is a recently recruited soldier and pilot of the UPF. During the campaign, which lasts for 20 rather long missions, he can travel and fight on foot, in tanks and various other ground vehicles, but most of the time he will be piloting a dropship, either of the attack, defender or transport class. Dropships can operate in hover and flight mode, and carry a large amount of weapons and cargo.

With gorgeous artwork and steamy, suggestive content, Dating Stories gives an experience for those seeking both charm and challenge.

description: Othello is a 1984 digital adaptation of Reversi featuring straightforward rules that demand strategic depth without relying on chance. Players flip opponent pieces by sandwiching them between their own, aiming to control the board through tactical positioning. The game includes practice tools such as move evaluation and undo functions to help players develop their skills. This arcade re-release offers adjustable difficulty settings, authentic arcade display options, and global leaderboards for competitive play.

It feels real — the old, abandoned school, the dark corners, and hidden secrets. You can almost touch the worn walls and feel the cracks beneath your fingertips.

It’s terrifying — the madman is out there, lurking. Be careful with every step. Stay sharp. This place may look deserted, but it hides terrible secrets.

Pay close attention to the clues — they might lead you back to where it all began. Only you have the power to put an end to it. Open the door and step into the nightmare.

title: Paranormal Watcher
description:
Paranormal Watcher invites you into the eerie world of paranormal hunting from a safe distance but don’t let the safety of the screen fool you. As a remote paranormal investigator, you’re tasked with monitoring haunted locations through surveillance cameras. Your mission: detect and report every unsettling anomaly that creeps into view, from flickering lights to ghostly apparitions.

Paranormal activity you capture isn’t always obvious objects might move, shadows could shift, and figures may emerge from the darkness. Only your sharp eye and quick reflexes can catch the disturbances in real time and fix the scene by filing accurate anomaly reports. But beware: the ghosts might be watching you, too.

"VS. MYSTERY TOWER" is an action puzzle game released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1986.
The Mystery Tower is an ancient structure full of secrets that stretches up to the heavens. You play as an archaeologist, seeking its peak on an adventure.

Curse Warrior is a dungeon crawler RPG where you explore and conquer the underground labyrinth “Eclipse,” filled with curses.

In the dungeon, your party members may become cursed through various actions.

Since curses alter the abilities and actions of your party members, players must constantly monitor the state of their party and make crucial decisions on how to proceed. Build stronger characters while managing and adjusting the effects of curses to successfully clear the dungeon.

title: Sono Hi no Kemono ni ha
description:
Ritsuki, his younger sister Runa and childhood friend Mayu attend a school that is popular for its drama activities, with many of its graduates going on to become famous actors and scenario writers. Shortly after the entrance ceremony, they were invited by their classmate Inori to join the drama club. Ritsuki was eager to aim for the school’s primaries for the national competition, but first year students were forbidden from participating in the contest. They wouldn’t accept the fact that they were excluded just because they didn’t have much experience. If only they were given the opportunity to demonstrate their acting abilities…

Rumour has it that there is a ghost that haunts the theater. It is said that it will grant any wish so long as it is related to drama.
