title: The Lost Dino: Survival Expedition
description: The jungle hides more than predators.

title: Chained Up Together
description: The chain binds you… but can it save you?

title: Renai Karichaimashita: Koikari - Love For Hire: Limited Edition
description:
Because of his family's unique circumstances, the only thing Yuki put his faith in was that "Money will make my little sister happy." To this end, he regularly worked a part-time job until late at night.

His goals were to graduate as soon as possible and get a full-time job. But, one day as he was leaving for work, his little sister told him, "If Yuki isn't going to college then I won't either." He knew he couldn't put such a burden upon his little sister.

So, in order to gather the necessary sum of money to enter university, Yuki signed up for a "human employment rental" website. It seemed extremely suspicious, but desperate times call for desperate measures.

He starts his new job...and for some reason, a girl in his class asks him to be her pretend boyfriend. Then he's hired to pretend to be a woman's lover, another girl's friend, and even the older brother to a pair of twins!

The details of his fake relationships with these girls begin as soon as he takes their money!

This edition includes:
- B2 tapestry
- Theme song CD
- Acyrlic key chain

title: Arcade Archives: Juno First
description:
"Juno FIRST" is a shooter released by KONAMI in 1983.
Operate your own aircraft to defeat countless approaching enemy UFOs and conquer the WAVE.
In an emergency, you can use warp to evade enemy attacks.

title: Magnitude: Gamma
description:
Radiation is accelerating the rogue electron incursion.

The core must remain protected in order to prevent a nuclear disaster.

title: Speeder Ship
description: Speeder Ship is an exhilarating endless runner game set in tunnels where players must navigate obstacles, collect points, and seize special items that grant temporary invincibility, double scores, or time slowdowns. As player accumulate points, the pace quickens, intensifying the challenge. Dodge obstacles, gather points, and push your reflexes to the limit in this adrenaline-fueled adventure!

title: Crowd Fighters
description: Call out the heroes and defend your fortress!

title: Firefighting Heroes: Truck 911 Simulator
description: Gear up and answer the call with "Firefighting Heroes: Truck 911 Simulator." Step into the role of a dedicated firefighter in this thrilling simulation, where you'll tackle fires across over 30 diverse areas inspired by real American locations. Experience the urgency of emergency response as you drive fire trucks, wield authentic firefighting tools, and save lives in a variety of challenging scenarios.

title: Heist Simulator: Urban Thief Shadows
description: Step into the thrilling world of "Heist Simulator: Urban Thief Shadows," where your dreams of masterful heists come to life. As a skilled thief, you'll navigate a series of daring robberies, from simple snatches to elaborate capers. Plan your operations meticulously, equip yourself with advanced tools, and upgrade your skills to become the ultimate heist artist.

title: Arcade Archives: Senkyu
description:
Aim for the winning SENKYU KING!!

"SENKYU" is a puzzle game released by SEIBU KAIHATSU in 1995.
The game is played by connecting four or more balls of the same color and erasing them to create a chain of four or more balls of the same color, aiming for a high score.
In addition to the SKILL TESTER MODE where you can judge your own skill, you can also participate in the SENKYU tournament and aim for the victory in the NORMAL MODE, as well as engage in 2-player versus battles.

title: Monster Popper
description: Step into a world full of fast-paced action and mischievous monsters! Monster Popper is a dynamic action platformer where you play as a young hero armed with a powerful energy blaster. Your mission is to eliminate waves of crazy, bouncing creatures and defeat giant bosses that threaten the magical kingdom.

title: Heroes Sky Legends
description: Heroes Sky Legends is a thrilling airplane shooter with simple yet challenging gameplay. Control your fighter by tapping the screen to dodge enemy planes and missiles while collecting ammo to fight back. Your plane can withstand two hits, but beware of the first, when your controls weaken. Grab repair power-ups to stay in the game. How high can you score?

title: Platformer Saga
description: Embark on an exciting journey through vibrant worlds in Platformer Saga, a nostalgic yet modern take on classic platforming action. Play as a brave adventurer, running, jumping, and smashing through levels filled with secrets, enemies, and golden coins.

title: Schoolboy Escape
description: Sneak, Think, Run

title: Tile Jong
description: Good tile?

title: Extreme Catch: Boat Crab & Fishing Simulator
description: Set sail on an exhilarating maritime journey with "Extreme Catch: Boat Crab & Fishing Simulator." Step into the role of a professional crab catcher navigating the treacherous waters of Alaska. Manage your ship, tackle dangerous weather, and capture crabs in the vast Bering Sea. Experience thrilling quests and challenges as you strive to build your fortune and become a legend on the open seas.

title: Bee Flowers: Royal Garden
description: Are you ready to lead the swarm and let your mind bloom?

title: Fight Club World
description: FCW - Fight Club World - Inspired by Fight Club is an exciting and intense fighting game that puts players in the shoes of skilled combatants from all over the world. The game offers a variety of characters to choose from, each with their unique fighting style and backstory.

title: Train Sim World 5: Thomas & Friends Edition
Arcade Archives: Land Sea Air Squad
description:
"Land Sea Air Squad" is an action game released by TAITO in 1986.
Players take on the role of Sergeant SARGY and advance through rounds destroying enemy fortifications.
In addition to hand grenades and machine guns, make full use of super mechs to break through the battlefield.

title: A Prison Digging Game
description: You are in prison and want to escape. To do so, you can only dig a hole. Luckily, you have a map in hand. Read it carefully and use your digging power to find your way to freedom. Look for fossils, pipelines, and antique objects to locate yourself on the map.

title: Thief Snatch & Run
description: Steal smart. Move fast. And remember — the cake is worth it.

title: Star Archer
description: Star Archer is an arcade game in which you control an archer who is tasked with shooting down oncoming stars. These star threats gradually get closer, and if you make contact with any of them, the game will end. Your goal is to survive as long as possible and achieve the highest score by shooting down as many stars as possible. How long can you last before the stars overwhelm you?

title: StackZap
description: StackZap is a game about stacking up differently colored balls in rows, columns and diagonals of 3 or more of the same color. You get points not for clearing them, but based on a distance that the remaining balls fall. There are 5 colors of the balls: red, green, blue, yellow, gray. The game is over when any of the balls is outside the play field.

title: Puzzle Wars
description: Use your brain to win the battle!

title: Operation: Hostage Rescue
description: Gear up. Get in. Get them out!

title: Flying Sushi
description: Flying Sushi is a fast-paced, side-scrolling arcade game where you control a sentient piece of sushi as it soars through the air. Navigate through endless obstacles while collecting bonuses and power-ups to rack up the highest score possible. How far can you go in this quirky and fun adventure?

title: Cat From Hell: Cat Simulator
description:
In this game you're about to destroy the grandma's house. Knock over priceless vases, shred curtains mid-nap, and bat heirlooms into oblivion! Whether it's eating the fish from the aquarium, breaking flower pots, or throwing random items across the room, a cat simulator lets you do it all.

Scratch carpets, couches, and any furniture in sight as you explore different rooms filled with destructible objects. Every scratched sofa and shattered plate fuels Granny’s escalating rage. How much havoc can you unleash before she snaps?

title: Vagrus: The Riven Realms - Praetor Edition
Guilty Gear Xrd: Rev 2 - Character Colors: Baiken
description: This DLC will add five more Baiken character color palettes to the game 'Guilty Gear Xrd REV 2.'

title: Guilty Gear Xrd: Rev 2 - Character Colors: Bedman
description: This DLC will add five more Bedman character color palettes to the game 'Guilty Gear Xrd REV 2.'

title: Ballon Jump
description: Ballon Jump is an exciting endless jumping game where you play as a the ballon. Your goal is to ascend as high as possible, navigating through colorful obstacles. Each obstacle matches a specific color, and your ballon can only pass through if it matches the obstacle's hue. Collect items to change your ballon's color and continue your ascent. Test your reflexes and see how far you can go in this challenging and colorful adventure!

title: Collectible Cars Shop Simulator
description:
Why settle for ordinary cars when some are real treasures? Live the collector's dream!

Open your own collector car shop and make it an international success. Welcome car enthusiasts and help them find rare and special models. Create a place where fans feel at home!

Upgrade and style your shop. Turn a simple shop into a stunning space for collectors.

Organise everything - add smart features to make shopping easier. Create zones for buying, trading and displaying cars. Add space for the races and let the best win!

Search for hidden gems and sell them to eager customers. Find rare cars to complete your collection!

title: Arcade Archives: Assault Plus
description:
"ASSAULT PLUS" is a shooter released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1988.
Take control of a tank and do battle with enemies! Using separate controls for your left and right treads, the game has a distinctive charm once you master its controls.
This title features minor upgrades over its predecessor, "ASSAULT," offering new stages to play while retaining the fun of the original!

title: Capy's Quest
description: Become the best chef on the summer islands!

title: Desert Tank Chaos
description:
Desert Tank Chaos – The Battle in the Desert Begins!

Can you survive the chaos in the scorching desert? Desert Tank Chaos is an action-packed tank warfare game! Fight your way through 6 uniquely designed levels, commanding your powerful tank against relentless enemies. But beware—it's not just rival tanks you'll face! Deadly aircraft patrol the skies, strategic watchtowers guard key locations, and enemy soldiers are ready to ambush you at any moment.

Use your heavy artillery, dodge incoming attacks, and find the best way to survive in the desert! Think tactically, plan your assaults, and conquer the battlefield amidst the chaos.

Are you ready, Commander? The desert awaits!

title: Masters Bowling HD
description: Multiplayer true-physics bowling game, up to 4 players

title: Sprint for Survival
description: Run like your life depends on it — because it does.

title: Valentine Revolution
description: Valentine Revolution is a high-energy, arcade-style shooter where you control Cupid in a heart-shaped hovercraft, shooting Valentine’s Day-themed objects like chocolates, hearts, and rings. Clear waves of romantic icons, dodge enemy attacks, and conquer increasingly challenging levels in this whimsical, love-filled adventure!

title: Twin Colliders
description: In this small arcade game, the player controls two catchers simultaneously—one on the right and one on the left. In the game, particles always move toward each other, and they must be caught at the point of collision using either the right or left catcher. If an annihilation is missed and it explodes, the player will lose one heart. Losing three hearts results in a game over.

title: Mortal Kombat X: Klassic Fatalities 1
description: Get four Klassic Fatalities from the original Mortal Kombat. Includes fatalities for Scorpion, Sub-Zero, Sonya and Johnny Cage.

title: Mortal Kombat X: Klassic Fatalities 2
description: Get four Klassic Fatalities from Mortal Kombat 2. Includes fatalities for Mileena, Kitana, Kung Lao and Jax.

title: Pixel Warrior
description: Only forward - towards the enemies! Without fear!

title: World Cup Soccer 2026
description: Get ready to experience the thrill of international soccer like never before in World Cup Soccer 2026! Whether you're battling it out in a high-stakes World Cup tournament or just enjoying a casual friendly match, this game brings all the excitement of the beautiful game to your console.

title: Mortal Kombat X: Kold War Scorpion
description: Play as Kollective Kold War Scorpion. Created by fan artist fear-sas, contributor to the MK Kollective.

title: Water Sort Challenge
description: Dive into a relaxing yet brain-teasing puzzle game where your goal is to sort colorful liquids into the correct bottles until each one holds only a single color. With 1,000 carefully designed levels, the challenge gradually increases—from simple and satisfying early stages to truly demanding logic puzzles that will put your brain to the test. Whether you're looking to unwind or train your mind, this game offers the perfect blend of fun, focus, and colorful satisfaction.

title: Port Logistics Simulator: Dockside Harbor Handling
description: Run the docks. Master the cargo. Rule the port.

title: JDM Pixel Street Car Racing
description: Race fast, drift hard, and claim victory in pixel streets.

title: Gym Lifting Hero: Tile Master
description: Gym Lifting Hero: Tile Master is a game that uses Tile Match combined with fitness elements to create a special and one-of-a-kind training environment.

title: Arcade Archives: Gangbusters
description:
"GANGBUSTERS" is an action shooter released by KONAMI in 1988.
Control SMITH & WESSON as they capture THE DAGRUS MOB, the gang that robbed THE GRANT BANK.
Use a limited number of bullets to catch THE RED GANG and replenish and power up your ammunition as you aim for the final stage.

title: Hook: Complete Edition
description: Unwind and challenge your mind with Hook

title: Arcade Archives: Tatakae! Big Fighter
description:
"Tatakae! Big Fighter" is a shooter released by Nichibutsu in 1989.
In this game, you can switch between fighter jet and robot form during battle.
The key to clearing a stage is to strengthen your ship with power-up items that appear along the way and change its shape to suit the situation.

title: UFO Builder
description: Meet the new kind of UFO!

title: The Flying Car
description: The Flying Car is an exhilarating endless runner game set in tunnels where players must navigate obstacles, collect points, and seize special items that grant temporary invincibility, double scores, or time slowdowns. As player accumulate points, the pace quickens, intensifying the challenge. Dodge obstacles, gather points, and push your reflexes to the limit in this adrenaline-fueled adventure!

title: Weed Drug Empire
description: Step into the shadows of a world where power is taken, not given. In this underground simulator, you're building more than a business—you're creating an empire from nothing. No cash, no allies—just ambition, strategy, and the will to rise. Every move matters. Every mistake leaves a mark.

title: Army Bus Driving Simulator
description: Your task is to safely transport soldiers between bases through difficult routes, overcoming off-road terrain, checkpoints and other obstacles.

title: Beat Heaven Symphony
description:
In Beat Heaven Symphony, rhythm isn’t just heard — it’s felt.
With 20 unique tracks, every beat is a challenge, every note a step in your musical journey.
From Easy to Expert, test your timing and let your fingers dance.
Hit the right keys at the right moment and become the master of rhythm.
The music is rising... the stage is yours, the tempo is with you!

title: Remember Easter
description: Celebrate the special day with Remember Easter, a festive card-matching memory game perfect for all ages! Flip cards to reveal delightful Easter-themed icons like bunnies, eggs, and chocolate, while testing your memory across increasing levels of fun and challenge. With cheerful visuals, cozy music, and endless holiday spirit, it’s the perfect way to make your gaming season merry and bright!

title: Taxi Simulator Driver: NY City Rides
Strawberry Jumping Journey
description: Embark on the Strawberry Jumping Journey and help the strawberry navigate through the forest! With countless obstacles blocking her path, you'll need to rely on the power of the quadruple jump to overcome them. Stay focused and survive as long as possible to achieve the highest score!

title: Sunseed Island
description: Welcome to Sunseed Island, a calming farming simulation where you create your own magical paradise. Grow crops, build up your farm, and rebuild your village, while discovering the secrets of the Tree of Life. This cozy experience lets you settle into a slow rhythm, whether you want to explore the sunny island archipelago or simply relax while tending to your land.

title: Atari Recharged Collection 3
description: The Atari Recharged Collection 3 includes Yars: Recharged and Caverns of Mars: Recharged.

title: Atari Recharged Collection 4
description: The Atari Recharged Collection 4 includes Missile Command: Recharged and Gravitar: Recharged.

title: Hell Froze Over
description: In this puzzle game you freeze the enemies into solid cubes by guiding them to an Ice Crystal. Move the enemies around and match them into lines of 3 or more to destroy them. Finish all 21 levels of mind-bending puzzle!

title: Toy Drop Balance Challenge
description: Toy Drop Balance Challenge is an endless arcade game that tests your precision and balancing skills. Toys drop from above, landing on a tower of blocks. Your goal? Tap to destroy blocks, score points, and keep the tower balanced. The higher the score, the greater the challenge how long can you keep your tower standing?

title: Sky Revolver
description: Sky Revolver is a guns blazing old-school shoot-em-up game just like they did in ‘90s! You play as a hotheaded space pilot destined to destroy the evil Empire. Your main goal is to survive through the endless waves of enemy spaceships and shuttles and to defeat the high command!

title: The Jumping Bird
description: The Jumping Bird is an exciting endless jumping game where you play as a the bird. Your goal is to ascend as high as possible, navigating through colorful obstacles. Each obstacle matches a specific color, and your bird can only pass through if it matches the obstacle's hue. Collect items to change your bird's color and continue your ascent. Test your reflexes and see how far you can go in this challenging and colorful adventure!

title: My Summer Drive
description: Craft your ride and master the endless journey.

title: Urban Showdown
description: One city. One fighter. Too many problems.

title: Mister Scary
description: A halloween-themed side-scrolling platformer for the Nintendo Entertainment System, developed by calgames. Featuring a purple monster named Mister Scary, who is searching for his family.

title: Irem Collection: Volume 3
description:
Release Date: 2025

* Limited to a maximum of 4,000 copies worldwide
* Manual included
* Mr. Heli/Battle Chopper (Arcade, PC Engine). Guide a cute heli through winding levels and buy upgrades in a shop along the way. Mr. Heli features fresh gameplay and beautiful graphics.
* Mystic Riders (Arcade). A quirky horizontal Shooter in a bright fantasy setting with wizards as protagonists.
* Dragon Breed (Arcade). Featuring impressive graphics and gameplay reminiscent of R-Type, ride your invincible dragon through a dark fantasy world.

title: Airplane Flight Simulator: Combat Zone
description: Prove Yourself as the Ultimate Pilot!

title: Aircraft Legends: Flight Academy Simulator
description: Your Gateway to the Skies – Experience the Most Realistic Flight Simulator and Soar Like Never Before!

title: Arcade Archives: Pinball Action
description:
"PINBALL ACTION" is a pinball game released by TEHKAN (KOEI TECMO GAMES) in 1985.
Try to clear all the features on all four tables, switching between them over the game!
Use tricks to shake the tables, control the ball, and seize any chance at a win!

title: Medieval Supermarket Shop Simulator
description: Your adventure in medieval business starts here!

title: The Quintessential Princesses: Fantasy, Abyss, and Magic Academy
description: Your goal is to become the private tutor of five underperforming quintuplets on the verge of flunking out of the Magic Academy, and guide them toward graduation.

title: Space KaBAAM: Neon II
description:
Join the Neon strike team as they continue to fight against an invading enemy force.
- Pick your shots and be careful not to overheat your weapon
- Master evasion for a greater chance of survival
- Use currency to purchase permanent upgrades

title: Candy Storm Bunny Catcher
description: Candy Storm Bunny Catcher puts you in the paws of a speedy bunny racing to collect falling candies while dodging bombs from the sky! Rack up points as the sugary storm intensifies, with everything falling faster and faster. Move left and right to avoid danger, catch as much candy as you can, and aim for the highest score. How many points can you earn before the storm overwhelms you?

title: Guest Rush
description: Become the ultimate housekeeper in this fast-paced retro arcade challenge! Clean hotel rooms as quickly as possible to keep the guests happy and the hotel running. Inspired by classic 80s games, Guest Rush delivers pixel-perfect nostalgia with charming 8-bit visuals and sounds. Can you keep up with the rush?

title: Reflex Master: Sight
description: Reflex Master: Sight is a fast and simple reflex game that puts your reaction speed to the test! Watch closely and click as soon as the signal appears. Your total reaction time across 5 quick rounds determines your final score—and your rank! Can you beat your personal best and rise above the rank of Snail? A perfect pick-up-and-play experience for sharpening reflexes and challenging friends offline!

title: Twist It
description: Twist it is an endless arcade game in which the player moves along a twisting branch, turning left or right to avoid obstacles. The game challenges reflexes and timing, as the branch is constantly accelerating and requires quick decisions to keep you on the right path.

title: Pretty Girls Game Collection 4
description: A collection of four games in the Pretty Girls mini-games series on a single PS4 disc / Switch cart. The bundle includes Pretty Girls 2048 Strike, Pretty Girls Breakers! PLUS, Pretty Girls Escape and Pretty Girls Tile Match.

title: Trainlax: Railway Puzzle Simulator
description: Relax. Build. Solve.

title: Arcade Archives: Super Xevious
description:
"SUPER XEVIOUS" is a shooter released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1984.
Players pilot the SOLVALOU and face off with the XEVIOUS forces.
Defeat airborne enemies with the zapper, and terrestrial enemies with the blaster.
This work has various changes from the previous work, including additional characters and different placement of hidden items.

title: Absurdika: Rebuild
description:
You get to play as a guy, a psychopath, or someone else—who knows? You'll have to use your imagination, complete 10 challenging levels, and defeat the main bosses. You'll be all set with this one weapon that has two different attacks: your CHAINSAW. Let your imagination take you on a journey through the mind of a great author as you play.**

"It's time to overcome your fear of conflict. Every time someone accused you, you kept silent and kept your anger inside. The demon you are about to face represents this fear.

title: Arcade Archives: Punk Shot
description:
"PUNK SHOT" is a sports game released by KONAMI in 1990.
Your goal is to defeat the rival team and win in a basketball game where all sorts of interference and attacks are allowed.
There are various gimmicks set up during the game, so you need to be careful not to get too distracted by your opponent and lose the ball to them.

title: Anomaly Seeker: The Diner
description: Step into the world of Anomaly Seeker: The Diner, a thrilling anomaly detection puzzle game that tests your attention to detail and memory! Set in a charming and atmospheric diner, you’ll need to carefully examine the room and identify hidden anomalies. But the challenge doesn’t stop there—on your next visit, the room may look the same, but there’s a twist! You’ll need to recall the details and determine if something’s changed. Only the most observant will be able to find all the anomalies and solve the mysteries lurking within. Featuring 27 anomalies. Can you find them all?

title: Airplane Flight Simulator: EVO
description: In this flight simulator, you’ll explore a globe-inspired open-world map featuring diverse regions and unique climates. With an impressive selection of 31 realistic airplanes, enjoy a fully immersive commercial aviation experience provided by advanced flight controls, realistic interiors and sound effects, full day-night cycle and challenging weather scenarios.

title: Bunny Cubed
description: Hop your way through dozens of springtime puzzle stages in isometric 3D style!

title: Escape Tung Sahur Backrooms
description: You heard the knock. Now run.

title: Prison Life Sim 2025: Survival
description: Adapt, fight, and outsmart rivals to earn respect behind bars.

title: Tokyo Racer X
description: Become the king of Tokyo’s underground races!

title: Musical Vibes RX
description: Get ready to move with Musical Vibes RX, a dynamic dance game you can play using Joy-Con controllers or your smartphone camera connected to your console!

title: Subway Simulator 2025: City Train
description: Your train, your rules, the city awaits.

title: Soccer Golf!
description: Kick a hole in one!

title: Arcade Archives: Nebulasray
description:
"NEBULASRAY" is a shooter released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1994.
Become a member of the Resistance Army and defeat the Suppression Army organized by the Unified Forces, which has staged a coup d'état.
The key to winning is to acquire items that appear along the way and strengthen your ship.

title: Marvel's Spider-Man Digital Deluxe Edition
description: Starring the world’s most iconic Super Hero, Spider-Man features the acrobatic abilities, improvisation and web-slinging that the wall-crawler is famous for, while also introducing elements never-before-seen in a Spider-Man game. From traversing with parkour and utilizing the environment, to new combat and blockbuster set pieces, it’s Spider-Man unlike any you’ve played before.

title: Metaphor: ReFantazio - Atlus Brand 35th Anniversary Edition
description: Celebrate the past 35 years of ATLUS with this special edition, offering bonuses that allow you to delve even deeper into the world of Metaphor: ReFantazio.

title: Underwater Submarine Rush
description: Underwater Submarine Rush is a thrilling endless game where you pilot a submarine through dangerous underwater terrain. Avoid obstacles, destroy them with standard shots or homing missiles, and activate a shield for protection when needed. Collect power-ups like extra ammo and health to extend your journey. The goal is to survive as long as possible and achieve the highest score!

title: Gemstones Rush Mania
description: Gemstones Rush Mania is a fast-paced puzzle game where you drop square gemstones into four columns, aiming to align and clear full rows for points. The closest row to the player must be perfectly aligned to disappear, triggering combos if rows below are also aligned. Occasionally, wooden blocks appear, requiring two hits to break before the row can be cleared. As the game progresses, the speed increases, making it more challenging. How long can you keep up, and what high score can you achieve?

title: Parkour on Rooftops
description: Explore, perform, dominate the urban playground.

title: Date Z: Welcome to Massville High
description: Navigate high school life in this dating sim meets mystery adventure. Date girls, uncover secrets, and prepare for a Friday Date no one fully understands. With whispers of an old virus outbreak and the past creeping into the present, every choice shapes your fate at Massville High.

title: Mini Wheels Racers: Turbo Toy Playground
description: Every playground is a racetrack where toys race like champions!

title: Criminal Cleaner Simulator
description: You’re not a criminal… just criminally good at cleaning.

title: Heist Man
description: Get ready for a thrilling caper in Heist Man, the colorful and clever 3D top-down puzzle adventure! Step into the shoes of a master thief and plot your perfect getaway as you dodge patrolling guards, slip past deadly traps, and snatch valuable treasures — all while keeping your cool under pressure. Plan your moves carefully, move with precision, and outwit the dangers that stand between you and your fortune.

title: Tralalero Tralala Backrooms Pools
description: Dive into madness: survive the Tralalero Tralala

title: Truck Simulator 25: Euro Driver
description: Drive Europe’s vast highways, master every challenging road.

title: Tung Sahur Supermarket Simulator
description: Bang the drums, stock the shelves, dominate the deals!

title: Tralalero Tralala Simulator
description: Free your inner shark and dive into a city bursting with destruction, adventure, and utter madness. Unleash your super abilities and tear through the urban jungle with unparalleled power.

title: Hole Digging Beach Simulator
description: Dig, explore, and discover the secrets buried beneath exotic beaches.

title: Motel Owner Simulator
description: Master hospitality, grow your empire.

title: Agent 07: Spy Revenge
description: Enter the mission and become a legend of espionage.

title: Dreams: VR
description:
This major update introduced virtual reality to Dreams. Media Molecule released a new collection of short games called "Inside the Box", which included an art gallery, motion-controlled maze puzzles, a speedrun shooter and a puzzle platformer.

Users could design their own creations using a Playstation VR headset and optional Playstation Move controllers. Most dreams could be played in VR, even if they weren't created in it.

title: Tren
description: A game that puts you in the driving seat of an adorable model engine. Deliver cargo! Solve puzzles! Do big flips! Rack up high scores and become the envy of all your friends! And join Tren on a grand tour of your fondest childhood memories, as you discover a story all about the transformative power of play.

title: Dreams: Dragons, Dungeons & Templates
description:
This update to Dreams included a new game and an overhaul of the creation experience. Media Molecule released "Ancient Dangers: A Bat's Tale", a dungeon-crawling action game featuring orcs and new PlayStation trophies. It couldn't be played in VR, but was one of the few Dreams creations that supported local co-op.

Templates were released that allowed people to quickly created themed dreams. These included mini golf courses, speedrun challenges, 2D platformers, shmups, and a fully featured toolkit to modify their dungeon-crawling game into something new.

title: Space Mines
description: SpaceMines takes you on a strategic puzzle adventure through the far reaches of the galaxy. On a grid-based field, carefully uncover tiles while avoiding hidden dangers lurking beneath the alien surface. Use logic and deduction to reveal all safe zones without triggering a single trap. Customize the challenge to your liking — choose from various grid sizes and difficulty levels to suit your play style. Whether you're a casual explorer or a seasoned tactician, SpaceMines delivers a thrilling and addictive puzzle experience for all players.

title: Ninjas Stars
description: Ninja Stars is an action-packed arcade game where players strategically fire and deflect ninja stars to break down surrounding walls. Use physics-based ricochet mechanics and precision aiming to eliminate obstacles and clear the level. With each wall sequence presenting new challenges, it’s a test of both reflexes and strategy as you work to complete each stage!

title: Masters Pool HD
description: Pure 8-ball billiards in stunning 3D.

title: Arcade Archives: Ryukyu
description: RYUKYU is a 1990 puzzle game where players strategically select and place cards from their hand onto a grid to form poker hands in vertical, horizontal, or diagonal lines. The objective is to maximize scoring by creating the strongest possible poker combinations across the board. The game features a mysterious element involving the Ryukyu card placement in the center square, which unlocks special content upon game completion. This arcade re-release includes the series' standard features such as adjustable difficulty settings and authentic arcade display options.

title: Ice Cream: Super Stacking Slot Machine
Supermarket Anime Collector's Simulator
description: From cashier to legend — in true anime style!

title: Storage Hunter: Bid War Simulator
description: Win auctions, uncover secrets, and become an auction legend.

title: Sniper Warrior Elite
description: Sniper Warrior Elite is a modern warfare sniping game that places players in the role of a skilled marksman. The game features a single-player campaign with open-ended maps, requiring tactical planning and precision. Players can customize their weapons and gear, adapting to various missions across diverse environments. The gameplay emphasizes realistic ballistics, weather effects, and stealth mechanics as players navigate through forests and urban areas to eliminate targets. Sniper Warrior Elite aims to provide a detailed sniping experience, challenging players to use strategy and marksmanship skills to complete their objectives.

title: Fishing Simulator 2025
description: Your Journey to the Perfect Catch Begins Here.

title: Bombardino Crocodilo vs. Tung Tung Sahur
description: In this high-flying, heart-pounding runner game, Crocodilo takes to the skies, soaring through dangerous landscapes while being relentlessly pursued by Tung’s Stalkers. It’s a race for survival, but with a twist—because who said memes can't be epic?

title: Astball
description:
Fly a spaceship through deep space and survive as long as you can!
Asteroids appear in your path — shoot them to earn points.
Large asteroids break into smaller pieces when hit.
Destroy the smallest ones to score even more!

But be careful: if any asteroid piece crashes into your ship, it’s game over.
Stay alert, keep moving, and test your reflexes in this fast-paced space shooter!

title: Police Border Contraband Patrol
description: Patrol. Inspect. Intercept. Justice starts with you.

title: Bunny Rampage: History of Revenge
description:
Embark on a captivating adventure with Max, a plush rabbit brought to life!

Unfold the secrets hidden within captivating portals, venturing from the bustling streets of New York City to the enigmatic depths of an alien bunker. Face hordes of enemies in exhilarating battles, unravel mind-bending puzzles, and navigate challenging platforming sections.

title: BMX City Run
description: Embark on an exciting journey, where you will explore various locations on your trusty bike, performing amazing stunts. In each mission, you have to earn points by performing daring stunts, which you can then spend on new bike models with unique designs. Whether you're traveling through urban landscape, an amusement theme park, or radioactive terrain, each trip is a new adventure. Expand your capabilities, demonstrate your skills and leave your mark in the world of extreme cycling. Are you ready to pedal your way to fame?

title: Toaplan Arcade Collection Vol. 1
description:
The Toaplan Arcade Collection Volume 1 is here with a bang! With modern enhancements, leaderboards, screen filters, quick save and other quality-of-life extras, anyone can experience these classic titles. Got what it takes? Prove it on the battlefield!

This collection includes Tiger-Heli, Flying Shark, Twin Cobra, Fire Shark, Out Zone, FixEight, Dogyuun, and Batsugun. It's octuple the action, a billion times the fun, and a thrill ride back in time to the neon-lit arcades of the past!

Through this re-release, a new generation of players will surely discover what made Toaplan such a special company, and their games timeless masterpieces. Now, let's blast some enemies!

title: Toaplan Arcade Collection Vol. 2
description:
The Toaplan Arcade Collection Volume 2 is here with a bang! With modern enhancements, leaderboards, screen filters, quick save and other quality-of-life extras, anyone can experience these classic titles. Got what it takes? Prove it on the battlefield!

This collection includes Slap Fight, Truxton, Hellfire, Twin Hawk, Zero Wing, Vimana, Truxton II and Grind Stormer. It's octuple the action, a billion times the fun, and a thrill ride back in time to the neon-lit arcades of the past!

Through this re-release, a new generation of players will surely discover what made Toaplan such a special company, and their games timeless masterpieces. Now, let's blast some enemies!

title: Maze: Interim Odyssey
description:
Maze: Interim Odyssey is a sequel spin-off to the hit puzzle adventure game, Maze: Pedestal of Trials. This entry into the TreeFall Studios Maze series brings all new challenges, complex puzzles, and new environments.

Taking place between "Pedestal of Trials" and the upcoming "Rising Trials" this Maze side story can be picked up and played by fans of the series or complete newcomers.

title: Anime Girls: Fantasy Desire
description: Battle, Charm, Conquer

title: Amber Alert Director's Cut
description: Step into the shoes of a policeman in "Amber Alert," a difficult survival horror game. Responding to a late-night call, you find a sinister cult of women abductors. Your mission: rescue a captive girl.

title: Puff Up
description: Grow the biggest balloon and don't POP!

title: Arcade Archives: Super World Court
description:
"SUPER WORLD COURT" is a sports game released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1993.
It is the sequence to "PRO TENNIS WORLD COURT" and adds support for 4-player simultaneous games.
Featuring a roster of numerous distinctive players with their own specialties, this is your chance to pick your favorite and win your way through tournaments!

title: Memory Holder: The Alphabet
description: A memory game dedicated to the letters that guide us through the day.

title: Bacrush
description: Bacrush is a fast-paced arcade game where you control a small green square. Your goal is to collect as many coins as possible while dodging dangerous gray cubes. You can shoot projectiles to push back the cubes, but be careful — shooting too much will cause your square to overheat! Gather as many coins as you can and survive as long as possible to set a new high score.

title: Sheep Running
description: In this charming and challenging game, you play as a shepherd with a critical mission — guide your flock safely into the barn without letting any sheep fall off cliffs or drown in the water. Use fear wisely to steer the sheep, but be careful — push them too hard, and they might panic and run to their doom! The more sheep you safely herd into the barn, the higher your score. Master the delicate balance between control and chaos in this fun and strategic herding adventure!

title: Breaker Brick Smashing
description: Breaker Brick Smashing is an endless brick breaker challenge where new bricks constantly appear and only the sharpest shots survive. Smash your way through tougher bricks that need multiple hits, collect power-ups like extra balls and safe zones, and climb through the waves as difficulty rises. How long can you last?

title: Dark Angels
description: Control a shadowy, winged angel in Dark Angels as you ram through rocks, crystals, and cursed barriers, absorbing dark energy along the way. With a blend of dark fantasy and arcade action, each level challenges you to clear obstacles and harness the power of darkness.

title: Cyber Car Seller Simulator
description:
Cyber Car Seller Simulator – Enter the Future of Automotive Trade!
In a neon-lit world where technology reigns, uncover hidden gems in the cyber car market
and build a thriving dealership. Scout futuristic vehicles, negotiate the best deals, enhance
them with cutting-edge modifications, and sell them for a massive profit. Will you become
the ultimate cyber car mogul, or will the digital underworld outmaneuver you?

title: Arcade Archives: Ridge Racer
description:
A port of Ridge Racer, a racing game released by Bandai in 1993. It was originally released in arcades for the Namco System 22 hardware.

The game has four modes to choose from, including three difficulty levels – Novice, Intermediate, and Advanced - as well as T. T. (Time Trial), where players compete one-on-one against a rival car to achieve the best time.

Additionally, a DX version featuring support for an H-shifter and clutch is also included.

title: Racing Rebels Mud Clash
description: Racing Rebels Mud Clash is a muddy, high-speed racing challenge where players unlock new maps and buy better cars by winning races. Earn cash based on your finishing position, upgrade your garage, and blast past rivals with powerful nitro boosts.

title: Deus Ex: The Conspiracy
description: The year is 2052 and the world is a dangerous and chaotic place. Terrorists operate openly - killing thousands; drugs, disease and pollution kill even more. The world's economies are close to collapse and the gap between the insanely wealthy and the desperately poor grows ever wider. Worst of all, an ages old conspiracy bent on world domination has decided that the time is right to emerge from the shadows and take control.

title: Twisted Metal III
description: A digital re-edition of Twisted Metal III, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Twisted Metal 4
description: A digital re-edition of Twisted Metal 4, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Tantei Jinguji Saburo: Prism of Eyes - Toki no Sugiyuku Mama ni
Lucky Drop
description: Lucky Drop is a fun game of chance where you release balls and watch where they land. The path through obstacles is always different, and each launch brings excitement and the challenge to score as many points as possible. A perfect game to relax and test your luck – simple, fast, and addictive!

title: Burger Bounce
description: Burger Bounce is a fast-paced game where you control a jet-powered burger, bouncing through levels filled with platforms, gaps, and food-themed enemies. Smash obstacles, collect ketchup coins, and upgrade your condiments to travel farther and achieve the highest score!

title: The Jumping Spaghetti
description: From the makers of the Jumping Food Games comes the next whirling adventure on the plate. In "The Jumping Spaghetti" you control an elastic noodle through 28 varied levels full of obstacles, rotating platforms and surprising twists and turns.

title: Weed & Greed
description:
Dive into the bustling world of Weed & Greed, where you'll build your illicit empire from the ground up!

Find clients or hire dealers to keep your business thriving and establish a loyal customer base. But be ready for intense action: battle NPCs and cops, arm yourself, and rule the streets like a true boss.

Explore a dynamic city with day-night cycles and shady corners perfect for deals. Build your empire by cultivating plants, synthesizing pills, and upgrading your equipment.

Rent labs, warehouses, and stash houses to dominate the game!

title: Retro Geek Shop Simulator
description:
Have you ever dreamed of running your very own geek store?

In Retro Geek Shop Simulator, you step into the shoes of a store owner managing a shop filled with the latest consoles, legendary video games, and must-have geek collectibles.

Your goal? Build the ultimate geek paradise, attract loyal customers, and make your shop the hottest spot in town!

title: Lens
description: Lens is a Japanese horror visual novel game.

title: A Long Climb Ago
description: Build towers, freeze time and climb your way through platforming puzzles to collect crystal shards in this fantastical adventure.

title: Boxstacker
description: Welcome to Boxstacker, a game where you pilot your brave ship around obstacles, stack boxes below yourself and close portals with them! Maneuver around meteors, defeat patrolling enemies, stack boxes and close portals below. Try to beat your high score!

title: Only Tung Tung Sahur Up
description: Up, up, and never give up!

title: Only Sky Parkour: Island Up!
description: Every jump is a step closer to the top!

title: Arcade Archives: Spinal Breakers
description:
“SPINAL BREAKERS” is an action shooting game released by VIDEO SYSTEM in 1991.
Players take control of Colonel WAFFLE and battle through stages by defeating enemies infected by the artificial lifeform known as “HILDROID.”
Dodge enemy attacks using the rotation button while aiming precisely to take them down. The game features three different endings, which vary depending on your performance throughout the playthrough.

title: Bodycam Stray Kitty
description: Furry, fun, and full of surprises.

title: Pirate Trails: Tentacles and Treasures
description: Arrr you ready for more puzzlin', plunderin' and perilous tentacles?

title: Brainrot: Fighting
description: This ain’t eSports. This is memeSports

title: Ice Block Slide Rush
description: Ice Block Slide Rush is a fast paced endless challenge where timing and precision are everything. Press to charge and release to slide. The harder you squash the ice block, the farther it slides. Smash into other blocks and try to land perfectly in the glowing zone. Miss the mark and your block gets chopped down. The smaller the block, the harder it is to push the next one. With only 3 lives, how far can you go on this slippery ride?

title: Bus Sim 25: City Simulator
description: Drive the city. Master the route. Rule the road.

title: House Renovator Simulator
description: Every broken house deserves a second chance – build your dream home.

title: Final Fantasy XV: King's Knight Sticker Set
description: A custom decal set based on the underground hit app, King's Knight. Ride around and pretend you're Ray Jack!

title: Final Fantasy XV: King's Knight Tee
description: An exclusive T-shirt highlighting the heroes of the mobile game that took Eos by storm.

title: 20th Century Beauties
description:
20th Century Beauties is a jigsaw puzzle game where each completed picture reveals a different icon of feminine flair - decked out in the stunning looks of her decade. From jazz lounges to power suits and hairspray, each puzzle peels back another layer of vintage charm.
Drag, drop, and take your time. Make it a challenge or do it with no rush. Just good company and better curves, wrapped in eras that knew how to make an entrance.

title: Arcade Archives: Strategy X
description: Will you go for the aggressive approach or the cautious approach?

title: Giant Flee
description: Run for your life and never look back!

title: Pixicharm: Gravenguard
description:
Slay skeletons and goblins in nonstop action!
In this fast-paced 2D action game, you control a fearless knight battling endless enemies across shifting platforms. Time your strikes, stay on the move, and see how long you can survive the onslaught!

title: Tralalero Tralala: Rage Bait!
description: Lose your mind and maybe even your voice in this brutally challenging 2D platformer featuring an unusually emotional shark with a short fuse and a long jump.

title: Final Fantasy XV: Memories of King's Knight
description: Listen to KING'S KNIGHT Original Soundtrack.

title: Final Fantasy XV: Noodle Helmet
description: Stave off both fatigue and hunger with Nissin on your noggin! Inspired by everyone's favorite Cup Noodles, this headpiece increases your HP recovery rate remarkably.

title: Final Fantasy XV: Gourmand Set
description: Turn campgrounds into kitchens and make meals into masterpieces with this custom cookware.

title: Dungeons of Paint
description: Can you colour the entire world with a gun?

title: Road Cafe Simulator
description:
Help tired travelers and create for them the most cozy tourist restaurant. Let every stop at your establishment become a real feast!

In Road Cafe Simulator puts you right in the middle of the action in the role of a roadside cafe owner. Start your own road cafe, serve appetizing dishes and turn your humble stall into the hottest hotspot in town. It's all about great food, satisfied customers and growing your business.

title: Be A Bee
description: Get a taste of the sweet life of a hardworking bee!

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate - Deluxe Edition
description:
TMNT Splintered Fate - Unleash the Turtles in a rogue-like quest to rescue Splinter from the Foot Clan! Master ninja skills, unite in bodacious co-op gameplay, and conquer iconic NYC locales.

The Deluxe Edition includes:
The Game
Casey Jones DLC
10 exclusive foil cards

title: Arcade Archives: Crazy Balloon
description: A thrilling balloon ride that’s not just hot air!

title: 3 on 3 Soccer
description: Fast. Fun. 3 on 3.

title: Content King: Streamer Simulator
description:
Content King: Streamer Simulator puts you behind the camera with one goal—build a streaming career from scratch and turn it into something worth watching.

Start with basic gear and zero followers. Stream regularly, improve your content, and grow your audience. Upgrade your setup, manage your time, and decide how you’ll rise—stay genuine, stir the pot, or cut corners for quicker success.

Expand your channel, work with other creators, and turn your online presence into a serious business. Just don’t forget: the internet loves a star—but it loves a scandal even more. Ready to chase clout or chaos? The camera’s on.

title: Arcade Archives: Air Combat 22
description: "AIR COMBAT 22" is a flight shooter released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1995. This title features an evolutionary step in 3D graphics and flashy animations using the "System Super 22" arcade board, an upgrade of the "System 22" architecture used for a wide range of legendary 3D games. Take on missions for the thrill of shooting down lots of enemy crafts, white-knuckle missions that require expert techniques, and more as you conquer diverse aerial combat scenarios. Become a hero of the skies!

title: Hatsune Miku: Project Diva Future Tone - Future Sound
description: Main content packs focusing on songs that debuted on PlayStation platforms.

title: Astro Surge
description: Dive into retro twin-stick chaos in Astro Surge! Shoot through endless waves, level up fast, and unleash pixel-powered mayhem in space.

title: Ballista Wall Defense Rush
description: Ballista Wall Defense Rush is a defense game where you upgrade your ballista and fight off endless waves of monsters. Earn gold from each kill, improve your defenses, and see how long you can survive against increasingly stronger enemies!

title: Bats Bits Balls
description: Welcome to BITS BATS BALLS - the place where your dual-analog reflexes are put to the test! Destroy blocks, collect bits, and progress from one level to the next, only to find yourself in an infinite mode catered for the most hardcore of players!

title: Call of Brothers: The Backrooms Zombie Survival
Command Under Fire RTS
description: Take Command. Build Power. Conquer Islands.

title: Fear of Hunger
description: Healthy breakfast before school lunch

title: DeviLevel: Try Again
description: Precision Platforming Meets Demonic Challenge

title: Fill The Cup 2
description: The main challenge lies in guiding the stream of water around obstacles that block its direct path to the cup. With only a limited supply of water, players must think strategically by avoiding unnecessary barriers and carefully managing their resources to fill the cup and bring a smile to its face. As the game progresses, each level becomes difficult.

title: Gemz Burst
description: Gemz Burst puts you in control of a high-speed ship orbiting a deadly space zone. Fire toward the center to break spinning rings of energy gems and expose the turret core at the heart of the chaos. Time your shots and dodge incoming fire as you blast through each layer of danger in this intense outer-ring shooter.

title: Pet Show
description: Draw a line to enclose the area and uncover the image underneath. Watch out for enemies who can catch you or cut your line!

title: Novel Rogue
description: In the mystical Ancient Library, a young apprentice named Wright trains under Yuisil, the Witch of Portals. As part of his magical studies, he delves into the stories of four enchanted books, each offering a unique realm to explore. From reclaiming a fallen kingdom to unraveling the mysteries of the underworld, your choices shape the destinies of captivating characters and their intertwining tales.

title: Hatsune Miku: Project Diva Future Tone - Colorful Tone
description: Main content packs focusing on songs that debuted on non-PlayStation platforms.

title: ZEN Pinball 2: The Walking Dead
description: Pinball table based on The Walking Dead from Telltale.

title: Zen Pinball 2: Portal Pinball
description: Aperature Laboratories presents the Heuristic Portal Pinball Device proving that science is not merely beneficial but also quite fun.

title: Spica Adventure
description:
From the arcade legends, TAITO, experience this formerly Japan-exclusive 2D action jump & run filled with charm and cartoonish delight on modern consoles for the very first time! Reminiscent of the parasol from Parasol Stars: Bubble Bobble III, this yellow parasol will become your favorite accessory and best weapon. Use it to take down a wild mix of enemies that come straight out of a toybox!

Whether it's slashing combos, shooting, jumping off platforms, gliding, or floating, Nico and her parasol have an arsenal of moves that are as varied as her colorful foes. Don’t forget to use the parasol for protection—and we don’t mean against the sun! Defend, parry, and reflect the enemy projectiles in up to 8 directions!

Tackle the challenge of 28 stages spread across multiple paths. With each playthrough, choose a new journey through the universe of Spica!

title: Classic Arcades: Pong
description: Classic Arcades: Pong brings the legendary black-and-white paddle game back with crisp visuals and tight controls. Play solo against the CPU with three difficulty levels or challenge a friend in local 2-player mode. It’s first to 11 in this pure, minimalist throwback—no frills, just fast-paced arcade action.

title: Crash Bugs Cake Defense
description: Crash Bugs Cake Defense is an arcade game where a delicious cake sits at the center, under attack by waves of hungry bugs. Tap the bugs to crush them before they reach and eat the cake. As the game progresses, more and more bugs appear, making it harder to defend. The goal is to protect the cake as long as possible and crush as many bugs as you can.

title: Cyber Tank Nano
description: Cyber Tank Nano is a puzzle game which adds various mechanics on top of the Sokoban genre

title: Space Kabaam: Neon III
description:
In their desperation, the invading force has activated an antimatter bomb.

Now, the void is consuming everything in its path.

All Neon strike teams have been ordered to evacuate the solar system. Hold off the remaining enemy forces to buy them enough time.

title: The Echo
description: The Echo is a retro-themed First-Person Horror/Mystery...

title: Arcade Archives: Super Dimension Fortress Macross II
description:
This is a time attack shoot 'em up!

The arcade game “Super Dimension Fortress MACROSS II” is a shooter released by BANPRESTO (Bandai Namco Entertainment inc.) in 1993.
The game follows the story of the original video animation “The Super Dimension Fortress Macross II -LOVERS AGAIN-”.
Set around 80 years after “The Super Dimension Fortress Macross,”
Earth is faced by a new threat that players must defeat - the Marduk.
Clear each stage by achieving the designated "CLEAR SCORE" within the time limit.

title: Glowface In Love 2
description: Glowface is back - and this time his heart is beating even brighter. A new chapter full of magic, adventure and emotion begins in "Glowface in Love 2". Accompany the glowing hero on a journey through 28 new levels in which not only tricky puzzles but also emotional twists and turns await him.

title: Wacky Run
description: Wacky Run is a cool and fun arcade game where you need to race against other people and acquire floorboards to use them for shortcuts. Every level is randomly generated, so you really need to use your wits and your tactics in order to win.

title: Lethal Cosmic Hunt
description: Hide, survive, and outsmart terrifying creatures in a deadly hunt.

title: Glint's Trial
description: Take control of Glint, a glowing explorer on a mission through 15 pixel-perfect platforming levels filled with deadly traps and quirky enemies. Inspired by classic retro games, Glint’s Trial delivers tight controls, charming pixel art, and speedrun-ready challenges. Whether you're hopping past spikes or dodging fishes every level is a handcrafted test of reflexes and memory. Can you survive the trial and prove you're a true retro platforming master? A game developed by CraePlay and ported by GGmuks

title: Super Hydorah: Collector's Edition
description:
An evil force has launched an invasion over the Omios star! Fly with the space fleet in a campaign to liberate planets, destroy enemy bases and discover the mysterious force behind the attack. Biomechanical enemies, space creatures, exotic planets and climatic threats are waiting for you, so select a route, equip your ship and prepare to die!

The Collector's Edition includes:
- Physical copy of Super Hydorah for Switch with reversible cover
- Super Hydorah Game Manual
- Super Hydorah Complete Original Soundtrack
- Arcade Cut-Out
- Super Hydorah "Making Of" Book
- Super Hydorah Keychain
- Omios Star and the Juggernaut Mother Ship Sticker

title: Mortar
description:
MORTAR is a fast-paced one-button game.

You are in charge of a mortar that constantly moves from side to side on its own. Your goal is to destroy the enemy tanks that are approaching you from the top. Hold a button to fire a bomb ahead and destroy all the enemies within the radius of its explosion. Or press a button to shoot the enemies with a small shot. You stop moving when you shoot or fire a bomb.

The game is over when any enemy reaches the bottom of the screen.

title: Digging Adventure Simulator 2025
description: Go deep or go home with nothing.

title: Arcade Archives: Super Basketball
description:
Can you turn the situation around in this dire situation?

"SUPER BASKETBALL" is a sports game released by KONAMI in 1984.
There are 10 competing teams. Every match starts at a disadvantage.
Use skillful dribbling and passing to turn the tide and aim to win within the time limit.

title: Learn to Play vol. 11: Drift Moto
description: No Breaks! No Fear!

title: Magnitude: Lambda
description:
The ongoing clash between two anomalies has taken its toll.
As they rose closer to the surface, the water around them has become increasingly toxic.
If the toxicity continues to spread, the consequences could be severe.
Could this disaster end if one anomaly prevails?

title: Pixicharm: Sparkrina
description: In Sparkrina, play as a fierce sorceress sprinting through endless realms packed with deadly traps and demonic foes. Unleash magic, dodge danger, and see how long you can survive in this fast-paced fantasy runner!

title: Pro Virtual Racing
description: Real cars. Real physics. Unreal thrill.

title: The Ultimate G
description: In those gritty concrete jungle streets, it takes a real man to prove himself. Take on the persona of THE ULTIMATE G and prove yourself on those streets! Defeat enemies, level up, and build a powerful warrior out of yourself from the wide array of perks! But be wary - your enemies improve just as much as you do...

title: Truck Simulator 2025: City Work Delivery
description: Complete deliveries, unlock new trucks, expand your trucking empire.

title: Deemo: Reborn - M2U X Nicode Collection
Deemo: Reborn - Eshen Chen Collection Vol.1: Transmission
EA Sports FC 26: Ultimate Edition
description:
Pre-Order EA SPORTS FC 26 Ultimate Edition by 26 Aug to get:

- Ultimate Team ICON Player Item (untradeable) for EA SPORTS FC 26
- Ultimate Team Player Evolution for EA SPORTS FC 25 (sold separately)
- Ultimate Team 1 of 5 Player Pick ICON Player Item (untradeable) for EA SPORTS FC 25 (sold separately)

Ultimate Edition preorder offer includes‡:
- Up to 7 Days Early Access
- Season 1 Premium Pass

Ultimate Edition also features:
- 6000 FC Points over 2 months††
- 1 additional Ultimate Team Player Evolution Slot
- Standard Edition Clubs and Career content

title: 40 Sports Games in 1
description: The largest collection of sports anywhere – With 40 different sports, there's something for everyone! Play against family and friends in football, bowling, volleyball, golf, horse racing, and more!

title: EmyLiveShow: King of Desires
description: Take on the girls, beat them at their own game, and score the chance to have your innermost wishes granted.

title: Arcade Archives: Stinger
description: Destroy the enemy and infiltrate the base!

title: Rookie Basketball Shoots
description: Step Up. Lock In. Shoot to Win.

title: Formula Racing GP: Apex Overtaking
description: You don’t chase victory — you overtake it.

title: Money Laundering Simulator
description:
It's easy - just take a cash delivery. Find a problem you need to solve. Clean the money. Send it back to your customers. Repeat.

Don't be afraid to get your hands dirty - it's part of your business. You are a cash cleaner. So do your job. And do it well, or face the consequences.

To achieve results, you need tools and equipment, so buy everything you need and turn your lab into a dream place.

title: Find Sort Match
description: Develop your mental skills and have fun.

title: Learn to Play: Jungle Frog
description: Protect the frog from the bees!

title: Arcade Archives: Field Day
description: Face off across seven sporting events to become the champion!

title: Final Fantasy Tactics: The Ivalice Chronicles - Deluxe Edition
description:
Final Fantasy Tactics: The Ivalice Chronicles is a tactical role-playing game that features turn-based, grid-based combat with a focus on positioning, terrain, and class-based progression. Players customize a party through a variety of jobs and abilities while engaging in strategy-driven battles.

The Deluxe Edition includes the following bonuses:
・ Weapon: Akademy Blade (Raises a unit's speed attribute slightly while equipped)
・ Headwear: Akademy Beret (Prevents the Charmed status while equipped)
・ Combat Garb: Akademy Tunic (Grants Shell while equipped)
・ Accessory: Ring of Aptitude (Boosts JP earned while equipped)
・ Consumable Items: Phoenix Down x10
・ Black Equipment for Ramza
・ Red Equipment for Ramza

title: Gothic 3 Classic
description: This overhauled console version of the Cult Classic RPG integrates the community patch 1.75 and further gameplay improvements, features tailor-made gamepad UI & controls and delivers advanced optimization to offer the smoothest Gothic 3 experience yet.

title: Recycling Station Simulator
description: The ultimate recycling business challenge awaits you.

title: Meteor Break Mission
description: Meteor Break Mission is a 2D arcade shooter where you control a cannon to destroy falling meteors, earn points and money, and upgrade your health, fire rate, and shot power. Survive as long as you can and aim for the highest score!

title: Bunkers 1944 FPS
description: Infiltrate. Eliminate. Obliterate.

title: Quarantine Area
description: Trust your instincts. The future depends on it.

title: Tung Tung Sahur Extreme
description: It’s not just a game — it’s TUNG TUNG time.

title: Quarantine Zone: Border Zombie Checkpoint
description: Control the border, safeguard countless lives.

title: Sushi Attack
description: Sushi Attack is a playful arcade shooter where you control a single animated chopstick to defend your wasabi from waves of mischievous sushi invaders. With vibrant visuals and escalating challenges, it’s a fun twist on a classic arcade experience.

title: Construction Sim: City and Road Builder
description: Take the reins of your own construction company and transform a small contracting gig into an industry-leading empire. In Construction Sim: City and Road Builder, every job is a stepping stone — from hauling materials and clearing sites to assembling massive bridges, paving roads, and even installing wind turbines.

title: Labublas: Battle Royale Shooter
description: Blablublas Battle Royale Shooter drops you into a vibrant world where you face off against numerous challengers in a high-stakes competition. As the last contender standing, you must rely on your instincts and quick thinking to outlast every opponent. The journey challenges your decision-making and perseverance as you fight to become the ultimate champion and secure your place among the legends of Blablublas land. Each encounter pushes you to adapt and stay sharp in the relentless battle for survival. Prepare to test your limits as you overcome fierce competition and prove your dominance in this thrilling solo experience. The path to victory is tough, but only one can claim the crown.

title: Run from Bubol Horror
description:
Something is wrong. Your thoughts are hazy, your memory shattered — but one thing is clear: you’re being hunted. The presence drawn to your fear.

You don’t know how it started. You don’t know what it wants. But it won’t stop.

It watches. It waits. And then… it strikes.

There’s no time to think — only time to run. Find a way to survive the impossible.
Every second counts. Every sound could be your last.

title: Moontales Picbook
description:
A beautifully framed interactive book with 4 whimsical, surreal short novels.
Follow 4 different protagonists on their dreamlike journeys.

Your choice matters! See what ending you get!

title: Scandinavian Cottage Survival Simulator
description: Build your life in the heart of the Scandinavian wilderness.

title: Escape the Backrooms Bodycam
description: See what the bodycam saw. Survive what it didn’t.

title: Battle Pixel
description: Survive intense firefights and claim victory.

title: Pixicharm: Majestreats
description:
In Majestreats, you play as a hungry holiday princess on a royal quest for delicious treats! Dash through sunny beaches and resort paths, collecting burgers, ice cream, and chocolate — but watch out for the pesky mosquitoes! Each bite will cost you precious points, so stay sharp and keep those snacks coming.

A lighthearted, fast-paced adventure full of yummy fun and royal flair!

title: Beam Driver
description:
Beam Driver — become a master driver and explore new horizons!
Get ready for an exhilarating adventure in the world of Beam Driver, where the lines between reality and virtuality blur! In this game, you will become a true driver capable of performing incredible tricks and maneuvers that will astonish even the most seasoned motorsport enthusiasts.

title: Arcade Archives: D-Day
description:
The order has now been given to begin the operation!
Break through the enemy's encirclement
and destroy the enemy fortress!!

"D-DAY" is a shooter released by JALECO in 1984.
Your mission is to pilot your battleship, fending off enemy battleships and bombers, and destroy the enemy fortress.
Today is the day the operation is to take place. The longest day begins...

title: Unicorns: The Troll Adventure
description: A fairytale adventure for all those who love fantasy, suspense and a pinch of magic!

title: Pixicharm: Spikoin
description:
In Spikoin, every coin is a step toward victory — but one wrong move could cost you! Jump your way through tight corridors, deadly spikes, and tricky platforms in this fast-paced coin-collecting platformer.

Your goal? Collect all coins in the level to unlock the next one. Sounds easy? Think again.

title: Deadliest Deep Sea Catch Fishing Simulator
description: Gear up and survive the deadliest fishing grounds.

title: Zombie Lockdown Simulator
description:
It's easy - just take the cash delivery. Find the problem you need to solve. Clean the money. Send it back to your clients. Repeat.

Don't be afraid to get your hands dirty - it's a part of your business. You are a cash cleaner. So do your job. And do it well or you will face the consequences.

You need tools and equipment to get the result, so buy what you need and make your lab a dream place.

title: Arcade Archives: Aqua Jet
description:
"AQUA JET" is a marine sports game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1996.

This game stood out at arcades at the time thanks to its large jet ski-style cabinet.
Savor the thrill of racing across shimmering waves under the blazing sun in a stunning, resort-like setting brought to life by the "System Super 22" hardware!

title: Sector Shooter
description: Step into the chaos of Sector Shooter, a fast-paced action game where you’ll battle through a series of themed sectors, from dusty desert to deep industrial mines. Face a variety of enemies, collect coins and buffs, and push forward through increasingly challenging sectors. Each sector contains a set number of enemies that must be defeated before you can move on. As you progress, upgrade your character and weapons, sharpen your reflexes, and prepare for a challenging boss fight showdown.

title: Grandia
description:
Grandia is a role-playing game that combines exploration, character progression, and turn-based combat within a structured adventure. Players travel across varied regions, develop a party, and engage in a battle system that emphasizes turn order management and strategic timing.
This version is a port of the original game, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Rabbit Run Carrot Hunt
description: Rabbit Run Carrot Hunt is a fast-paced endless runner where you play as a quick and clever rabbit trying to collect as many carrots as possible. Carrots restore your energy, which slowly depletes as you run. The longer you survive, the more points you earn. A black panther is chasing you and occasionally launches sudden attacks that you must jump over to avoid. At the same time, you need to dodge various obstacles along the way. Stay alert, keep collecting carrots, and run as far as you can before the panther catches you.

title: Cazzarion: Raccoon Valley
description: "Cazzarion: Raccoon Valley" is a relaxing nature adventure where you play as a curious raccoon exploring a lush valley filled with rivers, a serene lake, dense trees, and open meadows. Roam freely through the landscape in search of tasty critters like snails, worms, frogs, and more. With no enemies, it's all about foraging, exploring, and enjoying the peaceful rhythm of the wild.

title: To Farm Lands
description: Cultivate logic, harvest stars

title: Arab Drift Cars 2: The Definitive Edition
Life in Terminal Simulator: Airport Adventures
description: Survive harsh nights and unpredictable airport dangers.

title: Hole Digging Simulator 2025
description: Dig deeper for priceless secret discoveries.

title: Tune My Car: Tuning Studio & Mechanic Simulator 2025
Calc+-
description: Calc+- is a fun and brain-teasing puzzle game where you work with numbers. Each level gives you a set of number blocks. Using your controller, you can add, subtract, multiply, or divide them. Your goal? Make the final number match the target number. The more levels you beat, the harder it gets. How far can your brain take you?

title: Pic-A-Block
description: Welcome to Pic-A-Block, a brand new puzzle game from TreeFall Studios. Pic-A-Block is a 3D spatial brain teaser game. The goal of the game is to recreate 2D images in 3D by positioning blocks in a manner that matches the picture you are given.

title: Beanball
description:
Beanball is a fast-paced arcade game where you pilot a small spaceship and dodge incoming asteroids. The longer you survive, the more points you earn. Collect coins to boost your score and stay ahead!

But the real twist? If your ship gets destroyed, you can rewind time to bring it back—just be careful, your rewind energy is limited. Run out, and it’s game over!

How long can you last in the asteroid storm?

title: Fly Light
description: Fly Light is a game in which you need to turn on lamps located on 4 different sides, thereby attracting midges to you. Thus, you need to lure as many midges as possible to the exploding area. But you need to be careful, because if you attract a midge too close to you, it can sit on the lamp, thereby partially blocking the glow range of the lamp, which will mean that you will not be able to attract a new midge so easily. You will lose when the midges stick to one of the lamps so that it can no longer shine. You get points for the number of midges destroyed using explosions.

title: Double Dragon III: The Sacred Stones
description: Billy, Jimmy, and the whole Double Dragon gang fight for the Sacred Stones to save in the world in yet another beat-em-up.

title: Ash Pines: The Motel
description: Something is watching you, can you escape?

title: Ninja JaJaMaru Legendary Ninja Collection
description: With the ultimate JaJaMaru - Legendary Ninja Collection you get an extensive package of ninja action including eight games! Relive childhood memories with classic Ninja JaJaMaru Jump & Run titles from the ‘80s and ‘90s, experience the RPGs of the legendary series for the first time translated into English, enjoy the Ninja JaJaMaru Game Boy title now in color and play the brand new, 2022 released addition to the awesome series.

title: Persona 5: Dancing in Starlight - Yakuza Set
description: Yakuza costume set for P5 Protagonist, Ryuji, Ann, Yusuke, Makoto, Haru and Futaba.

title: Persona 5: Dancing in Starlight - Original Crossdressing Set
description: Original Crossdressing costume set for P5 Protagonist, Ryuji and Yusuke.

title: Persona 5: Dancing in Starlight - Catherine Set

title: Persona 5: Dancing in Starlight - Futaba's Shujin Academy Uniform & Loungewear Set

title: Persona 5: Dancing in Starlight - Atlus Selection Set
description: Atlus Selection costume set for P5 Protagonist, Ryuji, Ann, Yusuke, Makoto, Haru and Futaba.

title: Electronics Puzzle Lab 2
description: Learn circuitry and electronics engineering in a fun way with concepts simple enough for beginners but engaging for enthusiasts!

title: Arcade Archives: Chopper 1
description:
"CHOPPER 1" is a shooter released by SNK in 1988.
Pilot a combat helicopter deep into enemy territory in a mission to restore peace to your homeland.
Wielding overwhelming power far beyond what’s needed to simply protect one's family, what will these men discover at the end of their path of destruction?

title: Cauldron Forager
description: Step into the pixelated woods in this retro-inspired arcade adventure where you play as the Witch of the Forest. Collect magical ingredients, battle enemies with fiery spells, and brew the potion throughout endless levels. Simple, nostalgic, and endlessly replayable - perfect for fans of classic 80’s arcade fun!

title: Fishing Rush
description: Fishing Rush – Dive into the ultimate fishing adventure!

title: Arab Drift Cars 3
description: The third edition of the popular Arab Drift Cars game, specifically in Riyadh. Start playing, drifting, and drifting now with the most famous cars and maps.

title: Dragon Ball: Xenoverse 2 - Day One Edition
description:
Relive the Dragon Ball story by time traveling and protecting historic moments in the Dragon Ball universe
Next-gen visuals bring the Dragon Ball anime experience to life
New characters and boss fights
Brand new hub city more than 7X the size of the original game with 300 players online at the same time
More in depth character creation system and battle adjustments

title: Dot Connect
description: Can you complete them all and become the ultimate Dot Connector?

title: Formula
description: FORMULA is a game in which you need to fly a ball and collect elements of the formula. After each collection, the shape of the curve of the field changes, along which you can move. Points are awarded after selecting each element of the formula. The game ends when the ball touches the walls of the narrowing field.

title: Dragon Ball: Xenoverse - Day One Edition
description: Dragon Ball Xenoverse is the first installment of the Xenoverse series and the Dragon Ball game developed by Dimps. It is the first fighting game to feature full 3D battles similar to the Budokai Tenkaichi series. Fighters can traverse the levels free-roaming in large spaces and can fight on ground, in the air and underwater. The game features spoken dialogue from a majority of main characters while in battle, and characters show facial expressions when they strike an opponent or take damage. Although limited, the players have some freedom to explore the planet Earth as it exists in the Dragon Ball universe along with a handful of other locations.

title: Arcade Archives: Scrambled Egg
description:
Kick, launch, and get chased! It's a scramble emergency!!!

"SCRAMBLED EGG" is an action game released by Technos Japan in 1983.
Kick the eggs to crack them open and hatch chicks. Then launch all the new chicks into the sky!
Red chicks and chickens will help you take down enemies. Be sure to take good care of them!

title: The Life of Buzludzha
description: The game is the abandoned monument of Buzludzha and the game included a winter season of atmosphere as real. You have to look for some buttons and an exit.

title: Earth Defense Sticks
description:
Earth Defense Sticks is a fun and fast-paced 2D arcade game where you play as the planet Earth!

Asteroids are coming from all directions, and your job is to survive as long as possible. To help you, you have four powerful defense sticks — one on each side of the planet: top, bottom, left, and right. Press the matching buttons to extend the sticks and smash incoming asteroids.

Each asteroid you destroy gives you points. The more you hit, the higher your score!
Simple to play, hard to master — how long can you protect the Earth?

title: Icenoid
description:
Icenoid is a fun and easy-to-play brick-breaking game. Use the paddle to bounce the ball and destroy all the blocks on the screen. Break them all to complete each level!

Collect a wide variety of power-ups that make the game easier — ball, paddle upgrades, and even rockets that blast through bricks. But be careful! Not all drops are helpful — some power-downs will make things harder, so you’ll need to dodge them quickly.

title: Pixicharm: Brotillery
description:
Grab your bandana and load up — it’s time for Brotillery!
Dash through chaotic warzones as a one-bro army, blasting enemies, dodging traps, and collecting coins. It’s a wild, fast-paced run ’n gun with retro vibes and nonstop explosions.

Simple controls, endless action, and full bro-power!

title: The Chase: Police Rush
description: The Chase is an endless driving game where you take the role of a driver on the run from the police.
