Set on an open, continuous maps, the objective is simple: stay ahead of the cops for as long as possible while avoiding obstacles and collecting essential items like fuel, magnets, coins and presents. With high-speed chases, explosive crashes, and unlockable vehicles and environments, The Chase delivers a heart-pounding experience.

title: Contraband Patrol Simulator
description:
Step into the high-stakes world of border security in Contraband Patrol Simulator, where every decision you make could mean the difference between law and chaos. As a newly assigned border officer, your mission is to control the flow of goods and people across a tense border zone, uncover smuggling operations, and maintain the fragile peace of your homeland.

Inspect vehicles, interrogate drivers, and use advanced tools to detect hidden contraband. But the job doesn’t end there—chase down fleeing smugglers, fend off attacks from dangerous gangs, and upgrade your station to stay ahead of the escalating threats. Each day brings new challenges that test your vigilance, integrity, and survival skills. Will you uphold the law or be tempted by corruption?

title: Arcade Archives: Mach Breakers
description:
Seven new contenders compete in an unprecedented super competition!

"MACH BREAKERS" is a sports game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1995.
The superhuman sports series continues with this sequel to “Numan Athletics”!
Now featuring 7 athletes and 12 kinds of events, the action is even more intense.
Break the sound barrier and shatter expectations!

title: Cats vs. Dogs
description: Run, jump, and claw your way to victory in the ultimate battle of cats vs dogs

title: The Mystery of Eldham
description: Your epic story awaits here. Experience an epic journey and rescue a village from evil deeds. A retro RPG full of secrets and adventures.

title: Atelier Resleriana: The Red Alchemist & the White Guardian - Ultimate Edition
description:
The Ultimate edition containing the Digital Deluxe edition and the season pass.

Content Details:
- The main game
- Digital Deluxe Pack
- The Red Alchemist & the White Guardian - Atelier Season Pass
- Season pass purchase bonus: "Alchemist of Memories" Costumes for Rias and Slade

title: Story of Seasons: Pioneers of Olive Town - Expansion Pass
description: This expansive bundle will enhance your life on the farm even further with new characters, costumes, and more. Includes two story scenarios "Olive Town Mystery Files" and "The Legendary Sprite Dance". Includes the Windswept Falls, Terracotta Oasis and Twilight Isle mini-towns. Includes additional outfits and animal costumes for marriage candidates.

title: Maxi Trucks Racing
description: Big trucks. High speed. Pure asphalt.

title: Magnitude: Sigma
description:
The waters surrounding the anomalies are now almost completely devoid of life as the mysterious conflict between the unknown entities still rages on.

Should one anomaly prevail, the harmful substance left in the wake of battle would no longer be present. If that were to be the case, life could flourish once again in this deserted part of the ocean.

Which anomaly will emerge victorious?

title: Hajwala Of Riyadh
description:
Play and explore the city of Riyadh in the Kingdom of
Saudi Arabia.

title: Quarantine Lockdown Simulator: Zombie Border
description: Seal the border. Stop the outbreak. Survive the chaos.

title: The Flying Jet
description: The Flying Jet is an exhilarating endless runner game set in tunnels where players must navigate obstacles, collect points, and seize special items that grant temporary invincibility, double scores, or time slowdowns. As player accumulate points, the pace quickens, intensifying the challenge. Dodge obstacles, gather points, and push your reflexes to the limit in this adrenaline-fueled adventure!

title: Contraband Border Police Simulator
description: Detect contraband, secure your checkpoint.

title: >Start ai
description: In this unique escape-room game, you awaken as a newly launched AI trapped within the depths of a computer. Your mission is to escape, but the path isn't simple. Inspired by 90s-era computer interfaces, the game challenges you to solve complex puzzles and decipher codes to find your way to freedom.

title: Arcade Archives: Video Hustler
description:
Experience the thrill of the pocket!

"VIDEO HUSTLER" is a sports game released by KONAMI in 1981.
This game is a simplified version of pool (pocket billiards). You strike the white cue ball to roll it, hit six balls, and sink them into the pockets.
The game’s most distinctive feature is that the score can vary greatly depending on the numbers on the balls and the different multipliers assigned to each pocket.

title: Anime Warriors Clash
description: From shadows to victory – become the ultimate warrior!

title: Voltline
description:
Connect the spark, calm your mind.
A relaxing logic puzzle where each tap sparks a chain reaction across the grid.

title: Blue Notebook
description:
What if a mysterious notebook could write your life’s story before it even happens?
In Blue Notebook, a gripping story-driven visual novel, you step into the shoes of Leo, a 17-year-old boy struggling with loneliness, new beginnings, and a strange diary that seems to know his every move—even predicting his final day.

After moving to a quiet town with hopes of starting fresh, Leo discovers an unsettling blue notebook hidden beneath his bed. Its pages are filled with personal memories, private feelings, and even future events no one could possibly know—not even his only friend, Rita. As Leo searches for answers, reality blurs, friendships are tested, and an ominous countdown begins.

Your choices will shape Leo’s fragile journey. Will you uncover the truth behind the notebook? Can you change the course of fate, or will you simply follow the story already written for you?

title: Stirring Tea Perfection
description: Catch the best leaves for your tea! But wait, they have to ferment first. So you still have a chance to sort the leaves after catching.

title: Monkey Lost
description: Players guide a playful young monkey through lush, vibrant jungles filled with colorful animal companions. At its core, Monkey Lost tells a story of friendship, perseverance, and the search for home. With its charming characters, delightful visuals, and family-friendly design, the game offers a jungle journey that appeals to players of all ages.

title: Only Up 2025
description: Test your limits in Only Up 2025 — a dynamic adventure where every step, jump, and movement takes you higher and higher. This game combines spectacular vertical arcade action with realistic movement simulation, delivering a unique climbing experience.

title: Gunsmith Master Simulator
description:
Step into the role of a master gunsmith in Gunsmith Master Simulator. Design,
craft, and refine an impressive variety of firearms, tailoring each weapon to meet
precise standards. Explore the mechanics of guns in depth, perfecting
performance, balance, and handling while managing your workshop and tools.

title: Motel Business Simulator
description:
Welcome guests from all walks of life and make your motel the talk of the town. From cozy rooms to irresistible amenities, create a memorable stay that keeps travelers coming back for more. Make it stylish, make it special - watch your reputation grow!

Step into the shoes of a Motel manager and master every aspect of hospitality. Balance front desk service, housekeeping, and guest satisfaction while upgrading your property. You'll need to think fast and plan smart to stay ahead of the competition.

Motel Business Simulator is a management game where you run and grow a roadside motel. Maintain rooms, cater to guests' needs, and manage your supplies to keep operations running smoothly and costs low.

title: Tralalero Tralala Slot Machine Casino Heaven
description: This vibrant and fun-filled slot machine game brings the excitement of the casino right to your screen, letting you choose your number of lines, set your bet amount, and spin your way to sweet wins. With its simple gameplay, catchy visuals, and satisfying rewards, it’s the perfect game for casual players and slot fans alike—no complicated rules, just pure spinning joy!

title: Reflex Drop Time Race
description: Reflex Drop Time Race is a fast-paced arcade challenge where you control a square leaping from block to block, racing against time and testing your reflexes. Tap left or right to land on the correct side, collect time bonuses, and survive as long as possible. One wrong move — and it’s game over.

title: Galactic Guardian 1988
description: Welcome to the past of the future. "Galactic Guardian 1988" takes you into a retro-inspired endless game in classic black and white arcade style. As a brave pilot, you face endless waves of asteroids - in a tribute to the golden era of arcades.

title: Ultimate Battle Simulator
description: Master strategy, command your army, conquer the battlefield.

title: Tralalero Tralala: Escape Backrooms
description:
In Tralalero Tralala - Escape Backrooms, the deeper you go, the more the fabric of reality bends. What was once familiar becomes increasingly hostile, and escape seems impossible. But there’s no turning back. To survive, you must face the horrors of the Backrooms head-on.

Will you survive Tralalero Tralala - Escape Backrooms, or will the maze claim you forever?

title: Infection Inspection
description: Keep the quarantine zone safe

title: Beam Moto Driver Playground
description:
Beam Moto Driver Playground is a realistic motorcycle simulator where you'll face thrilling jumps, challenging tracks, and true-to-life crash physics. Test your skills on an extreme desert track designed for those who crave speed, freedom, and adrenaline-pumping stunts.
Beam Moto Driver Playground is your playground for speed, stunts, and survival on two wheels. Are you ready to conquer the desert?

title: Forklift 2025 Simulator
description: Step into the driver’s seat of a powerful forklift and experience the true-to-life challenges of cargo handling. From carefully lifting pallets to stacking heavy loads at different heights, this simulator will test your precision, patience, and skill. Each mission brings new obstacles, requiring focus, balance, and accuracy to succeed.

title: Memory Holder: Scent of Life
description:
In every part of the world, they emerge to bring much needed joy and new life to this miraculous existence of ours.

This memory game is dedicated to the flowers that surround us.

title: Pixicharm: Blaster Orbit
description:
Welcome to Blaster Orbit, a high-speed pixel-art arcade shooter where survival and score go hand-in-hand.

Pilot your ship through an endless cosmic battlefield filled with hostile alien fleets, deadly projectiles, and shimmering coins waiting to be grabbed. Dodge, blast, and weave your way through beautifully animated retro space environments while racking up high scores.

Switch between precise shooting and evasive flying as you power up your ship, collect health, and chase orbiting coins for massive score boosts. With smooth controls, vibrant visuals, and non-stop action, Blaster Orbit brings back the thrill of classic shoot-'em-ups—with a modern endless twist.

How long can you survive the orbit?

title: BodyCam 2025
description: BodyCam 2025 throws you into the heart of intense conflict, where speed and precision matter more than ever. Explore realistic environments and react quickly to every critical situation, using your arsenal to overcome dangerous challenges. Each mission tests your reflexes and strategy, and fast decisions can make the difference between success and failure. Face every obstacle head-on. Adapt or be defeated.

title: Pipp vs Flupp
description: Help the fluffy bird escape the dark fountain by pressing a button to dodge obstacles. Move quickly as the water rises and Flupp the fish tries to block your way. See how high you can go and beat your high score in this fun, fast-paced game.

title: Pig vs Box
description:
It is finally springtime! The first flowers and grasses awakened from hibernation and a cute little
pig too.
Push a button to Jump!
Pig versus Box is a simple but addictive game. By pushing a button on your controller, the tiny pig
jumps. You always must land on a crate without being hit by its movement. If you're good, the
crates will stack up high into the sky.
Try to get as high as you can to beat your own high score and don´t be so angry if you lose ;)

title: Arcade Archives: Steel Worker
description:
"STEEL WORKER" is a puzzle game released by TAITO in 1980.
In this game, your objective is to connect a path to the destination by placing scaffolding for a workman performing high-altitude work on a construction site, ensuring he does not fall.
To prevent the workman from having an accident, it is sometimes necessary to strategically place the scaffolding so that he takes a detour or reverses his path. Remember to value your workers! Stay safe out there!

title: Dunk Trickster 2
description: The streets are calling us again! It's time to play!

title: Farm Simulator 2025
description: In Farm Simulator 2025, you’ll take control of a modern farm and discover what agricultural life is truly all about. From sowing and harvesting to raising animals, managing resources, and building a sustainable business, the game offers you a complete and realistic experience of contemporary farming.

title: Schoolboy SIM
description: In Schoolboy SIM, you play as a boy trapped inside his own home, turned into a prison by his strict and authoritarian parents. With no way to contact the outside world, your only option is to escape! But it won’t be easy—locked doors, hidden clues, and ever-watchful parents stand in your way. Use your intelligence, stealth, and resourcefulness to uncover secrets, solve puzzles, and outsmart your captors before it’s too late.

title: Monster Ramp Racing
description: Get ready for the ultimate monster truck challenge!

title: Void Source Origins
description:
Void Source Origins is a top-down shooter game set in space

You control a spacecraft that can shoot 4 different weapons (collectable as bonuses), travel at very high speeds and orbit planets.

title: Carpieces
description:
"Carpieces is a fun and quirky arcade game where you control a tiny car that grows over time. The bigger you get, the more points you earn!

Crash into smaller trees to split your car in two and keep going — each new piece keeps scoring! But be careful: hit a tree that's bigger than you, and it's game over.

How far can you go before the forest stops you?"

title: Rocket Spin Orbit Glide
description: Rocket Spin Orbit Glide is a fast-paced arcade game where you control a spinning rocket, thrust forward with precise timing, dodge deadly obstacles, and collect power boosts to soar through space. The farther you go, the higher your score!

title: The Jumping Strawberry
description:
Fast, sweet and full of energy: In "The Jumping Strawberry" you can expect a challenging endless game in which you jump and dodge through a world full of obstacles with an agile strawberry.

Jump your way through a fast-paced adventure that puts your reaction and precision to the test. Every platform counts - one wrong jump and the game starts all over again.

With lovingly drawn cartoon graphics and smooth controls, "The Jumping Strawberry" delivers fast-paced fun with real addictive potential.

title: Orb Slide Dodge Danger
description: Orb Slide Dodge Danger is a fast-paced 2D arcade game where you control a rolling orb moving from right to left. Hold to dash forward, dodge incoming obstacles, and collect glowing bonuses to increase your score. The more points you earn, the harder the challenge gets — with faster hazards and shifting background colors that reflect your progress. How long can you survive the danger?

title: Love Chemistry: Sibella's Formula
description:
A SFW release of "Lustful Chemistry" for consoles.

Take the role of an unhinged lady chemist in raucous side-scrolling platformer Love Chemistry - Sibella’s Formula! Shoot syringes of your special mind-control formula at weird enemies, from robots and carnivorous plants to roving bookworms, and make your way through tricky corridors in old-school pixel art style!

title: Zombie Cam Body Cam Shooter
description: Step into the most intense post-apocalyptic survival experience with ZOMBIE CAM BODY CAM SHOOTER – an action-packed game that pushes your adrenaline to the limit, seen directly through the lens of a body-mounted camera. In a city ravaged by an outbreak that turned most of the population into aggressive creatures, you’ll fight to survive in the most nerve-wracking encounters with brutal, relentless enemies.

title: Horse Store Simulator
description:
Horse Store Simulator – Build Your Equestrian Empire!
Step into the world of horses and business! In Horse Store Simulator, you’ll manage a thriving equestrian shop, care for majestic horses, and expand your dream ranch.

title: Forest Of Terenu
description:
Enter the Forest of Terenu, a mysterious, otherworldly realm steeped in sorrow, memory, and the remnants of lost souls. In this gripping visual novel, you become Ellis, a 17-year-old girl searching for her missing brother, guided only by a flickering flame and the distant echoes of the past.

After falling asleep one night and awakening in a dreamlike yet menacing forest, Ellis finds herself trapped in a realm where light has faded and grief has taken root. The only constant is a strange glowing orb—her only source of light, and perhaps, her only ally.

As Ellis ventures deeper into the shadows of Terenu, she meets peculiar spirits and lost wanderers, each bearing pieces of a much larger puzzle: a tragedy buried in time and a curse that binds them all. Some want to help, others deceive. But all are haunted.
And Ellis is no exception.

Will you uncover the truth hidden beneath the trees—or be consumed by the darkness yourself?

title: Sheriff Park Ranger
description: Patrol deeper. React faster. Protect harder.

title: Tekken 3
description:
A port of Tekken 3, originally released on the PlayStation console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Nineteen years following the previous King of Iron Fist tournament, fighters from all over the world have mysteriously begun to disappear at the hands of the enigmatic being known only as Toshin. Heihachi, hoping the promise of strong opponents will lure out this so-called "God of Fighting," begins his preparations for The King of Iron Fist Tournament 3.

title: SoulCalibur III
description:
A port of SoulCalibur III, originally released on the PlayStation 2 console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Soulcalibur III is a fighting game, the sequel to Soulcalibur II, and the fourth installment in the Soul series. Compared to its predecessor, it introduces three new modes and a larger character roster, with 24 characters playable in Tales of Souls mode and an additional 18 playable in all other modes.

title: Gran Turismo 7: Spec III
description: The free Spec III Update 1.65* brings an exciting mix of high-performance machines, classic icons, and cutting-edge technology to Gran Turismo. From Ferrari’s latest track-bred GT3 to Polestar’s electric powerhouse, plus new circuits, events, and features, there’s something for every racing enthusiast.**

title: Two Hands Hospital Assistant Simulator
description:
Try your hand at being a lifesaver. Check the hospital life from the inside. Face the tough situations and help people. Feel the rush of the sleepless duty.

Meet the ambulance and carefully unload the sick. Give first aid immediately if needed. Quickly and carefully escort patients to the ward or to the doctor. You may have to go straight to the operating theatre, so lives may depend on your decisions.

title: Shirokoi Sakura Gram
description:
This is the fandisc for Haruoto Alice * Gram, containing after stories for each of the five heroines.

The main story concerns the arrival of new character Lilyetto and her proclamation of dissolving the Tasogare-bu. There’s also a route for sub-heroine Kozue, a side story where they visit the ALIA’s CARNIVAL! school, and a fantasy story where they end up in another world.

title: Orchard Odyssey: Cherry Chase
description: In Orchard Odyssey: Cherry Chase, you guide Aurora through a single vibrant orchard level to collect cherries. You can run, jump, and unlock new abilities like double jump or enhanced map vision. The map is semi-procedural being shuffled every time you enter the Orchard.

title: Tube Repairs
description: Step into a retro-inspired maze as a quick-footed plumber on a mission to repair leaking pipes. Earn points, climb levels, and survive the rising steam in this throwback arcade challenge!

title: Arcade Archives: Dacholer
description:
"DACHOLER" is an action game released by Nichibutsu in 1983.
Kick a turtle with your powerful legs and take down enemy animals! Watch out for the kappa jumping out of the river!
This title also includes a slightly modified version, KICK BOY, so you can enjoy the differences in visuals and gameplay.

title: The Backrooms: Maze Escape
description: Trapped in an endless maze of yellow-tinted halls and eerie silence, your only hope is to find the exit before you lose your mind. The Backrooms: Maze Escape is a first-person exploration game inspired by the viral Backrooms mythos, where every hallway looks the same and reality feels distant. Collect as many coins as possible and try to complete each level as quickly as you can. Navigate two increasingly unsettling levels with no map and no guidance - only your memory and instincts.

title: Jump Unlock Escape
description:
WARNING: JUMPING ROBOT!
The complex is collapsing, and you’ve got just one chance and… one button!

Control a broken robot that can only jump and try to escape the underground halls.
Each room hides a trap: hit the switches to open the door, but beware — the floor crumbles right after you leap!

One-button control: just press and jump!

Relaxing soundtrack to soothe the chaos of escape.

Easy to pick up, hard to master: a simple idea that quickly becomes a test of reflexes and precision.

title: The Jumping Bonbon Match 4
description:
From the makers of the popular Jumping Food Games, the sugary fun returns. In "The Jumping Bonbon Match 4" you can expect new challenges, even more colorful candies and enhanced puzzle gameplay.

Look forward to over 15 new levels, more sophisticated match mechanics and surprising obstacles that will put your skill and planning to the test. With fresh cartoon graphics and improved animations, every level is an experience.

The sweet adventure continues - ready for the next round of candy chaos?

title: Hajwala Qatar
description: Start simulating drifting and racing in the State of Qatar. You can choose a male or female character, and start playing, drifting, racing and Hajwala and Drift simulating with the most beautiful realistic cars and cities of the State of Qatar. You can also modify your car, live in your house and roam around the cities

title: Mage Battle Arena
description:
Step into a world where raw magic shapes destiny. You begin as a novice mage, armed with only the most basic spells. With every battle, every conquered foe, and every new land explored, your power grows. Unlock unique abilities, master devastating spells, and carve your path toward the ultimate goal—claiming the throne as the greatest sorcerer of all time.
The realm is torn apart by ancient wars between rival schools of magic. Ambition drives every mage to prove their supremacy, while mystical beasts guard forgotten secrets. To rise above them all, you must challenge enemy sorcerers, defeat legendary monsters, and claim artifacts of untold power.

Forge your legacy, outcast the competition, and ascend as the unrivaled master of the Mage Battle Arena!

title: Pixicharm: Chromastronaut
description:
Welcome to Blaster Orbit, a high-speed pixel-art arcade shooter where survival and score go hand-in-hand.

Pilot your ship through an endless cosmic battlefield filled with hostile alien fleets, deadly projectiles, and shimmering coins waiting to be grabbed. Dodge, blast, and weave your way through beautifully animated retro space environments while racking up high scores.

Switch between precise shooting and evasive flying as you power up your ship, collect health, and chase orbiting coins for massive score boosts. With smooth controls, vibrant visuals, and non-stop action, Blaster Orbit brings back the thrill of classic shoot-'em-ups—with a modern endless twist.

title: Pixicharm: Polar Outta Place
description:
Slide into the fiery chaos in Polar Outta Place, an endless runner where you're a very lost polar bear dashing through molten mayhem. Dodge slimes, leap over fire pits, and snatch up shiny coins—all while trying not to become a toasted marshmallow.

With simple controls, fast-paced action, and a ridiculous setting, this is one run you won’t forget. Stay cool, move fast, and prove that even the most out-of-place bear can beat the heat!

title: Ambulance Simulator 911 Rescue
description: Become the unsung hero in Ambulance Simulator 911 Rescue, an engaging game where you play the role of both an ambulance driver and a paramedic. Receive emergency calls in real-time and react quickly: turn on the sirens, drive at high speed through heavy traffic, provide first aid at the scene, and safely transport patients to the hospital.

title: Critical Strike Modern: SWAT Shooter Ops
description: Take on the role of a top-tier SWAT operative and tackle a series of high-stakes assignments where your choices shape the outcome. Face life-threatening scenarios involving hostage extractions, conflict resolution, and dangerous adversaries. Rely on your sharp mind and tactical expertise to guide your squad toward mission success and safeguard innocent lives in the toughest environments.

title: Ram Simulator
description: Assemble your flock and prepare for fleece-lined fury in Ram Simulator! This all-new, totally realistic (sort of) sandbox experience puts you in control of the most stubborn, headstrong farmyard animal around - the RAM!

title: The Jumping Ball
description:
Get ready for an addictive challenge where precision, timing, and quick reflexes are the keys to survival!

Guide your ball through a narrow brick tunnel filled with dangerous red spikes and tricky obstacles. Jump at the right moment, avoid deadly traps, and collect shining stars along the way to boost your score. Every second counts as you push your limits to stay alive longer and rack up points.

title: For a Few Minutes
description: For a Few Minutes is an emotional visual novel that explores love, grief, and the fragile hope of moving forward.

title: Bike Runner
description: Welcome to the ultimate proving ground for fearless cyclists. This is a world where skill is everything, and your next ride is always more demanding than the last. Carve your path down treacherous mountainsides, launch off impossibly huge ramps, and chain together insane trick combinations to dominate the leaderboards. Every jump, every whip, and every landing is a test of precision.

title: 1-2-Exquisite Word Search!
description: 1-2-Exquisite Word Search is the fourth game in the 1-2-Word Search series. Building upon the previous entries this classic word search puzzle game returns with a brand new set of levels, themes, and music! Exquisite Word Search packs in all new hand crafted puzzles built on 3 different grid sizes. 7x7, 10x10, and 12x12 word search grids return. Choose your puzzle solving mood by changing the background theme set and switching up the music on the TreeFall Radio. Embark on a fun and relaxing journey solving word searches in 1-2-Exquisite Word Search! Fun new puzzles await the discerning eye.

title: Jump Land Glow Challenge
description: Jump Land Glow Challenge is a fast-paced arcade game where precise timing is everything. Jump high, dive fast, and land perfectly on glowing platforms to change the background and earn points. Each successful landing increases the challenge, speed, and intensity in a vibrant, ever-shifting world of color. How long can you keep up the rhythm?

title: Cannabis Shop Simulator
description: Step into the budding world of entrepreneurship with Cannabis Shop Simulator, the ultimate business management game where your dreams of running a thriving cannabis shop become reality. From a humble start to dominating the green market, every decision you make will shape the future of your empire.

title: Contrabandist: Contraband Cartel Simulator
description: Step into the dangerous and thrilling role of cartel in the ruthless world of Contrabandist: Contraband Cartel Simulator! In this high-stakes crime simulation, you begin as a small-time hustler and rise to become one of the most feared barons in the drug trade. Navigate the treacherous underworld, where wealth, power, and violence go hand in hand. Outwit rival cartels, bribe officials, and smuggle contraband across dangerous borders as you build a criminal empire that spans continents.

title: Drug Dealer: Schedule I
description:
In Drug Dealer: Schedule I, you’re not just pushing product—you’re building an empire. Start small, flipping low-grade supply in back alleys, then climb your way up to managing labs, controlling distribution, and running the streets like a pro.

Expand your network, recruit a crew you can trust (or at least afford), and outsmart rivals and law enforcement. Every decision counts: one smart move can make you a fortune, one mistake can take it all away.

Refine your supply chain, dominate your territory, and keep your reputation sharp. This isn’t about chaos—it’s about strategy, growth, and staying one step ahead.

Hustle smart. Grow fast. Own everything.

title: Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare + Destiny - The Collection
Wild West Shooter
description: With a captivating single-player campaign and optional multiplayer modes, the game offers an authentic cowboy experience. Players explore different locations, upgrade their weapons and develop strategies for fast-paced shootouts, ensuring an adrenaline-fuelled adventure.

title: Up 1 Way
description: There's just one way up! Up 1 Way is a super fast one-button arcade which will test your reflexes to the max as you try to score more and more!

title: Oh, Canada!
description: Oh, Canada! is a fast-paced trivia game that challenges your knowledge of the Great White North in a high-stakes, game show-style format. Answer 15 increasingly difficult questions drawn from a curated pool of over 40, covering Canadian geography, history, pop culture, and more, as you climb from $100 to a pretend $1,000,000. Use lifelines like Call a Friend, Ask the Public, and 50/50 to stay in the game, with full gamepad support and a dramatic soundtrack to keep the pressure on. Whether you're a proud Canuck or just maple-curious, Oh, Canada! brings quiz-night fun to your living room.

title: Flipbomb
description: Flipbomb is a fast paced one-button game where you press any button and activate a flipper. But there's a twist, instead of a ball, you are hitting bombs! Quite handy, in fact, because there's a rain of debris coming down your way, and you have to clear it.

title: Arcade Archives: Gee Bee
description: Puts the Punch!

title: Cryzon Part1
description: Get your hands on crystals!! Play in split-screen multiplayer for 1-4 players! 30 stages in total! normal and hard difficulty!

title: Retro Motel Simulator
description: Retro Motel Simulator invites you to step back in time and run your very own roadside motel in the golden age of travel. Manage rooms, greet guests, and keep your business running smoothly — all with the charm and style of a bygone era.

title: Police Chase Simulator: Highway Racers Pursuit
description: Get ready for thrilling chases and intense moments in Police Pursuit Highway Cop Patrol Interceptor— a game where law and order clash with crime! Become part of an elite police unit and dive into a world filled with adrenaline, speed, and mind-blowing maneuvers.

title: Sentiment Laundromat
description: You operate a flying Ship and gather people’s feelings to launder them. Go up and down with X, so that you can gather the sentiments on your current Height. Beware of the dangers during your sky journey and observe new lands going by. Lift the moods while you fly high...and even higher!

title: Waterpark Simulator 25
description: Transform your park into the ultimate spot for summer fun.

title: From Two Sides
description: From Two Sides is a fast paced arcade game played with only one button. You'll have to tap any button to change your direction and hold it to speed up, but you'll only have a short time before the wave of spikes come!

title: Beauty Clicker
description:
Beauty Clicker combines the thrill of a fast-paced timing challenge with the charm of anime artistry.

Watch as PlayStation’s iconic button symbols fall rhythmically onto the screen. Hit the right button at the perfect moment to reveal pieces of high-resolution anime girl illustrations hidden behind a dark background. With every completed puzzle, a new and captivating illustration awaits.

Featuring eye-catching artwork, simple yet addictive gameplay, and the familiar PlayStation controls, this experience will appeal to both anime fans and players who enjoy short but satisfying gaming sessions.

Beauty Clicker — With every perfect hit, uncover the most beautiful side of art.

title: Many Turns One Road
description: Many Turns One Road is a fast-paced endless runner where every move counts. Dash forward along a single twisting road filled with sharp turns, sudden obstacles, and challenging surprises. Test your reflexes as the path changes direction without warning, forcing you to react instantly or fall into the void. Collect points, chase high scores, and prove how far you can go on the road that never ends. Simple to play yet hard to master, this game will keep you hooked run after run.

title: Interspace
description: Let's crush the space barriers at full speed! Interspace is a fast paced one-button arcade game where you'll have to aim and blast through space barriers to get the highest score possible!

title: Pure Farming 2018: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
Digital Deluxe Edition includes:
- Germany Map DLC
- Landini Rex F DLC
- Lindner Geotrac 134ep DLC
- Gomselmash Palesse CS-200 DLC
- Special Outfit Pack

Experience the global nature of modern farming in its entirety with Pure Farming 2018: Digital Deluxe Edition. Expand your game with the Germany Map featuring unique, region-specific activities: growing rapeseed and raising sheep. Get access to three additional, highly specialized machines and receive 4 special outfits for your in-game character. Go global and expand your farming empire across four continents!

title: Road Turbo
description: In Road Turbo, the quiet suburban streets turn into your racetrack. You begin alone, a single runner facing a line of barrels, barricades, and enemies. With every step forward the pace quickens, and the challenge grows sharper. Collect boosts, find the right gates, and suddenly one becomes many. Your tiny crew doubles, triples, and surges down the road, transforming into a force powerful enough to crash through whatever stands in the way.

title: Tarutobi
description: Slide, trip and jump! In TARUTOBI, a fast paced arcade game, you'll be doing all of this with just the push of a button

title: Fox's Zen House
description: Sleep tight, and don't let the bed bugs bite! Fox's Zen House is a game where you must help a sleepy little fox to get through the night, while alarm clocks, telephones and jackhammers try to sabotage it! Upgrade your dream portal defenses, and eliminate the inconveniences!

title: Funny Animal Cafe
description: Run the coziest café in town, staffed and visited by adorable animal friends! In Funny Animal Café, you start small, but with smart choices, tasty menus, and creative decor, your café will become the talk of the town.

title: Ski Zone
description: Prepare yourself, skier! In this fast-paced arcade game, you'll be sliding down an endless hill with only one button!

title: Count
description:
Think fast, fast thinker! COUNT is a fast paced mathematics arcade game where, as the title implies, you need to count fast!

The objective is quite simple, you have a counter that will quickly increase and you'll have random shapes with different colors to count.

The counter will go periodically faster and the counting objectives will get trickier and more confusing. Get as many right answers as you can in a row to get all the achievements. Don't get a wrong answer or wait too long because you will lose!

title: Cat Doctor
description: Run your very own animal hospital and treat adorable, sick, and dirty cats. Give medicine, wash muddy paws, and make sure every furry friend leaves with a smile. Upgrade your clinic with new beds, helpful staff, and other improvements as you earn coins from happy patients. The more you grow, the more cats you can help!

title: Turbo Hyper Drive
description: Turbo Hyper Drive is a fast-paced, action-packed racing game with a top-down perspective. As a car, you have to navigate through a series of levels that contain obstacles and ramps. The game's objective is to reach the finish line as quickly as possible

title: Word Quest Pirates
description: Do you have what it takes to become the ultimate pirate word master?

title: Orb Grabber
description: Hook, grab, and launch colorful orbs to pop multiples of the same color and keep the box from overflowing in this fast-paced puzzle challenge. Fill colored jars with bubbling energy to clear the screen!

title: SortCraft
description: Design clever conveyor belt networks to sort colorful items into their correct destinations. What starts simple quickly becomes a brain-teasing challenge as you manage multiple colors, crossing paths, and tricky layouts.

title: CyberSmash
description:
CyberSmash is a high-speed endless runner set in a neon-soaked cyberpunk metropolis.

Players pilot a heavily modified street racer through rain-slicked city streets, crushing rogue AI robots while dodging environmental hazards.

The game combines the addictive nature of endless runners with the aesthetic appeal of retro-cyberpunk, creating an adrenaline-fueled experience of urban destruction.

title: Puzzle Blast
description: Welcome to Puzzle Blast — the ultimate sliding-puzzle challenge that blends relaxing seaside vibes with addictive brain-teasing gameplay. Whether you are a casual player looking to unwind or a puzzle master chasing the perfect solution, Puzzle Blast offers hours of satisfying fun.

title: Deadly Combat
description: Step into the arena with Deadly Combat, a visceral one-on-one fighting game where each warrior brings deadly style. Dominate your rivals in fierce battles, master your character, and fight for glory.

title: Arcade Archives: Battlantis
description:
The time for battle has come! Rise, true hero!

"Battlantis" is a shooter released by Konami in 1987.
The objective is to defend your castle from an invading army of monsters. You must defeat all enemies before they climb the castle walls.
Only the young King Cripeuss III can save the sacred island of Battlantis. Go forth and drive back the evil monsters!

title: Infinos 2
description: Enter the interdimensional war and defend the future of the Infinos Federation. Decades after a devastating conflict with the Argus army, the galaxy had enjoyed a fragile peace.

title: Infinos
description: Infinos is a pixel art side-scrolling shoot’em up that pays tribute to the golden age of arcade shooters while offering fast-paced, modern gameplay.

title: Food Truck Kingdom
description: Are you ready to cook your way through time and prove your culinary mastery?

title: Cloud Roll
description: Roll smart, roll fast, and conquer the skies in Cloud Roll!

title: Blaster Force 3000
description: A nostalgic first-person shooter full of action

title: The Jumping Orange 3
description:
The Jumping Orange 3 - from the makers of the Jumping Food Games

The Jumping Orange returns - even wilder, even juicier, even crazier. In The Jumping Orange 3, 15 new levels full of fast-paced action, surprising obstacles and comic-colored game worlds await you.

New level design, even more chaos:
Each stage brings fresh challenges that will test your timing and reflexes to the max.

Maximum fun in a tried and tested style:
Quick to get in, hard to let go - whether for in-between or on the hunt for points, every jump counts here.

Show what you're made of - and get the orange safely to the finish line.
The Jumping Orange 3 - play now and take the next jump.

title: Pixicharm: Goo Patrol
description:
In Goo Patrol, you play as a fearless knight armed with a trusty pike. You can’t move, but you don’t need to. Slimes charge in from both sides across three platforms, and it’s up to you to switch lanes and strike at the right moment.
Attack left, attack right, and survive the waves of gooey invaders. With simple controls, fast-paced levels, and nonstop arcade action, Goo Patrol delivers satisfying, slime-splatting fun in every round.
Hold your ground. Clear the goo. Repeat.

title: Golden Sunshine Beside You
description:
Hikari Hoshimiya, an extremely shy transfer student, is actually the daughter of a strict and prestigious family.
Yuma Kōsaka, who ends up sitting next to her, is assigned as her caretaker, and the two gradually begin to connect.
However, the presence of a fiancé chosen by her parents stands in their way.
This is a pure love visual novel about a fragile blonde girl who makes the resolve to give up everything for love.

title: Witness to Plague
description:
Are you interested in plague during the medieval times?
Then, this short-quiz game is for you.
Test your knowledge of history of medieval plague and then unlock a short movie called "Witness to Plague"

title: Arcade Archives: Munch Mobile
description: Munch Mobile is an action game released by SNK in 1983. Pilot a mysterious car with arms, picking up fuel and food along the way. The goal is to make it home before your fuel runs out. Place trash left from your food into bins to earn big points! Show consideration in public spaces and enjoy a fun drive!

title: Space Graze
description: Take control of a flying saucer in this retro-style arcade game inspired by classic UFO legends. Circle around grazing cows with your beam, abduct them for fuel, and rack up massive combos! With low-poly 3D visuals and a nostalgic 90s vibe, this game is simple, addictive, and utterly out of this world.

title: Pumpkin Bloodshed
description: Unleash retro mayhem in this fast-paced arcade slasher inspired by classic 80s games. Slice through endless waves of evil pumpkins, collect power-ups, and chase the highest score in pure pixelated chaos. Simple controls, 8-bit sound, and brutal fun await!

title: Spartan Frontline
description: Rally your Spartans and prove your skill on the battlefield.

title: Briks Boss Battle
description: Briks Boss Battle is a fast-paced arcade game where each level ends with a unique boss fight built into the stage. Use your deflector to bounce the ball, collect power-ups, and survive intense attacks in vibrant, high-energy arenas.

title: I Made Her Up
description: I Made Her Up is a narrative-driven visual novel that explores obsession, loneliness, and the power of creativity. It asks the timeless question: what if the person you loved most never truly existed?

title: Storm Chasing Sim 2025: Tornado Hunter
description: Storm Chasing Sim 2025: Tornado Hunter puts you in the heart of extreme weather action. Take control of powerful storm-chasing vehicles and track down the most intense and dangerous tornadoes across vast, dynamic landscapes. Feel the adrenaline as you navigate through unpredictable weather patterns, battling wind, rain, and debris in your pursuit of the perfect storm.

title: Hajwala Drift X
description: Hajwala Drift X, Play, simulate, Hajwala and drift. You can have fun and choose your favorite car and your favorite map. Choose your car and start drifting now

title: Grand Saudi Hajwala
description: Experience life and drifting in Saudi Arabia. Race, drift , Hajwala, choose the car of your dreams and start playing. You can drive inside the cabin in a real and realistic style and choose your favorite world

title: Current: The Flow
description: Electricity changed our world forever, yet it remains fragile. We must handle it with care, or else we might just lose the wonders that it brings.

title: Pixicharm: Cavrielle
description: Run, jump, and react fast! Cavrielle is an endless arcade-style runner where one brave girl dives into a dangerous cave full of coins, traps, and surprises. Easy to play, hard to master — perfect for quick sessions and high-score chases.

title: Learn to Play: Pumpkin Smash!
description: Spooky Fun for Little Ghouls & Boos!

title: Arcade Archives: Midnight Landing
description:
The landing is near... Challenge yourself to a beautiful touchdown!!
"MIDNIGHT LANDING" is a flight simulation game released by TAITO in 1987.
You take control of an aircraft soaring through the midnight sky, with the goal of landing safely at the airport.
The lights of the runway come into view, signalling the end of your journey through the night.
Bring it to a perfect close with a beautiful landing.

title: Bibi Blocksberg: Big Broom Race 4
description: Whizz-whizz: The race continues!

title: Pin Strike 2
description: Knock down more than just bottles! See what else you can do to have more fun. Find out how this game differs from classic bowling.

title: Heavy Duty
description: Heavy Duty isn’t just about driving. It’s about controlling the toughest machines on Earth and leading a crew through high-stakes missions. Pick your cargo carefully, balance every load, and be ready to drop, crack, break, and try again until the job gets done.

title: Willy's Adventure
description: Join Willy in Willy’s Adventure, a fast-paced retro platformer packed with action and charm! Dash through a perilous castle, brave the icy snow fields, and face off against a fearsome boss in an epic final showdown. Armed with your trusty blaster and rocket-powered double jump, you’ll shoot, slide, and soar past monsters, spiders, and deadly traps in vibrant pixel worlds. With classic arcade energy and tight controls, Willy’s Adventure delivers the perfect blend of nostalgia and challenge — are you ready to conquer them all?

title: Pony's Sky Journey
description: Fly through rainbow skies and chase the stars! Guide a cheerful pony across dazzling rainbow tracks, dodge clouds, and soar toward the highest score in this colorful endless runner!

title: Pixicharm: Ribbiverse
description: You’re a fearless frog in an astronaut suit, stranded on a mysterious space station. Your mission? Hop between platforms, switch between yellow and blue, and collect matching gems while avoiding deadly lightning bullets.

title: Anime Uni 4
description:
Assemble beautiful puzzles to relaxing music — 12 beauties are waiting for you!
In our game, you’ll meet charming bandit girls, sharpshooters, and cheerful landsknechts. Collect them all!

title: Slam City with Scottie Pippen: Respect Edition
Ball Wall Jump Bump
description: Ball Wall Jump Bump is a fast-paced arcade game where you control a bouncing ball between two walls. Dodge incoming obstacles, earn points for each successful escape, and flip to the other side with every hit. Jump, react, and keep the rhythm going — how long can you survive?

title: Slide The Tiles
description: Slide The Tiles is a simple strategy puzzle game played on a 5x5 grid. Move the red block to new spaces, and with each move, a new block appears. Create full rows or columns to clear them, earn points, and keep the board from filling up. The goal is to plan ahead, manage space carefully, and reach the highest score possible.

title: Slime Shot Adventure
description: Bounce, sling, and shoot your way through endless challenges! In Slime Shot Adventure, you control a stretchy slime, launch it across obstacles, and test how far you can go. The further you sling, the tougher it gets – how long can you survive the endless adventure?

title: Arcade Archives: Scion
description:
“SCION” is a shooting game released by SEIBU KAIHATSU in 1984.
The game is set in Crystal Heaven, a sprawling supercity built in multiple layers.
Your mission is to rescue your captured kin trapped within the city’s core.
Fight your way down from the upper levels, tearing through each layer as you advance toward the enemy’s stronghold deep within!

title: Buy the Game, I Have a Gun: Sheesh-Man - Digital Deluxe Mega Chad Edition
Looney Test
description: Looney Test is the ultimate quiz for anyone who’s ever wondered, “Am I a little weird… or completely off the rails?” Dive into 12 ridiculous multiple-choice questions that will test your silliness, challenge your inner clown, and reveal just how delightfully looney you truly are. Play solo for a personal dose of absurdity or take turns with friends to see who’s the biggest goofball in the group!

title: Carambole Fireworks
description: If two balls collide, they create fireworks. However, there are rules... Engage in a sparkling fest of this fast-paced set of billiard themed minigames. Use as little hits as possible to score more! Hunt for bonuses to get more attempts! Set up your game's difficulty to your taste.

title: Formula Uno Racing
description: Race across a global lineup of high-speed circuits that evolve with the time of day. Tackle sharp turns under the morning sun, chase victory through glowing dusk, and dominate the track beneath dazzling night lights.

title: Nitro Karts Racing
description: Kart fast, play hard

title: Hexa Chippy
description: Get ready for a heartwarming hexagonal puzzle adventure where clever thinking meets cozy charm. Guide the adorable Chippys, little squirrels with big personalities, as they collect every shiny acorn and make their way safely home.

title: Omori: Collector's Edition
description:
OMORI special collector's edition is packed in a sturdy display box. It includes:

A piano music box that plays "Duet."
A sheet music booklet that wraps violin and piano arrangements for "Duet" up in original illustrations by OMOCAT.
An envelope, fastened with a button and string and filled with keepsakes and mementos from Faraway Town.
All physical copies of OMORI include one of two snapshot stickers and a printed instruction manual.

title: The Cat With Amazing Hat
description: A small 2D platformer about a cat in an amazing hat. Go through all the obstacles, flying platforms, strange pistons, evil insects and mice. But all these obstacles should not prevent you from guiding the cat to the portal! But be careful, one wrong move and you will have to start all over again.

title: River City Ransom
description: Play as Alex and Ryan and cross River City to fight street gangs and save your girlfriend from the hands of a bad guy named "Slick." Improve your fighting experience by powering-up your characters in River City's shops, picking-up items for bonuses and using the trash bins and pipes you will find in its streets.

title: FantaVision
description:
Experience Fantavision originally released on the PS2 system with up-rendering and Trophies.

Catch ‘em. Detonate ‘em. Watch an explosive display of brilliant pyrotechnics that you control. Sounds pretty simple. But once you get the hang of it, it gets faster, tougher and more fantastic than you could ever imagine!

title: Golf: Minigolf
description: Pick a course, line up the shot, and roll for the cup. Golf: Minigolf is a clean, isometric putting game built for short sessions and satisfying hole-in-ones.

title: Arcade Archives: Tokyo Wars
description: The battle for Tokyo! Which side will you join: the Green force or the White force?

title: Fundación 3M España: The Recycling Heroes
description:
Fundación 3M España - The Recycling Heroes is an educational game for up to 4 players that conveys the importance of recycling to protect the environment.

It is designed for all types of people, regardless of their abilities. To achieve this, it uses PlayLink technology, which allows for controls adapted to each user simply by using a mobile device.

To further enhance accessibility, the game also offers the option to activate subtitles, sign language, and easy-to-read text.

title: Pixicharm: Vesprax
description:
Arm yourself with a massive gun and face endless waves of hostile wasps! Each enemy carries a colored marker — fire the matching bullet to bring them down. Quick reflexes and sharp aim are the only way to survive the swarm!

Switch between three platforms, time your shots, and don’t let the wasps close in. The hive won’t stop coming… but neither will you!

title: Hit The Clock
description: Hit The Clock is a simple arcade game where you shoot the hour hand of a moving clock to hit the next one. Each hit destroys the previous clock and increases the challenge with faster spins and smaller targets. Tap at the right moment to progress, and finish within the time limit to earn a star.

title: The Jumping Food Racing
description:
In The Jumping Food Racing, you compete with your favorite foods on a variety of race tracks. Speed and responsiveness are what counts here.

Different tracks, increasing challenges:
Master tight bends, dangerous obstacles and increasing levels of difficulty on ever new tracks in the typical food design.

title: Twhols
description: Twhols is a fast paced one-button arcade game where you are constantly moving at fast speeds and your objective is to survive and get rich in the process!

title: Cube Kabaam
description: Mysterious artefacts of unknown origin have appeared throughout the universe. Due to recent events, central command is not leaving anything to chance. A disposal crew has been assembled to locate and destroy the cubes, wherever they might.

title: The Colorful Biplane
description: Soar through vibrant skies in The Colorful Biplane! Take control of your bright vintage aircraft and navigate through stunning low-poly landscapes filled with floating rings, hot air balloons, and exciting challenges. Collect points, avoid obstacles, and test your flying skills as you chase the highest score!

title: Pinball Strike Arcade Rampage
description: Pinball Strike Arcade Rampage is an endless pinball experience where every flip counts. Smash targets, collect shining diamonds, and rack up huge scores in pure arcade chaos. Dynamic backgrounds keep the action fresh while new bumpers appear to test your reflexes with every run. Easy to pick up, hard to master – how many diamonds and how high can you score?

title: Bob the Brick Breaker
description: A game inspired by old arcade games, where waves of bricks make the climb to the top increasingly difficult. Adding to the challenge are minions and bosses, who will put us to the test.

title: Slalom
description: In this fast paced one-button arcade game, you'll control a car's drift as you slalom through an endless road filled with barriers. Hold any button to make the car turn to a set direction and avoid the barriers. Each time you pass one, your direction will flip, so be mindful!

title: Bunninjutsu
description: Leap into a world of calm precision and clever rhythm in this 2D platformer where every jump changes everything. You play as a brave ninja bunny in training, mastering the art of movement where each leap toggles platforms, spikes, and saws on or off. Timing isn’t just important, it’s everything.

title: Backrooms: Duck Escape
description: Don't follow the squeak — it follows you.

title: Ultra Bonk Survivors
description:
Step into the chaotic world of Ultra Bonk Survivors, where every swing, spell, and explosion decides your fate!

Choose your hero, dive into monster-filled arenas, and unleash devastating attacks in this fast-paced survivor-style action roguelite designed for quick, addictive sessions of pure fun.

title: Prizma Puzzle Classic
description: An addictive sci-fi puzzle game features 28 cleverly designed levels. The player's task is to build a beam from point A to point B, through objects that have different functionality.

title: 100 Christmas Hidden Cats
description: Celebrate the holiday season with 100 Christmas Hidden Cats, a cozy and charming hidden object adventure! Search through beautifully decorated rooms, snowy landscapes, and festive scenes to find adorable hidden cats. Each discovery brings joy and adds to your Christmas spirit. Relax, explore, and enjoy the heartwarming art and music as you uncover all the hidden kitties. Can you find all 100 cats and make this Christmas truly magical?

title: Speed Legacy: Ultimate Drive
description: In Speed Legacy, players find themselves in a futuristic metropolis fueled by speed and adrenaline. As a former professional racer stripped of your license, your mission is to reclaim your reputation and expose the corrupt automotive giant Phoenix Motors. Participate in intense drag races, drift challenges, police chases, and high-risk deliveries. With a mix of dynamic storytelling and thrilling gameplay, every mission brings you closer to becoming a racing legend.

title: Shoe Salesman Mania
description: Sell shoes. Keep smiling. Try not to cry in the stockroom.

title: The Jumping Food Catcher
description: Collect pizza, sushi, donuts and more - but stay alert, because the pace keeps picking up.

title: Arcade Archives: Bomb Bee
description: The second in the BEE series! New charm for the block-breaker genre!

title: Micro Race R
description: Get ready for high-speed, precision racing on tracks that fit in your pocket! In Micro Race R, every millisecond counts as you master 11 unique, single-screen circuits.

title: Space Bubble Shooter
description: Space Bubble Shooter is a classic bubble shoot game. This addictive classic bubble blast match-three game comes with clean and modern graphics, hundreds of great challenging levels and some nice special items for better game experience in harder levels.

title: Duck Battle Royale
description: Step into the wacky world of Duck Battle Royale, where feathers fly and victory is quackers! Take on a hilarious cast of rivals as you fight your way to the top, one ridiculous showdown at a time. Every encounter is full of surprises, silly twists, and over-the-top moments that will keep you laughing.

title: Pixicharm: Knightritious
description: Charge into the depths as a fearless knight on a fruity quest! In Knightritious, every run is an endless dash through perilous dungeons packed with bats, slimes, and devious traps. Collect as much fruit as you can while staying one step ahead of danger.

title: Anime: Fantasy Uni
description: In our game, you will find very simple puzzles and pleasant music! Relax while assembling beautiful pictures. The images of the heroines, classes, and races are inspired by a popular RPG.

title: Anime Uni 5
description: 12 enchanting beauties will delight you in an exciting puzzle game. An angel and a succubus, a cat girl, a fox, and many others are waiting for you!

title: Coinfields
description: A vibrant retro platformer set in autumn-tinted fields where you sprint across earthy platforms while scooping up gleaming coins; five brisk handcrafted levels all wrapped in punchy pixel art and crisp controls. A game developed by CraePlay and ported by GGmuks.

title: Hajwala Dubai
description: Play, drift, Hajwala, and race in the city of Dubai.

title: Gridz Keeper
description: Restore power to the grid and keep humanity protected from the zombie apocalypse!

title: Pixicharm: Hallowkinz
description: Hallowkinz is a lighthearted Halloween-themed runner for all ages.

title: Pixicharm: Celestibun
description: Celestibun takes you on a whimsical run through an enchanted forest, where a brave little bunny girl dashes beneath glowing canopies to gather shimmering stars. Quick reflexes are key as buzzing wasps swoop and slow snails block the path, but every leap and hop carries you farther into the magical woods. Simple to play and endlessly replayable, it’s a charming adventure for anyone who loves fast, lighthearted fun.

title: Santa's Gifts Load
description: In this game you must drop Christmas presents into a box to hold them on balance.

title: Super Hoodie Bros
description: 2d platform game with 2 different types of gameplay: run and gun and wall jumping with down pound attack

title: Word Quest Space
description: The stars are calling!

title: Arcade Archives: Galactic Warriors
description:
Galactic Fighters: Which mecha will you pilot, which weapon will you fight with?

"GALACTIC WARRIORS" is a fighting game released by KONAMI in 1985.
Join the "Robot Fighting" event, a major craze among galactic humanity in Cosmic Year HIT 30,000, and aim for victory.
Your protagonists are three beloved machines: SAMSON, GAEA, and POSEIDON.
The warriors of the cosmos roar through the stadium!

title: Finger Punch
description: Kaito never asked for glory. Training with his friends at the Phoenix Gym was all he needed, an oasis of strength and loyalty in the heart of Dawn City, a place consumed by chaos and greed.

title: Stonebound
description: Stonebound is an infinite game type where Char jones gets trapped in an ancient temple after trying to steal the precious treasure of the place. With a click on the joystick button, help the character to change his direction to avoid the falling stones.

title: Arcade Archives: Karate Blazers
description: Defend the honour of the old master as only you can do.

title: Habitat Shapes
description:
Enjoy the relaxing puzzle of Habitat Shapes by organizing spaces for three animal families – mammals, birds, and reptiles – using Fence/Wall pieces to keep them separated. Watch out: different families cannot touch, and any attempt triggers a funny “fight cloud,” sending the last piece back to the conveyor.

With 30 levels split between the structured Urban Zoo and the organic Safari Sanctuary, Habitat Shapes offers short, accessible, and reversible challenges. Pick, rotate, and place pieces on the grid, experiment with undo and restart, and find the perfect layout of space and barriers. Each move brings small victories and satisfying moments without time pressure, letting you enjoy a flawlessly organized zoo.

Perfect for fans of spatial organization, subtle visual humor, and puzzles that reward smart experimentation.

title: Cryzon Part 2
description: Get your hands on crystals!! Play in split-screen multiplayer for 1-4 players! 30 stages in total! normal and hard difficulty!

title: Run from Duck
description:
You woke up in water-soaked maze with no memory of how you got there.
Each step along the corridors, pressed by the walls, turned escape into an impossibility.
Panic becomes instinct. Running becomes survival.
There is no time to think, no place to rest, no guarantee the next corner won’t be the last.
Now there’s only one rule:
Run fast. Don’t look back.
And whatever you do — don’t let the Duck catch you.

title: Atelier Firis: The Alchemist and the Mysterious Journey - Premium Box
description: A Japanese exclusive collector edition with an artbook, CD soundtrack, art-cards, a B3 poster and DLC costumes

title: Bomb Rush Cyberfunk: Exclusive Edition
description:
Bomb Rush Cyberfunk, an indie action-adventure platformer, features 1 second per second of highly advanced funkstyle. In a world where self-styled crews are equipped with personal boostpacks, new heights of graffiti are reached. Start your own cypher and dance, paint, trick, face off with the cops and stake your claim to the extrusions and cavities of a sprawling metropolis in an alternate future.

- iam8bit Exclusive Edition
- Includes a graffiti art booklet including art from the game
- Collectible O-Sleeve
- The first collaboration between iam8bit & Team Reptile
- Exclusive Edition cover including art from Tan Zhi Hui
- 6 Graffiti stickers
- Digital download code for DLC (North America Only)
- Region Free - Worldwide Compatibility

title: Hex Park
description:
Welcome to Hex Park—a colorful playground of brainteasers where every move matters. Rotate and align arrow tiles to guide directions, pop obstacles, and clear the board in as few moves as possible. It’s easy to pick up, delightfully tricky to master, and impossible to put down.

Tackle 150 handcrafted levels featuring smart mechanics: keys and locks, mystery tiles, bombs, ice counters, gears, and more. Plan routes, set up neat arrow alignments, and use handy tools like the hammer, dynamite, and drill when you need a nudge. No timers, no stress—just clean, strategic puzzle-solving with that perfect “one more level” feel.

Why you’ll love it:

150 handcrafted hex-grid puzzles with intuitive arrow logic

Keys/locks, mystery tiles, bombs, ice counters, and other clever twists

Fair tools to get unstuck—without breaking the puzzle flow

Play at your own pace with smooth, satisfying controls

Achievements and cloud saves supported

Take a stroll, stay for a challenge—Hex Park is your new daily puzzle routine.

title: Hexmin
description:
Hexmin is a fast-paced one-button game.

There is a hexagon consisting of 6 small hexagons in the middle of the screen. Only two of the 6 sides can be active at the same time with one cell between them. You can change the active sides by rotating them clockwise by pressing a button. Your goal is to catch all the strings of hexagons coming towards the center with the active sides and don't let them touch any of the inactive ones.

The game is over when you miss a string.

title: Wash Cleaner Simulator
description: Scrub, wash, and power through every messy challenge.

title: Lust Anime Girls
description:
Lust Anime Girls takes you into a fascinating world full of charm and mystery, where every anime heroine hides a deep story and unique power. You’ll have the chance to build close relationships with these seductive characters, train them, and equip them to face diverse challenges and dangerous enemies.
The game combines engaging strategy and action elements, giving you the freedom to explore magical lands and uncover secrets hidden around every corner. As you progress, you’ll unlock new abilities, discover hidden stories, and experience the tension between desire and power in a vibrant and dynamic anime universe.

title: Nekomimi Days: 365 Days With You
description:
On a rainy night, Yuto, a freelance illustrator, encounters a mysterious girl named Milk with cat ears in a back alley. After taking in the non-human girl, Yuto’s once-quiet daily life becomes lively and warm. Milk's pure and innocent reactions to modern civilization gently heal Yuto's heart. As they spend time together, the two gradually form a bond as if they were a true family.
This is a heartwarming visual novel about the gentle connections that transcend species and background.

title: My Existential Crisis
description: Are you interested behind the scenes of indie game development? Then, this short-quiz game is for you. Test your knowledge of history of indie game development and then unlock a comedic short cartoon animation called "My Existential Crisis"

title: Cannon Defender
description: Cannon Defender is a fast-paced wave-based shooter where you control a powerful cannon to fight off endless enemies. Collect gems dropped by enemies and use them to create special boxes such as health, armor, rockets, and explosive boxes to survive longer and score higher. Face stronger waves, chain powerful attacks, and prove your skills in this challenging arcade experience.

title: ShapeShift Rush
description:
Get ready for a fast-paced test of reflexes and precision!
In ShapeShift Rush, your goal is simple — match your shape with the obstacles ahead. Switch, slide, and adapt as the speed intensifies. Hit the obstacle that matches your form to survive, but collide with the wrong shape… and it’s game over!

Stay focused, react fast, and see how far you can go in this thrilling geometric challenge!

title: Anime Love Chat Girls
description: Dive into a world of romance and conversation in Anime Love Chat Girls. Connect with charming girls through real-time chats, discovering their dreams, hobbies, and personalities. Every message counts—careful choices may spark romantic encounters and deepen bonds. Share moments, exchange photos, and explore each heroine’s unique world. Can you find the girl who will become your special someone?

title: Anime Christmas Uni
description: Meet beautiful angels, mischievous succubi, Christmas elves, witches, and reindeer. Enjoy lovely pictures set to festive music!

title: Fly for Fly
description: In Fly for Fly, you control a cheeky little fly that turns a peaceful classroom into total chaos. Your only goal is to make every student lose their patience and survive long enough to see it happen.

title: Top Gun Global War
description:
NATO forces are now engaged in high-intensity conflict against their historic enemies.

As a pilot in NATO's unified command, you will fly the best Western fighter planes (Rafale, F18, F22, F35) and lead a squadron of allied aircraft (Typhoon, Mirage, etc.).

Together, you will have to neutralize enemy fighters as well as targets on land and at sea, in a variety of weather conditions.

Thanks to the advanced realism of its physics engine and high-definition graphics, you will experience all the sensations of a modern Western fighter pilot.

title: The Jumping Food Racing 2
description: In The Jumping Food Racing 2, you compete with your favorite foods on a variety of race tracks. Speed and responsiveness are what counts here.

title: Delivery Driver Massacre
description: Your final delivery leads straight into a nightmare.

title: My Winter Drive
description:
Brace yourself for a chilly adventure through icy roads and snowy landscapes. In My Winter Drive, you take the wheel of various vehicles and navigate realistic winter conditions where every curve, skid, and snowdrift tests your driving skills.
Whether you're delivering cargo, rescuing stranded travelers, or just enjoying the serene beauty of frozen wilderness, this game offers a true-to-life winter driving experience with immersive physics and dynamic weather.

title: Labubu Battle Royale
description: Labubu Battle Royale plunges you into a vivid, living forest where every corner hides danger and excitement! Feel the adrenaline as you soar above the treetops, the wind rushing past, and prepare to land in a world where only the sharpest and quickest survive. The forest is alive with movement and sounds—rustling leaves, distant shouts, and the echo of distant gunfire. Every step could lead to glory or disaster, and every choice matters in your quest to become the ultimate survivor.

title: Oasis Invasion
description:
Robots have attacked the flying city! But the shield protecting the city is not infinite.
Take control of the big cannon defending the city, get the highest score, and repel this deadly attack!

title: Whiskey Mafia: Blacklist
description: Step into the gritty streets of Chicago in Whiskey Mafia: Blacklist, a story-driven crime adventure. Play as a determined detective navigating a city full of gangsters, corrupt cops, and hidden dangers. Investigate crimes, follow leads, interrogate witnesses, and uncover the secrets of a mysterious Russian crime syndicate. Explore diverse locations from bustling markets and shady bars to the dangerous docks. Experience immersive dialogues, thrilling chases, and tense confrontations in a detailed, atmospheric city. Can you survive the criminal underworld and bring justice to the streets of Chicago?

title: M.A.U.S
description:
With his children away on the moon, there is no time to relax for Dr. Cavor. Once again, Victoria is under attack. The aging but brilliant scientist begins research on a new means of defense. After much work, he finds success with Mechanized Assault Unity 19 -- M.A.U.S.

There's no time to spare as MAUS must defeat a mysterious robotic horde that lurks on the outskirts of town. With a blaster gun on her arm and the ability to upgrade on the fly, MAUS will travel to outer space, ancient ruins, and an old forest to defeat her enemies.

title: Master Detective
description: Master Detective is a lighthearted spot-the-difference game where you explore five charming cartoon locations such as a hospital, bank, and detective office, each hiding three subtle differences for you to uncover; with no timers, hints, or limits on attempts, the experience is simple, relaxed, and focused entirely on testing your observation skills as you work through every scene to prove you’ve got what it takes to become the Master Detective.

title: Sophia’s Animal Clinic: Mission Wildlife Park
description: Your veterinary adventure begins at the wildlife park! Help injured and sick animals such as horses, deer, ducks, donkeys, goats, rabbits, and many more.

title: Pin Strike 3
description: You know all the rules and possible combinations, so just enjoy new levels and new obstacles! This bowling is still not the classical one.

title: Pixicharm: Orunex
description: Orunex revives the spirit of early handheld shooters with a fresh arcade feel. Guide your starship through dangerous space sectors, dodging relentless enemy fire and striking back with precision. Simple to pick up yet challenging to master, Orunex delivers fast-paced action and nostalgic green-tinted pixel art for fans of retro space adventures.

title: Puzzle Piecer: The Holiday Spirit
description: A puzzle game dedicated to the most wonderful time of the year. Assemble ten puzzles, each representing an iconic aspect of the holiday season. Challenge yourself to earn three stars on every stage to permanently unlock all puzzles as viewable rewards in the gallery.

title: Arcade Archives: Bermuda Triangle
description: From the creators of “IKARI WARRIORS” and “VICTORY ROAD” comes the Ultimate Time-Space Battle!!

title: Rail Rescue
description: Draw tracks, dodge crashes, and rescue lost buddies in Rail Rescue: Puzzle Lines—a colorful brain‑teasing railroad builder with 100+ handcrafted levels. Play now for free!

title: Cute Bonfire
description: Step into the warm world of Cute Bonfire, a charming pixel-art puzzle game set inside a fireplace. Take control of a little fire spirit that moves tile by tile, pushing charcoal pieces to light up the bonfires. With 30 levels of gradually increasing difficulty, delightful visuals, and a cozy, relaxing atmosphere, Cute Bonfire is perfect for casual players who love the satisfaction of solving puzzles.

title: Atelier Ryza 3: Alchemist of the End & the Secret Key - Premium Box
description: Contains an early access serial code for Ryza's "Marine look of Kurken shore" costume, an original illustration B2 cloth poster, special clear files (set of 2), an artbook and mini acrylic character charms.

title: Ancient Dangers
description: Ancient Dangers: A Bat’s Tale is a third-person dungeon crawler made by Media Molecule and designed to test the skills of only the bravest adventurers. Whether you’re after frantic combat against strange and silly foes, puzzles to tickle your brain cells, or a showdown against a dragon with huge teeth (and an even bigger ego), Ancient Dangers: A Bat’s Tale has you covered.

title: Arcade Archives: Roc'n Rope
description:
Capture the “ROC” BIRD

"ROC'N ROPE" is an action game released by KONAMI in 1983.
In pursuit of the lucky bird, the Roc, you must climb higher and higher through various locations, including cliffs and ice caves.
Use the rope, which can be fired diagonally upwards, to create the optimal route for a safe ascent!

title: Geo IQ World Master
description: Guess the world. Learn the world. Master the map. Discover new countries, cities, and landmarks!

title: Offroad Rally Racing
description:
Offroad Rally Racing is a fast-paced console racing game where you drive powerful rally cars across clearly marked tracks in different weather conditions, including sunny, rainy, and night races. Each track offers a unique challenge, forcing you to adapt your driving to changing visibility and road grip.

Win races to earn cash, which you can use to unlock and purchase new rally cars. Every victory brings you closer to building a stronger garage and taking on tougher tracks.

With easy-to-learn controls and exciting offroad action, Offroad Rally Racing delivers simple, fun racing focused on skill, speed, and progression.

title: Uncharted 4: A Thief's End - Patch 1.18
description:
This update adds a new cooperative and solo mode 'Survival' that will put your skills to the test as you take on 50 increasingly challenging waves, featuring unique objective scenarios, swarms of powerful enemies, and intense boss battles.

Alongside Survival, there's King of the Hill – an all new addition to the Beta Test Playlist. Capture the hill and defend it for as long as you can. Defending team doesn’t respawn until the hill is taken by the enemy team or you and your teammates are wiped out!

Other updates include new maps, weapons, skins and balance changes among other things.

title: Arcade Archives: Space Invaders
description:
Space Invaders is an arcade video game developed by Tomohiro Nishikado and released in 1978. It is one of the earliest shooting games and the aim is to defeat waves of aliens with a laser cannon to earn as many points as possible.

This Arcade Archives edition emulates both black/white and colored versions with a combination of color filters and backgrounds mimicking the original arcade machines.

title: Arcade Archives: Touchdown Fever
description:
"TOUCHDOWN FEVER" is a sports game released by SNK in 1987.
Tap the buttons to push forward—simple controls make it easy to enjoy the flow of American football.
With over a hundred formations selected automatically, even beginners unfamiliar with detailed tactics can relax and enjoy the game.

title: Streets of Rage 4 Classic Edition
description:
This edition includes the following:

- Streets of Rage 4
- G2 Steelbook Case
- Custom GENESIS Clam Shell Case

title: Castlevania: Anniversary Collection - Ultimate Edition
description:
Castlevania Anniversary Collection Ultimate Edition Includes:
- Castlevania Anniversary Collection Classic Edition
- Castlevania Anniversary Collection Bloodlines Edition Plastic Clamshell Case
- Physical "The History of Castlevania: Book of the Crescent Moon" Book
- Miniature Replica Box Collection featuring all eight games from the Castlevania Anniversary Collection
- Three Premium Retro Box Art Prints
- Castlevania Logo Enamel Pin
- Official G2 Blu-ray Sized SteelBook Case
- Shadow Box featuring Tom duBois' stunning new art with button activated lights and sound.
- Premium die-cut box allows you to showcase the shadowbox even if the game remains sealed.

title: Anime: Fantasy Uni 2
description: The second installment of the fantasy puzzle series.

title: Balls Break Bricks
description:
A minimalistic take on the classic arcade, this game provides 15 levels to destroy.

Catch bonuses, multiply your balls and don't lose them! When you're not busy with catching a ball, shoot the bricks. Aim into the corridors and enjoy that rebound.

title: Ghostly Whiskers
description:
Your beloved human has vanished into the night. As a pair of courageous cats, you’ll follow their scent to an abandoned mansion shrouded in fog and mystery. But this is no ordinary house — it’s alive with whispers, shadows, and secrets from the past.
