Ghostly Whiskers is a short but unforgettable co-op (or solo) adventure that blends light horror with heartwarming moments. Solve puzzles, explore eerie rooms, and use your feline instincts — like squeezing through tight spaces, climbing ledges, and sniffing out hidden clues — to uncover the truth.

title: The Perplexing Orb: Bounce Mania
description: The Perplexing Orb returns in the final chapter of the Bounce series, Bounce Mania! Welcome to the world of The Perplexing Orb, an arcade game where you roll the orb through various stages dodging obstacles, collecting items, and knocking down the finish post without falling off! Bounce Mania brings all new levels, enhanced art, new platforms, and new obstacles to dodge!

title: Atelier Sophie: The Alchemist of the Mysterious Book - Limited Edition
description: Includes a 48-page art book, 2-disc soundtrack, a cloth poster, and 5 mini art prints.

title: Arcade Archives: The Outfoxies
description:
Make use of various weapons to eliminate the enemy assassins

"THE OUTFOXIES" is an action game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1995.
You select one of the world’s top assassins as your protagonist, and under the orders of a mysterious billionaire, your mission is to eliminate all the others.
Whether for the reward, for pride, or simply for the thrill of combat…
A no-rules showdown among the world’s most dangerous professionals is about to begin!

title: Word Quest Fantasy
description: Wield enchanted swords, explore ancient castles, and unravel word puzzles charged with mystical power. Each grid hides words that bring you closer to becoming a true hero of the realm. Defeat challenges, unlock secrets, and let your imagination guide you through a storybook world where every word is part of your adventure. Are you ready to prove yourself in the ultimate fantasy word quest?

title: Tiny Biomes
description: Restore life to the troubled lands in tile-based brainteaser style!

title: EmyLiveShow: Demons and Mistresses Tale
description: Fantasy battle of EmyLiveShow vtubers — fight or fall to temptation!

title: Arcade Archives: Space Invaders Part II
description:
In 1979, and again in 2026, the Invaders are returning!

"Space Invaders Part II" is a shooting game released by Taito in 1979.
The enemy Invaders have returned more powerful than ever, having acquired new tactics like splitting and receiving reinforcements from Ufos!
With added features like the Rainbow Bonus to aim for high scores, this title is long beloved by skilled experts looking to hone their abilities!

title: Chinese PigLoad
description:
In this game you must drop pigs into a box to hold it on the balance.
The pigs affect the balance according to their distance from the Chinese motorcycle.

Match 3 pigs of the same color vertically or horizontally to remove them from the playfield.

Every pig has its own weight, so let them fall wisely. The weight is shown in the nose of each pig.

If one side of the box hits the ground, the game is over.

Use special pigs like column cleaner pig, row cleaner pig and the joker pig for a faster playfield cleaning and better score.

title: Dissidia Final Fantasy NT: Special Steelbook Edition
description:
In partnership with Team Ninja from KOEI TECMO GAMES, Square Enix presents DISSIDIA FINAL FANTASY NT as a new and refreshing experience – a team-based brawler.

Combining seamless gameplay, FINAL FANTASY characters and breathtaking worlds from the past 30 years of the franchise, DISSIDIA FINAL FANTASY NT welcomes all gamers to the online battle arena with its renowned bravery combat system.

DISSIDIA FINAL FANTASY NT allows you to choose from over 20 legendary FINAL FANTASY characters and battle in a 3-versus-3 arena. Each match will allow the player to call forth familiar summons like Ifrit, Shiva and Odin to dominate the opposing side or to turn the tide of the battle. This is not your average fighter – this is your fantasy, your fight.

title: Death Stranding: Higgs Variant
description:
Exclusive variant sleeve featuring the Man in the Golden Mask, Higgs, played by Troy Baker.

Sam bridges must brave a world utterly transformed by the death stranding. Carrying the disconnected remnants of our future in his hands, he embarks on a journey to reconnect the shattered world one step at a time. With spectral creatures plaguing the landscape, and humanity on the verge of a Mass extinction, it's up to Sam to journey across the ravaged continent and save mankind from impending annihilation. What is the mystery of the death stranding? What will Sam discover on the road ahead? An unprecedented gameplay experience holds these answers and more.

title: Resident Evil 3: Lenticular Edition
description:
Limited edition featuring a lenticular sleeve.

Resident Evil 3 is set amidst the nightmarish outbreak of the t-virus, a biological weapon developed by the pharmaceutical company umbrella Corporation. The game marks the debut of nemesis - a towering humanoid Bio weapon designed for both brutality and high-functioning intelligence - whose dogged hunt of S.T.A.R.S. Member Jill Valentine made him an icon of the Resident Evil series. Armed with an arsenal of high-powered weaponry and wrapped in a black suit to hide his mutilated features, nemesis will maim, pulverize or destroy any obstacle on the path to his target.

title: Ridge Racer
description: A port of Ridge Racer, originally released on the PlayStation console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Arcade Archives: Bomb Jack Twin
description:
Even the toughest challenge can be overcome by two players!
"Bomb Jack Twin" is an action game released by NMK(original work by Koei Tecmo Games) in 1993.
The popular "Bomb Jack" is back, cuter and tougher than ever! Two-player simultaneous play is also possible!
Dodge enemy attacks and collect all the bombs on the stage. Prioritize grabbing the lit bombs for a chance at a high score!

title: Mini Golf Quest
description: Can you conquer every hole and become the ultimate mini golf champion?

title: Nightfall Village
description: Sharpen your blade, follow the glow of the lanterns, and defend the village!

title: Voxel Panic
description: Blast your way through swarms of robotic enemies in this fast-paced, retro-style sci-fi FPS!

title: Street Combat Fighting
description: Fight Your Way to the Top!

title: Arcade Archives: Labyrinth Runner
description: Pit your wits against the Devil!!

title: Down Among the Dead Men
description:
Set sail on your very own epic pirate adventure.
Choose your class, forge your legend, and navigate a sea of perilous choices in this immersive gamebook adventure.

title: Parkour Simulator 2026
description: Jump, flip, and run across rooftops to become the ultimate parkour master.

title: Block Cascade
description:
Block Cascade is a puzzle game in which players clear groups of matching blocks to trigger chain reactions and progress through levels. The game features 150 levels with varying layouts, obstacles, and objectives that require planning and strategic use of moves.
Players can use power-ups such as time manipulation, block removal, and block attraction to solve puzzles more efficiently. Gameplay focuses on creating cascades and managing board space to complete each stage and advance through the game’s progression.

title: Dinosaur Survival Simulator: Prehistoric RPG
description:
Step into a world ruled by teeth, claws, and raw survival. Start as a small, fragile dinosaur and fight your way through life—hunting, hiding, and adapting in a prehistoric wilderness where danger lurks behind every rock and in every shadow. Grow stronger, dominate territories, and unlock more powerful dinosaurs as you rise through life stages, shaping your destiny in a world where only the clever and ruthless survive.
Hunger, thirst, and scarce resources make every decision critical. Some biomes are rich with prey, others nearly lifeless, forcing you to plan your moves carefully. Challenge hostile clans, battle the legendary T-Rex, and unlock free-roam mode to explore all dinosaurs, biomes, and gameplay systems at your leisure.

title: Crazy Cats Survivors
description: Cute cat heroes fight endless waves of enemies with fully automatic weapons—focus on dodging and strategic upgrade choices while attacks fire automatically. Quick 5-minute roguelite arenas deliver charming, accessible bullet-hell action with unlockable heroes and persistent upgrades.

title: Whispers of Winter Blossom
description: Beyond the falling snow awaits the miracle of meeting you.

title: Fred and Jeff: The Atomic Sulfate
description:
Originally developed as a pest repellent, atomic sulfate can transform insects into giants.

And now it's been stolen! The world is in danger! Join our heroes on their mission to retrieve it from inside a tyrant's fortress.

Infiltrate, find the spray, and return home with it in this point-and-click adventure game.

title: Cryzon Part3
description:
Get the crystals!!
Play in split-screen multiplayer with 1-4 players!
30 stages! Normal and Hard difficulty!

title: Junkyard Garage Simulator
description: Step into Junkyard Garage Simulator, where every rusted wreck tells a story and every repair brings a forgotten legend back to life. Take control of your own fully equipped garage and immerse yourself in the art of car restoration. From scrapyards to showrooms, every vehicle is a challenge waiting to be mastered.

title: Tobacco Market Simulator
description: Tobacco Market Simulator puts you in charge of your very own tobacco shop, where every decision shapes your path to success. Start small, manage your stock, and learn the ins and outs of running a business in a competitive market. From pricing products to serving customers, your choices determine the growth of your shop—and your reputation in the community.

title: Streamer Simulator 2026
description: Step into the neon-lit world of streaming stardom, where every click, every laugh, and every chat message can make—or break—you. In Streamer Simulator 2026, you don’t start in a cramped basement—you start with a high-end PC, sleek apartment, and lightning-fast internet. The only thing missing? An audience ready to watch your rise to fame. Will you conquer the cutthroat world of online entertainment or burn out under the spotlight?

title: Mote: Workshop
description: Mote: Workshop is a short, atmospheric story game set in a forgotten woodworking shop, where every tool, plank, and dust mote carries the echo of a father who spoke more through his craft than his words. Explore the dimly lit space at your own pace, interact with worn tools and scattered plans, and piece together a quiet narrative about memory, family, and the comfort of focused work. With simple controls and a cinematic first-person view, Mote: Workshop invites you to slow down, listen to the creak of the floorboards, and find meaning in the small details left behind on the bench.

title: Robo Rangers
description:
Robo Rangers is a fast-paced top-down twin-stick shooter where you take control of an elite combat robot. Fight your way through vibrant, handcrafted biomes, survive relentless enemy waves, and take down powerful bosses using a wide range of weapons and special abilities.

Every mission delivers intense, arcade-style combat that rewards quick reflexes, smart positioning, and tactical decision-making. Collect crystals, upgrade your gear, and evolve into an unstoppable Robo Ranger.

title: Dot Net
description:
This website is totally safe and definitely won't clog your operational system with the infinite number of extremely annoying pop-ups.
It absolutely won't install some extra desktop decorations.
Click the button and enjoy the entirely not shady offer.

A silly webpunk vaporwave arcade begins!

title: Anime Uni 6 3D
description: In our game, you can relax while assembling simple and intuitive puzzles accompanied by pleasant, atmospheric music.

title: Arcade Archives: Top Speed
description:
“Top Speed” is a racing game released by Taito in 1987.

Enter high-stakes street races where speed is everything, and aim for the finish line while dodging obstacles and avoiding collisions with rival cars.

Using Nitro grants you explosive acceleration. Blow past the competition, leave everyone in your dust, and show them what it means to be the best!

title: Anime Uni 7: A Happy Valentine
description: This puzzle is dedicated to Valentine’s Day and combines a romantic mood with the aesthetics of beautiful female imagery. Players assemble lovely images accompanied by pleasant music. Each puzzle is a visually appealing composition that creates a calm and relaxing gameplay experience, perfect for celebrating the day of love.

title: Pixel Puzzles Fantasy Jigsaws
description: Pixel Puzzles Fantasy Jigsaws brings mythical relaxation to your screen with 25 beautifully crafted fantasy-themed jigsaw puzzles. Choose your challenge level with puzzles ranging from 96 to 425 pieces. The game is perfect for both casual players and seasoned puzzlers alike. Whether you’re looking to unwind after a long day or escape into worlds of magic and legend, this traditional jigsaw experience offers calm, fun, and enchanting adventure.

title: Pixel Puzzles Christmas Jigsaws
description: Pixel Puzzles Christmas Jigsaws brings festive relaxation to your screen with 25 beautifully crafted Christmas-themed jigsaw puzzles. Choose your challenge level with puzzles ranging from 96 to 425 pieces. The game is perfect for both casual players and seasoned puzzlers alike. Whether you’re looking to unwind after a long day or get into the Christmas spirit, this traditional jigsaw experience offers calm, fun, and festive cheer.

title: Pixel Puzzles Japan Jigsaws
description: Pixel Puzzles Japan Jigsaws invites you to unwind with a serene collection of beautifully crafted jigsaw puzzles inspired by the landscapes, culture, and atmosphere of Japan. Designed for relaxation and focus, this traditional jigsaw experience lets you enjoy tranquil scenes at your own pace.

title: Pixel Puzzles Winter Jigsaws
description: Pixel Puzzles Winter Jigsaws invites you to unwind with a cozy collection of beautifully crafted, winter-themed jigsaw puzzles. Designed for relaxation and focus, this traditional jigsaw experience lets you enjoy the calm of winter scenes at your own pace.

title: Pixicharm: Acornflare
description: Dash through a magical forest in this fast-paced endless runner where every decision matters. Play as a nimble squirrel collecting acorns to boost your score, then transform into a fiery imp to defeat incoming enemies. Switch forms at the perfect moment, keep your momentum alive, and push your run as far as you can! Vultures, bats, and owls swoop in from above—some you dodge as a squirrel, others you burn away as a fire imp. Balancing both forms becomes the key to surviving longer and reaching higher scores.

title: Tekken: Dark Resurrection
description: A port of Tekken: Dark Resurrection, originally released on the PSP (PlayStation Portable) system, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Time Crisis
description: A port of Time Crisis, originally released on the PlayStation console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: A House That Glows
description: A House That Glows is a choice-driven visual novel about a journalist who comes to help a forgotten village—and stumbles into a mystery that only appears at midnight. Stranded by a blizzard, Shon finds shelter with the kind Atcins family, hears whispers about an orphanage that burned long ago, and sees the impossible: a house shining on the hill where only ruins should be. Pulled between duty to his family and a promise to strangers, he follows the light and uncovers a story the world tried to bury.

title: Beauty Clicker 2
description: Beauty Clicker 2 is the sequel that once again brings together the fast-paced timing challenge of the first game, Beauty Clicker, with the allure of anime art

title: Pseudo Collision
description: Don't stop running! In Pseudo Collision you are escaping from the crazy scientist patented Mega-Death-Conveyor-Belt alongside a seemingly infinite number of minions.

title: Arcade Archives: Quester
description:
"Quester" is a brick breaker released by Namco Limited (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1987.

Your goal is to safely return to Earth by piloting the spacecraft and defeating the mysterious space organisms（blocks） that obstruct your path.
The ball can split into multiple pieces if it continues to bounce off the walls. Use various power-up items to your advantage and aim to clear all 33 rounds!

title: You Have One Shot
description: You Have One Shot is a game in which you will need to select the moment when exactly you need to shoot, since you only have one shell and you will need to use it to destroy all the enemies on the level. If you shoot and don't hit all the enemies, you will lose. If you destroy all enemies with one shell, you will move to the next level.

title: Glint's Revenge
description: Glint’s Revenge is a retro platformer with a bold black-and-white aesthetic, where you play as Glint, an alien armed with a blaster on a quest through 10 deadly levels packed with traps, enemies, and clever puzzles. Shoot your way past relentless foes, flip levers to unlock hidden paths, and survive a gauntlet of challenges that demand quick reflexes and sharp thinking, all wrapped in a minimalist style that makes every move and every mistake stand out. A game developed by CraePlay and ported by GGmuks.

title: Arcane Paws
description: Arcane Paws is a vibrant, fast-paced platform adventure where quick thinking and agility are your greatest tools. Jump into the role of a charming little hero and set off across lively worlds filled with bouncy creatures, hidden treasures, and playful challenges. Every level delivers short, satisfying bursts of action: leap over gaps, smash mystery blocks, dodge quirky enemies, and collect shiny coins as you push toward the finish. With its cartoon visuals, expressive animations, and upbeat atmosphere, Arcane Paws offers an experience that’s lighthearted yet full of energy. Smooth controls, responsive movement, and cleverly designed obstacles make each run engaging—perfect for short sessions or longer explorations alike.

title: Beetle Shock
description: Get ready for ground-smashing fun and leafy adventures! In Beetle Shock, you control a strong beetle capable of breaking cracked logs with a powerful ground pound. Each level is a small forest mission: find the yellow fruit, open the door, and reach the insect house hidden inside a tree trunk.

title: Arcade Archives: Mega Zone
description: MEGA ZONE! FURTHER INTO UNKNOWN CRISIS...

title: Highway Roads Racer
description: Master the Curves. Own the Road.

title: Golfme
description: It's golfing time! Take a deep breath as you swing your club and... what's that? Money in the air?

title: Brothers In Duty: Space Brawl
description: Gear up for an all-out lunar shootout in Brothers in Duty – Space Brawl, an intense single-player team deathmatch set on the moon. Command your squad, outsmart enemy bots, and dominate the zero-gravity battlefield in this offline-only, AI-driven combat experience.

title: Do You Really Know?
description: Get your brain ready and sharpen your curiosity in Do You Really Know?, a charming quiz game where every correct answer is a step toward the top of the Owls’ Tower of Knowledge. It starts easy, but don’t be fooled. The higher you climb, the tougher the questions become.

title: Falling Bricks: Endless Smash
description: Falling Bricks Endless Smash is an addictive arcade challenge where endless waves of bricks keep falling, and your goal is to smash them, earn the highest score, and survive as long as possible. Collect powerful bonuses, unlock extra balls, and push your skills to the limit in the ultimate brick-smashing experience.

title: Fill The Cup 3: Frost
description: Fill The Cup 3: Frost is a physics-based puzzle game where players guide water from a pipe into a cup. By holding a button, water flows and reacts to the environment, requiring players to overcome obstacles such as spikes, portals, moving platforms, and more. The game introduces freezing zones that allow players to freeze water and create solid paths to help redirect the flow into the cup. Each level includes a collectible snowflake that challenges players to complete the level perfectly. With simple controls, colorful cartoon visuals, and increasingly challenging puzzles, the game is suitable for children and casual puzzle players.

title: Fischfutter
description: Help Flupp the fish to escape! Dive at the right time to float through the water. Avoid rocks and jellyfish, they slow you down. Collect stars and diamonds to get faster and swim away from the monster fish.

title: Floaty Rescue
description: Tap, drag, and draw the perfect path. Floaty Rescue is a clean, line-drawing arcade game where you pilot a small rescue boat, collect coins, and scoop survivors before they drift away.

title: Foam Frenzy
description: Charge forward, take aim, and pop every target with soft foam darts. Foam Frenzy is a fast, first-person arcade runner where rubbery foes flood the lane and your toy blaster keeps them bouncing. Snap to weak points, chain knockbacks, and clear waves before they crowd you.

title: Football 26 League Superstar
description:
Football 26 League Superstar invites you into the heart of modern football — where ambition, strategy, and skill decide who becomes a legend.
Start your journey as a hungry newcomer with a modest squad and limited resources. Every match is a step forward, every decision matters. Train harder, think smarter, and climb from local victories to the grandest stage of world football. Your ultimate dream? Lifting the World Cup and proving you belong among the elite.

title: From The Bunker
description: You are trapped in a crumbling, post-apocalyptic bunker, and your only goal is survival. Navigate dark corridors, smash obstacles with your trusty hammer, and find hidden paths as you search for an exit. Each level increases the difficulty with destructible doors, furniture, and secret rooms that test your wit, timing, and strategy.

title: Fruits Drop
description: Fruits Drop is a bright, feel-good arcade puzzler where every color is a fruit, every match pops with satisfying juice, and every cleared line rockets your score higher

title: Golf Journey Without End
description: Golf Journey Without End is an endless golfing adventure where every ball sunk into the hole earns you score and rewards you with extra swings to keep the journey going. Challenge yourself and see how high you can score!

title: Parallel Hearts
description: Parallel Hearts is a romantic, choice-driven visual novel about a connection that starts where most stories end—after you close your eyes. Each night, Nora meets a boy by a quiet lakeside; each morning, she remembers everything…and he remembers nothing. As the dreams grow shorter, clues from the dream world begin pointing to places in the real one, and Nora must decide whether this is fate—or a feeling she’s brave enough to follow.

title: Odd One Out 2
description: Odd One Out 2 is a simple, fun word puzzle game with 12 different subjects that can be selected on the rounds screen (for example Sport & Leisure). Each subject has 10 puzzles and each puzzle is a different category within the overall theme – for instance Water Sports or Famous Racehorses. For each category there are 12 answers on the screen but one does not belong in the category and is the odd one out. Simply find the answer in each category that does not belong. There is no time limit and each subject can be played as many times as you need to reach a great score!

title: Odd One Out Christmas
description: Odd One Out Christmas is a simple, fun word puzzle quiz game with 9 different festive subjects that can be selected on the rounds screen (for example Christmas Music). Each subject has 6 puzzles and each puzzle is a different category within the overall theme - for instance Christmas Carols or Christmas Pop Hits. For each category there are 12 answers on the screen but one does not belong in the category and is the odd one out. Simply find the answer in each category that does not belong. There is no time limit and each subject can be played as many times as you need to reach a great score!

title: Fast Food Master 2025
description: Step into the hectic world of fast food management in Fast Food Master 2025! Whether you're flipping burgers solo or running a full kitchen with up to 6 friends, every second counts as you take customer orders, cook up meals, and keep the chaos under control. From sizzling burgers to crispy fries, master the art of fast food and build your dream restaurant!

title: Pizza No Pizza
description:
What would that customer order? Will they be able to pay? Guess people's wishes, choose the correct option and build up your restaurant's Reputation to see new customers. Keep your Funds growing or face the loss.

Special customers come to the place with the high Reputation, so don't mess up these! Meet funny people along the way to a perfect Pizza Place!

Also, Triangle is for Pizza Slice.

title: Bloodstained: Ritual of the Night Complete Edition
description:
Complete Edition includes:

IGA’s Back Pack DLC
Succubus Cosmetic Pack DLC
Magical Girl Cosmetic Pack
Japanesque Cosmetic Pack DLC
Classic II: Dominique’s Curse DLC

title: Orchard Odyssey: Chestnut Christmas
description: In Orchard Odyssey: Chestnut Christmas, you guide Aurora through a single vibrant orchard level to collect chestnuts in a Christmas-themed Orchard. You can run, jump, and unlock new abilities like double jump or enhanced map vision. The map is semi-procedural, being shuffled every time you enter the Orchard.

title: Tobitaro
description: Jump Tobi, jump! Tobitaro is a fast paced one-button arcade game where you'll be jumping to avoid arrows and collect coins.

title: Springcar
description: Just a small ride with the car and... wait, how did we end up here!?

title: Barista Life Simulator 2026
description: Build your café, delight your customers, grow your empire.

title: Gravity Biker
description: Defy gravity and race through thrilling obstacle courses in Gravity Biker! Hop on your futuristic bike and master the art of balance, timing, and precision as you perform daring jumps, flips, and stunts across challenging tracks.

title: Happy Ball Rush
description: Happy Ball Rush is a vibrant side-scrolling blaster game where precision, timing, and quick reflexes are your keys to victory. Take control of your rolling ball blaster, shoot through waves of numbered balloons, collect shining coins, and push your skills to the limit in an ever-moving world full of surprises.

title: Have It Coming
description: Alien spaceships are invading our lands? Well... they have it coming! Have It Coming is a fast paced, one-button arcade game where you'll be defending the Earth and getting powered up while doing so!

title: Holiday Eye Spy 2
description:
Step into a cozy Christmas world full of festive charm and hidden details.
In this relaxing spot-the-differences experience, explore beautifully illustrated holiday scenes filled with snow, lights, decorations, and seasonal surprises.

title: Imball
description: Imagine if you were to breakout, but you were... the ball! Imball is a one button arcade game that puts spin on the classic block breaker game by letting you control the ball!

title: Mementos: Lost Things
description:
As we go through life, it is inevitable that we will lose a thing or two. Items are misplaced all the time, but sometimes we can’t afford to lose them.

Whether they are an important part of our everyday routine, or they simply hold significant meaning to us, a moment will come when we have to remember where we might have lost something.

title: Match Three: Farm Shoppers
description: Match-Three - Farm Shoppers is not your average match-three game! You have a farm, and you've got customers. Make sure that they are getting their wares - otherwise your reputation will tank into oblivion! And remember - you can do EVERY move you want. If you need multiple swaps to make a match - go for it!

title: Pocket Drift Rally
description: Pocket Drift Rally is a fast-paced, cartoon-style racing game where players slide through tight corners, master drifting techniques, and race on dynamic asphalt tracks inspired by real motorsport circuits. With vibrant graphics, exaggerated motion, and a charming rally car hero, the game delivers quick, satisfying drift action perfect for short, exciting play sessions. Customize your driving style, chase the perfect racing line, and leave clouds of smoke behind as you dominate each track!

title: Liminal Tower
description: Survive the monochrome nightmare! Battle endless waves of enemies in this 1-bit tower defense shooter where every kill earns you currency to build your defense towers.

title: Magnitude: X
description: Goals are a good thing. That distant objective that we always strive to chase. The X in the far distance that always somehow reappears.

title: Loaders, Inc.
description: Box by Box, Build Your Business

title: Memory Holders: The Colors II
description: A memory game dedicated to the abstract beauty of colors.

title: Pie Pie Cafeteria
description: Welcome to Pie Pie Cafeteria, an irresistible puzzle where round little desserts meet, collide, and transform into increasingly delicious treats. Inspired by the Suika style, dive into a charming café where combining identical sweets is the key to fulfilling orders, earning extra time, and keeping everything under control before the mess overflows.

title: Ragdoll Playground Sandbox
description: Ragdoll Playground Sandbox is a 2D physics sandbox built for experimentation, creativity, and pure chaos. Test explosions, run vehicle crash scenarios, or simply observe how objects behave under realistic physical forces.

title: Refbals
description: Time to juggle like a real pro! Refbals is a super fast paced, one-button arcade game which will test your juggling skills to the max!

title: RiddleWood
description: Welcome to RiddleWood, a mysterious puzzle adventure set in a world where nothing is quite as it seems. Step into an enigmatic woodland filled with handcrafted riddles, clever logic challenges, and interconnected puzzles that demand observation, patience, and creativity.

title: Snoot Booper
description: Meet the Snoots behind the Snoot franchise. You can Boop the Snoot to get points.

title: Space Kabaam: Dagger
description: Along the far edge of the galaxy, station R-37 has picked up a strange signal. All contact was lost with the first team that was sent to investigate the scene. As a direct response, Central command has deployed the Dagger unit to follow up on this investigation and report back.

title: The Adventures of Hori
description: Join Hori and his lovable crew of baby astronauts and their loyal Bernese Mountain Dog, Charlie, as they blast off on a thrilling journey across the galaxy! In The Adventures of Hori, you'll unravel cosmic mysteries, outsmart villainous cats known as the “Ronronneurs Maléfiques,” and discover magical objects like the Destructive Lollipop, all while forging bonds of friendship and teamwork. This heartwarming and humorous space tale is brought to life with adorable cartoon visuals, interactive choices, and immersive storytelling perfect for young players and families alike.

title: The Far Node
description: Enter a meditative maze where every jump matters. Navigate through an abstract network of interconnected nodes as you search for the elusive blue Exit Node, with each leap subtly shifting your momentum and altering your journey's rhythm. Experience pure, distraction-free gameplay with minimalist vector graphics and a soothing color palette designed to focus your mind on the process itself. Random events will test your choices and dramatically change your path — will you accept the risk or play it safe in this zen-like puzzle adventure?

title: The Jumping Cat
description: Dive into high-speed arcade action inside a glowing, ever-shifting tunnel. Collect energy cubes, dodge incoming obstacles, and push your reflexes to the limit as the pace intensifies. Simple to learn but endlessly addictive, every run challenges you to survive longer, score higher, and master the perfect flow.

title: Twin Rockets
description: Twin Rockets is a game in which you control a rocket in space. You need to control her left and right rocket boosters. When you press left, you activate the left accelerator, thereby turning the rocket to the right, and vice versa. You receive points when collecting bonus objects along your way. You will lose if you fly off the playing field or if you crash into dangerous objects along the way.

title: Oxide Room 208: File Josh
description: Immerse yourself in the most brutal body horror with Oxide Room 208 – File Josh. In this first episode, you’ll step into the skin of Josh, a hustler caught in a shady deal, desperately searching for the blood-soaked remains of his partner Matt while fighting for his life.

title: Pixicharm: BitPew
description: BitPew is a fast-paced retro arcade shooter inspired by classic handheld action. Take control of a robot head equipped with a vertical turret and put your memory and reflexes to the test. A faded silhouette of one of five enemy types slowly descends from the top of the screen. Watch carefully, identify the shape, and shoot the matching enemy before it reaches the bottom. Every mistake costs a life, and once they’re gone, it’s game over. With simple controls, chunky pixel graphics, and intense score-chasing gameplay, BitPew delivers a focused arcade experience where every shot matters.

title: Pixicharm: Cluckbit
description: Cluckbit is a small arcade platformer with single-screen levels, designed to be easy to understand and fun to play.

title: Pixicharm: Tankbit
description: Tankbit is a fast-paced endless arcade shooter where a cute green soldier rides a tiny tank into an ever-advancing battlefield.

title: Pixicharm: Timbershot
description: Timbershot is a fast-paced arcade shooter set along a rugged autumn trail filled with mischievous squirrels and ancient ents.

title: Pixicharm: Zippyron
description: Zippyron is a relaxed yet engaging arcade flying game focused on movement, collection, and smooth progression.

title: Rina-sama Musou: The Chosen One and the Reign of Madness
description: Perfect girl × Mad rule = No turning back from school life!?

title: Arcade Archives: Adventure Canoe
description: Brave canoeist, challenge the unknown rapids!

title: Arcade Archives: Rave Racer
description:
"Rave Racer" is a racing game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1995.
With dynamic presentation and more exhilarating drift control, this title evolved in every way, becoming a hit that soared past the high expectations set for the third installment in the RIDGE RACER series. The diverse soundtrack further pumps up the race, igniting a frenzy that truly lives up to its name—RAVE!

title: Anime: Fantasy Uni 3
description: The third installment in the fantasy puzzle series.

title: Raiden Fighters Remix Collection
description:
Raiden Fighters Remix Collection is a compilation developed by Moss, released in 2026 for the Sony PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch.

This compilation includes the three titles in the Raiden Fighters subseries, with both the Japanese and Overseas versions available for the three titles. It includes global leaderboards and a special Boss Rush mode for each of the games, as well as a Practice difficulty, rapid fire option and quick saves.

title: Six Seven Nights
description: You have six nights. The seventh day changes everything.

title: Mote: The Old Office
description: MOTE: The Old Office is a reflective walking simulator where you explore an abandoned startup space through the eyes of its CEO. Wander through meeting rooms, break areas, and forgotten corners as voice memories surface—stories of late nights, impossible deadlines, and the small moments that shaped everything. Along the way, collect 20 hidden donuts—a sweet reminder of the “night shift” days when sugar and panic powered the dream.

title: Car Dealer Garage Simulator 2026
description:
Step into the fast-paced world of car sales and repairs in Car Dealer Garage Simulator 2026! Manage your own dealership and garage, buying, repairing, and selling vehicles to customers. Inspect used cars, fix mechanical problems, and customize rides to boost their value and attract buyers.

Handle customer requests, negotiate prices, and build your reputation in a competitive market. Upgrade your garage with advanced tools and hire skilled mechanics to speed up repairs. Expand your business by acquiring rare and luxury cars to offer the best selection.

With realistic vehicle physics and detailed environments, experience the thrill of running a successful car dealership and garage. Are you ready to become the top dealer in town?

title: Retina Rush
description: Retina Rush is a fast-paced arcade dodger where you play as a demon’s runaway eyeball, blazing across the sky in a desperate escape from hell and humanity alike. Glide through pixel-art mountain vistas while weaving between relentless missiles and cursed projectiles that fill the screen. Simple controls and tight, responsive movement make it easy to pick up, but ruthless enemy patterns and score targets test your focus, reflexes, and nerve. Chase higher scores, master risky near-misses, and prove you’ve got the vision to survive the rush.

title: Terminator 2D: No Fate - Day One Edition
description:
The Day One Edition features a collector's box with a full-colour manual book, reversible cover sleeve, 25mm collectible metal arcade token, and a cloth poster.

Experience the thrill of Terminator 2: Judgment Day with arcade action & pixel-perfect graphics! In this unique story blending iconic scenes from the movie with original scenarios and multiple endings, humanity’s fate is yours to decide.

title: Gas Station Manager 2026
description: Step into the shoes of a station manager and take over an abandoned roadside gas station. From rusty pumps and empty shelves to a bustling hub of activity, every decision is yours. Refuel cars, clean vehicles, manage the store, and maintain the area — success depends on your skill, speed, and strategy. Experience the challenge of running a full-service station, where every role matters and every customer counts.

title: Frost Survival: Winter
description: The wind howls across the frozen mountains. Snow stretches endlessly to the horizon, and the cold cuts deeper with every step. In Frost Survival – Winter, you are alone in a merciless wilderness where nature shows no mercy and survival is never guaranteed.

title: Shooty McSpaceFace
description: Save your space base by shooting down the enemies!

title: Rooftop Rascal: The Alien Cat
description: In "Rooftop Rascal: The Alien Cat," take control of a mutant cat scaling platforms in this sci-fi-themed adventure. Test your quick thinking and jumping skills as you climb higher and higher to reach the rooftop.

title: Final Fantasy XV: Episode Duscae
description:
Final Fantasy XV Episode Duscae is the playable demo of Final Fantasy XV. The premise of the demo is that the party must make enough money to pay for their car to be fixed. It was created around a sequence in the full game where the party loses their car, but the plot is original to the demo and does not spoil the main story.
This demo has some major differences from the main game, especially when comparing the graphics.

title: Arcade Archives: Plump Pop
description: Let's all work together as a family!

title: Cryzon Part4
description: Get the crystals!! Play in split-screen multiplayer with 1-4 players! 30 stages! Normal and Hard difficulty!

title: Boundary Pusher
description: Push your boundaries to stop the ritual

title: Crazy Basket
description: Crazy Basket hurls you onto a wild street court where physics, timing, and a bit of chaos rule every shot.

title: G Press
description:
G Press is a fast-paced one-button game.

You control a press that is constantly moving up and down. Your goal is to catch the rising bubbles and keep the liquid below from evaporating. Press a button to press the bubbles and turn them back into liquid.

The game is over when the liquid at the bottom runs out.

title: Garbage Truck Sim Driver Simulator 26
description: Step into the cab of a massive garbage truck in Garbage Truck Sim Driver Simulator 26, where everyday city streets become your ultimate playground. Experience the thrill of driving a heavy vehicle, navigating busy urban roads, and completing challenging waste collection missions. From tight corners to traffic-packed avenues, every route tests your skill, precision, and strategy — proving that even cleaning the city can be an exciting adventure.

title: Hoodbound
description:
Hoodbound is a charming 2D platformer set in a whimsical yet mysterious fantasy world.
Step into the role of a small hooded adventurer and journey through forests, caves, snowy lands, and ancient dungeons filled with secrets, treasures, and playful dangers.

title: Piyopoyon
description: Get ready to cruise the neon sky with Piyopoyon, a fast paced one-button arcade game, while controlling... the ground!?

title: Road Jumper
description: Road Jumper is an action-packed arcade driving game where speed, timing, and precision are the keys to victory! Take control of a powerful off-road vehicle and race across crazy wooden ramps, massive loops, and daring jumps high above stunning mountain landscapes.

title: The Jumping Bonbon Match 5
description: From the creators of the popular Jumping Food Games, the sugar-sweet gaming fun returns. In “The Jumping Bonbon Match 5” you can expect new challenges, even more colorful candies and an evolved puzzle gameplay.

title: Raiden Fighters Remix
description: The legendary Seibu Kaihatsu arcade game Raiden Fighters returns, revived from the depths of time.

title: Raiden Fighters 2 Remix
description: The legendary Seibu Kaihatsu arcade game Raiden Fighters 2 returns, revived from the depths of time.

title: Raiden Fighters Jet Remix
description: The legendary Seibu Kaihatsu arcade game Raiden Fighters Jet returns, revived from the depths of time.

title: ACA Neo Geo: Pop'n Bounce
description:
"Pop’n Bounce" is a brick breaker released by Video System in 1997.
Enemy characters serving as blocks fuse into a single unit when adjacent enemies are the same color.
Connect as many as possible to make them grow, then take them down to score massive points and earn power-up items!

title: Rooftop Rascal: The Pirate Cat
description: In "Rooftop Rascal: The Pirate Cat," take control of a pirate cat scaling the deck of a pirate ship. Jump, meow, and collect sardines as you explore every corner of the vessel — from the hold to the crow's nest. How far will your curiosity take you on the high seas?

title: Jinrui no Minasama he: Suhaaya Shuka
description: A DLC making Shuka playable and adding her story.

title: Furry Hearts
description: Furry Hearts is a cozy, school-set visual novel about finding your place—and the people who feel like home. You play as Kit, a fox who’s just moved to a new town, new house, and new class where he knows no one. Then come the firsts: a teammate who has your back (Lupus), a stage to help paint, a park that becomes “your spot,” and a girl whose smile you can’t stop sketching (Chloe). There’s a rival who runs too fast, an ex who scowls too hard, and a birthday that changes everything.

title: Rogue Doodle
description: "You’re a tiny ninja on a giant sheet of paper. Dash across ink-thin platforms, dodge brutal traps, drop enemies with your bow, grab every coin you can, and dive through portals to find the exit. Rogue Doodle delivers tight, fast platforming with crisp pixel style, quick-to-learn controls, and “one more run” challenge."

title: Untamed Isle
description: Untamed Isle is a laid-back treasure hunt with two bite-size levels built for pure relaxation. Wander through a lush jungle paradise, follow your curiosity, and scoop up glowing treasures hidden across the island—no tools, no combat, no stress. Just smooth exploration, bright vibes, and a cute cast to keep you company as you aim for a perfect clear.

title: Chou Shin Jikuu Geimu Neptune: Unlimited
description:
Hyperdimension Neptunia!
The latest installment in the numbered series!

The Gamindustri world is facing an impending doom.
With the addition of a new goddess,
Eleven of them will face the giant meteorite together.
A hopeful adventure woven by goddesses
Now, the grand curtain rises.

title: Rooftop Rascal: The Farmer Cat
description: In "Rooftop Rascal: The Farmer Cat," you're a clever cat navigating a charming farm. Jump across platforms, collect easter eggs, and climb your way from the barnyard to the rooftop. In this special adventure, a special guest is visiting our rascal cat.

title: Yggdra Kingdom
description:
Yggdra Kingdom is a visual novel that combines interactive storytelling with action elements, set in a world that resembles London. Players take on the role of a protagonist who inadvertently enters this parallel realm. As they explore the royal capital, the gameplay involves character interactions and combat situations, utilizing special armor and abilities.

The game allows players to make choices that impact relationships and narrative outcomes. With its focus on character development and decision-making, Yggdra Kingdom presents a unique experience that explores themes of loyalty and justice within an engaging, interactive environment.

title: Arcade Archives: Devastators
description: For the GLORY, the MONEY... and to feed the BEAST inside their body!!

title: Cowboy Kart
description: Good, old-fashioned kart racing in the old west! Up to 4 players.

title: Farming TriPeaks Solitaire
description: Farm-themed TriPeaks Solitaire with 100 levels, daily rewards, power-ups

title: Evil Cat Simulator vs. Granny
description: Sneak through every room, outsmart Granny, and unleash true feline mischief.

title: Sinebomb
description: Cosine? Tangent? Who needs that? Prepare your sine bombs and blast away!

title: In Tow
description:
In Tow is a fast-paced one-button game.

You score points by collecting chickens. The more chickens you have, the more points you get. To collect chickens, you run forward and jump between platforms. Hold a button to jump higher, press a button while mid-air to jump multiple times. The number of times you can jump depends on the number of chickens you have and you lose one chicken with each additional jump. You lose all your chickens when you hit a bullet.

The game is over when you fall or hit a bullet when you don't have any chicken.

title: Arcade Archives: Final Lap
description:
"Final Lap" is a racing game released by Namco Limited (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1987.
1987 marked the dawn of the F1 boom in Japan. Set against the backdrop of that era, this title portrays the raw power of racing machines and the stoic world of professional competition.
Experience nail-biting, high-speed battles set on the legendary circuit as it was back then. Push yourself to the absolute limit where every tenth of a second counts—and give it everything you've got!

title: Solid Void: Topsy Turvy World
description:
A Fresh Mix Of Classic Nonogram And Jigsaw Puzzles.
Flex your puzzle skills and master nonogram and jigsaw challenges!

title: Learn Basic Mandarin!!
description: "Learn Basic Mandarin!!" is a game that helps to memorize 150 first level Mandarin Chinese words. The game also includes pinyin (their spelling) and a list of all the words. You have 5 lives which deplete after each wrong answer. Try to get the highest possible score.

title: Word Warp: Animal Edition
description: Do you like word search games? In Word Warp Animal Edition, you have to find animal names in 10 languages.

title: Wheelie Life Simulator
description: Feel the adrenaline of Wheelie Life Simulator, the ultimate motorcycle skill game where balance is everything. Ride on one wheel, push your limits, and prove your mastery in a world built for precision and thrills. Every ride is a test of control, focus, and daring — from quiet city streets to wide open countryside, this game is all about perfecting the art of the wheelie. Stylish, immersive, and endlessly challenging, it’s not just a ride — it’s your journey to becoming a wheelie legend.

title: Tricky Monkey Zoo
description: Put yourself in the paws of the cheekiest monkey in the zoo! In this hilarious first-person animal adventure, you can cause chaos, play pranks on visitors, and turn an ordinary zoo into a playground of pure monkey madness.

title: Blue Reflection: Final Fantasy XV Costumes
description: Aranea Highwind and Cindy Aurum costumes for Hinako Shirai and Kaori Mitsui.

title: Lion Simulator RPG: Animal Battle Survive
description: Build your pride, defend your territory, and conquer the animal kingdom.

title: ACA Neo Geo: Master of Syougi
description:
"Master of Syougi" is a shogi game released by SNK in 1995.
It stands as the only authentic shogi (Japanese chess) title for the Neo Geo system, offering both standard shogi and the simplified "hasami shogi."
With adjustable settings to display beginner guides or play with handicaps (piece drops), the game is designed to be enjoyed by everyone from novices to true masters!

title: Manor Dynasty Strategy
description: Begin your journey in the Early Stone Age, when your ancestors lived in simple huts and survived through hunting and gathering. In Manor Dynasty Strategy, every resource you collect and every decision you make lays the foundation for generations to come.

title: Parking Problem
description: Welcome to Parking Problem—a slick, satisfying puzzler about untangling jammed car parks. Slide vehicles in the right order, open up tight lanes, and guide every last car to the exit. It’s quick to learn, deeply strategic, and perfect for that “one more puzzle” rhythm.

title: Astro & Suzy Go to the Circus
description: Astro & Suzy are going to the circus! There are all kinds of yummy circus food being shot out of the circus cannons that Astro & Suzy are happy to eat.

title: Lift Up
description:
Lift Up is a fast-paced one-button game.

Your goal is to regulate the speed of the platform with the main character and to make sure that the main character avoids the walls on the sides. Hold a button to go up faster. The main character is constantly moving to one of the sides and can turn by collecting arrows indicating the direction on the way. All the arrows always point in one direction and they flip every time the main character picks up an arrow. The main character can also collect coins to score points.

The game is over when the main character hits a wall.

title: Animal Genius
description: Animal Genius turns animal trivia into a colorful classroom adventure where every question feels like a mini safari. Test your knowledge across three fun categories—identity, habitats, and wild fun facts—to discover just how much you really know about creatures big and small. With simple controls, bright visuals, and a friendly quiz-master vibe, it’s perfect for kids, families, and anyone who wants to see just how wild their animal brain really is.

title: Parasol Superstars
description: Get ready for a double dose of platforming nostalgia and charm as two beloved titles come together in one vibrant package. Parasol Superstars unites the classic bubble-blasting acclaimed adventure Parasol Stars: The Story of Bubble Bobble III with the cosmic, retro-inspired platformer Spica Adventure—new to western gamers—delivering hours of arcade-style action and timeless fun.

title: For Luna the Bell Tolls
description: A chime heard once in five years. A past that never left.

title: Dog Chaos
description: Play. Explore. Cause Chaos.

title: Duel Draw: Katana Clash
description:
"A lone samurai. Seven trials. One path to enlightenment.
The Crimson Wanderer walks a road few dare to find. At its end stands the enlightened one, undefeated, untouchable, the living myth of the blade.
Between you and him, seven legendary warriors wait in silence. Each one a wall. Each one a lesson.
This is not a battle of strength. It is a battle of stillness. One breath. One moment. One truth.
Honor the fallen. Carry their wisdom. Let each duel shape the swordsman you are becoming.
The path is long. The silence is deep. The enlightened one is waiting."

title: Mash Motion: Sprint Rush
description:
Step onto the track in Mash Motion: Sprint Rush, a fast-paced arcade sprint where four runners line up and race for victory. Compete against three rivals in a straight dash to the finish, where every race is quick, intense, and decided in seconds.

With a nostalgic pixel art style and a classic stadium setting, the game captures the spirit of retro sports titles. The focus is simple: line up, race, and aim for first place. Each run is a short burst of competition that encourages immediate replay and constant improvement.

Whether you win or fall just behind, every race pushes you to try again and chase a cleaner, faster finish.

title: Arcade Archives: Polaris
description:
"Polaris" is a shooting game released by Taito in 1980.
Take command of a submarine and battle advancing enemy forces using missiles that can only be fired directly upward.
Navigate through a relentless onslaught from all directions—bombers in the sky, frigates patrolling the surface, and mines lurking on the seabed!

title: Hyper Cars Ramp Crash
description: Drive Fast. Crash Hard.

title: Colorium
description: Master the Spectrum: A Minimalist Challenge of Pure Color and Memory

title: M Field
description:
M Field is a fast-paced one-button game.

You are running through a minefield. Press a button to jump and press it twice to double jump. Hold a button to jump farther. Score points by destroying the enemies with the mine explosions, but be careful not to get caught in the explosion. You can jump on top of the enemies, but you can't touch them while you're on the ground.

The game is over when you get caught in an explosion or touch an enemy.

title: Don't Skip The Beat
description: Don’t Skip The Beat is a clean, arcade-style rhythm game where notes fall and you hit Up, Down, Left, and Right in time to the music across five energetic tracks. Learn the patterns, lock into the groove, and rack up points with precise timing—no fluff, just neon vibes, crisp feedback, and the pure satisfaction of nailing the beat. Quick to pick up and replayable by design, it’s all about chasing that better score and proving you won’t skip the beat.

title: Arcade Archives: Konami GT
description:
"Konami GT" is a racing game released by Konami in 1985.
Keep a close eye on your fuel gauge as you race through checkpoints, aiming to conquer all 6 grueling stages.
With beautiful, shifting scenery—from coastal highways and arid wastelands to plains bathed in the sunset—push the pedal to the metal and blast toward the finish line in a shower of glory!

title: Wild Arms 4
description:
Experience Wild Arms 4 originally released on the PlayStation 2 console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Their meeting was fate. Filgaia, a world left in ruins by a brutal war, stands still. Ten years have passed since peace was won — yet true healing has never come. Now, on these scarred lands, a new journey begins.

title: Mote: The Manuscript
description: Step into a draft that refuses to stay still. MOTE: The Manuscript is the third entry in the MOTE series—a psychological walking simulator set within the crumbling mental landscape of a struggling writer. You play as a tiny wanderer navigating three eerie maze levels built from the pages themselves: Scribbles, Blank Pages, and Crumpled Paper. With minimal UI, unsettling sound design, and mind-bending post-process shifts, every corridor feels like a thought breaking apart mid-sentence. Discover short audio logs that hint at the writer’s unraveling story, and tackle a handful of small puzzles.

title: Backrooms: The Twisted One
description: Backrooms: The Twisted One is a tense horror escape experience set in the classic yellow liminal halls of the Backrooms. Explore 3 levels across Normal and Hard difficulties while haunted doll entities stalk your every move. They freeze when watched, but the moment you look away, they close in. Search the maze for collectible VHS tapes, stay alert, and find your way out before the twisted ones reach you.

title: Arcade Archives: Street Smart
description:
"Street Smart" is an action game released by SNK in 1989.
In an era where a man's true worth was measured solely by his strength, a lone karate master and a professional wrestler travel across America to prove who is the ultimate street brawler.
After teaming up in 2-player co-op, you'll face off in a 1P vs. 2P showdown! Victory earns you the blessings of the GALS!

title: Crypt Carnage
description: Survive the Crypt. Embrace Carnage.

title: Cywall
description: Test your speed and reflexes in this special single-button arcade game!

title: Assassin's Creed Unity: The Fleur-de-Lys
description: This massive sword whose hilt represents the symbol of the French Monarchy is a tremendously deadly weapon, if you can handle it.

title: A Living House
description: After the loss of his wife, architect Ethan withdraws from the world — until he becomes the first resident of an experimental smart home created to heal, protect, and optimize human life.

title: Ace Heli Pilot
description: Ace Heli Pilot drops you into the cockpit of a nimble chopper with one mission: beat the clock. Fly through tight city routes, land on tricky pads, rescue stranded targets, and hit every checkpoint before time runs out across 3 fast-paced levels.

title: Inoutcar
description: I don't think a car should behave like this, but alas, it is happening! INOUTCAR is a fast paced one-button arcade game where your car somehow got stranded in space and it's spinning in circles.

title: Arcade Archives: Cyber Commando
description:
"Cyber Commando" is an action game released by Namco Limited (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1994.
Board your vehicle and fight to stop a security computer malfunction that has broken out in a space colony.
The thrill of locking on and slamming missiles into a split-second opening—combined with diverse strategies unique to each vehicle—accelerates this ultimate one-on-one battle!

title: Super Jump Ninja
description: Dash, leap, and slice through hand-crafted levels as a nimble ninja on a mission to grab every shuriken — and earn your sushi. Tight 2D precision platformer that make every jump count.

title: Scaffold
description:
Scaffold is a fast-paced one-button game.

Your goal is to build a path for the main character. Press a button to change the construction angle and hold a button to build. The main character will go faster when you build. Make the main character collect coins on the way to score points and avoid the moving spikes and obstacles.

The game is over when the main character falls or hits a spike or an obstacle.

title: Block Run
description: BLOCK RUN is a fast, minimalist grid-based dodge game where you play as a single square racing to the far side of the arena across 10 quick levels. Each stage is a short, high-pressure run on a live grid. Enemy blocks move left and right in predictable “ping-pong” paths, with some resetting automatically, pushing you to judge timing, bait openings, and slip through at the exact moment; no extra assets, no distractions—just pure top-down arcade precision and rapid retries.

title: Arcade Archives: Arkanoid
description:
"Arkanoid" is a brick breaker released by Taito in 1986.
Take the helm of the spacecraft "Vaus" and bounce the Energy Ball to shatter the Space Walls.
Your goal is to escape from the dimension of a warped labyrinth and return to the mothership "Arkanoid." Collecting power-up items will give you the edge you need to conquer each stage!

title: Dungeonloop
description: Turn-based grid roguelite.

title: Skyforge Trails
description: Forge your path above the clouds.

title: Ecchi Crush
description: Casual match-3 puzzle game. Match colorful pieces, chain together juicy combos, and clear the board to reveal gorgeous surprises waiting underneath.

title: Archery King
description: Rule the Range.

title: 1-2-Dynamic Word Search!
description: 1-2-Dynamic Word Search is the fifth game in the 1-2-Word Search series. Building upon the previous entries this classic word search puzzle game returns with a brand new set of levels, themes, and one new big twist, multiplayer! In Dynamic Word search you can play local multiplayer with up to four friends and solve classic word search puzzles together! Although this is a cooperative experience, the game keeps track of which player finds the most words! This way you can compete with your friends and family as you work together to sovle each puzzle! Dynamic Word Search packs in all new hand crafted puzzles built on 3 different grid sizes, 7x7, 10x10, and 12x12. Choose your puzzle solving mood by changing the background theme set and switching up the music on the TreeFall Radio. Embark on a fun and relaxing journey solving word searches in 1-2-Dynamic Word Search! Fun new puzzles await the discerning eye.

title: Pixicharm: Hidden Ninja Dojo
description:
Hidden Ninja Dojo is a charming hidden object-style game that challenges you to find ninjas hidden throughout each level. Carefully explore every scene, pay attention to small details, and uncover every ninja before moving on.

What looks simple at first can quickly become tricky, as ninjas blend into the background and hide in unexpected places. Whether you are a casual player or a fan of hidden object games, Hidden Ninja Dojo offers a relaxing and satisfying search experience.

title: Beel the Pollinator
description: Fly and gather pollen to help flowers!

title: Bolmn
description: Bolmn has been sucked into a magic mirror. Help him escape his twisted reflections through a variety of challenges including 3D platforming, stealth, bomb throwing and pinball.

title: Boxed Beasts
description:
Red Bob is an inventor and biologist determined to study the region’s entire fauna. To achieve his ambitions, he created a special capture box capable of containing creatures without harming them. His mission is to regulate the population of each biome to prevent ecological imbalance, while also capturing creatures for research.

However, an accident during the transportation of the boxes caused them to scatter across the region. Now, Red Bob must track them down in order to restore control and properly capture the creatures once again.

title: Brainrot Clicker: Steal All
description: Click Italian brainrot animals, upgrade income!

title: Cut Corner Renovations USSR
description: Step into the gritty world of Cut Corner Renovations USSR, where every crumbling wall and leaking pipe tests your creativity.

title: Cube KaBaam: Cryptic Trail
description:
The disposal team has discovered a strange transmission after the artefacts on site one were destroyed. Was this discovery meaningless, or could the artefacts hold a greater secret? Site two might just have the answer.

The level of challenge has grown. Fifteen stages will have to be cleared as part of site two. Intelligence suggests that the artefacts found there have regenerative capabilities. Due to these circumstances, central command has issued a software update to all units. Your power-ups will now recharge over time. Make good use of this.

title: Cook the Word
description: Mix Letters, Make Words

title: Color Inverter
description:
Think you know your colors? Color Inverter puts that to the test. A color appears on screen and your job is to instantly pick its perfect opposite from a set of choices. Sounds simple… until the streak counter climbs, and your brain starts second-guessing every shade.

Learn how complementary colors work in a fun, visual way: reds flip to cyan, greens pop into magenta, blues burst into yellow, and every weird in-between color has its own surprising opposite. With each correct answer you build a streak.

title: Monster's Death
description: Hank fights his battle against the monster breed. Kill as many monsters as you can to beat your high score. Get falling items for special weapons and assistance (Dynamite, Defense Tower, Rocket Tower, Repair Kit, Second Gun).

title: Parcel Inspection Simulator
description: Welcome to Parcel Inspection Simulator, where every package tells a story — and every detail matters. Step into the role of an inspector responsible for keeping the flow of parcels moving smoothly. From small envelopes to large shipments, dozens of packages pass through your hands each day. Check documents, inspect deliveries, and make sure everything reaches the right destination. Stay sharp, work efficiently, and turn a small inspection point into a thriving logistics operation.

title: Pocket Putts
description: Dive into a vibrant and instantly accessible world of putting, perfect for players seeking a casual golf game with surprising depth.

title: Roadtrip Ruckus: RV Survival Crew
description: The game throws you and your crew into the most chaotic “shortcut” of your lives. One wrong turn, and suddenly you’re navigating a cursed backcountry valley where the roads are rough, the locals are… questionable, and survival requires equal parts teamwork and dumb luck.

title: Santa Slide Rush
description:
Slide into a fast-paced winter adventure in Santa Slide Rush! Help Santa glide through slippery zig-zag snowy trails deep inside a magical pine forest while collecting presents for children around the world.

Master smooth steering, dodge tricky turns, and keep your momentum as the speed increases. new challenges, and even entirely different worlds to explore.

title: Anime Uni 3D: Hot Vacay
description: Relax with tropical puzzles and colorful heroines!

title: Minigolf Rush
description: Chaos on Every Hole.

title: Arcade Archives: Mr.Do!
description:
"Mr. Do!" is an action game released by Universal in 1982.
Take control of a colorful clown as you clear stages by defeating monsters and collecting cherries.
In addition to the two widely played versions, this edition includes the rare "Oldest version"—the very first iteration featuring a unique character design for the protagonist!

title: Sector Ninja
description: Sector Ninja is a stealth action game where you play as a ninja assassin moving through enemy controlled sectors with only a katana. To advance, you must clear every sector by eliminating all hostile ninjas across 2-3 stages. Enemies patrol with blades and weapons, and once they spot you, survival becomes much harder. Stay out of sight, approach carefully, and strike first with silent takedowns. Defeated enemies drop money that can be used to unlock new skins. As you progress, sectors become harder and require better timing and stealth.

title: Perfect Ninja Painter 4
description:
Slide, paint, and outsmart every level!

Perfect Ninja Painter 4 takes the classic puzzle gameplay to the next level with new mechanics and fresh challenges. A robot girl joins the multi-colored chaos — new worlds, tricky traps, and puzzles that will twist your brain.

Every move matters and every mistake is very colorful.

title: Arcade Archives: Tag Team Wrestling
description: The Big Excite Series finally begins!!

title: Figure of Eight
description: The Space War IV rages on! You thought this was going to be just another normal skirmish, but seems like fate has another plan for you, and now your ship navigation controls have gone completely crazy!

title: Slashing Knight
description:
A mysterious portal has appeared right in the middle of the dungeon,
and of course there is a way to escape from it, but our Knight is not a coward
and will accept this deadly battle against the vile creatures rushing at him from
this portal!

title: Arcade Archives: Ace Driver
description:
"Ace Driver" is a racing game released by Namco Limited (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1994.

Experience the essence of racing with breathtaking race tracks and authentic handling.
Choose a class based on your player level and charge through the game! Who is the true Ace Driver!?

title: Paperly
description: Take Flight in a Beautiful World of Paper

title: Roblox: Captain Bristlejaw
description: Most walruses never stray from their cozy patch of sea ice, but there's no floe in the seven seas that can keep ol' Bristlejaw from open waters. He's faced down krakens, gales, pirates, cabin fever, and more stale ship's biscuits than you can shake a belaying pin at. And does he complain? Well, yes. But like any good sailor, he saves all his grumbling for when the seas are smooth and the harbor's in view. Get Captain Bristlejaw when you sign up for Roblox on PlayStation Plus.

title: Gitaroo Man
description: A port of Gitaroo Man, a rhythm video game featuring visual production by Mitsuru Nakamura and an original soundtrack by Japanese band COIL, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Onimusha: Dawn of Dreams
description: A port of Onimusha: Dawn of Dreams, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Exit 8 / Platform 8
description: A physical compilation containing both games by KOTAKE CREATE: The Exit 8 and its sequel, Platform 8.

title: Not Turn
description:
Not Turn is a fast-paced one-button game.

Your goal is to go down the platforms while avoiding the enemies. You slide down the pillars that hold the platforms and you can choose to switch the pillar using the nearest platform by pressing a button. Hold a button to speed up. Collect the coins that the enemies drop to score points.

The game is over when you hit an enemy.

title: Titanic Survival Simulator
description: April, 1912. A calm night in the Atlantic. Laughter echoes through grand halls, chandeliers glow warmly, and the world’s most luxurious ocean liner glides confidently through the water. Then — impact.

title: Ghost Platform
description: What happened on the oil platform? Find out in this third-person action game, search for clues and eliminate the zombies

title: Arcade Archives: Cameltry
description:
"Cameltry" is an action game released by Taito in 1990.
Rotate the maze to roll the ball and reach the goal before the timer hits zero. A variety of obstacles stand in your way, including traps that reduce your time and bumpers that bounce the ball away. It's a unique ball-action game with a whole new sensation.

title: Cloverpit Gamble
description: CloverPit Gamble is a hellish fusion of card madness and deadly roulette. A rogue-lite where you’ve built your own prison and are now doomed to rot inside it. Chained in a damp iron cell, face-to-face with a trembling slot machine and a greedy ATM, you must pay your debt after every round… or be consumed entirely and dragged into the endless pit of debt.

title: Garage Mechanic Simulator 2026
description: Build your own car empire in Garage Mechanics 2026

title: Mash Motion: Swimming Surge
description:
Race against the clock and rival swimmers in Mash Motion: Swimming Surge, a fast-paced arcade swim where four competitors dive in and race for victory. Compete against three rivals in a straight dash to the finish wall, where every race is quick, intense, and decided in seconds.
With a nostalgic pixel art style and a classic aquatic setting, the game captures the spirit of retro sports titles. The focus is simple: dive in, swim, and aim for first place. Each run is a short burst of competition that encourages immediate replay and constant improvement.
Whether you win or fall just behind, every race pushes you to try again and chase a cleaner, faster finish.

title: RV Co-Op Roadtrip
description: Hit the road with friends in RV Co-Op Roadtrip and experience the ultimate road trip adventure.

title: Witchfall
description: A cursed leap through shadow and thorn.

title: Hill Climb Legends
description: Climb higher. Drive farther. Become a legend.

title: Death Attraction
description: Are you afraid of clowns?

title: Damways
description: In Damways, you control a resourceful beaver that slides endlessly across the water, reshaping the environment with dams and creating unlikely paths toward home.

title: Blackwood House
description: Step into Blackwood House, a haunting text-driven horror mystery where every command pulls you deeper into a cursed family's buried past.

title: SNK Heroines: Tag Team Frenzy - Miss X
description: This content adds MissX from SNK Gals' Fighters. Download the v1.30 patch to unlock her as a playable character.

title: Cloud Golf
description: Putt Above the Clouds

title: Murder on the Disorient Express
description:
An interactive murder mystery on the world famous train!
Step into the role of a cunning detective tasked with solving a perplexing murder before time runs out.

title: Arcade Archives: Rack'em Up
description: Recreating the popular game of pool!

title: Soccer Kick-ups
description: Take on the challenge and become the king of kick-ups.

title: Is Today Another Day?
description: Break the Routine. Escape the Room.

title: Medieval Quest
description:
Medieval Quest is a Match-3 Puzzle game infused with RPG mechanics in a fantasy setting. Combine swords, arrows, staffs, and more to defeat enemies and achieve challenging quests.

Unlock the Archer, the Cleric and the Wizard characters to face and defeat the final Dragon.

title: Word Sweep
description: A Word-Finding Journey from the Deep Sea to Deep Space!

title: Arcade Archives: Space Cyclone
description: Stop the BEMs from building enemy rockets!

title: The Fissure
description: Investigate the mystery of an old family home in atmospheric visual novel style!

title: Barack Fu: The Adventures of Dirty Barry
Sackboy: A Big Adventure - Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
Iconic PlayStation hero, Sackboy returns in an all-new 3D adventure with a deeply immersive and expressive control scheme. Players can go on this epic platforming journey solo-style, or they can team up with friends for collaborative, chaotic multiplayer fun.

The Digital Deluxe Edition includes:
• Sackboy: A Big Adventure
• Digital art book.
• Digital soundtrack.
• Four Sackboy costumes.
• Four Sackboy emotes.
• 20 Avatars

title: Frankenstein: Awakening of Horror
description: Frankenstein: Awakening of Horror is an upcoming third-person survival horror game set in a frozen gothic landscape. Players navigate cursed streets, morgues, and Dr. Frankenstein’s laboratory while surviving both brutal creatures and the horrors of his experiments.

title: Killzone: Liberation
description:
A port of Killzone: Liberation, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Death has a thousand faces, evil only one. The Helghast return, stronger than ever under the brutal leadership of General Armin Metrac. As the fate of the planet hangs in the balance, one soldier is sent on an impossible mission… Metrac must be defeated!

title: Toy Story 3
description: A port of the version of Toy Story 3 originally released on PlayStation Portable, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Roblox: Mae Plunderjack
description: Mae is the undisputed ruler of Wrecker's Moon. Her wits are as sharp as her hullsplitter saws, and whether she's carving cores out of a damaged cruiser or haggling over respirators with the merchant fleet, she always gives her people the edge they need. Get Mae Plunderjack when you sign up for Roblox on PlayStation Plus.

title: Persona 5: Swimsuit Set
description: A special present as thanks for playing Persona 5! Contains swimsuit costumes for the Phantom Thieves. Enjoy the phantom life even more with these unique costumes!

title: Waterpark Manager Simulator
description: Build your summer water park adventure!

title: Roblox: Zorzax
description: Zorzax is the intergalactic equivalent of a travel blogger, zipping through wormholes to all the hottest spots in space, time, and dimensions untold. But when a quick flyover of New Mexico turned into a long weekend at Area 51—actually, quite a lot of long weekends—they fell in love with this silly little planet...even if the feeling isn't always mutual. Get Zorzax when you sign up for Roblox on PlayStation Plus.

title: Arcade Archives: Lady Bug
description: Strategic play is the key to victory!

title: Bubble Shooter Piratery
description: Pop your way to pirate glory.

title: Ultra Pixel Survive 2
description: Ultra Pixel Survive is back but this time you have allies.

title: Lamp Clicker
description: Build your lamp empire, one click at a time!

title: Gynoug
description:
In an era between the Middle Ages and the early modern period, the demons have grown in power by feeding on the evil ambitions of the people. Led by a being known as The Destroyer they plan their attack.

The angel Wor stands up for the survival of the entire tribe, and heads to Iccus to prevent the spread of the evil spirit.

Take control of Wor and shoot down every grotesque enemy in your path. Defeat the demon boss at the end of each area to advance onward.

title: Arcade Archives: Syvalion
description: The World of Syvalion, Changing with Your Play

title: Bee With Gun
description: This construction bee will make never seen defenses.

title: Arcade Archives: Armadillo Racing
description:
"Armadillo Racing" is a racing game released by Namco Limited (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1997.
Control an armadillo that rolls as it picks up speed, and head for the finish line through obstacle courses filled with unique events, or sprint courses designed for pure racing enjoyment. Finish in 1st place and you can enjoy a fun bonus game, too!

title: Arcade Archives: TX-1
description:
"TX-1" is a racing game released by TATSUMI in 1983.
Enjoy a powerful race, unique to the triple-screen display.
The course splits along the way, where deserts, coastlines, and city nightscapes dynamically flash past. Goals all around the world?! Cross the finish line and claim your glorious checkered flag!

title: Dating Stories 2
description: Dating Stories 2 blends the addictive satisfaction of solving jigsaw puzzles with the spicy thrill of seducing the most alluring women you can imagine.

title: I Want to Play the Villain!
description: I Want to Play the Villain! is a theatre-themed logic puzzle game. To create the perfect show, you must match actors to their roles. But every actor has their own ambitions, fears, and wishes. Rearrange the cast, change the story, and use your logic to make everyone happy!

title: Arcade Archives: Combat School
description:
"Combat School" is an action game released by KONAMI in 1987.
Join a prestigious military academy as a cadet and tackle brutal training like shooting and combat under a terrifying instructor.
Only those who survive these trials to claim the glory of graduation can face the next battle as a hero. Well, can you make it to the end?!

title: Traffic Rush: Ultimate Drive
description:
Step into the fast lane in Traffic Rush: Ultimate Drive, a high-speed arcade driving experience where precision, reflexes, and timing are everything.
