Navigate through intense traffic, dodge incoming vehicles, and master the road as you push your driving skills to the limit. The longer you survive, the higher your score but one mistake can end it all.

Compete against players worldwide with a dynamic leaderboard system, unlock achievements, and prove that you are the ultimate driver.

Features:
- Fast-paced arcade driving gameplay
- Global leaderboards compete with the best
- Challenging achievements to unlock

title: Disney's Atlantis: The Lost Empire
description:
A port of Disney’s Atlantis: The Lost Empire, originally released on the PlayStation console, enhanced with upscaling, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Disney's Atlantis: The Lost Empire is an action-adventure game based on the 2001 animated film. Players follow Milo Thatch and the expedition searching for the lost city of Atlantis, controlling several members of the crew across 12 levels. Gameplay combines platforming, combat, environmental puzzles, swimming, and vehicle sequences, with different characters providing abilities needed to overcome specific obstacles.

title: Memories Off: Yubikiri no Kioku - Futari no Fuuryuuan
description:
Memories Off: Yubikiri no Kioku's fandisc.
Shin Inaho asks the protagonist to help him with an advert for Furyuuan. He'll have to go around several places with his love interests and take their pictures.

title: Toaplan Arcade Garage: Flying Fire Shark
description:
Beasts of the Sea, Soaring through the Skies!
Shoot 'em up arcade classics Flying Shark and Fire Shark together at last!

title: Tank Odyssey
description:
Enter fast-paced tank arenas where sharp movement and quick decisions are the keys to survival. Fight relentless enemies, switch between four distinct weapons and take on a new challenge in every level - hunt for hidden keys, capture zones, complete time trials and more!

Battle through 20 increasingly difficult levels across the Arcade, Void, Paper and Distort arenas, then test your skills in four objective-free Endless modes. Stay mobile, master every weapon and survive the chaos in Tank Odyssey.

title: Arcade Archives: Cyber Cycles
description:
"CYBER CYCLES" is a racing game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1995.
This game featured a large bike-style cabinet design that stood out at arcades at the time.
Set against the backdrop of near-future motorcycle racing, choose from a lineup of unique machines with different performance features, and cross the finish line ahead of all your rivals!

title: 1x1 Street Football: mini soccer PvP
description: 1x1 Street Football: mini soccer PvP is a vibrant arcade game where every match turns into a real fight! PvP sports battles, mini football and the spirit of street playgrounds inspired us to create this online game. Here you are a football manager, a goalkeeper, and a striker - in short, a true football star! These are not just football games - players of all ages will enjoy them!

title: Arcade Archives: Satan of Saturn
description:
"Satan of Saturn" is a shooting game released by SNK in 1981.
Fire your missiles and laser beams to take down the UFOs and rockets coming to invade Earth. Clear the Earth stages and blast off for Saturn! Win the decisive battle against Satan of Saturn!

title: Mega Man X: Command Mission
description:
A port of Mega Man X: Command Mission, originally released on PlayStation 2, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Cyborg superhero Mega Man X must protect the endangered Giga City from the lethal attentions of the Liberion Army.

Fight across more than 50 missions in this full-throttle future-themed RPG. Joining the illustrious Mega Man on this colossal quest are familiar faces like Axl and Zero, together with a whole bunch of new characters.

Combine with your team-mates mid-battle to perform dynamic combat techniques - with challenging side quests to master and devastating boss encounters to overcome, the success of this Mission is by no means assured...

title: Gran Turismo 7: Spec IV
description:
The Spec IV Update includes:

October:
• A new circuit, 'Sportsland SUGO'
• Six new cars
• A new 'Spec IV' opening cinematic
• Vintage: a section featuring cars not available to purchase as new
• Car Concierge: a service for ordering Used and Legend cars
• Experience: a mode featuring brand-specific driving challenges
• Car Viewer: a feature that lets you admire the cars in your garage
• Collector Level cap increase.

December:
• A new circuit, 'Autumn Ring'
• Six new cars
• Family: a new mode to be enjoyed by the whole family, from kids to adults
• Shuffle Race: a luck-based race with randomly selected cars
• Online Drift Trial: a new mode where players can test their drifting skills against others worldwide
• The next evolution of Gran Turismo Sophy
• New difficulty level in Power Pack for advanced players.

title: Toro 2
description: The ultimate Bullfighting experience

title: Dino Odyssey
description: You have to complete this dangerous journey to survive extinction!

title: Arcade Archives: Arkanoid Revenge of Doh
Atelier Yumia: The Alchemist of Memories & the Envisioned Land - GS Combo Set
description: Contains a plush, an acrylic board, an original mini novel and DLC costumes.

title: 3AM Anomaly Store
description:
Step into the shoes of a clerk in 3AM ANOMALY STORE: Night Shift Horror, a tense first-person horror simulation where running a quiet roadside convenience store is only the beginning. This isn't your average neighborhood market. While you keep the shelves stocked, answer calls, and serve customers, a dark supernatural secret lurks just out of sight.
Behind the backroom door, a shimmering portal awaits. Every night, you must feed an otherworldly creature with specific visitors - not true human beings, but entities that look like ordinary people. You must solve the mystery of who belongs and who is an anomaly before they leave your sight.

title: Wednesday 13th
description:
Midnight strikes.
The gates slam shut.
The manor begins to breathe… and hunt.

You are Vanessa Mort — the lost soul trapped inside the haunted Institute on Wednesday the 13th, the cursed night when walls whisper, shadows stalk, and your darkest fears take shape. Every creak in the dark could be a jump scare. Every corridor could be your last.

title: 80's Disco Brawl
description: 80's Disco Brawl is a rhythm-based beat ’em up that throws you into the spotlight of the wildest dance floor in history, where every fight is a rhythm, every hit a beat, and every move a performance. Step into a world where combat and music collide, and your timing becomes your greatest weapon.

title: Agent Skunk: Stink Ops
description:
Step into the paws of the world’s stealthiest operative, a highly trained skunk agent on a mission to infiltrate, sabotage, and extract without ever being seen. Adorable on the outside, unstoppable in the field.

In this dynamic stealth-action adventure, you’ll crawl through shadows, leap across rooftops, and sabotage alien technology using a unique arsenal of spy tools. Set traps, deploy gas bombs, or vanish entirely with invisibility mode; every mission can be approached your way.

title: Granny Survival Escape
description:
Granny Survival Escape throws you into a chilling, suspense-filled horror experience where every creaking floorboard could give away your position. Trapped in a decrepit house with a terrifying and unpredictable granny on the hunt, your only goal is to escape... alive.
Search for hidden clues, solve eerie puzzles, and unlock doors as you stealthily move through the shadows. But be careful — Granny hears everything. One wrong move, and she’ll be right behind you.

title: Highway Blossoms: Gold Rush Edition
description: A yuri VN about two girls on a roadtrip through the southwest United States.

title: Arcade Archives: Mr.Do!'s Castle
description: Run, trap, and triumph!!

title: South Park: The Fractured But Whole - Deluxe Edition
Final Fantasy: Pixel Remaster Collection - Anniversary Edition
Tom Clancy's The Division 2 - Washington D.C. Edition
Skygrid Courier
description:
Taxi passengers across a cyberpunk cityscape with speed and precision!

Soar through neon-lit skies delivering passengers to their destinations as you pilot a taxi ship with speed and precision! Skygrid Courier is a physics-based action puzzler that requires you to manage the momentum of your craft to avoid obstacles and safely reach targets around single-screen cityscapes. Pick up passengers one at a time and fly to the landing pad of their color-coded destinations including clinics, clubs, hotels and labs.

Plan your route with quick-thinking strategy so you don’t run out of power for your ship and watch your shields! If you collide with objects or fly through hazards, a rough landing could cut your trip short! Choose from the task-based Mission mode to earn rewards, Arcade mode to race against the clock or Versus mode to compete in local multiplayer. Check your Hangar for unlockables as you progress, including alternate ships. Can you master the busy skyways of a neon-lit future, or will you crash and burn?

title: Seahorse Soap Patrol
description: When polluting sea creatures fill the ocean with trash, it’s up to the Seahorse Soap Patrol to clean things up! Float through different underwater biomes, blowing sud bubbles at naughty nautiluses, smelly sharks, and more! Pick up the trash and make the ocean a fresh, clean home for all to enjoy.

title: Croc's World 5
description: Croc is back for his fifth adventure! Jump, run and swim through 60 hand-crafted levels across four islands, packed with new enemies and huge boss fights. This time whole sections of the levels are constantly on the move — and in the gravity zones Croc simply carries on running along the ceiling. Classic 2D platforming with a twist, for players of every age.

title: Beta Bloc
description: The world of Beta Bloc is made up of 7 citadels and dungeons, guarded by legendary monsters! Use your paddle to fight your way through more than 120 stages, casting magic spells to fight tough foes!

title: Grand Theft Auto VI
description: Grand Theft Auto VI heads to the state of Leonida, home to the neon-soaked streets of Vice City and beyond in the biggest, most immersive evolution of the Grand Theft Auto series yet.

title: Super Ping Pong Trick Shot
description: Try throwing a ball across a room filled with moving platforms and obstacles and into a cup!

title: KORG Gadget
description:
Play Games. Make Music.
A Music Creation Studio That Feels Like a Game.

title: Twin Robots: Ultimate Edition
description: Only you can help the Twin Robots pass their tests and escape the old factory in one piece!

title: New York Mysteries 3: The Lantern of Souls
description: A new chapter of the cold-blooded saga transports us to the New York of the late 1950s. The brutal murder of a rich lawyer's widow is not what it seems. Laura James, a reporter with the 'Daily News', was investigating an ordinary murder case when it all went to hell. The deeper she digs, the darker it gets. It seems that the roots of the case are buried somewhere in the history of WWII. Are you brave enough to venture into the chilling night, full of horror? Well, are you?

title: New York Mysteries 2: High Voltage
description: New York City, sometime in the 1950s. A wave of mysterious murders has swept through the city. At each crime scene, only a pile of ash remains. Witnesses claim to have seen a ball of lightning. Could a human being be capable of such a thing? Who is behind the cryptic killings? Are they connected with a strange incident which took place during an execution at the Sing Sing penitentiary? The police are unable to answer any of these questions... and so the White Stone Order takes the reins. Fearless journalist Laura is again brought in to investigate murders nobody can explain! Immerse yourself in an exciting crime story and visit uncharted locations from 1950s New York!

title: Pocket Rockets
description: Fly rockets through dangerous and challenges courses in Pocket Rockets Simply navigate left or right to thrust the rocket around the course Collect coins, unlock rockets and don't run out of fuel! Enjoy some retro pixelated fun and experience a new chall…

title: Everspace: Stellar Edition
description: Everspace combines fast-paced combat with roguelike elements, great visuals and a captivating story.

title: Yomawari: The Long Night Collection
description: Traverse the haunting world of Yomawari: Night Alone as a young girl searches for her sister, or share in the terror facing schoolgirls Yui and Haru in Yomawari: Midnight Shadows. Uncover the mysteries plaguing a rural Japanese town, hide from the things lurking in the night, and maybe get home alive...

title: Axe Champ!
description: Axe Champ is a axe throwing game! Throw axes and smash the targets! Go all out for the best score! Cool graphics, extremely addictive game-play, amazingly fun ! Play Axe Champ now!

title: CupCakoon
description: An Indie 2D game about a CupCake that must jump through clouds!

title: Crossy Road Castle
description: Bring your friends and see how far you can get in this endless spinning tower of arcade fun! Keep climbing as high as you can. Every run is different.

title: Destruction AllStars
description:
Dominate the glittering global phenomenon of Destruction AllStars – the spectacular prime-time sport for dangerous drivers!

Master the art of intense vehicle-based combat through timing, tactics and skills to cause colossal amounts of damage, destruction and devastation in vibrant arenas across the globe.

Pile-on the destruction from behind the wheel or leap into the arena with a breathtaking reel of parkour action by dodging attacks, taking over vehicles or using abilities to disrupt the onslaught of incoming vehicles.

Cause enough mayhem to power up your AllStars game-changing hero vehicle fueled with special abilities.

A roster of 16 blockbuster Destruction AllStars are revved up and ready to compete in the name of entertainment and demolition. So, strap in for intense, explosive and unpredictable levels of free-flowing action and fight to be crowned the Global Destruction Federation Champion.

title: Astro's Playroom
description: Astro and his crew lead you on a magical introduction through PS5 in this fun platformer that comes pre-loaded on PS5. Explore four worlds, each based on PS5’s console components. Each area showcases innovative gameplay that taps into the new features of the PS5's DualSense wireless controller.

title: Demon's Souls
description: Entirely rebuilt from the ground up and masterfully enhanced, Demon's Souls is a remake of the 2009 release that introduces the horrors of a fog-laden, dark fantasy land to a whole new generation of gamers. Those who’ve faced its trials and tribulations before, can once again challenge the darkness in stunning visual quality with incredible performance. The remake features improved graphics and animations, sound and lighting tweaks and a reimagining of many of the visual, musical and mechanical aspects of the original game.

title: Borderlands 3: Diamond Loot Chest - Collector's Edition
description:
The following items are included in the Diamond Loot Chest:

- Diamond Loot Chest replica
- Borderlands 3 character figurines (X10)
- Sanctuary 3 snap model
- Vault Key chains (X4)
- Cloth galaxy map
- Character art lithographs (X5)

title: Devil May Cry 5: Special Edition
description: Devil May Cry 5: Special Edition features improved visuals and gameplay at up to 120 frames per second. Alongside all previously-released downloadable content, other additions include Vergil as a playable character, ray tracing graphics options, and two additional game modes: Legendary Dark Knight mode, which significantly increases the number of enemies in each level, and Turbo mode, which increases the game speed by 20%.

title: Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales - Ultimate Edition
description:
Experience the rise of Miles Morales as the new hero masters incredible, explosive new powers to become his own Spider-Man.

The Ultimate Edition of Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales includes the full base game, as well as the remastered version of the original, Marvel's Spider-Man, and all three chapters of it's DLC story arc.

title: Neptunia reVerse
description: Arrange Mode is a new mode for Go! Go! 5D Game: Neptunia reVerse, the upgraded version of Hyperdimension Neptunia Re;Birth 1, coming to the PS5 in December 2020 in Japan.

title: Injustice 3
description:
A new Injustice game was rumored due to repeated news around the franchise though the initial job listing would suggest that it is a long way off.

In June a job listing from Warner Bros. Games, that is still listed as of October 2020, for a Principal Software Engineer to work on the graphics of a next-gen vision of the Mortal Kombat and Injustice franchise.

In July it was brought up when the author of the Injustice tie-in comics teased a continuation of that series. The later announcement, of Injustice Year Zero, was not connected to a new game.

In August a teaser image was posted by BossLogic ahead of the DC FanDome event using the title Injustic3.

title: Warhammer: Chaosbane - Slayer Edition
description:
- The first action RPG set in the Warhammer fantasy battles world
- 6 character classes each with unique gameplay, skills, and equipment
- An XXL bestiary with over 70 monsters aligned with the chaos gods and epic boss battles.
- Optimized for co-op: solo or with up to 4 players, local or online, purge chaos from the world.
- The ultimate version of the game: unlock all DLC with this Edition to enjoy an enhanced game experience and unlimited Replay ability.

title: Mortal Kombat 11: Ultimate - Kollector's Edition
description: Mortal Kombat 11: Ultimate - Kollector's Edition comes with a 1:1 scale Sub-Zero Mask, a steelcase, exclusive Avalanche Sub-Zero DLC, and the Mortal Kombat 11: Ultimate game package as well.

title: Spirit of the North: Enhanced Edition
description: Spirit of the North: Enhanced Edition is a single-player third-person adventure game inspired by the breathtaking and mysterious landscapes of Iceland. The story takes root from various pieces of Nordic folklore. Play as an ordinary fox whose story becomes entwined with The Guardian of the Northern Lights, a magical spirit fox. As you journey over the mountains and under red-stained skies, you’ll discover more about your companion and a land left in ruin. Uniquely designed to purposefully have no dialogue or narration. Players must breathe in their surroundings to solve various puzzles and speculate the meaning of a lost ancient civilization.

title: The Nioh Collection
description:
The Nioh Collection is a package released by Team Ninja and Koei Tecmo in February 2021. This collection includes remastered versions of both Nioh games, optimized for next-gen consoles. Specifically, it features:

- Nioh Remastered - Complete Edition: The original Nioh game, along with all its DLC expansions (Dragon of the North, Defiant Honor, and Bloodshed's End), enhanced for improved graphics, faster load times, and support for 4K resolution and up to 120 FPS on compatible hardware.

- Nioh 2 Remastered - Complete Edition: The second installment, including all its DLC expansions (The Tengu's Disciple, Darkness in the Capital, and The First Samurai), also optimized with enhanced visuals, performance, and technical improvements.

title: Madden NFL 21: NXT LVL Edition
description:
Next Gen Player Movement utilizes Next Gen Stats—leveraging real athlete data from thousands of NFL plays fed into the Madden animation engine—to create fluid, athletic player movement when accelerating, running routes, and changing direction for every player on the field.

Feel game day come to life with authentic new environments unlocked by a new deferred lighting system that improves player fidelity and enhances the details of the game in every part of the stadium. Immerse yourself in the sounds of the game with location-based audio and brave the elements as stunning weather detail powered by next gen tech adds a new level of realism.

Getting the ball into the hands of your Superstar X-Factors has never been easier with star-driven play calling. Call the right play, for the right player, in clutch moments. Re-live the thrill of victory via new Next Gen Stats-powered replays. Triggered by certain statistical moments and presented in beautifully rendered cinematics, these replays highlight the biggest plays by the best players in the game, all backed by hard data.

In the next generation of Madden NFL, there’s nothing more real than game day.

title: FIFA 21: NXT LVL Edition
description: Feel Next Level in FIFA 21 on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X, and Xbox Series S with new features that take The World’s Game from visual to visceral.

title: Spirit of the North: Enhanced Edition - Signature Edition
description:
The Signature Edition version includes:

- Region free copy of Spirit of the North: Enhanced Edition on PlayStation5
- Two, all-new designs, limited edition enamel pins
- A delicately haunting original soundtrack CD featuring 14 tracks
- Numbered collector’s certificate of ownership
- A beautiful 36-page art and lore booklet
- Sturdy “Sierra” box with foam insert
- Outer sleeve featuring alternative artwork

title: Tennis World Tour 2: Complete Edition
description:
Tennis world Tour 2 - Complete Edition includes all content available for Tennis World Tour 2 and hits new heights in terms of technical and graphical performance.

The edition includes:
- The base game, 48 official players and the signature moves of the biggest stars!
- Roland-Garros and the Philippe-Chatrier, Suzanne-Lenglen and Simonne-Mathieu courts, the ATP Cup, Tie Break Tens, the Madrid Open and the Estadio Manolo Santana, the Halle Open and the Owl Arena are also included.
- A wide range of official equipment and outfits
- 4K/60FPS gaming with ray tracing, smoother gameplay and faster loading times

title: Save Farty: The Trivia Game
description: "Save Farty" represents a real low point in worldwide trivia games. Self-improvement and the advancement of knowledge have given way to idiocy and unbridled masochism. This is perhaps the sickest game that can be enjoyed alone or with friends since Russian Roulette.

title: Neon Chrome: Overseer Edition
description:
Neon Chrome Overseer Edition takes advantage of the blazing fast next generation hardware to deliver even smoother gameplay, and includes Arena expansion!

Neon Chrome is a ruthless top-down cyberpunk shooter with rogue-like elements. Blast your way through enemies and walls with guns and cybernetic abilities. Experiment with different roles like the Hacker or the Cyber Psycho. Upgrade your character stats, discover new cybernetic enhancements and build up strength. Every death is a new beginning - the path to stopping the Overseer is never the same.

Neon Chrome - Arena is an arena type survival game mode with leaderboards. Your goal is to survive as long as possible using any means necessary. Play single or as local co-op! How high can you score before your demise?

title: Panda Hero: Remastered
description:
Take on the role of the mighty panda and tread your path unerringly. Skilfully dodge your attackers and sweep aside any creatures standing in your way – attack!
Discover the exciting world of our intrepid panda hero in this thrilling platform game. Funny, thrilling and action-packed!

title: Nioh Remastered: Complete Edition
description:
Nioh Remastered: Complete Edition is an enhanced version of the action role-playing game Nioh, developed by Team Ninja and published by Koei Tecmo. Released in February 2021, this edition includes the base game along with all three DLC expansions:

- Dragon of the North: Adds new story content, regions, enemies, and gear centred around the warrior Date Masamune.
- Defiant Honor: Features new missions and a storyline focused on the siege of Osaka, introducing new characters and challenges.
- Bloodshed's End: Concludes the story of Nioh, adding further missions, enemies, and equipment.

The Remastered Complete Edition is optimised for next-gen consoles, offering improved graphics, faster load times, and support for 4K resolution and up to 120 FPS on compatible hardware.

title: 3D Billiards: Pool & Snooker Remastered
description:
Step up to the virtual table and show what you can do with a cue! In addition to the pool hall classic eight-ball, you can also play nine-ball, ten-ball and even snooker! Whether alone against the AI or in a duel against a real player on the same console, you'll send balls careening across the table in four selectable, highly-detailed rooms as you work your way up the local high score list.

Choose from ten attractive avatars as you duel against AI opponents of varying difficulty levels. Get pumped up by the engaging pool-playing soundtrack. And listen closely for the authentic sound effects, like the clack of the balls, collisions, breaks and the characteristic way the balls roll across the table. Take aim, put a bit of finesse on your shot and play like a real pro!

• 4 different rooms
• 4 game types (pool: eight-ball, nine-ball, ten-ball and snooker)
• 3 ball skins
• 3 cue skins
• Multiple difficulty levels
• Single and multiplayer modes (1-2 players)

title: Phantom Brave: The Hermuda Triangle Remastered
description:
In the year of 913, in a world called Ivoire, lives Marona, a 13 year old orphaned girl with a special ability to communicate with phantoms. Her ability brings resentment from others, but cheerful and optimistic Marona is not bothered.

Marona believes in her parents' teachings that people will one day come to like her as long as she stays compassionate and kind. Now Marona travels throughout Ivoire with her guardian, "Ash the Phantom," to resolve disputes around the world.

title: Ratchet & Clank: Rift Apart - Launch Edition
description: Blast your way through an interdimensional adventure with Ratchet and Clank. This edition includes the Carbonox Armor from 2003's Ratchet & Clank: Going Commando and the Pixelizer weapon, which appeared in the 2016 Ratchet & Clank.

title: Terminator: Resistance Enhanced
description:
Run and gun or sneak and hack through Skynet's defenses! Interact with a motley group of survivors and change their fates!
Get under the skin of the iconic T-800 series Infiltrator and strike out against Resistance forces with the new infiltrator mode.

title: Terminator: Resistance Enhanced - Collector's Edition
description:
Run and gun or sneak and hack through Skynet's defenses! Interact with a motley group of survivors and change their fates!
Get under the skin of the iconic T-800 series Infiltrator and strike out against Resistance forces with the new infiltrator mode.

The Collector's Edition includes:
- SteelBook case
- Mini Hardcover Comic
- 4x A6 Postcards
- Presented in a Collector's Box

title: The Persistence Enhanced
description: The Persistence challenges you to survive aboard a doomed starship, overrun with horrific and murderous abberations. Explore, evade and fight your way through the depths to bring the craft home.

title: Mortal Shell: Enhanced Edition
description: Mortal shell is a ruthless and deep action-RPG that tests your sanity and resilience in a shattered world. As the remains of humanity wither and rot, zealous foes fester in the ruins. They spare no mercy, with survival demanding superior awareness, precision and instincts. Track down hidden sanctums of devout followers and discover your true purpose. Possess Lost warriors the Lost remains of defeated warriors are yours to discover. Awaken these Mortal shells, occupy their bodies and significantly open your understanding to diverse masteries of combat. Face formidable foes your path is guarded by adversaries, devoted to inscrutable gods. Behold creatures both pitiable and grotesque and muster your courage and face them down. Iron sharpens Iron combat is strategic, deliberate, and unforgiving. Commit your sword only when an opportunity opens.

title: Void Terrarium++: Deluxe Edition
description:
The last living human is depending on you in Void Terrarium++! Rediscover a bleak yet charming story of a young girl named Toriko and her robot protector, along with extra features such as new afflictions, outfits, and an new environment to explore.

Deluxe Edition includes: Void terrarium++ game for PS5, official soundtrack CD

title: Goonya Fighter: Jiggly Haptic Edition
description:
Haptic feedback and adaptive triggers support.

A floppy kind of party fighting game! Up to 4 people can flop about until you can flop no more. Ready to become a Goonya Fighter?

Walk too far and you flop over; punch the wrong way and be sent flying!
And get back up again just as easily!

For beginners and pros alike, welcome to a different kind of fighting game.

title: Lost Lands 2: The Four Horsemen
description: An exciting adventure of a brave girl who found herself in a fantasy world. She is forced to fight against the Black Horsemen sent by evil forces to annihilate every living thing. Lost Lands: the Four Horsemen is an adventurous hidden object game-quest with puzzles and mini-games that tells a fairy-tale story about the world with never-before-seen races and folk types. One fine day an ordinary good-looking housewife was walking down the car-park of a shopping center when she got into a cloud of mysterious fog turning out to be an interdimensional portal. As a result, Susan returns to the fantasy world of the Lost Lands she has been before. There has been a talk of her for years - the brave woman from another world is known as Susan the Warrior. This time it is a Druid hermit, whose name is Maaron, who called her on. He had a vision of liberation of the Lost Lands from the oppression of the Four Horsemen: Heat, Coldness, Death and Darkness. Maaron decides on to seek support of the woman from the other side; the one who has already saved the world from the forces of evil once. Susan will set forth towards the encounter with Four Horsemen with an aim to confront them. But first, she has to eliminate the Horsemen forever in an uphill battle by finding the weakness of each… Game features: • Explore over 50 stunning locations • Complete over 40 different mini-games • Challenge yourself with interactive hidden object scenes • Assemble collections,…

title: Metro Exodus: Complete Edition
description:
Metro Exodus Complete Edition includes Metro Exodus single-player campaign, and both thrilling expansions; The Two Colonels and Sam's Story, all with stunning Ray Tracing at 60 FPS.

WHAT'S INCLUDED:
- Metro Exodus single-player campaign
- The Two Colonels expansion
- Sam's Story expansion
- Ray Tracing at 60 FPS

title: #Wish travel, Super Puzzles Dream
description: Puzzles move onto the next level with 'Super Puzzle Dream', a mix between classic jigsaw and a 'Tetris' style dynamic mechanic. Your jaw will drop as you complete puzzles with paradisiacal or cultural destinations from all around the world. Become an expert and finish the puzzles in the shortest possible time and you will find yourself amongst the best in the world on the online leaderboard.

title: Super Puzzles Dream: Xmas
description: Puzzles move onto the next level with ‘Super Puzzle Dream’, a mix between classic jigsaw and a ‘Tetris’-style dynamic mechanic. Become an expert and finish the puzzles in the shortest possible time and you will find yourself amongst the best in the world on the online leaderboard. Have fun working together to complete the puzzles in co-op mode. You can also play with friends and family in the one-on-one split-screen competition mode. Your rival won't make it easy for you! Don't give up! Fill an energy bar to perform a counterattack and put them in their place.

title: #womenUp, Super Puzzles Dream
description: Puzzles move onto the next level with ‘Super Puzzle Dream’, a mix between classic jigsaw and a ‘Tetris’-style dynamic mechanic. #womenUp! is the 'hashtag' for this programme, which dedicates beautiful illustrations and emotive phrases to women on completion of every puzzle. Two levels of play, 'senior' (for adults) and 'junior' (for children aged 3+), guarantee hours of entertainment for all. Become an expert and finish the puzzles in the shortest possible time and you will find yourself amongst the best in the world on the online leaderboard. You can also play with friends and family in the one-on-one split-screen competition mode. Your rival won't make it easy for you!

title: #Halloween, Super Puzzles Dream
description: #Halloween! is the hashtag for the most terrifying topic! Puzzles move onto the next level with ‘Super Puzzle Dream’, a mix between classic jigsaw and a ‘Tetris’-style dynamic mechanic. Two levels of play, 'senior' (for adults) and 'junior' (for children aged 3+), guarantee hours of entertainment for all. Become an expert and finish the puzzles in the shortest possible time and you will find yourself amongst the best in the world on the online leaderboard. Have fun working together to complete the puzzles in Cooperative (co-op) mode. You can also play with friends and family in the one-on-one split-screen competition mode. Your rival won't make it easy for you!

title: Up Cliff Drive
description: Drive over hilly tracks, collect stars, coins and pickups to upgrade your cars and get further! Also watch out for various obstacles!

title: Sky Roll!
description: Tilt the floor, roll the ball, avoid obstacles, jump gaps, go faster! Attempt to complete all 120 levels and find all 360 red coins Looking for something addictive with hours of game play? Install 'Sky Roll!' today!

title: Final Sword: Definitive Edition
description: The source of evil, it has brought numerous monster corps. Defeat the source of evil by acquiring various skills and magics through the adventure. You will experience breathtaking battles with real fantasy monsters.

title: Shin Megami Tensei V: Steelbook Launch Edition
description:
The Steelbook Launch Edition includes:
- Game
- Steelbook

title: Animal Kart Racer
description:
Fun, fast-paced racing for up to 4 players. Use power-ups and be the first over the finish line in Animal Kart Racer!

Are you ready to accelerate, fire rockets and knock your opponents off the road? Animal Kart Racer is a fast and cheerful racing game that puts your driving skills to the test! Choose your driver from one of 16 comical characters such as a raccoon, beaver, wolf or even a shark or crocodile! Race over 20 exciting tracks full of sharp turns, dangerous obstacles and unexpected surprises. Ram through destructible objects, jump from ramps and try to avoid fallen trees, rocks, ice and oil slicks!

Hit the road, put the pedal to the metal, and enjoy the intense kart racing in different modes. Play individual tracks or compete in tournaments. Play with friends in the local multiplayer mode for 4 players!

title: Real Farm: Premium Edition
description:
Real Farm Premium Edition includes:
- Base Game
- Potato pack DLCs
- Grunes Tal map DLCs

title: Super Hoops
description: Become the hoop throwing master! Go for perfect by not missing a shot! or try for infinite hoops by landing the golden pole! Over 100 levels with boss stages Awesome relaxing atmosphere Prepare to be addicted!

title: Override 2: Super Mech League - Bemular Fighter
description: This DLC unlocks Bemular as a playable character in Override 2: Super Mech League.

title: Override 2: Super Mech League - Dan Moroboshi Fighter
description: This DLC unlocks Dan Moroboshi as a playable character in Override 2: Super Mech League.

title: Override 2: Super Mech League - Ultraman
description: This DLC unlocks Ultraman as a playable character Override 2: Super Mech League.

title: Tesla vs Lovecraft: Game of the Year Edition
description: Tesla vs Lovecraft: Game of the Year Edition is an updated version of the game optimized for newer hardware, offering improved performance. It includes the For Science! expansion. The game is set after Nikola Tesla's lab is destroyed by creatures associated with H.P. Lovecraft. Players control Tesla, using advanced technology to fight Lovecraftian monsters.

title: Hunting Simulator 2: Elite Edition
description: The Elite Edition of Hunting Simulator 2 includes the full game and all additional content.

title: Truck Driver: Premium Edition
description: Truck Driver: Premium Edition will contain revamped truck models and will utilize the graphics-processing capabilities of the next-gen consoles. All previous DLC are also included, such as the 'Paint Jobs' DLCs, the 'Hidden Places & Damage System' DLC, as well as 'Heading North' DLC.

title: Timothy's Night
description:
Timothy's Night: an open world video game full of action and adventure.
Timothy had a pretty normal childhood for a gangster, except for the part where he was abducted. When he was just a kid, he was taken by these weird-looking beings who gave him superpowers. Since then, Timothy's done nothing except use those powers for his own benefit and now he controls the whole city. What Timothy neglected to remember was the part where aliens would come to conquer Earth... and now he's the scoundrel who has to save us all.

title: Marvel's Wolverine
description: Marvel's Wolverine is a single-player action-adventure game and a standalone entry in the Marvel's Spider-Man series, sharing continuity with those titles while telling its own self-contained story. Players control Logan/Wolverine in close-quarters combat, using his adamantium claws against enemies drawn from the X-Men comic book mythology.

title: Iron Harvest: Complete Edition
description: Iron Harvest Complete Edition, a squad-based real-time strategy game, was released for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S on October 26, 2021. The Complete Edition includes the previously released Rusviet Revolution and Operation Eagle DLC add-ons, and launched alongside an update introducing a new multiplayer map, a new buildable defensive structure, and various quality-of-life improvements.

title: Assetto Corsa Competizione: Day One Edition
description:
Assetto Corsa Competizione, the official GT World Challenge videogame. Thanks to the extraordinary quality of simulation, you will experience the atmosphere of the GT3 championship. Compete against official drivers, teams, cars and official circuits reproduced to the highest quality ever seen.

The Day One Edition includes the 2020 GT World Challenge Pack DLC.

title: Crusader Kings III: Day One Edition
description:
This edition includes:

- Crusader Kings III.
- Garments of the Holy Roman Empire DLC.
- A poster.

title: Yonder: The Cloud Catcher Chronicles - Enhanced Edition
description: Yonder: The Cloud Catcher Chronicles – Enhanced Edition features DualSense wireless controller haptic feedback and speaker support, 4K resolution and 60 frames per second gameplay, and additional player character accessories.

title: Yuoni: Sunset Edition
description: Yuoni is a first-person narrative horror game that whisks you away to a sunset-stained world to play a deadly game of hide and seek. As grade-schooler Ai, navigate authentic Japanese environments and utilise every hiding space you can find to survive the horrors ahead. And if they find you… run.

title: EA Sports College Football 25
description: In EA Sports College Football 25 experience explosive gameplay variety across 134 FBS schools and immerse yourself in the iconic atmospheres of college football as you chase college greatness.

title: Summer Sports Games: 4K Edition
description: Prove your athletic skills and challenge your friends in twelve exciting disciplines!

title: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire: New Edition
description: Game based on the television quiz show.

title: The Matrix: Awakens - An Unreal Engine 5 Experience
description: The Matrix: Awakens morphs from breathtakingly realistic cinematic to fast-paced third-person shooter experience, complete with action-packed car chase sequence, and also provides a rich, vastly detailed open world to explore, set within the universe of 'The Matrix'.

title: I Love Finding Cats!: Collector's Edition
description: I Love Finding Cats is a classic Hidden Object game with a great selection of mini-games. Visit beautiful locations from across the globe while you find and collect adorable feline friends! This Collector's Edition also includes Christmas Bonus levels.

title: Far Cry 6: Danny & Dani Vs. Everybody
description: “Danny & Dani vs. Everybody” is a new Yaran story where “players will need to prevent Antón Castillo’s forces from blowing up Danny’s plan to come to Yara to make his world-famous tasty tacos to feed the hungry.” Then, in The sixth and final Special Operation, “Malagua”, “Trejo returns a favor by joining players to help students protesting the Antón’s military – who is deploying the chemical weapon (PG-240X) in Yara.” Players also get access to the Danny Trejo Bundle, which includes themed gear, Trejo’s signature outfit, and the taco truck from the missions.

title: Faircroft's Antiques: The Forbidden Crypt - Collector's Edition
description: When an old friend requests Mia’s help restoring an old cathedral, she packs her bags for the seaside town of Porto Nacosti, Italy! But she soon finds trouble in paradise - a crypt below the church holds a long-lost secret that a powerful family is desperate to keep. Search through visually dazzling hidden-object scenes, restore art pieces in need of love, and reveal what history forgot in Faircroft's Antiques: The Forbidden Crypt!

title: Pure Chase 80's
description: One of the most exciting Nintendo Switch chase games! PC80's is pure arcade, pure speed, pure adrenaline. Frantic driving, with no time to even blink.

title: I Love Finding Pups!: Collector's Edition
description: Visit beautiful locations from across the globe while you find and collect adorable canine companions! I Love Finding Pups features classic hidden object gameplay across a wide variety of scenes with a great collection of mini-games sprinkled throughout!

title: Hell Let Loose: Spearhead Edition
description: Join the ever-expanding experience of Hell Let Loose - a hardcore World War Two first person shooter with epic battles of 100 players with infantry, tanks, artillery, a dynamically shifting front line and a unique resource based RTS-inspired meta-game.

title: Sleepin' Guy: Deluxe Edition
description: Sleepin' Guy Deluxe Edition is a first person action-puzzle game set in physics based worlds. This new enhanced edition includes lots of improvements plus extra contents.

title: Fishing: North Atlantic - Enhanced Edition
description: Commercial fishing in North Atlantic! Discover majestic world of Canadian Nova Scotia while admiring the vast diversity of ocean life. Search for the ocean gold with upgradable fishing boats and various fishing gear as you progress in your fisherman career.

title: Dracula's Legacy Remastered
description: Haunted by frightening dreams about her forgotten past, Isabella - along with her fiancé - travels to an old ghost town, the only clue to her origins that she has been able to dredge from the depths of her lost memories...

title: Instant Sports
description: - 6 sports : tennis, goal keeper, bowling, baseball, rafting and hurdle race. - 20 characters to customise (name, outfit, accessories, hair…) - Varied game modes, single player or multiplayer with up to 8 players. - 18 playable environments and tons of items to unlock!

title: Tropico 6: Next Gen Edition
description: In Tropico 6: Next Gen Edition, the streets of your island will be busier, the beaches and panoramic views will be more beautiful, and El Presidente's eyes will be more watchful than ever. Players will also receive the DLC "The Llama of Wall Street" and the El Prez Pack, which contains one additional mission, new buildings, new customization options for your palace, outfits for El Prez and much more!

title: Boomerang King
description: Sling your boomerang and smash the fruits! Avoid Bombs and Hungry plants Fun, fast and addictive, put your skills to the test!

title: Ghostwire: Tokyo - Deluxe Edition
description: Tokyo's population has vanished, and deadly supernatural forces prowl the streets. Use an arsenal of elemental abilities to unravel the truth behind the disappearance and save Tokyo.

title: Endzone: A World Apart - Survivor Edition
description: Endzone is a post-apocalyptic survival city builder, where you start a new civilization with a group of people after a global nuclear disaster. Build them a new home and ensure their survival in a shattered world, threatened by constant radiation, toxic rain, sandstorms, droughts, and raiders.

title: Demetrios: The Big Cynical Adventure - Replastered
description:
Demetrios is a quirky point and click adventure game inspired by classics like Broken Sword, packed with tons of humor, now in 4k!

Bjorn Thonen, a slob of an antique dealer living in Paris, is robbed one night after coming home drunk. Forced to conduct his own investigation with the help of his neighbor Sandra, he ends up involved in a murky, mysterious affair. Will these unlikely heroes be able to rise up and discover ancient secrets?

The game offers situations and puzzles for beginners and experts alike, with a high degree of interactivity. Explore ridiculous item combinations, just to see what happens!

title: Ys VIII: Lacrimosa of Dana - Deluxe Edition
description:
Deluxe Edition Includes:

- Ys VIII: Lacrimosa Of Dana PS5 Game
- Mini Art Collection
- Ys VIII: Lacrimosa of Dan, Select Soundtrack

title: Fallen Legion: Rise to Glory / Fallen Legion Revenants - Deluxe Edition
description: Deluxe Edition includes Fallen Legion: Rise to Glory / Fallen Legion Revenants game, Deluxe Digital Soundtrack (download code), and “Fallen Legion Compendium” Mini Art Book

title: Insomnis: Enhanced Edition
description:
Insomnis is a first-person horror game focused on story, exploration and solving puzzles to advance through a terrifying atmosphere. Players take control of Joe Castevet, who will have to deal with a mysterious inheritance he has just received. Discover all the secrets of the Castevet mansion!

Insomnis: Enhanced Edition includes:
- Base Game
- Special Cover
- Artbook
- Set of cards

title: Mortal Shell: Enhanced Edition - Game of the Year Edition
Marvel's Midnight Suns: Enhanced Edition
description: The Enhanced Edition of Marvel's Midnight Suns includes the base game with new-gen optimizations.

title: I Love Finding Critters!: Collector's Edition
description:
The Collector’s Edition includes:
- 6 extra locations: find even more critters!
- 12 additional minigames
- Downloadable wallpapers and music player
- Meet the developers' adorable critters!

title: Death's Door: Ultimate Edition
description: The Ultimate Edition of Death's Door includes a physical version of the game, an exclusive artbook, the official soundtrack CD in a carton sleeve, and a collectable tuck-in box housing all the contents.

title: Temtem: Collector's Edition
description: Temtem is a massively multiplayer creature collection adventure inspired by Pokémon. Seek adventure at the lovely Airborne Archipelago along your Temtem squad. Catch every Temtem, battle other trainers, customize your house, join a friend's adventure or explore the online living-world.

title: Crypt of the Serpent King: Remastered - 4K Edition
Asterix & Obelix XXXL: The Ram From Hibernia - Day One Edition
description: Join Asterix & Obelix in a brand-new original story in… Hibernia! Explore this crazy action-adventure in a local coop mode up to 4 players !

title: Hero Wheels
description: Drive at high speeds and take out the Boss! Dodge Enemies and bombs Take on new worlds Unlock different characters

title: Spin Path
description: Get addicted to this fast paced racing game! Excellent graphics and an endless supply of levels will keep you hooked Get the frenzy star and smash your way to the goal!

title: The Last of Us Part I: Firefly Edition
description:
The Last of Us Part I: Firefly Edition was made only available to buy as an exclusive directly from the PlayStation Direct online store.

Experience the emotional storytelling and unforgettable characters of Joel and Ellie in The Last of Us, winner of over 200 Game of the Year awards and now rebuilt for PlayStation5.

Enjoy a total overhaul of the original experience, faithfully reproduced but incorporating modernized gameplay, improved controls and expanded accessibility options. Plus, feel immersed with improved effects and enhanced exploration and combat.

The Last of Us Part I Firefly Edition includes the complete The Last of Us single-player story (PS5) and celebrated prequel chapter, Left Behind; limited edition SteelBook display case; The Last of Us: American Dreams #1 - #4 comics reprint with new cover art; and early in-game unlocks.

title: Just Dance 2023 Edition
description: Welcome to a new era of dance with Just Dance 2023 edition! Now with online multiplayer, personalization, 3D immersive worlds and new songs and modes year-round, you can experience a never- ending dance party all year long!

title: Tape: Unveil the Memories - Director's Edition
description: Contains 3 movie postcards, Iria's letter, and storyboard for an unpublished prologue.

title: Sifu: Redemption Edition
description:
Redemption Edition Includes:

Steelbook
3 Lithographs
Tenacity Pendant
Digital Soundtrack
Figurine
Behind the Art of Sifu – Developers Diary

title: Just Dance 2023 Edition: Special Edition
description: Welcome to a new era of dance with Just Dance 2023 edition! Now with online multiplayer, personalization, 3D immersive worlds and new songs and modes year-round, you can experience a never- ending dance party all year long!

title: Work from Home
description:
“Work from Home” is a co-op party game for 1 to 4 players.
Players act as workers who slack off behind their boss and pretend to work when their boss is around.
Appropriate allocation of "slacking" and "pretending to work" is the workplace survival rule in "Work from Home".
Use all the things you can reach in the workplace to slack off and have fun with colleagues.

title: Silent Hill: The Short Message
description: Silent Hill: The Short Message is a free-to-play Silent Hill spin-off set in modern-day Germany. Players explore a location known as The Villa from a first-person perspective.

title: I Love Finding More Pups: Collector's Edition
description: Who doesn’t love finding pups?

title: Returnal: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
Returnal is a 2021 roguelike third-person shooter video game developed by Housemarque and published by Sony Interactive Entertainment.

It follows Selene Vassos, an astronaut who lands on the planet Atropos in search of the mysterious "White Shadow" signal and finds herself trapped in a time loop.

After crash-landing on a shape-shifting alien planet, Selene finds herself fighting tooth and nail for survival. Every time she’s defeated, the player is forced to restart the journey.

The Digital Deluxe Edition includes:
- Main game
- Electropylon Driver weapon
- Hollowseeker weapon
- One Reflex Stimulant
- One Adrenaline Booster
- One Pulsating Mass artefact
- PSN avatars for PS5
- Digital soundtrack

An exclusive 104-page artbook in landscape format.

title: Marvel's Spider-Man 2: Launch Edition
description:
Marvel's Spider-Man 2 is an action-adventure game developed by Insomniac Games and published by Sony Interactive Entertainment. Released in October 2023 exclusively for the PlayStation 5, it is a direct sequel to Marvel's Spider-Man (2018) and Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales (2020). The game continues the story of Peter Parker and Miles Morales as they face new challenges and threats in New York City.

In Marvel's Spider-Man 2, players can switch between Peter and Miles, each with unique abilities and combat styles. The game introduces new villains, including Kraven the Hunter and Venom, while expanding the open-world environment with more detailed and interactive elements.

The Launch Edition includes a voucher code for the Arachknight Suit for Peter (with 3 color variants), the Shadow Spider Suit for Miles (with 3 color variants), the Web Grabber gadget, and 3 skill points.

title: EA Sports UFC 5
description: EA Sports UFC 5 is as real as it gets. Powered by Frostbite engine’s advanced rendering capabilities, your favorite fighters now have unparalleled character likenesses to complement next-level environment fidelity that’ll make their walk to the Octagon feel like a PPV main event. The all-new authentic damage system brings the intensity and strategy of a fight to life, as cuts and strikes absorbed can affect mobility, defense, stamina, and more. Take too much damage, and the doctor will check to see if you’re able to continue. For lovers of the ground game, the new Transition-Based Submissions make grappling feel more fluid and realistic than ever before. And if you like to admire your handiwork, new Cinematic K.O. Replays capture your fight-ending finishes in all their punishing glory. Plus, a completely revamped live service schedule builds exciting challenges around all PPV fight weeks. Bring the next evolution of the fight game home with UFC 5.

- About The Darkside Detective

Where cultists crawl, where demons dwell, where the occult… occults? *ahem* That's where you’ll find Detective Francis McQueen, the lead investigator of the criminally underfunded Darkside Division. When evil darkens the doorsteps of Twin Lakes City – hell, even when it just loiters around shop fronts or hangs out in shady alleyways – he’s there, ready to investigate the cases that nobody else will.

- About The Darkside Detective: Fumble in the Dark

Twin Lakes is a cursed city. Less cursed than say, “Demons are tearing it apart” but more cursed than “always loses its keys” or “often steps in puddles”. It’s roughly in the middle of the cursed scale, is what we’re trying to say.

Cursed enough that it’s a nuisance. Cursed enough that somebody has to deal with it…

That’s where The Darkside Detective comes in. Whenever you hear a bump in the night, feel a tingle up your spine, or smell something fishy, Detective Francis McQueen isn’t far behind. No, he doesn’t smell of fish - it’s a phrase, come on...

title: D.U.M.B. Ducks
description: D.U.M.B. Ducks is an action-filled, retro platform game. Slaughter giant snails. Battle gigantic beasts. Buy better guns. Blow up walls. Collect fat stacks of cash.

title: Ball Rush 2
description: Smash a path to the finish!

title: Buck Blastem
description: Explore large levels. Find gold and artifacts. Buy guns. Earn upgrades. Bring an end to the chaos!

title: Virgo Versus the Zodiac: Collector's Edition
description:
This Collector’s Edition includes the physical game, Collector’s Box, 55cm Cloth Map, Holographic Stickers, Digital Soundtrack, Shiny Character Cards and Virgo Golden Pin.
Virgo Versus the Zodiac is a sci-fi/fantasy JRPG inspired by the Mario & Luigi RPG series and the Mother RPG series in which you play as an obsessed villain.

The game features traditional turn-based combat with real-time execution of moves: blocking, countering and timing your attacks carefully as well as predicting your foes' moves is essential to succeed in Virgo’s twisted and unforgiving cosmic quest to bring back the Golden Age, a period of peace, symmetry and balance, or so she thinks.

title: Anno: Mutationem - Complete Edition
description:
Anno: Mutationem is an action-adventure game with RPG elements set in a cyberpunk world, featuring a unique mix of pixelated 2D & 3D graphic style with a rich, dark and bizarre plot.

Welcome to the neon-covered, 2D-meets-3D Cyberpunk world of ANNO: Mutationem. In this Action-Adventure game with RPG elements you become Ann: a highly-skilled combat-trained lone wolf on a personal mission in the giant Metropolis, full of sinister mega-corporations, mysterious fringe groups and creatures more bizarre than words can express.

title: Rattle Royale
description: 4 Player Madness!

title: Neon Blood: Limited Edition
description:
Neon Blood is a neo-noir cyberpunk RPG / Graphic Adventure with a striking 2.5D aesthetic, based on the use of PixelArt 2D sprites with 3D modeled environments. Prepare to embark on a thrilling adventure where you will help Axel McCoin, an idealistic detective, start a revolution to change the world. In this video game, developed by ChaoticBrain Studios and published by Meridiem, you will experience a variety of puzzles and classic turn-based combat with precise Quick Time Events.
The physical Limited Edition of Neon Blood for PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch includes a metallic textured sleeve, art book, city guide and downloadable soundtrack.

title: Smells Like A Mushroom: 100% Vegan Edition
description:
Includes super-cool neon effect cover, awesome sticker sheet, stunning boss guide

Features
CHILL OUT AND LAUGH WITH THE MAGIC MUSHROOMS
The fun is provided by hilarious dialogues and a plot filled with symbols of "human" pop culture.

STOP THE MUSHACRE!
Take on the role of the carrot commando to liberate every planet in the solar system.

Use a variety of weapons to defeat different enemies and customise your appearance - will the vegetables succeed?

PLAY ALONE OR BRING A FRIEND
Enjoy the single-player mode with a bizarre storyline or join forces with a friend in split-screen co-op for two players.

EXPLORE SPACE WORLDS
Vast interstellar maps with a beautiful galactic art style accompanied by retro electro music.

title: Balatro: Special Edition
description: Balatro: Special Edition Includes 10 physical versions of the in-game cards.

title: 63 Days: The Home Army Edition
description:
A real-time tactics game that takes place during 63 days of the Warsaw Uprising in 1944.
Sneak, plan and fight your way through the captivating main story of brotherhood and bravery against overwhelming odds, solo or in co-op.

The game has been developed by Destructive Creations, a veteran company based in Poland that has been responsible for other successful titles such as Shame Legacy, Hatred, Daymare: 1998 or War Mongrels. The latter was the base game for the development of 63 Days.

Immerse yourself in a fast-paced action and strategy game set in World War II where your tactics and stealth will make the difference.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutants Unleashed - Deluxe Edition
description:
Embark on an pizza-fueled journey with Leonardo, Raphael, Donatello and Michelangelo to battle an all-new wave of havoc-wreaking mutants as you join forces with familiar faces in thrilling missions across the streets of NYC!
The Deluxe Edition features exclusive TMNT themed collectibles that pay homage to your favourite heroes in a half shell, including an awesome Steelbook and a radical artbook which tells the story behind Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutants Unleashed! Beyond the physical game, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutants Unleashed – Deluxe Edition includes the following exclusive items: · Steelbook
· 4 Pin Badges resembling the belt buckles of each of the 4 Turtles.
· 4 Keychains resembling the weapons of each of the 4 Turtles.
· Softcover Artbook.
· All contents packaged inside a collectible tuck-in box.

title: Dead Rising Deluxe Remaster: Special Edition
description:
Say cheese! Everyone’s favorite zombie-hunting photojournalist, Frank West, is back in action with the beautifully remastered Dead Rising Deluxe Remaster. Reanimated from the ground up with Capcom’s RE ENGINE, Dead Rising Deluxe Remaster is the definitive remaster of the 2006 classic Dead Rising, which delivered a fresh take on the zombie genre with incredible action, over-the-top combat, hordes of weapon choices, wacky costumes (trust us, they’re even wackier this time around), and a comedic yet compelling storyline

Dead Rising Deluxe Remaster introduces freelance photojournalist Frank West as he ventures to Willamette, Colorado after overhearing there is something going on in town. Frank soon finds out he is in the middle of a zombie takeover and has 72 hours to uncover the truth about this outbreak!

title: Evil Nun: The Broken Mask - Unholy Edition
description: Evil Nun: The Broken Mask – Unholy Edition is a first-person horror game where players try to escape a haunted school while avoiding Sister Madeline, an AI-driven enemy who reacts to the player’s actions. The gameplay involves solving puzzles, crafting items, and exploring different escape paths. It’s based on the original mobile game series and includes updated graphics, new areas, and an expanded story. The Unholy Edition includes a slipcover, digital soundtrack, camp admission letter, art book, and the game disc.

title: Papetura: Craft Edition
description:
One day Pape escapes from a flowery prison and finds little Tura, a magical being that he’ll take care of. Together they will have to face dark and flaming monsters which will try to burn down their beloved paper world.

Papetura is a handcrafted puzzle adventure game made entirely out of paper.

Along with atmospheric music made by Floex, Tomas Dvorak, it creates a mysterious and unique paper world shrouded in shadow and light.

Everything is made out of paper, from tiny insects, strange creatures and monsters to truly magical locations.

Includes Exclusive Case, Downloadable Soundtrack, Art book and Base Game.

title: Runner Heroes: The Curse of Night and Day - Enhanced Edition
description: Runner Heroes is a unique adventure in which you control two characters at the same time. Sprint your way through the mystical lands of Celuria, a war-torn land of magic, to break a wicked curse and reunite with your childhood sweetheart. Do you accept the challenge? Follow Colwyn and Lyssa, heirs of their respective kingdoms, as an evil Red Witch prevents their love from flourishing. Harness the magic of Celuria to fight her curse as she chases you across 5 challenging worlds! Escape her clutches by running, jumping, diving and riding mine cars across 47 levels.

title: Tomb Raider I•II•III Remastered: Deluxe Edition
description:
Tomb Raider I•II•III Remastered is a collection of the first three Tomb Raider games, originally released between 1996 and 1998, updated with enhanced visuals and modern controls.

Players follow Lara Croft across global locations, solving puzzles, exploring tombs, and engaging in combat. The remasters allow switching between original and updated graphics during gameplay.

The Deluxe edition includes:
• Physical copy of Tomb Raider I-III Remastered Starring Lara Croft
• SteelBook
• Exploration map book (featuring over 80 pages full of secrets, including all maps from all three games and their expansions)
• Collectible tuck-in box
• The collection's original soundtrack

title: As Dusk Falls: Special Edition
description:
As Dusk Falls is an original interactive drama from INTERIOR/NIGHT that explores the entangled lives of two families across thirty years.
Special Edition includes: Game, Cinematic Poster, Collector's Box, Dante's Black Book, Postcards, Pins and Desert Dream Motel Replica Key.

Shake the earth. Break the heavens. Make yours the destructive power of the strongest fighters ever to appear in DRAGON BALL!

Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero
Metallic Bookmark
Dragon Ball:Sparking! Zero Exclusive Diorama 264 x 174 mm

title: Dragon's Dogma II: Lenticular Edition
description: Dragon's Dogma is a single player, narrative driven action-RPG that challenges players to choose their own experience – from the appearance of their Arisen, their vocation, their party, how to approach different situations and more.

title: Morkull: Ragast's Rage - Collector's Edition
description:
A 2D video game that combines platforming and action with a touch of exploration in which we control Morkull, God of death and darkness and lord of the Ragast, whose main mechanics lies in the breaking of the fourth wall, which will allow Morkull to communicate with the player in various ways.
The Collector's Edition contains:
• The Base Game (Standard Edition)
• Special Box with exclusive illustration
• An Artbook
• 4 stickers
• Postcards Set
• Original soundtrack on CD-ROM

title: High Cars 2
description: Sky-high racing

title: Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet
description: Set thousands of years in the future, Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet puts players into the role of Jordan A. Mun, a dangerous bounty hunter who ends up stranded on Sempiria – a distant planet whose communication with the outside universe went dark hundreds of years ago. Jordan will have to use all her skills and wits if she hopes to be the first person in over 600 years to leave its orbit.

title: Way of the Hunter: Wild Expeditions
description:
Way of the Hunter: Wild Expeditions is the ultimate compilation of hunting grounds all over the world. In this authentic hunting simulation, you can explore the vast the in-game wilderness and fulfil all your hunting fantasies. The wide world of Way of the Hunter allows you to follow the many storylines in hunting grounds all over the world, master the challenges of ethical hunting and solve intriguing cases of unethical behaviour. Or venture out in free hunt, and explore the breath-taking landscapes of North America, Europe, New Zealand and Africa to learn about habitats, animal behaviour and ultimately how to manage animal fitness in order to harvest the rarest and most impressive trophies.

This latest edition bundles 6 enormous hunting areas and includes agile UTVs for off-roading. All of this has been enriched with the cosmetics of the Hunter's Pack and the Outfits Pack: 5 alternative outfits for your playable hunters, a beautifully engraved antique shotgun, a cameo paintjob for the car and an impressive wooden carved statue for your Transylvania hunting lodge.

Wild Expeditions includes 6 amazing DLCs:

• Tikamoon Plains is a huge new hunting ground in Africa. Explore diverse landscapes, from windy mountains to deadly deserts and vast savannahs teeming with life. Join Malachi, a professional hunting guide, as he leads a group of adventurers through the thrilling world of Tikamoon Plains, inspired by the African wilderness. Includes bowhunting and 2 top-of-the-line hunting bows.

• Aurora Shores is a breath-taking hunting area in the northernmost part of the USA, the Alaskan wilderness. As a fresh graduate of the Wildlife Trooper School, your job is to protect the natural resources of Aurora Shores. Explore untouched nature with rich populations of wild animals, such as Kodiak bears, Roosevelt elk, Wood bison, and many more. Includes crossbows.

• Matariki Park in New Zealand offers a remarkable blend of biomes. Traverse hilly or mountainous terrain, home to the unique Himalayan tahr and the mighty Sambar deer, and venture into the lowland forest areas, the domain of the majestic Red deer. Immerse yourself in nature's beauty and lifelike wildlife that will keep you engaged for hours, all while offering insights into unique local habits and traditions.

• Lintukoto Reserve is an amazing hunting ground in Scandinavia and the newest addition to Way of the Hunter. Experience the adventures of game warden Mikael and discover the nature and animals of the European North.

• The Outfits Pack contains one original costume for each character - River, April, Wallace, Jackie and Malachi, usable in Free Hunt and Multiplayer mode.

• Hunter's Pack: a shotgun with engravings, a paintjob for the Car, and a wooden carved mouflon statue for the lodge

title: Hajwala 2
description: HAJWALA 2 amps up high-speed drift racing in vast Gulf-inspired open worlds. With realistic car physics, stunning graphics, and new third-person characters, players can race, drift, and explore with total freedom. Experience the thrill of HAJWALA like never before.

title: Neva: Devolver Deluxe Edition
description:
Neva: Devolver Deluxe will include the following exclusive items, besides the physical game:
· A stunning softbound 88-page artbook showcasing concept art and game art.
· A copy of the game’s original soundtrack by Berlinist, on a CD and as digital download.
· A collector’s tuck-in box housing all the contents.

Neva is an emotionally charged action-adventure from the team behind GRIS.

title: To the Moon: Sigmund Minisode 1 (Holiday Special)
description: Return to the world of To the Moon in this heartfelt spin-off that dives deeper into the lives of Dr. Eva Rosalene and Dr. Neil Watts. During a holiday season filled with both festive cheer and public protests against the Sigmund Corporation, this minisode explores the ethical dilemmas and emotional challenges behind their wish-fulfillment work.

title: To the Moon: Sigmund Minisode 2 (Holiday Special)
description: Step into the next chapter of To the Moon with Sigmund Minisode 2, a poignant holiday-themed spin-off that offers a deeper look at the lives of Dr. Eva Rosalene and Dr. Neil Watts. This part continues to explore the personal struggles, mysterious secrets, and ethical dilemmas faced by the doctors of Sigmund Corporation.

title: Killing Floor III: Day One Edition
description:
The Flatline Tactical Bundle; 'Flatliner' weapon skin, 'Fear the Reaper' weapon trinket and 'Special Action Force' player card. Also includes (retail exclusive) Clamefield Patrol Character Skins cosmetic DLC.

The Battle Begins With Nightfall

It’s 2091 and megacorp Horzine has produced the ultimate army: an obedient horde of bioengineered monstrosities called zeds. Now, only the rebel group Nightfall stands between these infernal creations and the future of humanity.

Killing Floor 3 is the next installment in the legendary action/horror series. This intense FPS puts you in the boots of a Nightfall specialist joining forces with up to five teammates to battle waves of zeds, earn dosh, unlock skills, and build the ultimate arsenal.

title: Code Violet
description:
Developed by TeamKill Media, Code Violet is a third-person action horror game, where you take on the role of Violet Sinclair, a girl plucked from the past who must unravel the mysteries of the Aion Bioengineering Complex as she avoids, hides or fights against the creatures who have overrun it.

With the evacuation protocol in effect, Violet’s main goal is to escape the complex and save those she cares for, but with the creatures and a mysterious Director doing all in their power to stop you, will you get out alive?

description: "Destination Paradise" is a hidden object game that takes players through 20 chapters, each set in different global locations. Every chapter contains three unique scenes, offering a range of challenges. The game includes various puzzle types such as jigsaw puzzles, tile-swapping, and tile-rotation. Players will also complete tasks like finding listed objects, unscrambling letters to form words, and solving riddles in an optional bonus mode.

title: The Reward of Cherishment and Eternity.
description:
Death, nature's remedy for all things, offers you a deal: Help him, and he shall grant peace for a lost loved one.

-Explore a visually stunning world filled with hidden secrets and unravel its mysteries at your own pace.
-Chart your own path by playing the levels in any order, enhancing replayability.
-Master a deep and complex combat system, with fully integrated DualSense wireless controller features, including haptic feedback and adaptive triggers for unparalleled tactile engagement.

The Reward of Cherishment and Eternity is a third-person, action-adventure shooter that combines exploration, emotionally charged storytelling, and intense, rewarding combat.

Take control of powerful sports cars and race through thrilling tracks filled with sharp turns and challenging obstacles, with one goal in mind: reach the finish line before time runs out. Every second counts in this adrenaline-fueled challenge, where only the most skilled drivers can claim the glory and become champions of Golden Racing.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Ridge Racer
description:
A port of Ridge Racer, a racing game released by Bandai in 1993. It was originally released in arcades for the Namco System 22 hardware.

The game has four modes to choose from, including three difficulty levels – Novice, Intermediate, and Advanced - as well as T. T. (Time Trial), where players compete one-on-one against a rival car to achieve the best time.

Additionally, a DX version featuring support for an H-shifter and clutch is also included.

title: Maths Pals

From counting and addition to multiplication and division, explore 20 levels per topic, starting with simple visuals like fingers and dice, and working up to complex challenges with numbers up to 25x25. Earn stars for every correct answer, improve your score, and choose your own path to learning success. "NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION: Awakening," where players can truly experience the Warring States period with officers who make decisions for themselves, now has a collector's edition that includes various add-on content that has been released, along with an officer artbook and complete soundtrack.

The contents:
In addition to "NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION: Awakening Complete Edition" and all its add-on content, the collector's set includes:
- The "Kou Shibusawa's 40th Anniversary Commemorative Officer Data Set,"
- "Digital Officer Artbook," "Digital NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION 40th Anniversary Commemorative Book,"
- "Digital Complete Soundtrack."
For more details about the collector's edition contents, please see the official site (https:///).

title: Bag Hero
description: Blast through monster hordes with crazy weapons in a wild bullet hell! It’s chaotic, casual, and seriously fun!

title: Date with Devils
description: Being the Lord of Hell is hard. One minute you're judging souls, the next you're speed-dating devils and writing love poems to angels.

title: No Mosaic Girls With Sess-AI 2.0
description: Break Mosaic to Save the Girls! Simulation RPG by Great Think Program!

title: Piece Out: Avatarland
description: Avatarland is a jigsaw puzzle game with a twist. Solve puzzles to unlock new levels, then discover and collect your favorite avatars from the in-game store. Join the weekly challenge, race to complete puzzles faster than players around the world, and climb the global leaderboard. With fresh puzzles and avatars added regularly, there's always a reason to Piece Out!

title: Beat of Life
description: Hit the beat and watch her journey through life.

title: Clash of Weirdos: Card Carnage
description: Unleash chaos with crazy cards in epic weirdo battles!

title: God Wars
description: Loot and roguelike thrills await. Begin your epic action RPG adventure!

title: Tralalero Tralala Jumper
description: A shark. A wall. A dodge. A meme. Swipe, switch, and laugh as the viral "Tralalero Tralala" sound follows your every move. No pressure. Just pure meme-powered chaos.

title: Arisen Force: Life Devotee
description: A challenging action combat experience on Journey to the West with your companions!

title: Asonde Chess ga Tsuyoku Naru! Ginsei Chess DX
Glitch: Dead Loop Horror
description: Code the game. Survive the night.

title: Solitaire Dreamscapes
description: Drift away into a world of cards and dreams.

title: Climate Station
description:
Designed for the power of PlayStation 5 consoles, and enhanced for PS VR2, this free, immersive experience puts you in the middle of Earth’s most critical story: our own.

Over 90 minutes of interactive content - narrated by climate advocate Laura Tobin - takes you through rising seas, shifting temperatures, and stark climate futures, all built from real-world data by NASA, NOAA, and the IPCC.

Explore three main zones: Weather Year (a time-lapse of planetary change), Observations (where we are), and Projections (where we could go).

title: Touhou Luna Nights: 5 Year Anniversary Edition
Touhou Luna Nights: 5 Year Anniversary Limited Edition
description:
Touhou Luna Nights: 5 Year Anniversary Limited Edition - Switch - Touhou Luna Nights: 5 Year Anniversary Limited Edition Includes: the Physical Game, Anniversary Collector’s Box, Instruction Booklet, Steelbook, Double CD Original Soundtrack, Serialised Certificate of Authenticity and 3 Alternative Inlays.

Step into the enchanting world of Touhou Luna Nights! Experience a Metroidvania adventure that combines the captivating universe of the Touhou Project with unique gameplay mechanics. As Sakuya Izayoi, the time-stopping maid, explore a mysterious world filled with danger and secrets. Utilise the innovative time stop ability, master the graze system, and uncover the mysteries behind Remilia Scarlet's strange new world. With stunning pixel art and fluid animations, this game offers both fans and newcomers a thrilling 2D action experience that’s as beautiful as it is challenging.

title: Gris: Deluxe Edition
description:
GRIS Devolver Deluxe Edition Contents:
• Physical Nintendo Switch or PlayStation 5 game
• 100+ page artbook
• Official soundtrack CD
• Collectible box

GRIS is a narrative-driven platformer about a young girl processing emotional pain. As she journeys through a stylized world, her dress grants new abilities that help her navigate and understand her experience. The game offers a peaceful, artistic exploration with light puzzles and platforming, designed to be accessible to all players regardless of language. The experience focuses on emotional growth and discovery without traditional game challenges like death or frustration.

title: Legacy of Kain Soul Reaver 1&2 Remastered - Deluxe Edition
description:
Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver 1 & 2 Remastered is a collection of remastered versions of Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver and Soul Reaver 2. The games follow the vampire-turned-wraith Raziel and his conflict with his former master Kain, combining exploration, combat, environmental puzzles, and the ability to shift between the Material and Spectral Realms.

The collection features higher-resolution textures, updated character and environment models, improved visual effects, an upgraded camera, new control options, a map and compass, photo mode, and the ability to switch between the original and remastered graphics. It also includes bonus materials such as concept art, lore, soundtracks, and explorable areas cut from the original Soul Reaver.

The Deluxe Edition includes the following exclusive items:
• Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver
• Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver 2
• Steelbook with some of the game’s motifs.
• A soft-bound artbook highlighting the game’s remastered gothic environments, architecture, characters, enemies, weapons, and concept & key art.
• The official soundtrack on a physical CD.
• A collectible tuck-in box housing all the contents.

title: Medieval Escape
description: Medieval Escape is a third-person adventure game. The protagonist is a young woman trapped in an ancient medieval labyrinth. To survive, she must avoid deadly traps and find a way out.

title: Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter: Steelbook Edition
description:
Flip through the pages of the iconic Trails series to where it all began with Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter! This stunning remake reimagines the beloved classic with new breathtaking visuals, refined gameplay, and the first unforgettable adventure across Liberl Kingdom.

Join Estelle Bright and her adoptive brother, Joshua, as they embark on their journey as junior bracers, determined to climb the ranks of their renowned peacekeeping guild. What begins as a straightforward mission to prove their worth quickly evolves into a gripping adventure of intrigue and peril, as they unravel a conspiracy that threatens the very heart of their homeland.
