Experience the story that redefined the JRPG genre and set the Trails series on its legendary path!

title: Yasha: Legends of the Demon Blade - Deluxe Edition
description:
Taking place during the Edo period, Yasha: Legends of the Demon Blade is an action RPG infused with fantasy elements and roguelite mechanics. Immerse yourself in a realm brimming with authentic Japanese ambiance as you engage in seamless combo attacks against relentless demon adversaries. Once upon a time, a delicate equilibrium existed between humans and demons. Despite occasional discord, both factions labored to uphold their dearly attained peace. This equilibrium shattered when the sovereign of all demons, the "Nine-tailed Fox" arose, rallying demon kind to sow chaos across the mortal realm. Embark on a journey in a chaotic world, confronting a myriad of demons, and seeking a path to reclaim peace. Through a series of adventures, piece together the truth behind the mystery and forge a path to restoration. Yasha: Legends of the Demon Blade – Deluxe Edition includes the physical game on PlayStation 5 or Nintendo Switch along the following exclusive items: ? A soft-bound artbook highlighting the game’s distinctive art style, characters, enemies, story, and demonic environments.
? 3 Postcards with each of the game´s main character´s gorgeous art.
? A poster with the game´s Key Art.
? Digital OST & Singles voucher.
? A collectible tuck-in box housing the physical game and all the Deluxe Edition contents. Key Features: ? Packed with replayability: Character-specific scenarios: An immortal ninja, the hellish grim reaper, a yokai samurai... Each character features completely distinct combat styles and fully independent storylines. Enjoy unique exclusive weapons, a deep and compelling narrative, and a richly diverse world centered around three protagonists. ? Spectacular and dynamic action: Harness the ever-changing attributes of mystical blades to take on rampaging supernatural creatures! Combine weapons freely, collect hundreds of "Orbs" imbued with mysterious powers, and receive the blessings of the Cat God as you create your own unique build. ? Join the Demon Festival: On your journey to hunt demon, discover a hidden festival in an alternate realm where you’ll meet friendly demon, earn abundant resources, and acquire various enhancement items. Collect materials to evolve your weapons, ingredients to satisfy your hunger, and even savor the legendary ramen that grants immense power! You’ll also have the chance to tackle diverse, challenging special stages. Hardcore players who love high difficulty, enjoy challenges, and seek replayability—don’t miss out.

title: Karma: The Dark World - Limited Edition
description:
KARMA: The Dark World Physical Limited Edition include:
- An Exclusive Slipcover case
️- Three Art Cards,
- Leviathan ID Badge
- Digital Soundtrack
- Digital Art Book!

title: Arcade Archives 2: Air Combat 22
description:
"AIR COMBAT 22" is a flight shooter released by NAMCO (Bandai Namco Entertainment) in 1995. This title features an evolutionary step in 3D graphics and flashy animations using the "System Super 22" arcade board, an upgrade of the "System 22" architecture used for a wide range of legendary 3D games. Take on missions for the thrill of shooting down lots of enemy crafts, white-knuckle missions that require expert techniques, and more as you conquer diverse aerial combat scenarios. Become a hero of the skies!

The "Arcade Archives 2" series includes "ORIGINAL MODE", "HIGH SCORE MODE", "CARAVAN MODE", "TIME ATTACK MODE" and "NETWORK MODE". In "TIME ATTACK MODE"

title: Saturday Morning RPG: It's So Bad Edition
description: Saturday Morning RPG is an episodic JRPG set in world heavily inspired by 1980s Saturday morning cartoons and pop culture. Players take the role of Martin 'Marty' Michael Hall, an average high-school student who has just been granted an incredible power - a power that ultimately leads him to attract the ire of the world's most notorious villain, Commander Hood! Saturday Morning RPG features a full soundtrack by legendary composer Vince DiCola (Transformers: The Animated Movie, Rocky IV) and his composing partner, Kenny Meriedeth (contributor for DuckTales, Power Rangers, X-Men, and others).

title: Lawn Mower Racing
description: Fire up your engines and hit the tracks in Lawn Mower Racing, the ultimate competitive racing game with a humorous twist! Whether you're racing SOLO or in the exciting SPLIT-SCREEN MODE, you'll experience a unique blend of fun and strategy.

title: Hexa Road
description: Connect the roads and build a thriving city in this engaging puzzle game. With 40 challenging levels, a dynamic soundtrack, and sleek low-poly visuals, each puzzle you solve brings streets to life, sparking new homes and bustling traffic. Dive into a satisfying and strategic experience as you piece together the perfect path to grow your urban world.

title: Crossbars
description: Get ready for the ultimate downhill mountain biking experience in Crossbars, where speed, skill, and adventure collide. Set across four stunning, mountainous islands, Crossbars challenges you to race through 20 thrilling tracks, each with its own unique terrain and environmental hazards. From rocky cliffs and forested trails to muddy paths and open hills, every track offers a new adventure—will you stick to the main path and race against the clock, or venture off-road and discover hidden secrets?

title: Trial of Greed
description: Trial of Greed is a minimalist first-person dungeon crawler where your only path forward is guided by one thing: gold. In a vast, procedurally generated level filled with mysterious locked doors and hidden chests, your mission is simple—collect enough gold to buy your way through.

title: BodyCam: Tactical Freelancer
description: Step into the boots of an elite tactical freelancer in this ultra-realistic first-person shooter that delivers the raw, unfiltered intensity of real police operations. Through authentic bodycam perspective, experience heart-pounding counter-terrorism missions where split-second decisions mean the difference between life and death.

title: Tiny Titans: Card Rumble
description: Exciting epic chibi heroes and fast, tactical card battles!

title: Lollipop Chainsaw 2 Back2Back
description: Juliet returns to a rebuilt San Romero, now transformed into “Jaredwood”, a sprawling metropolis built around the film industry. When a mysterious director traps her inside his twisted zombie movie, Juliet must fight alongside her allies, uncover the conspiracy behind the chaos, and stop a new threat posed by the Corrupted Realm zombies.

title: Mergery
description: Mergery is a puzzle game where each move combines images into higher-ranked visuals. Start with the basics and merge your way toward rare and powerful artwork. Every decision matters as you manage space, plan your moves, and push for the perfect merge.

title: Elite Sports Gaming Football
description: ESG Football 27 is bigger, faster, and more connected than ever. Build your player, compete with friends, and experience football your way with brand-new 11v11 Rec Mode, cross-play between PlayStation and Xbox, improved matchmaking and connectivity, tutorials to learn the fundamentals, nostalgia-inspired mini-games, and a deeper player progression system with grindable badges and boosts to increase your character's attributes. Whether you’re playing Head-to-Head, teaming up in 11v11, or grinding to build your player, ESG Football 27 brings the ultimate football experience to life.

title: Galaxy Roll
description: Roll through the stars. React, survive, repeat.

title: Just Dance 2026 Edition
description:
Just Dance 2026 Edition is a dance rhythm game that scores you as you match choreography on screen. It includes a new tracklist with 40 songs ranging from recent hits to classics, plus modes for solo dancing, co-op play, and competitive challenges with up to 6 players in local multiplayer.
You can also dance using your phone as a camera controller and choose workout sessions to stay active while you play. The game brings together content from multiple Just Dance editions into one place for easy access to songs.

title: Once Upon A Katamari: King of All Sounds Edition
description:
The King of All Sounds Edition includes:
- Once Upon A KATAMARI
- Katamari Damacy Series Songs: Side A
- Katamari Damacy Series Songs: Side B

Once upon a time a katamari rolled through both past and present. In this story across time, the adage endures: Let The Good Times Roll! Now onward through new worlds to roll up thy heart's desires and to restore the stars!

title: Borderlands 4: Deluxe Edition
description:
Pre-Purchase Borderlands 4 and receive the Gilded Glory Pack featuring a Vault Hunter Skin, a Weapon Skin, and an ECHO-4 Drone Skin!
Take on new areas with unique missions and bosses, earn more rewards with Vault Cards, and collect all kinds of additional loot with the Borderlands 4 Deluxe Edition!

Borderlands 4 Deluxe Edition includes:
• Full base game
• Pre-Purchase Bonus: Gilded Glory Pack*

1 Vault Hunter Skin

1 Weapon Skin

1 ECHO-4 Drone Skin
• Firehawk's Fury Weapon Skin
• Bounty Pack Bundle**

4 unique areas, featuring new missions and unique bosses

4 Vault Cards with unique challenges and rewards

New gear and weapons

New Vault Hunter cosmetics

4 New vehicles with new cosmetics

Borderlands 4 brings intense action, badass Vault Hunters, and billions of wild and deadly weapons to an all-new planet ruled by a ruthless tyrant.

title: NHL 26
description: Play like a superstar in EA Sports NHL 26. That starts with ICE-Q 2.0, now powered by NHL EDGE data, so your favorite superstars think, move, and play like their on-ice selves. That includes data-informed Attributes and Tendencies which make star players perform in true-to-life fashion, with their playstyles and decision-making game-aware and impactful. A fine-tuned and enhanced arsenal of 28 X-Factors spans five different categories and is driven by unique animations, tactical gameplay outcomes, and tiers of impact, turning each into a formidable on-ice weapon. Superstars now truly feel like superstars.

title: Ultrashot: Kill Protocol
description: When the system fails, the protocol begins.

title: Police Officers Simulator
description: Step into the uniform and protect the city you serve!

title: Ship Simulator: Ocean Fishing
description:
Embark on the Ultimate Ocean Fishing Adventure!
In SHIP SIMULATOR: OCEAN FISHING, you are an independent fisherman starting with nothing but an old boat and the open sea. Navigate coastal waters in search of fish, crabs, and rare seafood, then sell your catch at bustling ports – each offering different prices, challenges, and opportunities.
Every voyage is a test of skill and strategy. Monitor your fuel, adapt to realistic water physics, and face the ever-changing moods of the ocean – from calm sunrises wrapped in fog to raging storms that push your ship to its limits.

title: Death Mask
description: A series of murders follows a mysterious ritual dance in rural China.

title: Farland Saga I & II: Saturn Tribute
Classic Solitaire
description: Classic Solitaire is an exciting card game that comes with 15 card styles and 5 backgrounds.

title: Antarctica 88: Remaster
description: Survive this horror and creepy action adventure!

title: Zumba: Treasure of the Marble Sea
description: Set sail on a marble-blasting adventure! In Zumba – Treasure of the Marble Sea, shoot and match marbles before they reach the end. Unlock upgrades, earn stars, and explore pirate worlds!

title: DoomCrush
description: Step into the chaotic rhythm of DOOMCRUSH, a visually striking arcade experience where every tap is a fight for survival. This high-intensity game blends fast reflexes with a meta-narrative twist, as you battle against time, destruction, and the game’s own rebellious antagonist, Dystro—who wants nothing more than to erase himself from existence.

title: Fast & Furious: Arcade Edition
description: Fast & Furious: Arcade Edition delivers high-speed racing and pedal-to-the-metal action straight from the arcade to consoles and PC! Hit the road in legendary cars including the Dodge Charger, Corvette Z06, Shelby GT500 KR, Ford GT, Bronco DR, Jeep Wrangler and more - plus customize your car with unique color schemes.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Aqua Jet
description:
The "Arcade Archives" (ACA) series faithfully reproduces classic arcade game masterpieces, staying true to its original.
You can customize game settings to your liking, such as adjusting the difficulty level, and depending on the title, even recreate the nostalgic atmosphere of CRT TVs back in the day.
Additionally, you can compete for high scores with players from all around the world through online rankings.

In addition to the “ORIGINAL MODE,” “HIGH SCORE MODE,” and “CARAVAN MODE” included in the “Arcade Archives” series, “Arcade Archives 2” series will add new features such as “TIME ATTACK MODE” and “NETWORK MODE.”In “TIME ATTACK MODE” you compete to see who can beat the final boss the fastest stating from the first battle. This mode focuses on how quickly you can complete the game, regardless of the score you achieve. In “NETWORK MODE” you can play against other users over the network.

Additionally, functionality has been significantly enhanced. Multiple save slots have been implemented instead of just one, along with a rewind feature that allows players to retry gameplay and a quick start feature for those who want to dive straight into the game. Furthermore, VRR support has been added, enabling more accurate reproduction of the original arcade game’s experience.

Enjoy the legendary arcade masterpiece with “Arcade Archives 2,” now more fun and user-friendly.

title: Bombordiro Crocodilo: Flight Simulator
description: Let’s get this meme flight started!

title: Steam-Heart's & Advanced V.G.: Saturn Tribute
description: Steam-Heart's & Advanced V.G.: Saturn Tribute is a compilation that includes the sci‑fi shoot ’em up Steam‑Heart’s and the 2D fighting game Advanced Variable Geo. Both titles are modernized for the “Saturn Tribute” line with features like rewind, quick save/load, difficulty/assist options, and an included manual.

title: Life is Strange Collection
description:
LIFE IS STRANGE is a single-player narrative adventure series that focuses on heartfelt, grounded stories with a twist of the strange, and a franchise that has won over 100 awards since its inception - including from The Peabody Awards, BAFTA, and GLAAD.

Over five cinematic, emotional adventures, you’ll Rewind Time as Max Caulfield and uncover the secrets of Arcadia Bay with Chloe Price, take a road trip with Sean Diaz and his telekinetic brother Daniel, find a new home with psychic empath Alex Chen, and return to Max to solve a murder across two timelines.

The box set comprises a disc with LIFE IS STRANGE: TRUE COLORS and LIFE IS STRANGE: DOUBLE EXPOSURE, alongside a redemption code granting entitlement to LIFE IS STRANGE REMASTERED, LIFE IS STRANGE: BEFORE THE STORM REMASTERED, LIFE IS STRANGE 2, and all associated DLC and pre-order incentive items.

title: Ghost of Yotei: Legends
description:
Ghost of Yötei Legends is an online cooperative multiplayer mode, up to four players, where players can team up with friends to challenge monstrous, supernatural enemies across three distinct game modes:
• Survival - Team up with up to three other players to take down waves of increasingly difficult enemies on one of four maps. Fight to control territory on each map. While in control, you can choose to activate a Blessing to receive an advantage in battle, but losing control can activate a Curse that puts your team at a disadvantage.
• Story - Team up with another player to tackle a series of 12 missions. Work together, combining your unique skills to overcome a range of encounters, enemies and challenges.
• Incursion - Upon completing each set of three Story missions, you’ll unlock a large-scale, four-player assault on a stronghold belonging to a member of the Yōtei Six. Each Incursion will culminate in a boss fight versus a giant, supernatural version of The Spider, The Oni, The Kitsune, or The Snake.

title: Black Myth: Zhong Kui
description: Black Myth: Zhong Kui is an action-RPG focusing on the legendary Chinese demon-slayer, depicting his journey from a wronged, scholar-turned-ghost into a powerful, fearsome judge of the underworld. The game features a new storyline distinct from Wukong, exploring themes of justice and fighting evil with evil.

title: Frostpunk 2: Icebreaker Edition
description:
The ICEBREAKER EDITION of Frostpunk 2 is a special version of the game that includes some unique extras. In addition to the base game, which lets you build and manage a city in a post-apocalyptic world, you'll get:

• A New London pop-up diorama, a detailed miniature model of the game's frozen city.
• An official artbook, featuring behind-the-scenes concept art, sketches, and more.
• A novella called "Warm Flesh", a gripping short story set in the Frostpunk universe.

title: Metal Gear Solid Delta Snake Eater: Day One Edition
description: Discover the origin story of iconic military operative Snake and begin to unravel the plot of the legendary METAL GEAR series. METAL GEAR SOLID ?: SNAKE EATER brings unprecedented new graphics, immersive stealth action gameplay and sounds to its riveting story as players once again return to the world of METAL GEAR. Rival nations are secretly developing weapons that could threaten the future of mankind. Deep in the jungle, an elite soldier must combine stealth with survival to infiltrate the enemy and stop a weapon of mass destruction from triggering the largest full-scale war the world has ever seen

title: Asphalt Legends Unite: Supercharged Edition
description:
Legends of the world UNITE.

The latest entry in the long-running series, Asphalt Legends UNITE puts you behind the wheel of the world's most powerful cars to race through breath-taking landscapes. Build up your own garage from 250+ hypercars and build your legend, solo or united, versus or co-op.

Get ready to rev your engines and dominate the streets like never before in Asphalt Legends UNITE: Supercharged Edition! Prepare for an unparalleled gaming experience with the top-dollar luxury DLC bundle, featuring a fleet of high-caliber cars that are the epitome of performance.

Start the game with 5 extra hypercars waiting in your garage from D to S class, as well as an elite A class: the Lamborghini Countach LPI 800-4 (***) and a bank of tokens and credits to get a rolling start.

Content list

Lamborghini Countach LPI 800-4 at 3 stars.
Chevrolet Corvette ZR1.
McLaren 765LT.
Ferrari 296 GTB.
Porsche Taycan Turbo S.
5,000 Tokens.
5,000,000 Credits.
Take command of world-class supercars and equip them with the latest upgrades using the abundant coins and tokens included in the bundle. With these invaluable resources, you can supercharge your rides to their maximum potential, ensuring that victory is not just within reach, but guaranteed in the adrenaline-fueled battles that await."

Take on the World/ Face off with the World: Gear up and dive into the international arena of Asphalt Legends Unite's online multiplayer mode. Challenge up to 7 opponents across platforms from every corner of the world in thrilling cross-play races. Engage in split-screen competitions with friends, up to 4 players. Get ready to group together, dominate, and leave your mark on the asphalt!

Join Global Racing Legends: Embrace the global racing community where camaraderie fuels the pursuit of victory. Join and create racing clubs, unlock exclusive rewards as you climb the leaderboard. Rally with the Asphalt titans and leave your lasting legacy on the asphalt!

Pick your Ride and Dominate the Competition: Harness the power of the pack: Over 250 hypercars await, from elite manufacturers like Ferrari, Porsche and Lamborghini, each meticulously crafted to push the boundaries of speed and performance. Conquer tracks inspired by iconic locations across the world, cherished by racers worldwide.

Feel the Rush of Absolute Control: Feel one with the beat of the track as you and your teammates dive into electrifying races, perform gravity-defying stunts, and power to victory with adrenaline-fueled boosts. With precise manual control or streamlined TouchDrive, Asphalt Legends Unite puts you in the driver’s seat, ready to steal the show!

Arcade Racing at Its Finest: Dive into the thrilling world of high-speed racing, where detailed vehicles, stunning effects, and vibrant dynamic lights await. With gameplay flowing at 120FPS, become one with the asphalt, taking on the world like a true champion!

Kickstart Your Racing Legacy / Embark on Your Racing Saga: Take the wheel on your journey to racing greatness in Career Mode, maneuvering through endless seasons and conquering diverse challenges at every turn. Feel the thrill of pulse-pounding events, with a constant stream of time-limited challenges and activities to keep you on the edge of your seat. This is your chance to carve out a legacy that echoes throughout the racetrack!

Customize Your Ride, Own the Road: Personalize your vehicle and show off your style to your rivals with unique body paint, rims, wheels, and body parts!

Features

Over 250 officially licensed hypercars from Ferrari, Lamborghini, Porsche...
Short-burst, instant fun: 30s to 2min races
Intense arcade feel: nitro, barrel rolls, 360s...
Solo or multiplayer, local or online, co-op or vs
Dozens of "postcard" tracks with dynamic lights
Always new: each season, fresh events and cars

title: Lumines Arise: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
Lumines Arise: Digital Deluxe Edition Includes:

- Lumines Arise full game
- ASTRO BOT Loomii in-game avatar
- Tetris Effect: Connected Loomii in-game avatar
- Rez Infinite Loomii in-game avatar
- HUMANITY Loomii in-game avatar

title: Arcade Archives 2: Scrambled Egg
description:
Kick, launch, and get chased! It's a scramble emergency!!!

"SCRAMBLED EGG" is an action game released by Technos Japan in 1983.
Kick the eggs to crack them open and hatch chicks. Then launch all the new chicks into the sky!
Red chicks and chickens will help you take down enemies. Be sure to take good care of them!

title: Off-the-Ground Survival
description: Trapped on the top floor, 99 stories off the ground, you hope to reach the ground floor and escape. With limited food and supplies, find your exit and survive the apocalypse!

title: Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree - Collector's Edition
description:
Collectors' Edition includes:
An exclusive Art Book showcasing never-before-seen illustrations
A CD Soundtrack featuring the haunting Original Soundtrack (OST) composed by Christos Antoniou (from the Greek metal band Septicflesh) and primarily performed by the FILMharmonic Orchestra of Prague!
A double-sided poster
The physical game
A collectible tuck-in box housing all the contents

title: Monument Valley: The Trilogy
description:
Monument Valley: Trilogy is a puzzle game featuring geometric landscapes and optical illusion-based levels. Players navigate through surreal architectural environments, solving spatial puzzles by manipulating the game's architectural structures. The series follows a silent protagonist through interconnected puzzle worlds, combining minimalist design with intricate spatial challenges.

It includes:

• The complete series in one physical edition
• Includes Six Premium Art Cards, featuring gorgeous scenes from each game
• Exclusive, Sleek all- black O-Sleeve design
• Pre-orders receive a download code for all three Monument Valley soundtracks
• Region Free - Worldwide Compatibility

title: Arcade Archives 2: Chopper 1
description:
"CHOPPER 1" is a shooter released by SNK in 1988.
Pilot a combat helicopter deep into enemy territory in a mission to restore peace to your homeland.
Wielding overwhelming power far beyond what’s needed to simply protect one's family, what will these men discover at the end of their path of destruction?

"Arcade Archives 2" series includes "ORIGINAL MODE," "HIGH SCORE MODE," "CARAVAN MODE," and "TIME ATTACK MODE."
It also features multiple save slots, a rewind function that lets you restart your gameplay, and a quick start function for those who want to get started right away.
Furthermore, VRR support has been added, enabling more accurate reproduction of the original arcade game's experience.

title: Zip's Jumping Adventure
description:
This vertical platformer challenges your reflexes, timing, and precision across 40 adventure levels and an endless arcade mode with over 1 billion unique combinations.

Collect coins as you ascend, and try to beat the gold time on each level. Collecting every coin and finishing under the gold time awards gold stars. It’s all about precision, speed, and finding the best path upward.

As you progress, you'll travel through a variety of environments and experience shifting times of day, including bright middays, glowing sunsets, and quiet midnight climbs. Each level encourages players to push their skills further.

Compete with friends and players around the world on global leaderboards. Every adventure level tracks your best time — can you claim the top spot?

Whether you're collecting every coin or racing for the best time, Zip’s Jumping Adventures delivers a focused, skill-based challenge with plenty of variety!

title: Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater - Tactical Edition
description: The same gripping story and engrossing world, but now with cutting-edge graphics and 3D audio, which bring the jungle to life. Get ready for the ultimate survival, stealth and action experience.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Mach Breakers
description:
Seven new contenders compete in an unprecedented super competition!

"MACH BREAKERS" is a sports game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1995.
The superhuman sports series continues with this sequel to “Numan Athletics”!
Now featuring 7 athletes and 12 kinds of events, the action is even more intense.
Break the sound barrier and shatter expectations!

title: Nordic Ashes: The Complete Saga
description: Nordic Ashes is a challenging Norse inspired roguelite-survivor game, where you’ll have to survive hordes of creatures that come your way.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Video Hustler
description:
Experience the thrill of the pocket!

"VIDEO HUSTLER" is a sports game released by KONAMI in 1981.
This game is a simplified version of pool (pocket billiards). You strike the white cue ball to roll it, hit six balls, and sink them into the pockets.
The game’s most distinctive feature is that the score can vary greatly depending on the numbers on the balls and the different multipliers assigned to each pocket.

title: Gang Wars: Cards and Bullets
description: Become an underworld mafia boss in fast, tactical card battles!

title: Ginsei Igo: AI Teaches You How to Play Go
Beat Hazard Arcade
description:
Experience your music collection like never before in this intense, music-driven twin-stick shooter.

Each of your songs creates its own unique ebb and flow, fueling your weapons with the power of the beat. Beat Hazard Arcade seamlessly blends the thrill of gaming and love of music, together they become greater than the sum of their parts.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Steel Worker
description:
"STEEL WORKER" is a puzzle game released by TAITO in 1980.
In this game, your objective is to connect a path to the destination by placing scaffolding for a workman performing high-altitude work on a construction site, ensuring he does not fall.
To prevent the workman from having an accident, it is sometimes necessary to strategically place the scaffolding so that he takes a detour or reverses his path. Remember to value your workers! Stay safe out there!

“Arcade Archives 2” series introduces a brand-new mode called TIME ATTACK MODE, in addition to the ORIGINAL MODE, HI SCORE MODE, and CARAVAN MODE from Arcade Archives. TIME ATTACK MODE focuses on how quickly you can complete the game, regardless of the score you achieve.
What’s more, with VRR (Variable Refresh Rate) support, the gameplay can be reproduced even more accurately, closer to the original arcade experience.

title: Ball In the Hole!
description: Test your skills and guide the ball into the hole across 15 levels of increasing difficulty!

title: Rennsport: Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition of RENNSPORT comes packed with exclusive content to take your racing experience to the next level:
- Nordschleife x 911 GT3 R Pack – Race on the legendary German circuit behind the wheel of the Porsche 911 GT3 R Rennsport.
- 1,100 RENN$ in-game credits – Unlock new liveries.
- Endurance Classics – Part 1 (post-launch DLC) – Conquer the iconic 24H Le Mans track with historic legends like the Porsche 911 GT1, Mercedes CLK, and Porsche 956.
- Touring Classics – Part 1 (post-launch DLC) – Experience touring car glory on the Hockenheim Classic with the Alfa Classic DTM, Mercedes Classic DTM, and Audi Classic DTM.

title: Rebeloid
description: A non-VR release of a an arcade brick-breaker.

title: Path of Legends
description: Become a legend by slaying demons and collecting their souls!

title: Pirate Simulator: Corsair Skull & Sails
description: Raise the sails and prepare to explore a world full of dangers and opportunities in Pirate Simulator - Corsair Skull & Sails! Step into the shoes of of Sebastian Roco and embark on a legendary adventure across endless seas. Explore tropical islands, conquer enemy ships, and uncover hidden treasures that could change the fate of the world.

title: Truck Driver: The Dutch Connection
description: Set in a reimagined Netherlands in 2027, discover a new era of trucking where AI dispatchers work alongside human drivers and the industry is thriving. Join Lucas and Felix as they face new challenges, forge alliances, and adapt to an evolving industry in this next chapter of the Truck Driver series.

title: Silent Hill f: Day One Edition
description:
Silent Hill f is a survival horror game published by Konami as part of the Silent Hill series.
It is set in rural Japan during the 1960s, marking a departure from the franchise’s traditional Western settings. The story is written by Ryukishi07 and focuses on psychological horror, social pressure, and transformation.

The Day One Edition includes the full game and the following additional items, provided via a voucher included in the game pack: the White Marine School Uniform, Omamori (Peony), and an item pack containing one Shriveled Aburaage, one Holy Water, and one Emergency Kit.

title: Yasuke: Black Samurai Legend
description: Based on the extraordinary true story of history's first African samurai, embark on an epic journey in feudal Japan. From slave to legendary warrior, live the incredible tale of Yasuke as he masters the way of the samurai and shapes Japan's destiny.

title: Let's Sing 2026
description: The global karaoke party returns with Let’s Sing 2026, your ultimate ticket to fun-filled nights and unforgettable performances.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Gee Bee
description: Puts the PUNCH!

title: Campfire of Oasis 2
description: The desert night is calm, the fire flickers, and your loyal dog is by your side. In Campfire Oasis 2, you embark on a cozy adventure. Your companion searches the surroundings for wood, and you gather what is found. Every bundle strengthens the fire at the heart of your camp, turning a quiet night into a safe haven of warmth.

title: Flockout
description: Flockout is a chaotic 4-player local party game where you play as furious, fluffy sheep in wild mini-games! Chase thieves, slam goals in sheep soccer, or race across wobbly obstacle courses at wool-warping speed. With every match, chaos, laughter, and revenge pile up — making it the perfect couch-party showdown for friends, families, and frenemies alike.

title: Dark Steel Legends
description:
Enter the world of Fight Legends, a fast-paced, action-packed medieval combat game where your skills and strategy will decide your fate.
Face hordes of challengers, hone your abilities, and hunt down enemies worldwide in epic duels.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Battlantis
description:
The time for battle has come!
Rise, true hero!

"BATTLANTIS" is a shooter released by KONAMI in 1987.
The objective is to defend your castle from an invading army of monsters. You must defeat all enemies before they climb the castle walls.
Only the young King Cripeuss III can save the sacred island of Battlantis. Go forth and drive back the evil monsters!

title: Arcade Archives 2: Munch Mobile
description: Munch Mobile is an action game released by SNK in 1983. Pilot a mysterious car with arms, picking up fuel and food along the way. The goal is to make it home before your fuel runs out. Place trash left from your food into bins to earn big points! Show consideration in public spaces and enjoy a fun drive!

title: Grayland Remastered
description:
Fly through breathtaking hand-painted environments, dodge enemy drones, cleanse toxic hotspots, and confront colossal bosses in your journey to save your loved ones. Discover the haunting mystery behind the fall of this world — and fight to restore hope where none remains.

Remastered Edition Enhancements
* 4K resolution with enhanced visuals and refined animations
* Redesigned controls optimized for the DualSense controller
* Rebalanced difficulty system for smoother, more rewarding progression

title: Icarus: Console Edition
description: Land on Icarus, a planet broken due to failed terraforming. Once meant to be humanity’s second home, it is now a hostile frontier of toxic skies, savage wildlife, and relentless storms. Every drop from orbit is a fight for survival. Build shelter, craft weapons, hunt for food, and seek your fortune in exotic matter.

title: Death Park 2: Remaster
description: Be the first to survive this action-packed horror game in stunning graphics and uncover the dark secret behind the murderous clown!

title: Arcade Archives 2: Midnight Landing
description:
"MIDNIGHT LANDING" is a flight simulation game released by TAITO in 1987.
You take control of an aircraft soaring through the midnight sky, with the goal of landing safely at the airport.
The lights of the runway come into view, signalling the end of your journey through the night.
Bring it to a perfect close with a beautiful landing.

“Arcade Archives 2” adds a new “TIME ATTACK MODE” to the lineup of “ORIGINAL MODE,” “HI SCORE MODE,” and “CARAVAN MODE” included in the Arcade Archives series. In “TIME ATTACK MODE,” players compete to clear the game as quickly as possible, regardless of the score achieved. VRR (Variable Refresh Rate) support has also been added, allowing gameplay to be reproduced even closer to the original arcade experience.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Scion
description:
"SCION" is a shooting game released by SEIBU KAIHATSU in 1984.
The game is set in Crystal Heaven, a sprawling supercity built in multiple layers.
Your mission is to rescue your captured kin trapped within the city’s core.
Fight your way down from the upper levels, tearing through each layer as you advance toward the enemy’s stronghold deep within!

“Arcade Archives 2” adds a new “TIME ATTACK MODE” to the lineup of “ORIGINAL MODE,” “HI SCORE MODE,” and “CARAVAN MODE” included in the Arcade Archives series. In “TIME ATTACK MODE,” players compete to clear the game as quickly as possible, regardless of the score achieved. VRR (Variable Refresh Rate) support has also been added, allowing gameplay to be reproduced even closer to the original arcade experience.

title: Elden Ring: Nightreign - Seeker's Edition
description: The Seeker's Edition Includes: • ELDEN RING NIGHTREIGN in a steelbook case • An upgrade code to the Digital Deluxe edition of the game

title: Drifties
description: Arcade racing turned up to eleven!

title: Baseball Dreams VR
description:
Baseball Dreams VR is a true-to-life baseball simulator.
Enjoy realistic games in immersive VR from a first-person view.
Customize your settings for a more casual gameplay experience.

title: Monster House Racing
description: Monster House Racing invites you to rev your engines and speed through the haunted corridors of the Grindstone Manor in this exhilarating kart racing game. Embrace the Halloween spirit as you compete against friends and AI opponents in thrilling races across ghostly tracks filled with supernatural challenges and spooky surprises. Whether you're a seasoned racer or new to the track, Monster House Racing offers a heart-pounding experience perfect for any fan of high-speed action and haunted thrills.

title: Desert War: Military Combat Shooter
description: Desert War: Military Combat Shooter throws you into the chaos of a war-torn desert city. As an elite soldier, you’ll battle through explosive missions, adapt to shifting combat zones, and outsmart enemies that react to your every move.

title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection - Deluxe Edition
description:
Set Contents:
- Base Game
- Deluxe Kit
Additional Side Story: Rudy
Special Outfits Set:
Layered Armor for Eleanor: Royal Flair
Layered Armor for Gaul: Protective Wings

title: Arcade Archives 2: Tokyo Wars
description: The battle for Tokyo! Which side will you join: the Green force or the White force?

title: Detective Girl: The Case of Immortality
description: Return to Renaissance Florence and uncover an ancient secret of immortality.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Galactic Warriors
description:
Galactic Fighters: Which mecha will you pilot, which weapon will you fight with?

"GALACTIC WARRIORS" is a fighting game released by KONAMI in 1985.
Join the "Robot Fighting" event, a major craze among galactic humanity in Cosmic Year HIT 30,000, and aim for victory.
Your protagonists are three beloved machines: SAMSON, GAEA, and POSEIDON.
The warriors of the cosmos roar through the stadium!

title: Top Shot Pool
description: Step up to the table in Top Shot Pool - the ultimate cue-sport experience combining realistic physics with fun, competitive arcade action.

title: Marvel's Spider-Man: The Great Web
description: Marvel’s Spider-Man: The Great Web was a cancelled cooperative multiplayer project by Insomniac Games, designed as a live-service experience set in the Spider-Man universe. It would have allowed up to five players to control different Spider-Heroes across the multiverse, teaming up in missions against threats like the Sinister Six. Focused on character customization and shared gameplay, the game was shelved before its official announcement.

title: Reanimal: Deluxe Edition
description:
Reanimal is a cooperative horror adventure game created by the team behind Little Nightmares and Little Nightmares II. The story follows a brother and sister as they search for their missing friends on an isolated island. Players explore both land and water areas, solving problems together and navigating hostile environments while uncovering the island’s underlying mystery.

The Deluxe Edition includes the base game and a Season Pass.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Bomb Bee
description:
"Bomb Bee" is a brick breaker released by Namco Limited (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1979.
The biggest feature of this sequel to GEE BEE, as its title suggests, is the bomb!
Find the hidden bombs in the playfield, set off explosions, and aim for a high score! Like its predecessor, this title also supports mouse control. Let's BOMB BEE with simple controls!

title: Mind Twist
description: Sharpen your focus and put both sides of your brain to the ultimate test in Mind Twist - a fast-paced mental workout designed to confuse, challenge, and train your mind.

title: Super Hoops 2
description: Throw, dodge, and master endless hoops.

title: Emoji Rampage: Origins
description: Blast through endless swarms of chaotic emojis in this fast-paced rogue-like FPS! Unlock arenas, collect power-ups, upgrade your run, and survive the madness.

title: Tales of Morphos
description:
Tales of Morphos is a psychological horror/adventure game in which you play as a man who has recently been discharged from a psychiatric hospital after losing his memory.

Upon returning home, your wife, a research scientist, out of compassion and a desire to keep an eye on you, arranges for you to join her team. Your workplace turns out to be a gloomy and mysterious underground complex where experiments with anomalous phenomena are conducted.

At first, everything seems like an attempt to return to normal life, but soon strange things begin to happen underground.

title: Plane Flight Simulator
description:
Experience the thrill of aviation like never before in Plane Flight Simulator. Step into the cockpit of realistic aircraft, from small private planes to massive commercial jets, and master the art of flying.
Soar through open skies, navigate changing weather conditions, and complete challenging missions that test your piloting skills. Explore airports around the world, practice smooth landings, or simply enjoy free-flight mode for a relaxing journey above the clouds.

title: Silent Hill f: Steelbook Edition
description: A physical Day One edition that includes an exclusive steelbook. This special case features the oil-painted, haunting art of protagonist Hinako Shimizu. Available for PS5 and Xbox Series X through select European retailers.

title: Zumba: Dragon's Marble Trial
description: Unleash your dragon’s fire—match, blast, and master the marble trial!

title: Arcade Archives 2: Roc'n Rope
description:
Capture the “ROC” BIRD

"ROC'N ROPE" is an action game released by KONAMI in 1983.
In pursuit of the lucky bird, the Roc, you must climb higher and higher through various locations, including cliffs and ice caves.
Use the rope, which can be fired diagonally upwards, to create the optimal route for a safe ascent!

title: Arcade Archives 2: Bermuda Triangle
description:
"BERMUDA TRIANGLE" is a shooting game released by SNK in 1987.
Pilot the time-space battleship ZIG and face off against mysterious enemies seeking to invade human history.
From the present to the past, the battlefield shifts with the changing ages. Power up your warship and gain the strength to survive any era!

title: Arcade Archives 2: Space Invaders
description:
Space Invaders is an arcade video game developed by Tomohiro Nishikado and released in 1978. It is one of the earliest shooting games and the aim is to defeat waves of aliens with a laser cannon to earn as many points as possible.

This Arcade Archives edition emulates both black/white and colored versions with a combination of color filters and backgrounds mimicking the original arcade machines, along with VRR (Variable Refresh Rate) support for smoother playback of the original frame rate.

title: Tomb Raider IV•V•VI Remastered: Deluxe Edition
description:
Play the next series of Tomb Raider adventures in this remastered collection of the Darkness Trilogy.

See the Classic & Remastered Visuals: Play with the original polygonal models or swap to the remastered graphics at any time.

Travel the Globe: Follow Lara Croft around iconic locales including Cairo, Rome, Paris, and many more Experience Lara’s Darkest Adventures: Uncover the secrets of Lara Croft’s past and shed light on the mystery of her disappearance.

Tomb Raider IV-VI Remastered Deluxe Edition includes:

- the physical game steelbook
- an exploration map book
- a greatest hits music CD
- collector’s box

title: Arcade Archives 2: The Outfoxies
description:
"THE OUTFOXIES" is an action game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1995.

You select one of the world’s top assassins as your protagonist, and under the orders of a mysterious billionaire, your mission is to eliminate all the others.

Whether for the reward, for pride, or simply for the thrill of combat…

A no-rules showdown among the world’s most dangerous professionals is about to begin!

The “Arcade Archives”series is developed with the concept of faithfully reproducing classic arcade games. It also includes convenient features such as difficulty and screen settings, rewind, rapid-fire, and multiple save slots. In addition, players can compete for the best scores with players around the world through online rankings.

“Arcade Archives 2” adds a new “TIME ATTACK MODE” to the lineup of “ORIGINAL MODE,” “HI SCORE MODE,” and “CARAVAN MODE” included in the Arcade Archives series. In “TIME ATTACK MODE,” players compete to clear the game as quickly as possible, regardless of the score achieved. VRR (Variable Refresh Rate) support has also been added, allowing gameplay to be reproduced even closer to the original arcade experience.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Touchdown Fever
description:
"TOUCHDOWN FEVER" is a sports game released by SNK in 1987.
Tap the buttons to push forward—simple controls make it easy to enjoy the flow of American football.
With over a hundred formations selected automatically, even beginners unfamiliar with detailed tactics can relax and enjoy the game.

“Arcade Archives 2” adds a new “TIME ATTACK MODE” to the lineup of “ORIGINAL MODE,” “HI SCORE MODE,” and “CARAVAN MODE” included in the Arcade Archives series. In “TIME ATTACK MODE,” players compete to clear the game as quickly as possible, regardless of the score achieved. VRR (Variable Refresh Rate) support has also been added, allowing gameplay to be reproduced even closer to the original arcade experience.

title: Mage Wars
description:
Shout — and Cast!
In Mage Wars, you control magic with your voice. Your real voice.

Want to blow up your enemies? Just say “Fireball!”
Want to disappear? Say “Invisible!” — and vanish into the shadows.

Yes, your voice is your weapon. Experience magic like never before!

title: Owlen and the Spirits of the Past
description: Help Owlen to restore the past, and uncover lost memories.

title: Lil Gator Game: Gator of the Year Edition
description: The complete Lil Gator adventure, all bundled up in one heartwarming package.

title: Battle Puzzle 2048: Queens of the Abyss
description: Combine tiles and face off against anime witches, seductive demons, and powerful queens of darkness!

title: Arcade Archives 2: Space Invaders Part II
description:
In 1979, and again in 2026, the Invaders are returning!

"Space Invaders Part II" is a shooting game released by Taito in 1979.
The enemy Invaders have returned more powerful than ever, having acquired new tactics like splitting and receiving reinforcements from Ufos!
With added features like the Rainbow Bonus to aim for high scores, this title is long beloved by skilled experts looking to hone their abilities!

title: Let's Sing 2026 with German Hits
description: Let's Sing 2026 with German Hits is a karaoke rhythm game focused on German-language pop hits, offering party-friendly multiplayer and solo modes. Players sing along to a curated setlist, score with pitch and timing accuracy, unlock cosmetic rewards, and enjoy themed playlists tailored to the German-speaking market.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Bomb Jack Twin
description:
Even the toughest challenge can be overcome by two players!

"Bomb Jack Twin" is an action game released by NMK(original work by Koei Tecmo Games) in 1993.
The popular "Bomb Jack" is back, cuter and tougher than ever! Two-player simultaneous play is also possible!
Dodge enemy attacks and collect all the bombs on the stage. Prioritize grabbing the lit bombs for a chance at a high score!

title: Horror Tale: Remaster
description: Start a scary adventure and be the first to solve all the mysteries of this horror game!

title: Yakuza: Like a Dragon - Limited Edition
description:
SEGA and Pix'n Love are pleased to present the Yakuza: Like a Dragon exclusive numbered Limited Edition!

This numbered edition includes:

- The game Yakuza: Like a Dragon for PlayStation 5.
- An 128-page artbook featuring numerous illustrations and exclusive interviews with Toshihiro Nagoshi, Hiroyuki Sakamoto and Masayoshi Yokoyama.
- A numbered certificate of authenticity.
- 4 lithographs.
- An original cardboard box with Pantone colors.

title: Untitled God of War Live-Service Game
description: Little is known about the title, aside from its multiplayer nature, and some screenshots that hint at a Greek setting. It was cancelled by Sony after the failure of Concord, along with another live-service game being made by Bend Studios.

title: The Last of Us Online
description: The Last of Us Online was a planned multiplayer game based on The Last of Us series being developed by Naughty Dog. Initially announced in 2018 as an expansion to The Last of Us Part II, the game later entered development as a standalone live service title before it was cancelled in December 2023.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Labyrinth Runner
description:
“LABYRINTH RUNNER” is a shooting game released by KONAMI in 1988.
You set off on a journey towards the castle where the evil Devil awaits, in order to rescue the kidnapped Princess Papaya.
Be wary of the various traps along the way, and use three types of projectiles to defeat enemies appearing from all directions as you advance!

title: Succubus: Hellish Edition
description:
her unique skills to take revenge on your enemies.
Regain your kingdom making hell tremble under your hooves! Leave no one alive if they won't bend the knee.

Betrayed by your own species you are left with only one goal that matters – revenge!

title: Arcade Room Simulator 2026
description:
Arcade Room Simulator – Build, Manage, and Play!

Step into the world of neon lights and nostalgic gaming in Arcade Room Simulator, a first-person immersive simulation where you become the owner of your very own arcade! Start with a small space, purchase and upgrade machines, and create a thriving entertainment hub filled with classic and modern arcade games.

title: Dead Cells: Return to Castlevania - Signature Edition
description:
The Signature Edition version of ‘Dead Cells: Return to Castlevania’, featuring the following delectable and collectable extras:

Standard copy of the game with retro reversible cover unique to Switch and Playstation

Unique Signature Edition outer sleeves

Alternative disc soundtrack featuring 28 original Castlevania tunes re-imagined in a Dead Cells style

Collection of 4 enamel pins

Exclusive art book

5 snapshot photos souvenirs of the Beheaded in Castlevania

Lenticular castle card

4 ‘Dead Cells: Return to Castlevania’ postcards featuring printed signatures

Special edition collectors box

title: Arcade Archives 2: Quester
description:
Your goal is to safely return to Earth by piloting the spacecraft and defeating the mysterious space organisms (blocks) that obstruct your path.

The ball can split into multiple pieces if it continues to bounce off the walls. Use various power-up items to your advantage and aim to clear all 33 rounds!

title: Sora: Winds of the Jungle
description: Soar as a spirited parrot through lush jungles and tropical islands. Follow your flock, hit speed boosts, and glide through sky markers in a peaceful flying adventure.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Rave Racer
description:
"Rave Racer" is a racing game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1995.
With dynamic presentation and more exhilarating drift control, this title evolved in every way, becoming a hit that soared past the high expectations set for the third installment in the RIDGE RACER series. The diverse soundtrack further pumps up the race, igniting a frenzy that truly lives up to its name—RAVE!

title: Console Archives: Doraemon
description:
Doraemon was released by Hudson (current Konami) in 1986 for an 8-bit home console.
This is an action game in which Doraemon goes on adventure using various Secret Gadgets to search for Nobita, Shizuka, Gian, Suneo who have been sent to "Space," "The haunts of evil," and "Undersea" due to a problem with their Time machine.
Once you defeat the bosses in each world and rescue all of them, a wonderful ending awaits you!

title: Console Archives: Sonic Wings Special
description:
"Sonic Wings Special" was released by Video System in 1996 for a 32-bit home console.
In this shooting game, a diverse group of fighter pilots from around the world battle to stop a coup staged by an evil organization.
The game features a multi-ending system where the story route changes based on the player's choices. Choose your ultimate partner and fight to restore world peace!

title: Console Archives: Cool Boarders
description:
"Cool Boarders" was released by UEP SYSTEMS in 1996 for a 32-bit home console.

It is a snowboarding game that uses 3D graphics to capture the pure excitement of racing down snowy mountains at breakneck speeds.
Experience the thrill of navigating cliffside courses, show off your skills with jumps and tricks, and master your own unique style through a variety of runs!

title: Console Archives: Ninja Gaiden II - The Dark Sword of Chaos
description:
"Ninja Gaiden II: The Dark Sword of Chaos" was released by TECMO in 1990 for an 8-bit home console.

In this side-scrolling action game, the Dragon Ninja, Ryu Hayabusa, fights with his katana and ninjutsu to stop the resurrection of an evil god.
The title gained worldwide popularity for the thrill of conquering demanding stages with ninja actions, combined with cinematic "Tecmo Theater" cutscenes that look just like a movie.

title: Console Archives: UFO - A Day in the Life
description:
UFO: A Day in the Life is a quirky puzzle adventure developed by Love-de-Lic and released by ASCII Entertainment in 1999. Explore an apartment building to rescue 50 invisible aliens stranded on Earth after a crash.

Now being brought back by Hamster Corporation under the Console Archives label for modern platforms, it includes quality-of-life options such as customizable button layouts, rapid-fire settings, multiple save points, and screen filters that recreate the nostalgic feel of CRT TVs.

title: Escape Tsunami: Take Brainrots!
description: Dive into a chaotic arena where brainrots are scattered everywhere, just waiting to be taken and brought back to safety.

title: Paws & Clean: Japan
description: “Paws & Clean: Japan” takes you inside a traditional Japanese school where your loyal pet companion helps you tidy classrooms, hallways, and courtyard areas. Sweep floors, collect trash, polish surfaces, and bring order to every corner. Easy controls, calm atmosphere, and satisfying cleaning tasks make this a relaxing experience for all ages.

title: Weeb Store Simulator: Supermarket Together
description: Welcome to Weeb Store Simulator: Supermarket Together, the ultimate management simulator where you and your friends run a nerdy supermarket filled with games, manga, and collectibles!

title: Arcade Archives 2: Top Speed
description:
“Top Speed” is a racing game released by Taito in 1987.
Enter high-stakes street races where speed is everything, and aim for the finish line while dodging obstacles and avoiding collisions with rival cars.
Using Nitro grants you explosive acceleration. Blow past the competition, leave everyone in your dust, and show them what it means to be the best!

title: Dark Quest: Remastered
description:
Turn based
Dungeon Crawler

title: Project Windless
description:
Project Windless is a single-player open-world action RPG set in the universe of the acclaimed Korean fantasy novel series The Bird That Drinks Tears.

Step into a mythic age as a mighty Rekon warrior and journey across a breathtaking, war-torn world. Stand against overwhelming odds, forge alliances, and wage war across massive battlefields to unite a fractured land and give birth to a new kingdom.

title: God of War Sons of Sparta
description:
Join young Kratos and Deimos, sons of Sparta, on a Greek odyssey as they discover the meaning of duty and honour.
An engaging and exciting 2D action-adventure brought to life from the talented pixel superstars at Mega Cat Studios. Experience retro classic gameplay with God of War’s signature spectacle, action, and heartfelt storytelling.

title: A Cafe at the End of the World
description: A Café at the End of the World is a kinetic visual novel—a "still motion" story experience told through evocative static imagery and text.

title: Vampire Blood Dynasty
description:
Claim vengeance as a vampire forged in darkness.

On your wedding day, your priest murdered you, stole your bride, and unleashed plague and demons upon your land. Ten years later, you rise from the underworld as a powerful vampire — driven by rage, cursed by immortality, and sworn to reclaim everything taken from you.

title: Dorkomon
description:
Welcome to Extinction
In the mid-1990s, mysterious monsters, each with unique powers, began appearing throughout Japan. What began as a harmless monster collecting craze quickly descended into brutal underground monster deathmatches. Now the Dorkomon are breeding like rabbits and running wild—and it’s YOUR job to blow every last one to kingdom come.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Mega Zone
description: MEGA ZONE! FURTHER INTO UNKNOWN CRISIS...

title: Aquamarine: Explorer's Edition
description:
Aquamarine is a turn-based playable comic book about surviving in an alien ocean.

Inspired by the psychedelic sci-fi of the '70s & '80s, Aquamarine combines the mystery of old-school adventure games and challenging roguelikes with elements of survival, exploration, and puzzle solving.

Journey across a water world reclaimed by nature. Overcome survival and navigational challenges as you discover the planet's lost history. Master your pod's controls, study the ocean wildlife, and solve environmental puzzles to help you find your way home.

Cultivate a variety of alien plants with unique attributes. Forage the depths for food and salvage tools to help you survive. Collect and craft powerful upgrades for your humble escape pod, and customize your loadout to fit the needs of every plunge into the water.

You play as a lone space traveler known only as The Seeker. While orbiting an uncharted aquaplanet, your starcraft is disrupted by a strange signal and you're forced to eject. You crash land on a tiny island surrounded by an endless alien ocean, with nothing to help you but an amphibious survival pod. Throughout your underwater journey to reach your crashed ship, you'll uncover the planet's lost history and discover the true nature of why The Seeker ended up here.

title: MLB The Show 26: Digital Deluxe Edition
description: Make your mark. Become a Legend. Own The Show.

title: Dream Peak
description: Dream Peak is a warm adventure about courage and hope. Play as a boy who, after an emergency landing, must find his way home, overcoming mountain paths, raging rivers and the whims of the wild nature. Glide on the wind, build bridges, solve friendly puzzles and follow the clues of the compass to open the way home.

title: Fatal Slash
description:
One strike decides your fate:

Enter a world of silhouettes and steel in Fatal Slash, a minimalist 2D dueling game of precision, timing, and tension. Every encounter is a deadly test where a single cut can end the fight. There are no long combos or super moves - only patience, skill, and the courage to strike first.

title: Fire Jump
description: In Fire Jump, you will guide a brave girl across a series of platforms suspended above a sea of burning lava. Every jump is a challenge: some platforms are stable, while others sway or move. A moment of distraction could mean the end! Carefully calculate timing and distance, stay focused, and find the best path to reach the finish line.

title: Gladiator Warrior
description:
Step into the arena where legends are forged in this breathtaking realistic gladiatorial RPG! Powered by Unreal Engine 5's cutting-edge technology, experience brutal combat and epic glory in stunning photorealistic detail.
From slave to legend, forge your path through treacherous gladiatorial schools and blood-soaked arenas. Master diverse fighting styles, earn the crowd's favor, and rise to become the most celebrated warrior in the empire.

title: WWE 2K26: King of Kings Edition
description:
Claim the throne with the King of Kings Edition of WWE 2K26. Includes WWE royalty Triple H ’98 and Stephanie McMahon ’00, plus Ringside Pass Premium Season 1 with four new Superstars to unlock, along with the Joe Hendry Pack.

The King of Kings Edition Includes:
• King of Kings Pack
- Playable Superstar: Triple H ’98
- Playable Superstar: Stephanie McMahon ’00
- MySUPERSTAR Island Emote: Triple H Signature Taunt
• Joe Hendry Pack
- New Playable Superstar: Joe Hendry
- MyFACTION EVO Card: Joe Hendry
- MySUPERSTAR CAS Part: Joe Hendry T-Shirt
- MySUPERSTAR Island Emote: Joe Hendry Spin
• Ringside Pass Premium Season 1
• 32,500 VC

title: Metal Gear Solid Master Collection: Volume 2 - Day One Edition
description: The Day One Edition includes in-game items usable in both Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots and Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker (HD Collection version): the Cardboard Camouflage bonus for Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots and the LOVE BOX Uniform bonus for Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker (HD Collection version).

title: Lonely Hospital
description: In an abandoned hospital long forgotten by time, the hallways are littered with shattered glass. Dim, flickering lights cast distorted shadows across peeling walls, while pieces of the ceiling occasionally break loose and crash to the floor, echoing through the empty corridors. Everything around Sophie feels strangely unreal — as if the hospital exists somewhere between memory and nightmare, more atmospheric than truly physical.

title: The Christmas Pickle
description:
‘Twas the night before Christmas—and something slimy is stirring.

You’re on the naughty list, and something green is coming for you. Something pickled! Run, hide, and survive the brined wrath of the Christmas Pickle—a festive slasher nightmare soaked in blood, and vinegar.

Deck the halls… with screams. Because this Christmas Dill be your last!

title: Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance - Launch Edition
description:
Launch Edition featuring exclusive Steelbook

Embark on this definitive version of the critically acclaimed Shin Megami Tensei V, massively expanded with a brand-new storyline featuring new locations, demons, and choices to make that will dictate the fate of all existence.

title: Sun, Sand & Monster Slayers
description: Sun, sea, a deserted island — what could possibly go wrong? A spider invasion! Help the girl in a bikini eliminate all the enemies, grab your gun, and free the island.

title: Racecar Crashers
description: Racecar Crashers is a high-octane, couch multiplayer, competitive racing experience, where up to 4 friends (or enemies) compete to be the last car standing.

title: The Shore: Enhanced Edition
description: The complete experience unfolds in The Shore, a first-person Lovecraftian horror adventure that blends exploration and puzzles in a world shaped by ancient gods and forbidden knowledge.

title: Console Archives: Dezaemon
description:
"Dezaemon" was released by Athena in 1991 for an 8-bit home console.
It is a game creation tool that allows you to produce your very own original shooting game.

title: Romancing SaGa: Minstrel Song Remastered International Special Edition
description:
A remastered version of the classic RPG featuring the signature “Glimmer” and “Combo” battle systems, Kenji Ito’s acclaimed soundtrack, and the Free-form Scenario System, where your choices shape a unique story across eight protagonists. The update adds high-definition visuals, quality-of-life improvements, and new content while preserving the original’s depth and charm.

Special edition includes:
Game with reversible cover
Manual
PVC keychain

title: Park My Car
description: “Park My Car” is a skill and precision game in which the player must drive a car and park it correctly inside a garage. The objective may seem simple at first: enter the designated space, position the vehicle within the lines, and do so without hitting obstacles or other cars.

title: Tralalero Tralala: Backrooms
description: You’ve become lost in an endless maze of yellow rooms, with stained carpet underfoot and the hum of fluorescent lights buzzing overhead. This place is The Backrooms. There are no windows. No doors. No escape… only the emptiness and something watching you.

title: Emoji Battlefield: Island Warfare
description: Fast-paced rogue-like FPS mayhem on a mysterious island!

title: Panzer Knights: Commander’s Edition
description:
Panzer Knights: Commander's Edition is an anime-inspired WWII tank simulation where you command a German Panzer platoon through the chaos of Europe's battlefields. Engage in explosive third-person combat from the Battle of France to Operation Barbarossa, managing your tank's vital systems, loading specialized ammunition, and targeting enemy weak points. Between missions, assemble an elite crew from 30 recruits with unique skills and backstories, then deploy your arsenal of meticulously detailed tanks.
The Commander's Edition represents the definitive console version, bundling the base game with three bonus tank packs featuring the M4-748 Sherman, M26 Pershing, Churchill VII, Valentine XI, Panzer VIII Maus, and Elefant—tanks not included in the original PC release.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Adventure Canoe
description: Brave canoeist, challenge the unknown rapids!

title: Resident Evil Requiem: Lenticular Edition
description:
Limited edition featuring a lenticular sleeve.

Resident Evil Requiem is the ninth entry in the Resident Evil series. Experience terrifying survival horror with FBI analyst Grace Ashcroft, and dive into pulse-pounding action with legendary agent Leon S. Kennedy. Both of their journeys and unique gameplay styles intertwine into a heart-stopping, emotional experience that will chill you to your core.

title: The House of the Dead 2: Remake - Infect Edition
description:
The Infect Edition comes with a slipcase and 3 art cards.

The House of the Dead 2: Remake is a remake of the second entry in the well-known and popular rail-shooter series. Take on the lone role of a secret agent as James or Gary, or team up in co-op mode to neutralize the dangerous undead monsters standing in your way.

title: Kong: Survivor Instinct - Titans Edition
description:
Titans Edition features a slipcover with a beast journal book.

When giant monsters fight, no one’s safe. Embark on a thrilling quest of survival in a city that’s become a battleground for Titans. Use the lethal strength of Kong and other monsters to your own advantage in this official Monsterverse game set shortly after the events of Godzilla vs. Kong.

title: Legendary Spell
description: Build your deck and unleash the most powerful spells.

title: Console Archives: Nobunaga's Ambition
description:
An undying masterpiece—the ultimate long-running legend!

Nobunaga's Ambition was released by Koei in 1988 for an 8-bit home console.
In this historical simulation game, you become a Sengoku daimyo with the ultimate goal of unifying all of Japan.
As the tides of war shift from moment to moment, you must determine how to enrich your domain, strengthen your military, and conquer rival nations. Use every ounce of your ingenuity to bring an end to the turbulent Sengoku period!

title: Flingin' Poo
description: Have fun playing with goofy little monkeys as they throw absurdly large blobs of poo at each other in this arcade style action packed game. Have fun with the whole family or invite friends over. The more goofy little monkeys the better!

title: Horses 2025
description: Experience the ultimate horse care and riding adventure! Discover the joy of building a special bond with your own horse through daily care, training, and exciting riding challenges.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Plump Pop
description: Let's all work together as a family!

title: Console Archives: Ninja-Kid II
description:
Ninja-Kid II was released by UPL in 1988 for an 8-bit home console.¸

In this action game, you embark on an adventure across diverse fields—including mountains, oceans, and caves—to defeat your greatest and most powerful foe, Ashura.

Despite its cute art style, the game offers hardcore ninja action, featuring wall-kicking and intense battles using a wide variety of weapons.

The Console Archives series is developed with the concept of faithfully reproducing masterpieces released on various home game consoles, allowing players to easily enjoy them on the latest hardware.

The series is packed with convenient features, including customizable button layouts and screen settings, as well as the ability to save and load at any point.

Whether you played them back in the day or are experiencing them for the first time, please enjoy the masterpieces that shaped the history of console gaming!

(The options menu and manual are available in Japanese, English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.)

title: Task Force Ranger: Lead the way!
description: Strike back against global terror and lead the fight in modern combat zones.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Devastators
description: For the GLORY, the MONEY... and to feed the BEAST inside their body!!

title: Arcade Archives 2: Final Lap
description:
"Final Lap" is a racing game released by Namco Limited (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1987.
1987 marked the dawn of the F1 boom in Japan. Set against the backdrop of that era, this title portrays the raw power of racing machines and the stoic world of professional competition.
Experience nail-biting, high-speed battles set on the legendary circuit as it was back then. Push yourself to the absolute limit where every tenth of a second counts—and give it everything you've got!

title: Console Archives: Terra Cresta
description:
Total control over your split-mode and firing directions! Features a custom Formation Design system!

"Terra Cresta" was released by Nichibutsu in 1986 for an 8-bit home console.
It is a shooting game in which humanity, driven to the bottom of the sea by the evil Mandora, fights to reclaim the Earth.

title: Blades of Vharan
description: In a world consumed by darkness, a lone warrior rises against the forces of evil. Face monstrous creatures, survive brutal battles, and forge your legend in a retro-flavored action fantasy.

title: Atomic Heart: Ultimate Edition
description:
Atomic Heart: Ultimate Edition is a physical release containing the base game, 4 story DLCs, 3 skin packs, and a digital artbook.

Note: North American/European and Japanese releases differ in their physical contents.

title: Medieval Escape 2
description: Medieval Escape 2 is a third-person adventure game. The protagonist is a young woman trapped in an ancient medieval labyrinth. To survive, she must avoid deadly traps and find a way out. There is no combat—only cleverness, observation, and quick reflexes. Every corner of the maze hides danger, and every step could mean the difference between life and death.

title: Fruit Catcher
description: Fruit Catcher is a game where you have to collect the fruits that fall from the tree. Speed and good reflexes are essential to catch all the fruits and score as many points as possible!

title: Save Next Christmas
description: Someone hates Christmas! They kidnapped Santa Claus! Help Santa escape, collect the key and run through the levels.

title: Gym Simulator 26
description: Gym Simulator 26 is a game where you build, customize, and expand your own fitness center. Start with a small space, design every area to your taste, and grow your gym into a thriving business filled with dedicated members and high-end equipment. It’s made for fitness lovers, management fans, and anyone who enjoys running their own virtual business.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 - Ultima Limited Edition
description: The galaxy is in peril. Entire worlds are falling. The Imperium needs you. Embody the superhuman skill and brutality of a Space Marine, the greatest of the Emperor's warriors, with Clive Standen (Vikings, Taken) as the iconic Captain Titus. Unleash deadly abilities and an arsenal of devastating weaponry to obliterate the relentless Tyranid hordes. Hold at bay the horrors of the galaxy in epic battles on far-flung planets. Uncover dark secrets and drive back the everlasting night to prove your ultimate loyalty to humanity.

title: Campire of Oasis: The Story
description: Campfire of Oasis: The Story is a quiet, story-driven experience set deep within a frozen forest.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Polaris
description:
"Polaris" is a shooting game released by Taito in 1980.
Take command of a submarine and battle advancing enemy forces using missiles that can only be fired directly upward.
Navigate through a relentless onslaught from all directions—bombers in the sky, frigates patrolling the surface, and mines lurking on the seabed!

title: Console Archives: Seicross
description:
"Seicross" was released by Nichibutsu in 1986 for an 8-bit home console.
In this shooting game, you pilot a hover bike to save the peaceful people of Petra, whose homeland has been invaded by a once-coexisting tribe that has turned to evil.
As you rescue the captive people of Petra from enemy territory, your bike's weight increases, causing it to consume fuel energy much faster—but in return, you'll earn massive bonuses upon clearing the stage!

title: Elevator Mayhem
description: Terrorists have taken control of a building, eliminate all enemies, reach the top floor and defuse the bomb

title: Shattered Frames
description: A gallery of animal photography has been fractured into scattered shards. It is up to you to mend the broken edges and bring these stunning portraits back into focus.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Konami GT
description:
"Konami GT" is a racing game released by Konami in 1985.
Keep a close eye on your fuel gauge as you race through checkpoints, aiming to conquer all 6 grueling stages.
With beautiful, shifting scenery—from coastal highways and arid wastelands to plains bathed in the sunset—push the pedal to the metal and blast toward the finish line in a shower of glory!

title: Console Archives: Ishin no Arashi
description:
"Ishin no Arashi" was released by Koei in 1990 for an 8-bit home console.
Step into the role of a Bakumatsu-era patriot in this historical simulation game, where you engage in fierce debates with feudal lords and key figures across Japan to win them over to your ideology and lead the nation toward a new dawn.
Experience the thrill of moving history not just with swordsmanship, but through intellect and passion! Prevail in the clash of opposing ideals and survive the chaotic upheaval of the shogunate's final days!

title: Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection - Deluxe Edition
description:
Deluxe Edition includes: Collector's Box, Standard Game, Steelbook, Arcade Flyers, Arcade Cabinet Cards, Lenticular Card, Mini-Marquees, Magnet.

Step into the arena and choose your fighter! Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection includes all the essential games from Mortal Kombat's early years. Experience the legendary origins of the franchise with the iconic arcade classics that started it all—alongside a curated selection of most-loved home versions for the Super NES and Sega Genesis. Dive deeper with rare and fan-favorite releases across the Game Boy, Game Gear, Sega 32X, Game Boy Advance, and more—a celebration of the franchise’s groundbreaking legacy.

Digital Eclipse's interactive documentary format explores how Mortal Kombat changed the way society perceived video games. By using digitized humans as player sprites in an over-the-top, martial-arts fighter, the game thrilled players, shocked critics, and laid the foundation for a franchise that has thrived for more than 30 years. Hear firsthand from the original dev team of Ed Boon, John Tobias, John Vogel, and Dan Forden, along with other exclusive interviews, rare concept art, vintage marketing materials, and archival video footage.

Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection also lets players explore Mortal Kombat lore, with a timeline of the original series' storyline and comprehensive character histories that offer stories, secrets, and glimpses behind the scenes at their creation.

title: Arcade Archives 2: Street Smart
description:
"Street Smart" is an action game released by SNK in 1989.
In an era where a man's true worth was measured solely by his strength, a lone karate master and a professional wrestler travel across America to prove who is the ultimate street brawler.
After teaming up in 2-player co-op, you'll face off in a 1P vs. 2P showdown! Victory earns you the blessings of the GALS!

title: Console Archives: Ninja Gaiden III - The Ancient Ship of Doom
description:
"Ninja Gaiden III: The Ancient Ship of Doom" was released by Tecmo in 1991 for an 8-bit home console.
In this side-scrolling action game, the Dragon Ninja, Ryu Hayabusa, fights with his katana and ninjutsu to prove his innocence in the murder of Irene and uncover the truth.
Enjoy the ninja battles and "Tecmo Theater", which have evolved even further since the previous game.

title: Lacrosse 26
description: Lacrosse 26 is a lacrosse experience built from the ground up to feel real. Powered by a motion-matching animation system and all-new motion capture, every movement on the field is dynamic. Players don’t just trigger animations, they react. Speed, direction, stick position, and player input all blend in real time, creating gameplay that feels fluid, grounded, and authentic to the sport. With hundreds of unique animations—from dodges and cuts to passes, checks, and goalie saves—Lacrosse 26 captures the nuance of lacrosse like never before. Whether you’re splitting defenders, snapping off a quick-stick finish, or chasing down a ground ball, every moment in Lacrosse is driven by the player's timing, not canned sequences. Build your program in Dynasty Mode, where recruiting, player development, and scheduling shape your path from underdog to powerhouse. Develop your roster over multiple seasons, manage resources, and compete against increasingly difficult opponents as you climb the ranks.

title: Crymelight: Tea Party Box
description: Includes an original art book “Memoirs of the Invited” (80 pages), 2-disc special album CD (11 OST and 3 vocal songs), a voice drama (3 tracks), an original playing card set “Crime Cards” and a DLC set (6 items)

title: Utawarerumono: Past and Present Rediscovered - Premium Edition
description: Includes an acrylic plate, drama CD, visual book and OST CD.

title: Demon Huntress
description:
Demon Huntress is a top-down roguelike shooter built around fast combat, endless progression, and outrageous power scaling.
Each run sends you through three randomized worlds chosen from five distinct areas, each filled with demons, traps, treasures, and escalating danger. Combat is fluid and aggressive, centered around precise movement, dodge rolls, and ranged combat using a powerful crossbow.

title: Cazzarion: Laser Puzzle
description: Sharpen your aim in this precision-based puzzle game with 20 playable levels. Rotate laser cannons, mirrors, and prisms to direct beams toward radiant crystals. Some challenges include switches that reveal hidden doors. This Game is a true test of logic and ingenuity

title: Saros: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
Saros is an action game developed by Housemarque and published by Sony Interactive Entertainment. Players control Arjun Devraj, a Soltari Enforcer investigating a lost off-world colony on Carcosa. The game features fast-paced third-person combat, boss encounters, and progression across repeated attempts.

This edition includes:
- Saros full game
- Astra Armour
- Onryo Armour
- Midgard Armour
